# Outlands Discord knowledge base

Generated by `harness/discord_kb.py digest` on 2026-10-03 20:22 UTC. Do not edit by hand.

- Corpus: 2026-06-28 to 2026-10-03, channels #newplayer, #harvesting, #patch-notes.
- Facts by verdict: single_source 3280, consensus 801, disputed 58, outdated 26, official 19, not_useful 18, wrong 1.
- Model: claude-sonnet-5-5; extraction prompt x1, adjudication a1.
- Confidence: everything here is community-derived. `official` = stated in #patch-notes or #announcements; `consensus` = at least two independent players agree and outnumber the dissent; `single_source` = one player said it, unverified. Verify in game before relying on it.

## Skills & training

- **artisan aspect leveling**: The Artisan aspect gains experience from crafting, from societies, and from PvM when you land the killing blow with a weapon while being artful. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546693552459743252)
- **avararite map mining skill requirement**: Decoding or mining avararite maps requires 110 effective Mining skill, which can be reached by combining base Mining with Harvest aspect bonus and harvest links; the item need not be printed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547455923021418598)
- **bard codex leveling without musicianship**: Level the Bard Codex while holding Musicianship to earn codex points first; once you have enough points in Self Taught (tier 2 per one player), you can lower Musicianship and replace it with another bard skill such as Peacemaking. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189403081248809)
- **bard codex self taught**: The Bard Codex 'Self Taught' node lets you drop Musicianship by using the lowest of Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance as your effective Musicianship, so all three must be trained to a similar level. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555238569340178465)
- **camping skill carry weight**: Raising Camping (up to 120) increases total carry weight (about 40 extra), which helps with carrying ore, and beyond 60 also adds item limit and a damage bonus against most targets other than follower damage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554537713728884889)
- **chest trap removal skill**: Detect Hidden is the skill used to remove traps from dungeon chests; all dungeon chests are trapped, and better remove trap tools and picks plus higher Detect Hidden and lockpicking skill improve the success chance. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554845620806623383)
- **dull copper resource maps for mining skill**: Dull copper resource maps can train Mining all the way to 120, because resource maps bypass the normal dull copper gain cutoff and keep giving gain chances, though it takes many maps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **hiding skill gain in inn rooms and homes**: Hiding cannot gain skill inside a player inn room or house because it always succeeds there, so train it outside; Stealth may still work there, and being in a home gives a hiding bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554905675610718331)
- **leveling harvest aspect**: Harvest aspect is leveled by gathering (lumberjacking, mining, fishing) or by running treasure maps. Treasure maps are ranked fastest, then dungeon picking, then lumberjacking or fishing, and mining is slowest. For lumberjacking the aspect needs to be only on armor, not the weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536196749239259197)
- **magery training from 80 to 100**: Players commonly train Magery from about 80 to 100 by scripting (e.g. in Razor) a cast-and-release of a reagent elemental summon (earth, air or water, not fire), using a restock agent to refill reagents from a bank box bag or a secure bag or chest in the inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586641098604597)
- **mining skill gain above 100**: Above 100 Mining, the fastest way to gain skill is mining with ore maps (dull copper maps work), but progress is very slow; one player needed roughly 700+ maps to go from 102 to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555542430286086145)
- **mining skill gain above 100**: Above 100 mining skill, skill gain chances come only from mining colored (non-iron) ore, so gains are slow because colored ore is rarer, and resource maps can help push gains. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **mining versus lumberjacking skill gain**: Mining skill gain is very slow, especially after 100, and Lumberjacking skill gain is noticeably faster, with estimates ranging from 2-3x to about 10x. Below 100, traditional mining beats maps for gains. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555544324207419453)
- **new player dungeon skill gain boost**: The New Player Dungeon boosts skill gain chance (about 6x) up to 80 skill for all characters and all skills except gathering and crafting skills, allowing the first 80 levels to be trained in under half an hour. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554160966801948855)
- **npc trainer skill cap and cost**: NPC trainers can train a skill only up to 50, at a cost of 500 gold per skill, payable with a skill deed or training credit. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555040785957789707)
- **shelter dungeon skill gain boost**: The Shelter Island dungeon gives a large skill gain boost that applies to any player, not just new ones, but gain is capped at 80 there; beyond that you must train elsewhere at the slower regular rate. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553357770210672671)
- **shelter island pickpocket dips**: Pickpocket dips on the roof of the battle trainer building in the southwest corner of Shelter Island train Snooping and Stealing up to 80; beyond 80, publicly accessible dip locations (listed by the !dips command) train them to GM and beyond. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554526571753242635)
- **showing skill gain chance**: Left-click your character once and select 'Show Skill Gain Chances' from the context menu; system messages then show a percentage for each action that can raise a skill, so if percentages appear and you are not at cap, training works (watch system messages, not the skill gump). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555031633042874458)
- **skill cap and skill orbs**: The total skill cap starts at 700 and can be raised up to 720 by using skill mastery orbs, while skill scrolls raise individual skill caps; skill arrows set skills to raise, lower or lock, and at cap raised skills take points from lowered ones. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555255804356075583)
- **summoner's tome acquisition**: Summoners use a Summoner's Tome that holds upgrade points; one is given by the new player quest after leaving Shelter Island, and since it is a player-crafted item, extra or blessed ones can be bought from player vendors, searchable via the vendor portal. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149764648280176)
- **alchemy effect on potion duration**: Alchemy substantially lengthens stat potion and elixir durations, with stat potions lasting about 20 minutes with Alchemy versus about 2 minutes without. The Potion Codex also adds defensive benefits, better healing, and reduced potion cooldown. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553785079380320359)
- **dual mining and lumberjacking harvester template**: Mining and Lumberjacking can be trained together on one character or echo as a dual harvester, adding Forensic Evaluation if leather is wanted, with a separate dedicated crafter echo recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549354240139329648)
- **harvest aspect effective skill bonus**: Harvest aspect on armor adds to effective Mining and Lumberjacking skill (for example, 77 raw plus 18 from armor plus 15 from links equals 110, and 120 plus Tier 15 gives about 138), though yield gains are modest at first. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549607914853896283)
- **harvest aspect experience sources**: Harvest aspect experience is gained from successful harvesting and from opening treasure map chests and dungeon chests, but not from paragon chests; treasure maps are the fastest way to level it, followed by ocean fishing and lumberjacking. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555365620332236822)
- **item identification skill**: Item Identification is used by clicking the skill and then the item, and your skill level equals your percent chance to identify successfully, so low skill may need repeated attempts; at 120 skill you can identify entire containers at once, and unidentified items can also be identified with a player-craftable ItemID wand. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551077936436617277)
- **item identification skill at 120**: Item Identification skill identifies individual items with success chance equal to skill level, and at 120 skill (reachable with skill scrolls) it can identify entire containers at once, including another player's backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551257377175642213)
- **leveling harvest aspect by ocean fishing**: Ocean fishing, including net fishing, is the best way to level Harvest aspect once past the learning curve, and harvest aspect is nearly required to reach the effective fishing skill soft-cap of 205; on land, treasure maps and lumberjacking are best. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555344193294041121)
- **lumberjacking skill gain and colored nodes**: Higher Lumberjacking skill does not increase the number of coloured nodes, only success chances; at 100.0-119.9 only attempts that harvest a coloured log can gain skill, which is why lumberjacking maps help since every attempt yields that colour. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531309388663361558)
- **mining resource maps speed**: Resource maps remain faster than regular mining for progressing Mining skill and for leaderboards, so players focused on those use them, often with Tracking and an anti-PK recall script. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **poisoning training and poison build**: Poisoning is trained with Greater Poison until 80, Deadly Poison to 100, and Lethal Poison beyond 100; the wiki cites about 1,100 Deadly Poison potions for 80-100, 100-120 is estimated at 2,500-3,000, and skill gain is random so counts vary. A 120 Poisoning and 120 Taste Identification build with the poison aspect works without Poison spell points, which can be added and reset later. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554436365511426059)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Resource maps require only the matching gathering skill; neither Camping nor Cartography is needed to hike to or use them. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553116268473753722)
- **retaming animals for taming skill gain**: Releasing and retaming an animal can give animal taming skill gains, and players report it is faster than passive gain, though gains only occur within certain skill breakpoints and the chance is the same as taming a new animal. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553403005271932928)
- **shelter island skill cap**: Skill gain on Shelter Island is capped at 80, which is too low to mine avarite, so players must leave the island to progress further. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554905832217387051)
- **total skill point cap**: Characters have a total skill cap of 700 points, which can be raised to 720 with skill orbs, and skills stop gaining at the cap, so unused skills must be set to down to free points. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589345241600153)
- **animal taming and lore training**: Training Animal Taming and Animal Lore both to 110 is favored over Taming alone at 120, since new creatures unlock every 5 skill levels and need Lore to use; both skills also rise by fighting with a pet whose minimum taming is within 10 points of your skill, and Taming can reportedly be scripted up to 120 by repeatedly taming and releasing pets. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554297267517915168)
- **arcane staff casting requirements**: To cast spells while keeping an Arcane Staff equipped without it unequipping, a character needs at least 80 Arcane, 80 Magery and 80 Wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587250160078903)
- **archery codex early stance choice**: In the Archers Codex, players should take their best stance to level 5 before choosing an ability, and Arcane (which grants accuracy) is a strong early choice, especially when accuracy is below 100% or aspect level is low; raising it also raises the finisher tier, and everything is eventually maxed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553900970667147366)
- **aspect choice for dungeon lockpicker**: A dungeon lockpicker should use the Harvest aspect, which improves loot and helps picking, while Fortune gives good XP for unlocking links but does not help picking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554001480598552617)
- **bard codex self taught requirements**: The Bard Codex requires 80+ in two barding skills to work; otherwise the character is ineligible, Self Taught does not work, and effective music skill is 0. Self Taught tier 1 allows bard skills at 40 and tier 2 at 80, so with 80 bard skills only the first 2 upgrades (3 points) are needed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936214447358003)
- **cartography requirement for treasure maps**: Treasure maps require Cartography skill, with 100 or more recommended, and Cartography is strong enough to add to almost any build to run up to level 6/7 treasure maps unless min-maxing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541530759884705792)
- **chest opening requirements**: Opening dungeon and Paragon chests requires the Lockpicking and Detect Hidden skills plus lockpicks and trap removal tools; Detect Hidden is used to remove traps and Lockpicking to unlock. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554688892056248351)
- **chivalry on tri-bard dexxer build**: Chivalry can be used on a tri-bard dexxer build and works with archery, but adding it to the tri-bard archer build means dropping healing and anatomy. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896009619218434)
- **dull copper mining skill gain cap**: When mining directly rather than through resource maps, dull copper ore stops giving Mining skill gains at 105, so at higher skill only rarer ore such as bronze and beyond offers gain chances. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851501669613662)
- **dullwood lumber maps for lumberjacking**: Dullwood lumber maps can be used to train Lumberjacking from 100 all the way to 120, so progressively harvesting higher colored woods is not required, although natural harvesting past about 115 may only give gains from copperwood and higher. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531320012399185971)
- **effective harvest skill on harvest links**: Effective Harvest Skill on harvest chain links adds a bonus to every gathering skill (e.g., one bronze link on 120 Lumberjacking gives 121 effective) without affecting skill gains, and is mostly useful for fishing and for reaching higher-level resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552005955976437895)
- **fishing resource maps for skill gain**: From about 65 Fishing skill, fishing up resource maps (dullscale at 65 up to avarscale at 110) is much faster for skill gain than other methods, and dullscale maps remain usable for gains up to 120 Fishing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549167843193389078)
- **fishing skill gain and new player dungeon**: Fishing is a gathering skill, so it gets no skill gain bonus from fighting mobs, including in the new player dungeon or with a harpoon or trident, and no practice weapon exists for it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552050023540203634)
- **forensic evaluation for skinning**: Forensic Evaluation is used with a skinning knife to skin killed mobs for leather and meat, including mobs spawned at fishing locations and MiBs, and adding harvesting links to your chain yields more leather. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546232366790615082)
- **harvest aspect and fishing**: Anything that levels or benefits from the Harvest aspect counts as harvesting, including fishing; fishing and lumberjacking are recommended ways to raise Harvest aspect, and it also works for ore on resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553088708025253968)
- **harvest aspect uses**: The Harvest aspect increases harvest amount and gives a PvM buff, and it is useful beyond traditional harvesting, including for treasure maps, dungeon lockpicking, ocean fishing and MiBs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550617182461886579)
- **herding pet damage bonus**: Herding gives roughly 15% pet damage, requires a crook in your inventory that you double click to activate, and the bonus applies to necromancer pets. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554167796768833637)
- **horseshoe bay pickpocket dip**: The pickpocket dip location at Horseshoe Bay lets you train Hiding, Stealth, Stealing and Snooping at the same time, and you can stand 2 tiles outside the home and still reach the dips. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541493250498634)
- **inscription and magery skill requirements**: Making full spellbooks and spell scrolls requires Magery in addition to Inscription; a full spellbook needs 100 Inscription, and 80 Magery is enough for society inscription jobs including level 7/8 scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555202002248671283)
- **inscription spell damage bonus**: Inscription increases the supplemental damage of spells cast from scrolls by 40% × (Inscription skill / 100), about 48% at skill 120, and does nothing for spells not cast from scrolls; lower-level scrolls have a chance to not be consumed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552784161906102323)
- **item identification for backstabber builds**: Item Identification boosts magical item properties, so it suits characters that benefit from magic items, such as backstabber builds using magic weapons or bows. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088301224071262)
- **magery training with flamestrike**: Casting Flamestrike on creatures at the Prevalia Zoo is a good way to train Magery from 80 up to 100, and is probably the fastest and cheapest method. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550695509558038630)
- **message in a bottle salvage crate xp**: Message in a Bottle salvage crates give roughly 5,000 XP each, a bottle can yield 1 to 3 crates (3 being very rare), and killing the mobs carrying them gives extra XP. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553463332558606457)
- **passive skill checks from tamed followers**: When a player kills a creature, each of their tamed followers whose Min Taming is within 10 points of the player's printed Animal Taming skill contributes toward a passive skill check for Animal Taming, Animal Lore, and Herding; passive points are no longer banked while taming. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555413701509775466)
- **pilfering mobs**: Pilfering means stealing from mobs, and it can be done on a mob in combat or before killing and looting it, though mugging is better if you plan to kill it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413957498408971)
- **recycling spell scrolls**: Spell scrolls can be recycled into blank scrolls, which are useful for training Inscription; scrolls crafted while training inscription from 50 to 100 can be recycled via the crafting queue, while looted scrolls require cutting two identical scrolls with scissors to get 1 blank scroll, which sells to an inscription NPC for 1 gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554576330186559685)
- **self taught effective skill**: The Bard Codex Self Taught passive uses the lowest of the three bard skills (Peacemaking, Provocation, Discordance) as the effective music skill, so if one of them is at 0 the effective music skill is 0; each point invested adds 20 effective skill, so 3 points are needed to reach 100 and it is practical mainly with all three song skills at 80 or higher. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551638370772328542)
- **shelter dungeon skill gain bonus**: The Shelter (new player) dungeon gives a skill gain bonus for non-crafting, non-gathering skills, making skills below 80 train much faster there, but crafting and gathering skills get no benefit. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551671180396724275)
- **skill training speed**: Skills train to 100 or 120 very quickly in Outlands, often 80 to 100 in a single overnight AFK session, and the real grind lies in the advanced progression systems. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550142836660240517)
- **spirit speak effect on summons**: The Spirit Speak skill increases the base stats of a mage's summoned creatures, directly buffing them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149217996243036)
- **tamer treasure map skill builds**: Players run tamer-based treasure map builds with 120 Taming, Animal Lore, Herding and Veterinary plus map-related skills like Lockpicking, with variations such as Fencing Expertise and Fishing, or Fencing, Arms Lore and Camping, or Cartography, Magery and Tracking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541897479048396830)
- **taming skill gain location restriction**: Animal Taming skill gain does not work inside player-owned or guild-owned houses or inn rooms, so train taming outdoors, such as in a quiet spot in a town. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554948137603305483)
- **taming skill gain range**: Taming skill gain continues only while a creature is within roughly 20 to 25 points of your skill, so reaching 120 requires tamables needing 95 or more taming. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553028165138382940)
- **training magery with scrolls**: Casting spells from scrolls levels up Magery, and reagents, a spell stone, or scrolls all work equally for training, though you still need Magery skill to cast from scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551145880810291281)
- **700 point skill cap and skill gain**: When a character is at the 700 total skill point cap, a skill will not rise until another skill is set to down (lowered), so points can transfer to the skill set to up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546159664666771647)
- **afk taming training setup**: For AFK taming training, stay inside a closed room in a building (not a rented inn room or house) so the animal cannot run off. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452745956925612)
- **alchemy and tinkering trap damage bonus**: Alchemy increases trap damage and Tinkering also boosts trap damage, while Detect Hidden affects trap cooldown; both crafting skills have their own additional bonuses and help with society jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298979841609748)
- **alchemy in pvm builds**: Alchemy is a well-regarded skill for most PvM builds, and Magic Resist can be used alongside it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586650599985245)
- **alchemy skill benefits**: Alchemy boosts potions, providing a 7 second potion cooldown, bigger heal potions, some resists, and reduced bleed/disease damage, and it helps make up for losing Healing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896266612604979)
- **alchemy training**: Train Alchemy by crafting potions: train to 70 with lesser resist potions, then do profitable society jobs each week, which took about 5 weeks to reach 100 on one player's crafters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554287200148131922)
- **arcane skill in skill list**: The Arcane skill is listed under new skills in the skill list, and you may need to press reset groups for it to show up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550592642151350485)
- **archer tamer stat distribution**: An archer tamer build uses 100 strength, 100 dexterity and 25 intelligence, since only mage builds use 100 intelligence with 25 dexterity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555389742374461601)
- **artisan xp sources**: Artisan XP is gained from society quests and from every craft performed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547993692303007985)
- **aspect on pickaxe and harvest xp**: A pickaxe with no aspect or a Harvest aspect gives full harvest XP, while a different non-harvest aspect splits XP to 50% harvest while gathering and 50% weapon XP from killing mobs, so any non-harvest activity needs the weapon aspected too or XP is only 50%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529972265557557248)
- **backstabber hiding methods**: A backstabber can hide using the Hiding skill, which must be trained like any other skill, or with smoke bombs when they are not on cooldown. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554874773597851800)
- **bard starting skill setup**: Start with 80 musicianship, 80 peacemaking and 80 discordance until you have points in Self Taught, then drop musicianship and replace it with provocation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189403081248809)
- **barding mastery links at 120 skills**: Effective Barding mastery links still have an effect even when you have 120 Discordance and 120 Peacemaking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553059123849863219)
- **battle skill training sources**: Battletrainer NPCs can raise battle skills, but a literal inanimate training dummy placed in a home cannot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547780818519334996)
- **campfire lighting and duration**: Lighting a campfire needs only kindling; a successful ignite consumes one kindling, a failed attempt consumes none, and a lit campfire lasts 10 minutes so it does not need constant relighting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548224617485967462)
- **camping skill training on shelter island**: Camping can be trained up to 80 skill in the Shelter Island newbie dungeon, and it also gives chances to raise Str, Dex and Int when starting a fire and continuously while standing next to it for the full 10 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547045008459177984)
- **cartography skill benefits**: Cartography increases the distance you can see with the spyglass, helps you find fishing spots, and also provides additional damage and resistance bonuses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527638781098725416)
- **cartography training difficulty**: Cartography is cheap and easy to raise, whereas the Echo skill is harder to raise. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531096547419492363)
- **cheap skills for society jobs**: Alchemy, Inscription and Tailoring are cheaper to train and useful for society jobs, which are weekly work orders that earn points exchangeable for valuable rewards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586196835274943)
- **checking skill caps with skillmastery**: Type [skillmastery in game to check your skill caps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576026817429515)
- **chivalry and wrestling synergy**: Chivalry works together with Wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555150858482614343)
- **chivalry cap increase to 120**: Chivalry can be raised to 120 once a player has used 20 skill orbs to raise the 700 total skill cap to 720 and 20 chivalry skill scrolls to raise the chivalry cap from 100 to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457332115578881)
- **chivalry on outlands**: Chivalry exists on the Outlands server. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555285145035219019)
- **chivalry training method**: Chivalry can be trained by attacking a battle trainer, and one player reports it can also be trained AFK against a training dummy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555030789736108113)
- **cook scavenger build**: A cook scavenger build of Hiding, Stealth, Forensic Evaluation, Cooking, Lockpicking and Detect Hidden is considered a pretty good build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554363371262836811)
- **crafting skill training cost**: Blacksmithing, Tinkering and Carpentry are expensive to train in Outlands and earn little gold from selling crafted items, so they are not beginner friendly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586486804029494)
- **dexxer skill retraining**: Dexxer skills are neither hard nor expensive to train, so changing a character's skills is a viable alternative to making a new character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553813703835516950)
- **dull copper skill gain cap**: Ordinary mining stops giving skill gain on dull copper at a certain skill level, as the Outlands wiki states, while resource maps are an exception. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **dullhide maps for leveling**: Dullhide maps can be used to level a harvester to 120 FE quickly, making low-tier maps useful for new players to train skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534387937113018570)
- **dungeon lockpicker build**: A dungeon lockpicker build typically runs 100-120 Lockpicking, 100-120 Detect Hidden, 100 Hiding and 100-120 Stealth, with optional Camping, Forensic Evaluation, Tracking and Magery (80-100); the Harvest aspect may allow lower totals around 100 pick and detect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **effective skill cap for mining and lumberjacking**: For Mining and Lumberjacking, effective skill affects the success chance of gathering but not the quantity gathered, and there is no benefit beyond 139.1 effective skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527451641001939055)
- **evaluating intelligence value**: Evaluating Intelligence matters if you do significant offensive spell damage; pet-damage builds are better served by other skills that boost pet damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554504398691106838)
- **evaluating tameable pets**: To evaluate a tameable, use Animal Lore on it and read the green and red percentage bonuses shown on the right; the base value is the same for all pets of that type, so only the percentages differ. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555662558092853340)
- **fe abbreviation in fishing build**: In the fishing build, FE stands for forensic evaluation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539460981577490553)
- **fishing training with harpoon on dummy**: Fishing skill can be trained by hitting a training dummy or battletrainer with a harpoon (or trident); throwing a regular harpoon at a battletrainer works without missing out on anything. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548464821437988965)
- **focus skill effects**: The Focus skill increases swing speed and accuracy, and is also reported to give defense and mana refund. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555426919657250867)
- **forensic evaluation barding bonus**: Forensic Evaluation gives an effective Barding skill bonus, with a maximum of about 12 per the formula 10 * (skill / 100); Tracking also gives a Barding bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554927763020976229)
- **forensic evaluation training**: Some players recommend Forensic Evaluation at 110 rather than 120 for a dungeon picker, and the New Player Dungeon is a good place to train it to 80 even without a bonus because mobs respawn quickly and are easy to kill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545085772699406476)
- **forensic evaluation training speed**: Forensic Evaluation can be trained to 120 within a day, and training it with backstabbing is much faster than training mining and lumberjacking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525121868963778722)
- **harvest aspect experience from maps versus normal harvesting**: Normal harvesting gives harvest aspect experience based on how many resources are extracted, whereas resource maps give a fixed value of about 1 experience per swing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522342627276620047)
- **harvest aspect experience rates by resource**: Unaspected ore gives 0.2 harvest aspect experience per hit; resource maps give more per hit than ore and less than lumberjacking, at roughly 0.5 per second for maps, 0.2 for ore and 0.4 for lumber (approximate). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522354275844489246)
- **harvest aspect for fishing**: Harvest aspect is the best aspect for fishing because it grants effective fishing skill, reducing failures and yielding more sea serpents, and without it reaching the 205 effective fishing soft-cap and maximizing profit and message-in-a-bottle chances is very hard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536025672890318908)
- **harvest success chance formula**: Harvest success chance is calculated as ((effective harvest skill - resource skill requirement) / 0.8) x (1 + total tool bonus), as used by the Outlands harvesting calculator and wiki chart; the wiki lists 65 as the requirement for Avarite. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538654640718090302)
- **harvest xp from killing mobs**: Killing mobs does not give harvest XP, and a Harvest aspect on a weapon gives no extra XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543544685845545032)
- **harvesting experience gains**: Harvesting grants only Harvest aspect XP and no mastery chain, Codex, or Redline progress, so harvesters cannot advance those through harvesting alone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553430663678664705)
- **harvesting skill cap and gains**: After reaching 100 harvesting skill, further skill is gained only from colored resource nodes, and skill beyond the 100% chance cap does not yield more wood or ore. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **horse taming skill requirement**: Taming a horse requires Animal Taming skill, and a horse needs only 50 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552108164122677339)
- **identifying unidentified armor and weapons**: Unidentified armor and weapons require a higher Item ID skill or an Item ID wand, which can be purchased from other players, to be identified. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546966609086906428)
- **inscription and eldritch for evaluating intelligence training**: Inscription and Eldritch also help train Evaluating Intelligence when casting from scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546685994147905576)
- **inscription training 100 to 120**: Training Inscription from 100 to 120 uses magic wizard's hats, which require cloth, and the crafting tool does not recycle the hats, so they must be cut up with scissors, typically via a script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552974392282316883)
- **inscription training 50 to 100**: Training Inscription from 50 to 100 requires roughly 65k scrolls, and the 80-100 range uses regular spellbooks rather than full ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546611167731122247)
- **item identification alt character**: An alt character dedicated to Item Identification can identify items, e.g. 50 Item ID is enough to identify items for recycling, though an alt with 100 Item ID works better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550666111245230101)
- **item identification skill mechanics**: Item Identification success chance equals current skill, so at 100 skill attempts no longer fail, and at 120 skill it can identify entire containers at once. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054416489480203)
- **lesser poison and poisoning training**: Lesser poison does not train Poisoning skill at 50. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549871980881121422)
- **lockpicking and detect hidden training boxes**: Training boxes train Lockpicking by picking the lock (removing the trap does not raise it, and only one can be worked at a time), and Detect Hidden can be trained by keeping a stock of NPC remove trap tools and ticking the box to continue working the trap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554861638941671488)
- **lockpicking tool requirement for chests**: Chest success or progress links are not needed for lockpicking; a Gold Lockpick/Tool is sufficient for most chests, including all up to level 6. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316410117300245)
- **lockpicking use for t-maps**: After the T-map update, lockpicking is no longer used for T-maps and players use cartography instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531043404568465558)
- **lowering a skill**: To lower a skill, set it to the down arrow (lower) and train other skills, and the points are taken from the lowered skill; to lower it by only a set amount, train a placeholder skill via NPC for those points, lock the original skill, and set the placeholder to go down while training something else. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553284351674818642)
- **magery leveling difficulty**: Leveling Magery is considerably harder than leveling melee skills, though not literally 20 times harder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260698433192056)
- **magery requirement for 8th circle spells**: Casting 8th circle spells succeeds 100% of the time only at 100 Magery, with the chance scaling from 0% at 80 Magery up to 100% at 100 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553456791004774451)
- **magery training spells**: Magery training needs higher-tier spells as skill rises: at 60-80 cast spells like Invisibility, Explosion and Energy Bolt, and above 80 cast higher-tier spells such as Flame Strike, so the spellbook must contain them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546582908679102556)
- **magery training to 80**: Magery can be trained to 80 using the spell stone in the dungeon, which is accessible from Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210556034977915)
- **magic resist training at telescope island**: To train Magic Resist (Resisting Spells) from about 80 to 100, go to Telescope Island (witcher number 4), let the roughly 9 low-tier caster mobs cast on you, and keep yourself healed, for example with a healing script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554479807499341869)
- **mining location and skill gain**: The location where you mine does not affect mining skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535764497321435310)
- **mining skill training to 120**: Reaching 120 mining is very slow with ordinary mining, which can still get there, while ore maps are a faster route; mining is likely among the slowest skills to level to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **mount bonding and control skill**: Bonding and controlling a mount does not require Animal Taming skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257521035354203)
- **multi-skill link bonus**: A link listing two skills grants the full stated percentage to both skills, though the stated number is lower than that of a dedicated single-skill link. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551645677032046668)
- **necromancy replacement skills in arcane mage build**: Focus, Wrestling, Parry, and Magic Resist are skills that could replace Necromancy in an arcane mage build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327463356432464)
- **outlands butler lockpicking tool**: The Outlands Butler website offers a lockpicking page at outlandsbutler.com/lockpicking that helps determine the skill and tools needed to open chests and fine-tune chest success chance with links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546288113309978694)
- **outlands butler planner tool**: The Outlands Butler planner tool is used to plan character templates and to compare how different skill choices change a build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555429029635428352)
- **passive animal lore skill gain**: Animal Lore can gain passively while you fight with a newly tamed creature whose minimum taming requirement is within about 10 points of your Taming skill, and it also gains while taming new creatures; music skills do not level this way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553271049842597950)
- **per-mob skill gain cap**: The cap on skill gains from each mob has been removed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550231771168112651)
- **pet control requirements**: Controlling a pet requires both Animal Taming and Animal Lore skill, with the amount needed depending on the specific pet. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257447798607925)
- **potion codex requirements**: 80+ Alchemy makes a player eligible for the Potion Codex, and alchemy is considered a very strong combat skill for the safety it provides once eligible. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551009173125210243)
- **pure gatherer harvest level cap**: A pure gatherer can only raise Harvest to level 15 by gathering, because level 16 and above requires redline points that gathering cannot provide. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530899546563940503)
- **recommended stat distribution**: Spellcasters are advised to use 100 Strength, 100 Intelligence and 25 Dexterity, while non-casters are advised to use 100 Strength, 100 Dexterity and 25 Intelligence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554371518446960672)
- **resisting spells training in shelter dungeon**: In the Shelter dungeon, the Familiar (which casts about four spells) and the room with two mages on level 2 raise Resisting Spells quickly, for example from 50 to 80 in a few minutes, but you need a way to heal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550231198578511944)
- **resource maps skill gain**: Resource maps give harvesting skill gains at all skill levels and can be used from around 50 skill; in one test of 587 maps, skills reached 63.1 Mining, 87.0 Lumberjacking, 81.0 Fishing and 97.4 Forensic Evaluation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529114803273809)
- **risks of telescope island resist training**: Training Magic Resist at Telescope Island risks death from a banshee and occasional PKs, but it is considered one of the best spots for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667307830251591)
- **secure campfire for hiking**: After the patch, a secure campfire is no longer needed to use the hiking skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534388773071098047)
- **shelter dungeon parry training**: Shelter dungeon is a quick place to train Parrying up to about 80 skill: taunt Cats and Dogs with an area-of-effect taunt near Terran and let them attack you while you hold a shield. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544321026358509648)
- **skill gain chance command**: Use the [ShowSkillGain command to display the percent chance to increase messages when using a skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553271246282690651)
- **skill point cap and lowering skills**: To gain skill you need available skill points, so if your total is at the 700 cap you must set some skills to decrease before others can gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260388025339925)
- **skinning harvest aspect gain**: Skinning raises Harvest Aspect only by a negligible amount, so it is a very slow way to level it, including in dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521356898723696662)
- **smelting skill gain**: Smelting ore does not give skill gains. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528414271363354665)
- **tamer skill template**: A tamer template spends about 4x120 skill points on Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding, with the rest typically on Camping and Forensics, using 100 Tracking or Magery as a stopgap until skill scrolls are affordable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548270797758533663)
- **taming skill training**: Taming is fairly easy to skill up in Outlands, and leveling it was made easier in a past update. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547616147233316886)
- **taming training scripts and pet progression**: Taming scripts repeatedly tame and release the same pet and cannot be used inside a house; one lets you choose the animal, while a prescriptive one uses a cave bear, forest ostard and frenzied ostard, typically cave bear to 80, forest ostard to 100, frenzied ostard to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553404822928236630)
- **taste identification skill effects**: Taste Identification boosts applied poison effectiveness and the Food Satisfaction buff, helps identify ideal plant-growing conditions, and reduces damage taken from bleeds, poisons and diseases. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554356657981628497)
- **template stat and skill targets**: A finished template consists of 7 skills at 100 each (700 total points) and aims for 100 Strength, 100 Intelligence and 25 Dexterity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925129480601620)
- **thieves codex pilfering hide protection**: The thieving codex helps prevent pilfering from unhiding the player, and it has a maximum of 20 points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550598485831848098)
- **tinkering for gatherer characters**: Having 120 Tinkering helps a gatherer character deal with thieves, and Tinkering allows crafting exceptional trap tools and lockpicks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552042311821688904)
- **tinkering training cost**: Leveling Tinkering is very expensive, even when using gems, and is difficult for a new player to afford early on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551216275269619813)
- **tracking criminals and pks with begin hunting**: In the Tracking menu, choose the option that tracks criminals and PKs and click 'Begin Hunting'; it keeps running continuously without needing a loop. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549668597935378472)
- **tracking skill damage bonus**: The Tracking skill adds damage to weapon attacks and spells, and it can also alert you to nearby PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339561496772631)
- **training camping**: To train Camping, make kindling and double-click it to light a campfire; each lit campfire gives skill gain opportunities for 10 minutes, after which a new campfire is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659233887191092)
- **training parry**: Train Parry by equipping a shield (or 2h weapon) and letting many monsters hit you, such as in Shelter dungeon while healing yourself; to train a weapon skill at the same time, fight back with a training weapon that does 1 damage so mobs last longer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554579111173816482)
- **training with npcs when skill-capped**: When skill-capped, NPCs will not teach a skill unless another skill is locked down (lowered) and the skill you want to train is locked up in the skill lock settings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544724470080610365)
- **trap detonator for trappers**: A trapper needs to carry only one trap detonator, as it is not consumed and is lost only if you die and do not recover your body. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217080106356908)
- **trapping skills**: Tinkering and Detect Hidden are the trapping skills, and one player reports trapping requires 120 Tinkering. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550068281740763177)
- **treasure map skill requirements**: Treasure maps require the Cartography skill, with a 20 skill minimum to attempt and a 100% chance at 40 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546285793356808273)
- **tri bard definition and skill balance**: A tri bard uses all three bard skills (provocation, discordance, peacemaking); musicianship equals the lowest of the three, so keep them at the same level (e.g. 80) and take 2 levels in Self Taught. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548699199107891295)
- **tribard 120 with self-taught**: Reaching 120 Tribard with Self-Taught does not require the Musicianship skill to also have 20x scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550163349176590447)
- **tribard tamer build**: A recommended tribard tamer build uses 80 in each of the three bard skills (peacemaking, provocation, musicianship) and 120 in each of the four taming skills (taming, lore, veterinary, herding). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189469422559233)
- **veterinary training**: To train veterinary up to 80, bandage a dead bonded horse in the shelter dungeon; past 80, have two pets with one attacking the other and bandage the one being attacked, which takes about 5k bandages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550121133083197453)
- **wrestling and spell interruption**: Wrestling (and the related secondary skill melee defense) only gives a chance to avoid melee hits and some special abilities, which indirectly avoids spell interruption from melee, and the chance depends on your skill versus the enemy's weapon skill (100 vs 100 is about 50%). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554939634134552687)
- **100 tracking with 120 detect hidden**: With 100 Tracking and 120 Detect Hidden, approaching PKs show up on Tracking before they head toward the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542270226215862282)
- **125 effective inscription scroll consumption**: With 125 effective Inscription skill, casting Flame Strike from scrolls does not consume the scroll, so mages using Inscription typically aim for 125 effective Inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554515694324944997)
- **20 alchemy with 60 focus**: With 60 Focus a player can have 20 Alchemy, which gives a small potion buff but does not grant access to the Alchemy codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553898305593806879)
- **7th and 8th circle spells for magery spellbook**: A scribe can supply the 7th and 8th circle spells for a Magery spellbook using arcane scrolls looted during play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544878166605037670)
- **8x8 skill training method**: The old 8x8 skill training method of moving 8 steps and retrying the skill is not needed in UO Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378503564132434)
- **activating aspect without a weapon**: To activate an aspect without wielding a weapon, equip a spellbook and then activate the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528958349201117356)
- **afk fishing training on battle trainer**: Fishing can be trained AFK on a battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552050075562147892)
- **afk gatherer skill build**: For an AFK mining and lumberjacking gatherer, a suggested build is 120 Mining and Lumberjacking with Camping; Meditation, Magic Resist and Tracking are overkill, and Meditation is useless if using Hiking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550580351984865383)
- **afk mace fighting training on trainer npc**: Mace Fighting may be trainable AFK by attacking a trainer NPC, though the source was unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666762885308477)
- **afk skill training**: Nearly all skills in Outlands can be trained AFK; very few cannot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551606960640495788)
- **afk taming training**: Taming can be trained to maximum by going AFK with three different types of ostards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552848347285561485)
- **afk training of lumberjacking and mining**: Lumberjacking and Mining are easy to train AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659842732621875)
- **afk wrestling training in shelter dungeon**: Wrestling cannot be trained AFK in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669266272550984)
- **air elemental summoning for training**: Summoning air elementals can be used for training anywhere, and standing in a safe place makes being overweight acceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550342421546668123)
- **alchemy codex bonus skill requirement**: Lowering Resist, Anatomy and Parry to 80 would reportedly grant the full Alchemy codex bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548204544251666484)
- **alchemy in tri-bard template**: Having 20 Alchemy skill in the tri-bard template gives a slight increase to heals and potion buff durations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936139930931342)
- **alchemy level for societies**: Players eventually want 100-120 Alchemy on their main account to do societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553897828286206036)
- **alchemy leveling cost**: Leveling alchemy to 80 costs quite a bit, so parry can be used in its place to begin with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553014536565432391)
- **alchemy potion healing and panacea**: Alchemy gives almost twice the potion healing of Elixir and Bandolier together, and Panacea is very useful on lower dungeon levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552030910591934507)
- **alchemy purpose**: Alchemy is used to make potions such as heal, strength and explosion potions, which are useful for survivability for PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553984171767238748)
- **alchemy requirement for 120 hp**: Alchemy is not required to reach 120 hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **alchemy skill for 20-minute potions**: Getting 20-minute potions with Alchemy requires 80 Alchemy skill, which is costly to raise for a starting character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553785705354764299)
- **alchemy versus inscription for arcane mage**: Players consider Alchemy a much better skill than Inscription for an Arcane mage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544398661138645062)
- **anatomy requirement for healing**: Anatomy is needed to make effective use of the Healing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362038690516993)
- **animal lore and tracking training**: Animal Lore and Tracking are easy to train back up AFK later, so they can be temporarily dropped in a template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477205342425214)
- **animal lore skill category**: The Animal Lore skill is listed under the Wilderness category of skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145144006283378)
- **animal lore training**: Animal Lore is trained by using it on a mob, or by training Animal Taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555616760265310270)
- **animal lore training method**: Animal Lore can be trained by using the skill repeatedly in a loop while targeting one of your own followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555410574878445599)
- **animal taming training to 120**: Animal Taming can be trained to 120 by using 3 pets and repeatedly taming and releasing them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380155657682995)
- **arcane effective skill cap for interrupts**: Arcane's effective skill for interrupt avoidance cannot exceed the character's wrestling skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660770111037592)
- **arcane interrupt avoidance**: Arcane provides additive interrupt avoidance per skill point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660733725708318)
- **arcane mage meditation skill swap**: Early on, an arcane mage uses 80 Meditation (instead of Cooking) and meditates between mobs to sustain, then can swap Meditation for another skill such as Cooking at about T10-11 arcane aspect or once they have some links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683406624694385)
- **arcane skill training**: Arcane skill increases simply by casting spells, even when the arcane staff is not equipped, so it can be trained using summons for protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587315318464553)
- **archer bard build**: For an archer bard, one suggested build uses chivalry plus 80 alchemy instead of healing and anatomy, since alchemy offers a healing alternative along with damage and utility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552028366369062973)
- **archery and swordsmanship dexxer build**: Archery and Swordsmanship together can be a solid PvP dexxer build, but are not great for PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555270946254749737)
- **arms lore armor durability check**: Arms Lore on Outlands may be usable to check armor durability, but this is unconfirmed and the required skill level is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **arms lore for arcane mages**: Arms Lore is not an efficient skill choice for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891319019339776)
- **arms lore purpose**: Arms Lore is usually used to increase weapon specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545890429885743216)
- **arms lore versus tracking**: One player considers 80 Arms Lore a better choice than Tracking for a build mixing PvP and PvM, though this is an uncertain opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553451730304507985)
- **aspect kit requirement**: Starting aspect training from scratch requires an aspect kit, which can be found through Outlands Portal vendor search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549695198186176585)
- **aspect xp for treasure map digging**: For treasure map digging, full aspect XP likely requires both armor and weapon aspects to be active, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528951493426941983)
- **aspect xp when harvesting**: When harvesting ore, logs and leather, full aspect XP is gained with only the armor aspect activated; an aspected weapon is not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529070200794775632)
- **aspect xp while ocean fishing**: While ocean fishing, throwing nets gives 100% Harvest aspect XP when it is on armor and killing spawned mobs gives 50% XP to the weapon aspect, so put Harvest on armor and another aspect on the weapon; in dungeons harvest XP is 50% lower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546642998455042058)
- **attacking a trainer npc**: To attack a trainer NPC, switch to WAR mode with TAB, double-click his nameplate, and stand on a tile directly adjacent to him. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549671041750540381)
- **automatic skill gain and gain chances**: Skill points are gained automatically from your actions when the skill is set to increase in the skill menu, and enabling "show skill gain chances" (via left click on your sprite) shows which actions raise which skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547568111648112811)
- **bandage resurrection success rate**: With 120 Veterinary and Animal Lore plus specialist points, resurrecting a player with bandages reportedly succeeds more often than it fails. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101942782857278)
- **bard codex benefits**: The bard codex can increase song buffs, raise the success chance of barding a mob, and increase the damage provoked mobs do to one another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610137252986950)
- **bard codex build order**: For a bard codex build, take Self Taught first if you want to replace music with peace, then the bonus that increases song buffs; once Self Taught is invested you can drop Musicianship and replace it with Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186642658238516)
