- **bard codex point cap**: The bard codex has a cap of 20 points that can be earned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610404484685914)
- **bard dexxer skill pairings**: Wrestling and Swords are good melee skills to pair with Bard for a bard dexxer, and Archery or Throwing is recommended when playing in groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550845773623595072)
- **bard difficulty**: Bard is easy as long as the player can successfully keep a target barded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547970588583272550)
- **bard self taught buff requirements**: The bard Self Taught buff appears on the buff bar only when all three bard skills (provocation, discordance, peacemaking) have sufficient skill, for example all three set to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547672288973951016)
- **bard skill buffs**: Each bard skill can give you and your followers a significant buff in addition to its effects on monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186642658238516)
- **bard skills not working**: If bard skills stop working, say [stats and check the durability of your instrument, since a worn-out instrument can stop them from working. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544961333261377646)
- **bard skills training time**: Training all four bard skills to 100 reportedly takes at least a couple of days, possibly around three full days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544651823174914059)
- **bard syop before virtuoso when soloing**: When playing a Bard solo, the SYOP tier should be taken before Virtuoso; SYOP is preferred for solo play and not SYOP for group content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549826958656016457)
- **bard tamer codexes**: The taming bestiary codex and healers codex are useful for a bard tamer, but they must be bought or obtained from a guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551190893036568771)
- **bard tamer skill setup**: A bard tamer typically uses Music, Peace and Discordance until the bard codex is leveled enough to invest points into Self Taught, then replaces Music with Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550914980491042887)
- **bardic skills in kill speed**: Bardic skills do not speed up kills because they are gated by a skill timer; barding only buffs and provokes while pets do the killing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546230285992198155)
- **barding codex against resistance**: A barding codex would help against creature resistance to Barding by raising Barding skill, up to 120 with a scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554924348865904681)
- **barding skill cap and lyric aspect**: The Barding skill can be raised to 120 with a scroll, and the Lyric Aspect gives a bonus to Barding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554924348865904681)
- **barding skills on party members**: For barding skills to apply to party members, the Sing Your Own Praises perk must be maxed out and the party option ticked in the Bard Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552511438411530292)
- **barding without musicianship**: Barding may not work without Musicianship or without points in Self Taught; this is unconfirmed, though the codex rules suggest Self Taught is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553895114584105063)
- **basic backstabber build**: A basic backstabber build of 700 skill points is 100 Strength, 100 Dexterity, 25 Intelligence, and 100 each of Macefighting or Fencing, Tactics, Hiding, Stealth, Stealing, Snooping, and Tracking or Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550142627335372862)
- **begging skill usefulness**: The begging skill is useful in Outlands for players who like boating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546670048439967745)
- **beginner training credit skill cap**: Beginner training credits (deeds or cash gold) only buy 50 skill, while a custom template lets you start with 60 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544976241004642354)
- **best fishing build**: After the last patch, the best fishing build is 120 cartography, 120 fishing, 120 focus/forensic evaluation, 100 chivalry, 100 tactics, 80 anatomy and 80 healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540980034460975144)
- **best way to level harvesting skills**: Regular harvesting has always been considered the best way to level harvesting skills, because it also earns gold, unlike resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528212023228370966)
- **build skill synergy**: Trying to do too much with one build generally makes a character bad at everything, so builds need skill synergy to be effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554284810816458847)
- **camouflage for pilfering**: Camouflage from the thieves codex helps avoid being revealed while pilfering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552080767838855309)
- **campfire stat gain**: Standing near a campfire accelerates stat gains; the Camping skill must be set to UP for stats to rise, but the skill itself need not gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547044624487678063)
- **camping and spirit speak bonuses**: Camping provides extra carry weight, and Spirit Speak gives a small buff to your summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550334799951040523)
- **camping skill for heavy loot runs**: Camping skill is beneficial for players running harvest and T4-5 maps because it lets them carry more loot without hitting the weight limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542354237290315816)
- **camping skill for resource mappers**: Resource mappers do not need the Camping skill, since they can recall out or find a nearby forge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531432212703215697)
- **cartography 120 for resource maps**: 120 Cartography may be needed to execute all Resource Maps, depending on how upcoming patches play out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **cartography alternative in seafaring build**: If you don't want cartography in a seafaring or fishing build, you can swap it out for arms lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539458464311418921)
- **cartography and chivalry skill split**: With the upcoming cartography changes, a recommended split is 120 cartography and 100 chivalry rather than the reverse, though this is speculative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533727021329416334)
- **cartography buff**: Cartography was buffed and is now worth having on the character who actually does the treasure mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549793341846323221)
- **cartography damage bonus**: Cartography gives the player a large damage boost but does not add damage to pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542193754100736100)
- **cartography for boat players**: Cartography is useful for players who plan to spend time on a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361119974498338)
- **cartography for fishing competition**: During peak hours with many fishers on the ocean, running 100 cartography helps compete for fishing spots; off-peak, competition is low and those skill points are better spent on a damage-increasing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527654040736104550)
- **cartography full backpack behavior**: When training Cartography with a full backpack, crafted maps fall at your feet instead of stopping the crafting queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540782132826143)
- **cartography leveling with crafting queue**: The crafting queue makes leveling cartography, for treasure maps, easy to do. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545833019544313897)
- **cartography map disposal**: While training Cartography, craft maps with the trash can selected as the destination so they are disposed of automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540782132826143)
- **cartography needs for tamers on treasure maps**: Tamers running treasure maps with pets only need enough Cartography to read the map, because 120 Cartography does not boost pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542193754100736100)
- **cartography training cost to 120**: Reaching 120 cartography takes about 15,000 blank maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539458464311418921)
- **carving another player's monster corpse**: To carve another player's monster corpse, for example to train Forensic Evaluation, target the corpse with the carve instead of using self-targeting; you cannot open the corpse but the carve still happens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544141356706832395)
- **casting mark from a scroll**: Mark can be attempted from a scroll at 40 Magery and is cast with 100% success from a scroll at 60 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544096873386614865)
- **casting with a shield equipped**: A player can cast spells with a shield equipped without it being unequipped by having 80+ magery and 80+ parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551065450983723119)
- **cave bears as starter tames**: Cave bears can be found on Shelter Island and are considered among the best tame options for a new tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552855138073448529)
- **changing class**: Players can change class at any time by manually retraining skills or by purchasing an echo to flip between builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545711828267565057)
- **changing skill sets**: A player can change their skill set at any time, and doing so is very easy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550387661972316295)
- **cheap aspect core templates**: Templates using cheap aspect cores, such as the discipline aspect, make aspects easier to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554431582063038505)
- **cheapest crafting skills**: Alchemy, tailoring and inscription are the cheapest crafting skills to raise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550050210623787080)
- **checking effective fishing skill**: Effective fishing skill cannot be viewed in game, so the Outlands Butler website's fishing calculator must be used to check it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553116468193796278)
- **chivalry buff icon behavior**: The Chivalry buff icon disappears whenever you gain skill in Chivalry, which stops mattering once training is finished. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546146207141732413)
- **codex stance requirements**: Codex stances may require around 80 skill and 80 tactics, though the exact requirement is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891821018939503)
- **colored materials skill gain**: Colored materials have the same skill gain chance as iron, and after 100 harvest skill you can only gain from colored nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545831570710204527)
- **combat skill improvement**: Combat skills improve through use, such as hitting a monster with a sword to raise Swords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547899728887291925)
- **combined wrestling tracking and spirit speak training**: To train Wrestling, Tracking and Spirit Speak together on Shelter Island, start Tracking (which repeats automatically), run a loop for Spirit Speak, and attack the wrestling trainer NPC in the south west of the island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667682721202208)
- **commodity boards for carpentry training**: Commodity boards can be used to level carpenters up to 120 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529852835775123657)
- **container wands for identification**: Container wands remove the tedium of identifying items one by one and can identify a whole full container of 125 items at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451740733677640)
- **container wands with 120 item id**: Container wands can also be used with 120 Item ID, which requires obtaining the 20 skill scrolls for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451996414255226)
- **continuous chest picking**: To pick chests continuously, double-click the chest rather than using lockpicks or the trap removal tool directly; the gump offers continuous remove trap or lockpick, and you should run remove trap first, then lockpick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550335876608032901)
- **converting tamer to mapper**: If you already have a tamer character, you can convert it to a mapper easily by using an echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541897479048396830)
- **cost to reach 80 magery**: Reaching 80 magery costs roughly 800 gold when buying raw reagents and does not require many casts in the shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544133684444004394)
- **crafter skill priority**: For a crafting and item identification character, the suggested skill order is tailoring, item identification, then alchemy, with tinkering last because it is far more expensive; 80 magery and inscription can be added later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634527851323496)
- **crafter stat distribution**: A suggested crafter stat distribution is 100 Str, 25 Dex and 100 Int, with 100 strength being the only especially important value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549635937326338129)
- **create food for evaluating intelligence training**: Casting Create Food, which makes many mushrooms, is a good way to train Evaluating Intelligence, and casting it from scrolls is the best method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546678486692003911)
- **crew buffs for boaters**: Boaters can push their effective skill beyond the normal range by using crew buffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526795418787385355)
- **damaged town critters**: Town critters like cats are often below full health because players or their scripts attack them, sometimes aggroing many to train Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551605839695970466)
- **default skill gain settings**: New characters have every skill set to increase by default, so with a 700 cap you must set unwanted skills to decrease or lock so wanted skills can go up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918564781072425)
- **default skill lock state on new characters**: A newly created character has every skill set to increase (up), so skills the build does not need must be set down manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549591418916446361)
- **deleting skills**: A skill cannot be deleted; it can only be set to 0 and ignored. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257198979776573)
- **desirable tamed dragon stats**: Desirable stats on a tamed dragon are 4%+ speed, 8%+ damage and 8%+ wrestling; if not all can be had, speed and damage matter most. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487900019269743)
- **detect hidden and trap cooldown**: Detect Hidden affects trap cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250969782681780)
- **detect hidden effect on trap cooldown**: Detect Hidden shortens the player's trap cooldown, which is (40 - (0.5 * (Detect Hidden skill - 80))) seconds, so higher Detect Hidden means a lower cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538779666264096778)
- **detect hidden for treasure maps**: Treasure maps do not require Detect Hidden; Detect Hidden is only needed for dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521076297680420946)
- **detect hidden training 80 to 100**: To train Detect Hidden from 80 to 100, use a locksmith training box and remove trap tools from a provisioner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546499753360105593)
- **detect hidden usefulness**: Detect Hidden is useful for revealing very sneaky hidden players that a tracking script may not pick up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543052329656254604)
- **detecting hidden with tracking**: Detecting Hidden works together with Tracking to help detect hidden PKs and thieves at a greater distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **dexxer codex choices**: Axe dexxers should take Swordsmanship as their weapon codex, and nearly all dexxers use the Healers codex plus either Parrying or Alchemy depending on build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555315428409085963)
- **dexxer dungeon mining skill distribution**: A dexxer dungeon mining build uses 120 mining, 100 tracking, chivalry and tactics, 80 macing, anatomy and healing, and 60 camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521401614974455948)
- **dexxer template progression**: As a dexxer gets orbs and scrolls, raise Chivalry to 120, and when the aspect reaches level 10-12 move 20 points from weapon skill to arms lore, or do so sooner with the Discipline aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553775013813952523)
- **disarming magic trapped pouches**: Thieves likely cannot disarm a magic trapped pouch without setting it off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545799237525049425)
- **dockmaster tracking trainer**: The dockmaster on the dock down from the inn on Shelter Island may also teach Tracking, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555560179448283218)
- **dropping a skill by an exact amount**: To drop a skill by an exact amount, buy 20 skill points of a random skill and set it to decrease, then give the NPC fewer coins (200 instead of the 500 asked) so the skill drops exactly 20 points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554188251114377297)
- **dropping healing and anatomy**: A character that relies on potions and Chivalry instead of bandages can drop Healing and Anatomy from its skill set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362117405282305)
- **dropping tracking for inscription**: Tracking can be dropped in favor of a crafting skill like Inscription once you no longer rely on tracking for survival and can afford the training costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544543983982743562)
- **dual wield build suggestion**: One suggested dual wield build is 120 chivalry, 100 tactics, 100 dual wield, 80 healing, 80 anatomy, 80 arms lore, 80 parry and 80 focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553933172587368572)
- **dual wield skill requirement**: Dual wielding requires only the one dual wield weapon skill, and no second combat skill such as swords or fencing is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553934113810030669)
- **dual wielding chivalry gain**: Dual wielding may increase Chivalry through combat, with the related weapon skills (e.g. Tactics) reportedly needing to be at 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544744134496227368)
- **dull resource maps for lumberjacking gains**: Dull resource maps are better for pure lumberjacking skill gains because they contain more lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529114803273809)
- **dungeon chests for harvest aspect**: Opening dungeon chests raises Harvest Aspect quickly, but it is poorly suited to tamers because it requires stealthing around or acting as a teleport/rope ninja. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521056035584868412)
- **dungeon lockpicker carry capacity links**: A dungeon lockpicker build can use the Special Loot and Effective Camping links to gain extra carry capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550315938635718746)
- **dungeon mining dexxer build play style**: A dungeon mining dexxer kills mobs with a pickaxe and mines ore while waiting for the mobs to respawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521386825095315486)
- **dungeon picking for harvesting**: Dungeon picking is not a fast way to level the Harvesting skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **early backstab effectiveness**: Early in training, backstabbing cannot one-shot even easier mobs; Ettins take around 3 to 5 attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549616480683950151)
- **earth drake taming requirement**: An Earth Drake requires 105 taming and can be used to train taming up to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083574855237715)
- **easy skills to macro**: Easy skills like Spirit Speak and Tracking always gain and are good to macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340620403347507)
- **echo alchemy training shortcut**: Using an echo for another build that has 120 Alchemy lets a player avoid training Alchemy to 80 twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553898267232960613)
- **echo gathering skill split**: Unlocking an echo lets a player easily split gathering skills, such as mining and lumberjacking, across separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535305372238221414)
- **echo harvesting skill builds**: Proposed Echo harvesting builds are Ore Maps: 120 Mining, 120 Camping, 100 Magery, 100 Spirit Speak, 100 Wrestling, 100 Alchemy, 80 Resist; and Lumber Maps: 120 Lumberjacking, 120 Spirit Speak, 100 Magery, 100 Wrestling, 100 Alchemy, 80 Healing, 80 Anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532959316833996901)
- **echo swap skill locking**: Whenever you swap echoes, skills get locked, so skills set to up or down arrows become locked and must be readjusted when you echo back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550465599111565333)
- **effective fishing skill for sea serpents**: An effective fishing skill of 205 gives the best chance of a sea serpent spawn, and anything above 205 is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540255302408999052)
- **effective skill and harvest success**: Per the Outlands wiki, effective skill only increases the success chance for harvesting specific materials, and 120 skill plus an avar nearly caps it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526279551683133693)
- **elemental summon reagent costs**: Air, earth and water elemental summons are each 3-reagent casts, while fire elemental costs more, so water is not cheaper than the other non-fire elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549989221266227233)
- **evaluating intelligence training**: Every spell has the same chance to raise Evaluating Intelligence, so training is fastest with a spell that can be cast quickly and will not kill you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546677556466425892)
- **exceptional iron lockpicks for level 6 chests**: Exceptional Iron lockpicks can handle level 6 chests easily, so the Gold tool can be saved for level 7-8 chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316727642886235)
- **farming level 7 and 8 spells**: Level 7 and level 8 spells cannot be farmed for skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554417794731348031)
- **fast fishing skill training**: To train fishing fast, buy fishing skill to 50 from an NPC, get a small or medium boat, and fish on the ocean to reach 120 in about 5-6 hours (some report 1-2 hours); alternatively AFK train with a harpoon on a battle trainer to 100 and from shore to 120, though shore fishing is not worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527310732163678249)
- **fast skill training at shelter**: Skills such as Chivalry can be brought to 80 quickly at Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314411653496924)
- **faster veterinary training via poison**: A faster veterinary training method may exist that involves poisoning your pet and curing it with bandages, but details are unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550121133083197453)
- **fastest harvesting skill training**: Fishing is much faster than any other method for raising Harvesting once the player gets past the large ocean learning curve; after fishing, the next fastest are treasure mapping and then lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **fastest way to raise dexterity**: Snooping is claimed to be the fastest way to raise Dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552428248464363632)
- **fe skill gain on pvm dexxer**: Gaining fe skill on a fully grown PvM dexxer is relatively easy but feels like a grind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552846080855515218)
- **fencing dexxer secondary skills**: A Fencing dexxer can pair Fencing with Poisoning and Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225255196201002)
- **fencing skill level and accuracy**: Raising Fencing to 90% gives better hit accuracy than 80%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548228302806978651)
- **finisher unlock requirements**: Reaching Rank 5 in any Stance for a skill unlocks the first tier finisher, and each additional stance at Rank 5 unlocks an additional finisher tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **first fishing boat upgrades**: The first boat upgrades to buy for fishing are the fisherman outfitting and mariner's fortune, which give the best +fishing bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527083312655630586)
- **fisher echo chain experience**: Fishing on a fisher echo character with the harvest aspect gives decent chain experience, especially during guild boss and omni runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534202062001279036)
- **fishing as weapon skill**: Fishing already functions as a weapon skill, so adding mace or swords to a fisher template is unnecessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535321888321048587)
- **fishing codex and combat use**: Fishing has its own Codex and also doubles as a combat skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529654863431209120)
- **fishing skill and harvest aspect progression**: Fishing skill rises quickly while Harvest aspect levels slowly; Harvest aspect adds effective fishing skill, which raises spawn chances and yields more special fishing nets in the long run, and gaining Harvest by fishing is slow until the player learns the method, then becomes very fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **fishing skill for land resource maps**: Fishing resource maps on land can be done without 120 fishing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553101282347319383)
- **fishing skill for ocean fishing**: 120 fishing skill is effectively required for ocean fishing, since the best ocean spots need 205 effective fishing skill, which is unreachable without 120 base skill plus bonuses such as harvest aspect, links, and ship upgrades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553102046562099403)
- **fishing skill gain from fighting**: Fishing skill can be raised by fighting, but only very slowly, and it does not raise while in sanctuary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362464760762409)
- **fishing skill in tamer tmap build**: In a tamer treasure map build the Fishing skill level is flexible, but it helps slightly with hitting command procs on the weapon, and fishing is ranged and needs no ammo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524365055125094611)
- **fishing skill range**: Fishing counts as a combat skill up to 100, and the range from 100 to 120 applies only to fishing and is mostly beneficial for MIBs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554360957260533861)
- **fishing skill requirement for mibs**: Fishing up messages in bottles (MIBs) requires a high level of the Fishing skill, not just Tidings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553382823275143179)
- **fishing skill soft-cap**: The fishing soft-cap is 205 effective fishing skill, which is very hard to reach without the harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534240670171004978)
- **fishing skill training speed**: Fishing is a harvest skill that takes a very long time to raise without a boat and nets or many fishing maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554360957260533861)
- **fishing skill training with harvest aspect**: Harvest aspect combined with harvest links is likely sufficient for training fishing skill, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521687308565348402)
- **fishing xp rewards**: Fishing gives chain/redline XP, unlike most other harvesting, and much better harvest XP than mining, though sinking NPC ships gives more chain XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **fixing failing bard skills without codex**: If you are ineligible for the codex and your bard skills are failing, train Discordance and Provocation up to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936550847447203)
- **flame strike magery gain rate**: Training Magery with Flame Strike at around 80 skill gives roughly a 16% gain chance per cast, or about one gain every 7 casts on average. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260337869987921)
- **flame strike mana limit at 80 magery**: At around 80 Magery a mage can cast Flame Strike only about 3 times before needing to regenerate mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260640996532235)
- **focus and arms lore versus camping for dexers**: Focus and Arms Lore are more useful than Camping for a dexer, because Focus procs more special attacks and Arms Lore gives attack speed and accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549313937755869215)
- **focus for necromancy casters**: For a Necromancy caster, Focus mainly boosts mana regeneration, stacking with crafted book bonuses, Meditation and meditation rate for 'turbo med', and also raises charged spell chance when running Spell Strike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544378693911060621)
- **focus skill in pvp**: The Focus skill is not needed for PvP on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547631491612155916)
- **focus skill swing speed**: The Focus skill gives the most swing speed increase (SSI) per skill point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554250949252489237)
- **focus versus arms lore swing speed**: Focus gives a higher swing speed increase per skill point than Arms Lore, plus accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555526675024973915)
- **food satisfaction bonus calculation**: The Food Satisfaction bonus from cooked food is calculated from the higher of the Taste Identification and Cooking skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554357172765204581)
- **forensic evaluation benefits**: Forensic Evaluation allows you to carve monster corpses for leather and also gives a damage bonus to spells and melee damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339949386014723)
- **forensic evaluation build fit**: Few templates fit Forensic Evaluation naturally, though backstabbers might, but it can fit many builds if the player gives up something else for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072372224426035)
- **forensic evaluation corpse carving**: Forensic Evaluation allows carving corpses for extra gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **forensic evaluation damage bonus**: Forensic Evaluation grants bonus supplemental spell and melee damage (including archery) against creatures, capped at 30%, calculated as 25% * (skill / 100) and applied as Base Weapon Damage * bonus per swing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547073232400683050)
- **forensic evaluation for tamers**: One player recommends running Forensic Evaluation as a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542361059560783993)
- **forensic evaluation leather income**: Forensic Evaluation increases leather income when skinning, with one player estimating it added around 10 million leather over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542363865218682940)
- **forensic evaluation on builds**: Forensic Evaluation is recommended on any build that has spare skill points to absorb it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527454237758455888)
- **forensic evaluation spell damage increase**: Forensic Evaluation may provide spell damage increase (SDI), but this is unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072597575860246)
- **forensic evaluation training via skinning**: Forensic Evaluation can gain very fast by running around a dungeon and skinning other people's dead mobs, while skinning only your own PVM kills is probably as slow as mining and lumberjacking, if not slower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525098647719776256)
- **fortune expertise and barding**: Fortune Expertise gives effective barding skill, so barding builds use it well, and backstabbers also benefit from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537615466611089538)
- **fortune expertise skill**: Outlands has a Fortune Expertise (FE) skill, and a PvM character can run 120 FE without Harvest if the build supports it, making it a good moneymaker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537615466611089538)
- **frenzied ostard behavior**: Frenzied Ostards were aggressive on OSI but are believed to be passive on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493765914370140)
- **frenzied ostard taming requirement**: Frenzied Ostards are believed to require 95 taming skill, though they are hard to find. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493891923714241)
- **gatherer stat distribution**: Unless the character has Meditation, a gatherer should use 100/100/25 for STR/DEX/INT. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546774767267352596)
- **gathering gains after 80**: After 80 gathering skill, you need to leave safe areas and go into the dangerous world for gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629650599186433)
- **gathering skill progression speed**: Gathering skills progress slowly, especially past 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544628826288562206)
- **gemstone uses**: Gemstones are used for Tinkering training and are expected to be important for upcoming Golems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547328675580739754)
- **greater heal requirements**: Greater Heal needs about 60 Magery for a 100% cast chance, may be castable from a scroll at around 40 Magery per the wiki, and costs 11 mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551146383011086417)
- **greater paragon chest lockpicking requirement**: A player with 110 Lockpicking, 110 Detect Hidden, 10 Harvest and exceptional Agapi tools has 139 effective skill, which is enough to open greater paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546290270667018320)
- **greater paragon chest requirement**: A greater paragon chest needs 150 effective skill to open, per Outlands Butler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546290270667018320)
- **green skill orbs**: Green skill orbs raise a character's total skill points up to 720 and reportedly cost around 8k each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553728428044320810)
- **harvest armor with frost weapon**: Wear harvest-aspected armor with a frost-aspected weapon to get 100% harvest XP while harvesting and 50% frost XP when killing something. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529972502875607121)
- **harvest aspect equipment slot for avararite maps**: Harvest aspect is only needed on armor, not on the weapon, for mining avararite maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935389215457453)
- **harvest aspect leveling**: Carving skin from killed mobs levels the harvest aspect, whereas simply killing mobs in dungeons does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536195856234053632)
- **harvest aspect leveling graphic**: The circulating graphic for leveling the harvest aspect is outdated because the maps have changed since it was made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555344193294041121)
- **harvest level 16 requirement**: Reaching Harvest level 16 requires redline points, which can be earned by backstabbing (15 redline points). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530954393526993066)
- **harvest level uses beyond gathering**: Harvest level is useful beyond pure gathering, including T-maps, dungeon chest lockpicking, ocean fishing and MiBs, so XP from gathering benefits those activities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540257199748808714)
- **harvest leveling via dungeon chests**: Players can level the harvesting skill by picking dungeon chests inside dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552120738897469482)
- **harvest skill bonus for cartography**: The harvest skill bonus does not apply to Cartography when decoding maps, though the developer Luthius reportedly is considering adding it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536832302217437204)
- **harvest vs fortune on treasure map characters**: On a treasure map character, Harvest yields more profit while Fortune yields more experience, with Fortune estimated at roughly 80% of Harvest's profit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526298550286291075)
- **harvester build strength**: A harvester build should not use 70 STR; starting with the traditional harvester build and chopping is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547357834474422333)
- **harvesting skill above 100**: Harvesting skill above 100 does not improve money flow; income is the same as at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535422228194394132)
- **harvesting skill needed for treasure maps**: On a treasure map harvest, swings cannot fail, so there is no need to raise harvesting skill above 110 effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547770495863226450)
- **harvesting skill redline**: Harvesting skills have no redline experience system because there is nothing for them to redline to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898527852073083)
- **harvesting skill training time**: Training a harvesting skill to Grandmaster takes roughly 10 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521280733040082965)
- **harvesting skill training time**: Harvesting skills are the longest skills to raise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548975879760117903)
- **healers codex point gain**: Healers Codex points are gained by killing monsters, not by using bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548203429011390464)
- **healing codex requirements**: Reaching 80+ Healing and 80+ Anatomy unlocks the Healing Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **healing training in shelter dungeon**: To train Healing in the Shelter dungeon, tag one weak mob, stand in a corner so it keeps hitting you, and spam bandages via script or macro; players report it reaches 80 quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554938707344097281)
- **herding crook activation**: A herding crook does not need to be equipped; it is active whenever it shows [activated] when clicked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554169009560101005)
- **herding for tamers**: Herding is typically recommended for tamers because it provides a large damage increase to their pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552175754337583115)
- **herding in builds**: Most builds include Herding; generally only PvP or hybrid PvP builds skip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552245864645398570)
- **hiding and stealth benefits**: 100 Hiding and 100+ Stealth help avoid PKs, who can be waited out until they leave, and help avoid the 60 second timer each time you recall home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **hiding success without skill**: You can hide with a 100% chance of success even if you have no Hiding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552488863958704160)
- **hiding training in towns**: You can hide in any town, such as outside your inn room, to train hiding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489685509050531)
- **hybrid builds**: Hybrid builds are common in Outlands but are not great at either of their functions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093812779458641)
- **hybrid r-map echo build**: For a hybrid resource-map build, one Echo can cover mining and lumberjacking and a second Echo can cover fishing and Fishing Expertise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532872864200654919)
- **identifying magic items**: There is no spell to identify magic items; players must use the Item ID skill or an Item ID wand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546920166418415636)
- **infrequent skill gains**: Some skills gain seldom, so players should look at gain chance percentages rather than actual gains to judge progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549672678137397301)
- **ingot cost of training tinkering and blacksmithing**: Training tinkering and blacksmithing takes a large number of ingots, and tinkering is somewhat cheaper if gems are used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549596054498975755)
- **inscription 100 to 120 scroll cost**: Going from 100 to 120 Inscription reportedly used about 28 to 30 scroll commodities, roughly 75k scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546616971444092928)
- **inscription as supplementary skill**: Inscription is considered a good supplementary skill for Magery characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210179642466366)
- **inscription bless and protection duration**: With Inscription, Bless and Protection last 12 minutes before they need to be recast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552788764261224471)
- **inscription for flame strike mages**: Inscription is a reasonable skill choice for spell-damage-focused characters, especially those who mostly cast Flame Strike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552785933110218913)
- **inscription for necro summoner**: Inscription provides substantial benefit to a necro summoner regardless of when it is added to the build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544544256465571851)
- **inscription for pvm**: Inscription is a good PvM skill when casting offensively but not when focusing on pet damage, and Item Identification is best kept on another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554513962895155222)
- **inscription interrupt avoidance**: At 100 skill, inscription gives the same interrupt avoidance as 100 arcane plus 100 wrestling and prevents PvE spell interrupts; it does not help in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660801862180886)
- **intelligence stat for non-casters**: Characters that do not cast spells do not need Intelligence, while casters want maximum Intelligence and gain less from Dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554371723523133481)
- **invisibility macro skill gain**: Repeatedly casting Invisibility on a new character is reported to raise skills such as Magery, Spirit Speak and Focus, reaching the 700 total skill cap in roughly 20 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546160006246699019)
- **item identification afk training**: Item Identification can gain skill even when used on an already identified item such as starter pants, so it can be looped AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551257806886404108)
- **item identification result**: Using Item Identification on a magical item changes its name from 'unidentified <item>' to its actual magical name, e.g. 'unidentified parrying dagger' becomes 'durable parrying dagger'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551761726632890392)
- **item identification training**: Once Item Identification reaches 50, repeatedly using Item ID on any item (for example via a Razor macro) slowly raises the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763296447627265)
- **kindling needed to max camping**: About 50 kindling is enough to max out Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548214185937215529)
- **learning lockpicking in starter town**: Buy Lockpicking and Detect Hidden up to 50 from the thief NPC under the Shelter inn, buy the training box, remove trap tools and lock picks, then train in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547915931286642729)
- **learning spells from scrolls**: You learn spells by having a spellbook containing them; scrolls for spells missing from your book can be dropped onto the book to add them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550689245864136749)
- **level 4 treasure chest cartography requirement**: After the treasure map change, a level 4 chest requires at least 100 cartography, whereas previously about 60 lockpicking and the harvest aspect sufficed, and a level 8 chest costs about 60 more skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528317969091006506)
- **leveling a healing codex**: To level a healing codex easily, join a guild and leech experience while in a party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551301412212711475)
- **leveling artisan skills by stocking shelves**: Crafters can level artisan skills cheaply by stocking guild or other players' shelves with potions, armor, weapons and other needed items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553100695895281784)
- **leveling forensics**: To level Forensics, carry a knife and run through +spawn or +xp dungeons skinning every corpse, according to a single player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552790217432367268)
- **leveling skill through fishing**: Fishing can be used to level a skill, though it is somewhat monotonous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549690701808148510)
- **lightning for magery training**: Lightning works for training Magery at the start, but players eventually need to switch to other spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544917614008999987)
- **locking non-template skills**: Lock all skills in the skills gump that are not part of your chosen template to avoid hitting the skill cap as quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554678412717723810)
- **lockpicking chest run chain experience**: Doing lockpicking chest runs grants chain experience, which eventually gives a small boost to link amount or redlines. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544660612900978740)
- **lockpicking chest sharing**: Multiple lockpickers can be in the same dungeon, and anyone can click a chest to see whether someone is already unlocking it; an empty chest means another picker is nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548965007772090442)
- **lockpicking mastery chain contribution**: Lockpicking contributes to the Mastery Chain when harvesting from chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550849903159414905)
- **lockpicking skill gain in shelter dungeon**: Lockpicking may benefit from the increased skill gain in the Shelter dungeon, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554906494833795093)
- **lockpicking skill links**: Effective Skill on Chests links are better than effective harvest links for dungeon lockpicking, because effective harvest links give far less skill there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540269481241084034)
- **lockpicking skill pairing**: Lockpicking is commonly paired with hiding, stealth, snooping and stealing so a character can steal from monsters between unlocking chests; it should only be included on characters intended for lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690693002166275)
- **lockpicking training**: Training lockpicking is easy and cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531043404568465558)
- **lockpicking training box**: A lockpick training box exists that players can use to train the Lockpicking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550331442599301205)
- **lockpicking training box durability**: The lockpicking training box is not consumable and can be kept permanently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554842876268126260)
- **lockpicking training box use**: To use the lockpicking training box, double click it, tick the box to keep working the lock, then click the gem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547916559803097101)
- **lockpicking training path**: Train Lockpicking to 80 in the Shelter dungeon, then continue training outside Shelter to raise it beyond 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554906596805709956)
- **low-level treasure maps and cartography skill points**: Running only level 1-3 treasure maps requires fewer cartography skill points, which frees points for other skills in a trapper skill configuration, though this is one player's tentative plan. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538698106558873642)
- **lowering skills to free skill cap**: To free up skill points under the cap, set skills you no longer need to go down so other skills can be raised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971820438855782)
- **lumberjacking forensic evaluation skinner builds**: A lumberjacking 120 / forensic evaluation 120 character can run skinning dungeons by adding some magery, magic resist, alchemy and parrying and using teleport and rope around skinning spots, or alternatively by using magery and spirit speak with defensive skills and summons to take aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531381838776500394)
- **lumberjacking skill cap and training**: Lumberjacking can be trained to 120 through normal chopping without resource maps, though the 120 cap rests on a single player report and an uncertain question. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546284094189608983)
- **lumberjacking xp per log**: When lumberjacking, XP is fixed at 0.2 XP per log harvested regardless of log color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540966627695267880)
- **lumberjacking-focused template**: One recommended lumberjacking template is 120 Lumberjacking, 100 Magery, 100 Spirit Speak, 100 Wrestling, 100 Resist Spells, 100 Tracking and 100 Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532225014567538748)
- **mace build weapon skill requirement**: A mace-focused build only needs the Mace skill as its weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554393785830604842)
- **mage armor restrictions**: Mages can only use leather armor, but an arcane mage can wear plate because they later drop Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549647082149912667)
- **mage bard skill setup**: A mage bard would need Music instead of one of the bard skills at first, until they have a bard codex with enough points for Self Taught. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548195397829402625)
- **mage template skills to lower**: On a mage template, Anatomy, Arms Lore, Tactics and Parry are the skills to lower in order to free up points at the skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925004930744360)
- **mage wrestling skill in pvp**: Nearly all mages who PvP reportedly take 100 Wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555039039499931780)
- **magery and camping training location**: Magery and Camping can be trained in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659191499558983)
- **magery needed for elemental summons**: A character needs 100 Magery to summon elementals reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526681589105426562)
- **magery needed for reliable mark**: 80 Magery gives a 100% casting chance for the Mark spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452160245694535)
- **magery training costs**: New players reportedly get a free allotment of roughly 500-1000 casts that makes reaching 80 magery easy, while training from 80 to 100 reportedly takes about 1.5-2k casts times three and roughly 20k gold without an Avarhide satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544133859208069121)
- **magery training spot in shelter**: To train Magery in Shelter, stand behind Lord Warner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660260266934377)
- **magery training to 80**: Only the Invisibility spell is needed to train Magery to 80, and its scrolls are sold by the Mage NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547415341452365924)
- **magic mushroom stockpile for skill training**: A stockpile of magic mushrooms is a good way to raise skills like focus and necromancy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583571384672257)
- **magic mushrooms for skill gain**: Making and eating magic mushrooms for mana helps casters gain skills such as meditation and focus faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551004378503061595)
- **magic resist training locations**: Witcher 44 tower and a Witcher observatory (possibly Witcher 4 or 6) are reported places to train Magic Resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332322888089732)
- **manual skill training time**: Raising a skill such as taming fully by hand can take about a year, so scripting gains up to 100 and then raising the remainder manually is suggested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552858574202343616)
- **marking a rune with magery**: With 60 Magery you can mark a blank rune and recall to it: buy Mark and Recall scrolls, add them to your spellbook, open the spellbook, click Mark and target the rune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549619803856314449)
- **mastery codex requirements**: Mastery Chain experience is gained without a chain, and all codices are supposed to work if you have the appropriate skills and the codex with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551294168293179405)
- **mastery tier stale bonus display**: After upgrading a Mastery tier, the skill list may show a stale bonus such as 100 Tactics instead of 116; lowering and raising the tier again refreshes the display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551931042653409322)
- **max skills on a single character**: A single character cannot have all skills maxed at the same time, because it would be too overpowered given how the systems interact. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386855575556137)
- **meditation for caster builds**: A caster build without the Meditation skill is likely to be very hard to play because of mana limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550787753896054815)
- **meditation for inscription**: Inscription society work needs Magery but does not require Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553668363396456511)
- **meditation on mage build**: If other measures fail, a mage can keep Meditation on their build until they level up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **melee skills and bows**: Bows are classified as melee, so a character generally needs only one melee skill, which sets core accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555274705584398407)
- **minimum magery to cast spells**: The minimum Magery to attempt a spell is its spell circle times 10, and adding 20 to that gives the skill needed for a 100% success chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552425507465855107)
- **mining and lumberjacking skill requirements**: Mining and lumberjacking may not need to reach 120 because of harvest level, but 110 may be needed; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548976825978458203)
- **mining and magery resource needs**: Mining is an active skill requiring attention, while Magery consumes reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666638985437239)
- **mining in hollow hills for grimoire and redline**: Mining inside the Hollow Hills while summons kill spiders, harpies and drakes can level the Wizard Grimoire and Summoner's Tome and earn Redline points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529945032671494255)
- **mining mace fighting bonus**: Mining reportedly gives a buff to Mace Fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665291754012703)
- **mining skill cap from rocks**: Mining rocks alone can raise mining skill to 105.3, though it takes a long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528361489335844934)
