- **mining skill gain by ore type**: In regular mining, skill gain from lower ore types stops as Mining skill rises, so gains slow down over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545656855164882985)
- **mining training time from 100 to 110**: Raising Mining from 100 to 110 by pure mining took one player about 2 months at roughly 4 hours a day. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **mining xp per ore**: Mining grants about 0.2 XP per ore mined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541093808530530374)
- **missing skill gain chance**: A skill may stop showing a gain chance if a skill scroll was not consumed and the cap was not raised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553575945330229370)
- **missing skill gain chance display**: If skill gain chance does not display after a map, a skill arrow may be pointing the wrong way; click 'show real' and check every skill for a 1.0 gain setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546283753033170984)
- **necro mage summoner skill order**: For a necro mage summoner build, Necromancy should be raised to 120 first and Inscription added later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554188437857378405)
- **necromancer aspect choice for spellcasters**: A spellcaster necromancer can use almost any aspect, with Eldritch or Death being fine choices; one player's first three tier 15 aspects were Death, Eldritch and Blood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551566877631848611)
- **necromancer template availability**: Necromancer is a possible template in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547976745574072422)
- **necromancy and chivalry books**: Necromancy and Chivalry books are not codices like the Magery grimoire, and they are required to train the Necromancy and Chivalry skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544749833955581983)
- **necromancy as complementary skill**: Necromancy is a versatile complementary skill that fits poison builds, summoner builds and arcane builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338460756480051)
- **necromancy book and codex progression**: The necromancy book is required to train the Necromancy skill and earns no experience, with its abilities unlocking as Necromancy skill increases, whereas the grimoire is a Codex, the first of the post-skill XP progression systems, which earns XP from kills to unlock bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919281572118559)
- **necromancy dependence on magery**: Necromancy is not intended to be used standalone; it enhances Magery spells in various ways, so you need Magery skill and a normal spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554283736445624351)
- **necromancy for arcane mage builds**: Arcane mage builds take Necromancy mainly to apply disease stacks through offensive spells, and also for other damage bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544541946049986600)
- **necromancy starting book**: A starting necromancy book is required before you can train the Necromancy skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544947706441633812)
- **necromancy training cap from npcs**: NPC trainers only train Necromancy up to a limit; to reach 80 you must train in Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545652507295088792)
- **necromancy vampire thrall summon**: Adding Necromancy to a summoner build replaces the daemon summon with a vampire thrall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548026883906609333)
- **nightstalker pet taming requirement**: The Nightstalker pet requires 110 Taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549642441647460412)
- **noobie dungeon skill gain**: There is a noobie dungeon with vastly increased skill gain, but skills cannot be raised beyond 80 there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274468800987339)
- **npc item identification training**: An NPC trainer can instantly raise Item Identification to 50 for 500 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763161957408769)
- **npc mining training**: You can pay an NPC to train mining to 50, and the resources gathered at 50 mining are still very lucrative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603219024650253)
- **npc trainer skill purchase limit**: Skills already at 50 or higher cannot be bought up from NPC trainers, which only train skills up to 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918053365387265)
- **npd skill gain bonus**: In the NPD, Herding gets a bonus skill gain chance, while gathering and crafting skills do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552535820605587477)
- **obtaining kindling**: Kindling is obtained by using a dagger on a tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548214021659037707)
- **ocean fishing rewards**: In ocean fishing, gold, XP and skill gains come from fishing spots fished with a fishing net rather than from fishing with a pole. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527311426245628035)
- **open nearby corpses option**: An 'open nearby corpses' option exists, letting players skin without using a skinning knife on each corpse, though few players use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677858633285693)
- **outlands butler build tool**: The Outlands Butler website offers a build-making tool that highlights available abilities, such as hamstring, once the required skills are entered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546511161468657714)
- **outlands butler taming levelling page**: The Outlands Butler taming levelling page shows which creatures to tame for your current skill level as you progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552408653850480684)
- **overlooked skill in thieves codex**: The Overlooked skill in the thieves codex is considered useless and unreliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545802906752524358)
- **paladin pvm and dungeon picker combination**: A paladin template has no spare skill slots for Lockpicking and Detect Hidden, so a dungeon picker cannot be combined with a paladin PvM character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547921524747407400)
- **paladin pvm template**: A commonly suggested paladin template is 100 Chivalry, 100 Tactics, 100 weapon skill, and 80 each in Healing, Anatomy, Parrying, and Arms Lore, with the last slot going to a flexible skill such as Focus, Alchemy or Resisting Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553014447134482614)
- **paladin skill drop for 700 cap**: A paladin who must drop a skill to fit the 700 cap can drop parry or resist, with resist probably the better one to drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553013591400124518)
- **parry armor bonus requirement**: The armor bonus from the Parry skill only works while a shield is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381196671098951)
- **parry requirement**: A Parry skill of 80, rather than 60, is needed for it to be useful in the discussed setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549385257831366657)
- **passive taming skill gains**: Passive taming skill gains still exist, but they are no longer banked from active taming as they used to be. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555401356775522366)
- **passive tracking training in city**: Tracking can reportedly be trained passively in a city by setting the hunting/tracking agent to 'always get closest' instead of 'new when no target', though this comes from a single unconfirmed player report. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546491330358677585)
- **pet animal lore requirement**: Pets do not drop Animal Lore, so you need both Animal Lore and Taming to have pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477246136488047)
- **pet bonding**: To bond a pet, fight alongside it until it reaches level 1, which requires the minimum Taming skill to issue aggressive pet commands; a bonded pet can also be obtained by trade from another player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546869269202210888)
- **pet claiming during taming**: Another player can claim a pet you are taming if it wanders too far from you, for example when a taming script pauses because the pet moved out of range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549472307137749145)
- **pet leveling requirements**: Taming and Animal Lore are both required to use pets in combat so that they level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546709391267340299)
- **pet training bricking**: A pet's training cannot really be bricked, since a pet can still reach level 15 by grinding XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547442795038642317)
- **pet wrestle stat tolerance vs minimum taming**: As a pet's minimum taming requirement increases, its base wrestling rises too, so a player can be more lenient about its wrestle stat when choosing a pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487894067286058)
- **pets attacking their owner**: Pets can attack their owner, which players can use to take damage for training Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554938962051862700)
- **pickpocket dip**: A pickpocket dip is a training dummy used to train stealing and snooping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549111728174792727)
- **pickpocket dip training**: After reaching 80 Snooping and Stealing, publicly accessible pickpocket dip locations can be used to train those skills to GM and beyond. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541493250498634)
- **pickpocket dips training**: To train pickpocket dips, talk to a thief NPC and join the Grayhand thieves guild, which reportedly costs roughly 5k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553265910389932114)
- **pilfering baseline success chance**: Pilfering has a baseline success chance of 75% before creature difficulty is factored in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552081064237863006)
- **pilfering item drop chance**: The chance to get an item, such as a treasure map, while pilfering is quite low, and the range of possible items is wide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550574103746838639)
- **pilfering while invisible**: You can pilfer while invisible from Magery, though mugging is the better option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549715139438055505)
- **pitchfork skill**: Pitchforks use the Fencing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547771916096380929)
- **player resurrection method**: Players can be resurrected only with bandages; veterinary supplies and kits do not work on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101942782857278)
- **poison backstabber alchemy requirement**: A Poison Backstabber build also needs the Alchemy skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555166223732314143)
- **poison spell skill and poison upgrade chance**: Skilling the Poison spell in the Wizard tome influences the chance of a poison upgrade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554426984472379403)
- **poisoner alchemy requirement**: A Poisoner should have 80 Alchemy to use the potion codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225868734922753)
- **poisoner build choice**: The Agorawave aspect is weak, and a normal poisoner using the Poison aspect is much stronger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545921708467290213)
- **poisoning in trap/summon builds**: Poisoning cannot be fully leaned into as a build focus, so some players consider dropping 80 Poisoning from a trap/summon build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298979841609748)
- **poisoning pvm builds**: Several different PvM builds use the Poisoning skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551587023624740985)
- **poisoning training progression**: Train poisoning by using potions in order: Regular poison at 50-60 skill, Greater at 55-80, Deadly at 75-100, and Lethal at 95-120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549871677901373441)
- **prevalia afk training area**: The AFK training area in Prevalia is at the Prevalia Moongate, top left. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553860190577623041)
- **provocation strength**: Provocation has been buffed multiple times recently but is still not strong enough to stand on its own, so pairing it with a combat skill is recommended because monsters do not damage each other much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609126358745258)
- **provocation training**: To train Provocation, run around provoking mobs onto each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551670892419874959)
- **provocation training locations**: Provocation can be trained to 80 in the shelter dungeon, or in the prev zoo if you want to AFK it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555239469475565712)
- **public dip outside prevalia**: A public dip for training backstabber stealing is located just outside Prevalia, at the back of the building by the weapons training dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545960381850058784)
- **pvm arcane mage skill set**: A suggested PvM arcane mage build is 100 Resisting Spells, 100 Focus, 100 Magery, 100 Evaluating Intelligence, 80 Wrestling, 80 Arcane and 80 Alchemy, with remaining points in Meditation until around T10-11 arcane aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546226010712711320)
- **recall spell reagent cost**: One Recall spell cast by a mage requires 1 black pearl, 1 blood moss and 1 mandrake root. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554807216014630955)
- **redline point gaining methods**: Message in a Bottle (MIB) content is the best way to gain redline points, with pits or ocean also good, while treasure maps are currently among the worst for xp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531368826178900048)
- **remove trap skill**: Remove Trap is now part of the Detect Hidden skill, but remove trap tools are still used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554862337918238902)
- **removing box traps**: Use Detect Hidden with remove trap tools to remove a trap from a box; the trap stays gone until a tinker re-traps the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550977402648141839)
- **removing traps from dungeon chests**: To remove traps from locked dungeon chests, you need the Detecting Hidden skill and trap removal tools; double-click the chest to open a gump with the remove-trap option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042217725395045)
- **replacing musicianship with provocation**: Once you have a few points to put into Self Taught in the Bard Codex, you can drop Musicianship and replace it with Provocation, provided the codex requirements of 80+ in two barding skills are met. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553893610829774869)
- **resetting skills on a character**: Instead of deleting a character, a player can set unwanted skills down and work up new skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549588929370394786)
- **resist spells defense**: 100 Resist Spells provides general defense against caster PKs and mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **resisting spells on melee template**: Players who want Resisting Spells on the sword-and-shield template can drop Focus to make room for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457563825709149)
- **resisting spells training 90 to 100**: Training Resisting Spells from 90 to 100 is slow when the enemies being fought are not strong enough, so players need to fight stronger enemies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547406189351145554)
- **resisting spells training above 80**: Above 80 Resisting Spells you must do similar training against casters in the wilderness or let it rise naturally, and the POI Telescope Island is a great spot for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299911667154965)
- **resisting spells training in sanctuary dungeon**: Train Resisting Spells in the weekly Sanctuary dungeon by finding the weakest caster mob and auto-healing, which avoids the risk of PK interruption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495732323459073)
- **resisting spells training location andaria ruined tower**: Andaria Ruined Tower is another place to train Resisting Spells, though Telescope Island is preferred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554480174584692737)
- **resisting spells training to 80**: To train Resisting Spells, train to 50 from a mage NPC, then stand next to casters in the Shelter dungeon and heal yourself to reach 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299819568627885)
- **resisting spells training with banshees**: Banshees are good enemies for training Resisting Spells; one player maxed it in a few hours starting from 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547406189351145554)
- **resource map build direction**: Resource map builds will likely become a hybrid of harvesting and PvM skills, since going in blind requires combat skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531409988340416724)
- **resource map skill**: Under the new system, resource map handling uses the Cartography skill in place of Lock Picking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528170156445143143)
- **resource maps for gathering above 100**: Resource maps should be saved for gathering skill above 100, as they make that grind much faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544630564533833749)
- **resource recovery while training crafting**: While training crafting skills, you should recover as many resources as possible so you can keep crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098464857038890)
- **retaming location for taming skill gain**: To retame animals for taming skill gain, stand inside a building with small rooms in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553575595777065031)
- **retaming same pet change**: The ability to retame the same pet for training is a recent change, so many older taming guides are out of date. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083318901772380)
- **sacred journey buff and chivalry**: The Sacred Journey buff disappears whenever your displayed Chivalry skill value changes, such as while still training the skill; this stops once skills are finalized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555659377577566350)
- **safer pilfering method**: To pilfer more safely, stay in populated dungeons and pilfer from a mob that is already aggroed on someone else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552081446183764111)
- **scavenger benefits**: A scavenger produces loot, lets you learn the dungeons, and yields practically endless meats, reagents and leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554365194560610326)
- **scavenger chest level limits**: A scavenger will likely not open chests above level 6, and adding the harvest aspect makes the build work well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364957674577992)
- **scavenger role activities**: A scavenger hides and skins monster kills made by other players and lockpicks dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364920877813863)
- **self taught bard requirement**: Self Taught requires being invested in all three bard skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186784551796768)
- **self taught codex point requirement**: Self Taught needs only two codex points, assuming the character stays at 80 skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936891072483559)
- **self-taught music skill replacement**: Self-Taught does not replace the Music skill with Musicianship; it replaces it with the lowest of your Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551666308347732002)
- **setting skill lock status**: Click the arrow next to a skill to set it to up, down, or locked; Razor makes it easy to see and change all skills at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918164141150329)
- **setting skills down**: Open the paperdoll, click skills, and click the arrow next to a skill once to set it down, which drains points into skills marked up; click again to lock it so it neither gains nor loses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589539205681235)
- **shadow hands codex effect**: Shadow Hands in the Thieves' codex replaces the snooping skill only for pilfering or mugging, not for stealing from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529674172727300107)
- **shadow hands tier 3 snooping**: With Shadow Hands Tier 3, a player can have 0 printed Snooping and use 100 Hiding skill to get an effective Snooping of 100 for Pilfering and Mugging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549480003320815617)
- **shelter dungeon parry spot**: To train Parrying in Shelter dungeon, bring one mob to the stairs going down from inside the cave under the moongate and keep a shield equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544321026358509648)
- **shelter level 2 mage room**: Level 2 of the Shelter dungeon has a room with 2 mages that trains Resisting Spells to 80 in a few minutes if you can heal through the damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299911667154965)
- **skeletal dragon taming location**: Skeletal dragons may be tamed on level 2 of the Ossuary outside the mini boss room, with a gate right next to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486654562377771)
- **skill and harvest bonus needed for avar map**: A character with 13 Harvest from harvest armor and 102.5 Lumberjacking skill is reported to be enough to harvest an avar map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535707720500514907)
- **skill and stat gain by use**: Skills and stats in Ultima Online are gained by using them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554372782941413408)
- **skill cap stalling**: If a skill stops increasing you may be at the skill cap and need to set another skill to 'down'; check this with [skillmastery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546259928262385815)
- **skill change flexibility**: Changing skills later is easy and a player cannot permanently ruin their skill choices, though investment in an Aspect may need to be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546772439998922772)
- **skill gain at 100% success chance**: Skill gain is typically based on chance to succeed, and with a 100% chance to succeed there are no gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489642299465782)
- **skill gain chance versus xp gain**: Skill gain chance and XP gain are separate mechanics, so improving one does not necessarily affect the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413563221377055)
- **skill lock arrows**: Skill lock arrows direct skill gain: pointing a skill up raises it, pointing it down lowers it, and locking holds it at its current value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567801336733797)
- **skill lock management**: To manage skill locks, set all skills to 'down' first, then set the skills you want to keep training long term back to 'up'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550391268213784617)
- **skill mastery above 100**: Skills above 100 up to 120 require skill mastery scrolls, and not all skills can reach 120; the [skillmastery command shows which skills can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553358883521691684)
- **skill mastery orb sources**: Skill mastery orbs drop as loot from monsters and can also be bought from players and player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971609708896328)
- **skill not gaining due to cap**: If a skill will not gain, run [skillmastery to check whether you have hit the 700 total skill cap; if so, set another skill to 'down' so the wanted skill can gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548184508426231862)
- **skill point transfer from down skills**: Points in skills set to 'down' eventually trade over to skills set to 'up' as those skills gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548188628738383925)
- **skill restrictions in homes and inns**: A few skills do not work or gain in homes or inn rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489489345646716)
- **skill scrolls**: Skill scrolls are used to raise a skill past 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553728523997544560)
- **skills below 80**: Skills below 80 generally accomplish nothing useful, though small leftover points in skills like camping (which raises carry weight capacity) can still be worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690313396944987)
- **skinning effect on forensic evaluation**: Skinning mobs killed during resource map runs may be why Forensic Evaluation rose much faster than the other harvesting skills, though this is only a suspicion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544402378625908849)
- **skinning for fishers**: Fishers benefit from also training skinning because skinning yields double procs of leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533644285205811351)
- **smoke bombs for pilfering thieves**: Smoke bombs can be a life saver for thieves when pilfering, so carry some. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552085247363907627)
- **snooping requirement for pilfering**: You need the Snooping skill at first to pilfer; a Codex perk can later remove that requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549440052839448687)
- **solo bard skill reduction with ebs links**: A solo bard with suitable links can drop bard skills to 100 or even 80 and supplement them with EBS links, freeing points for skills like focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552030925628514356)
- **spear build adaptation**: For a spear build, take a sword-based build and swap Swordsmanship for Fencing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550014139223511062)
- **spell ball usage for magery training**: Save the spell ball until you are ready to train magery, since training in the dungeon gives increased skill gain and players protect the spell ball. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544129349228437565)
- **spellbook casting at 60 magery**: With 60 Magery you can cast from the spellbook without fail, and only one Recall or Mark scroll is needed to add that spell to your spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549623684677767260)
- **spellbook for dungeon lockpicker**: A player's existing spellbook can be used on a dungeon lockpicker because it is already blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543808818323005481)
- **spirit speak and ghost speech**: Spirit Speak likely still allows you to understand ghost speech. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287349802045602)
- **spirit speak and summons on harvesters**: Resource map harvesters are likely to adopt Spirit Speak and summons on their builds to tank mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531419405265670265)
- **spirit speak effect on summons**: Having Spirit Speak makes summoned creatures extra strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553465169189937245)
- **spirit speak for resource maps**: Spirit Speak is useful for doing resource maps, so it should be kept on a harvester template if you plan to do them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521187885083136081)
- **spirit speak summon duration**: Casting Spirit Speak reportedly extends the summon duration of followers, up to a maximum of 30 minutes, and also grants some buffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551556400457580546)
- **spirit speak versus magic resist**: Spirit Speak is mainly an offensive skill; unless you intend to fight back, Magic Resist is the better choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664979446145075)
- **starting dexxer template**: A starting dexxer template is 80 anatomy, 80 arms lore, 100 chivalry, 80 focus, 80 healing, 80 parrying, 100 tactics and 100 weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553775013813952523)
- **stat gain from skill use**: Stats rise as a side effect of using skills, and attacking a trainer NPC also raises them without needing a skill change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547896603942191205)
- **stat gain independent of skills**: Stats (Str, Dex, Int) can be raised independently of skills by setting the stat arrows up or down, so a character with maxed skills can still raise strength, for example by punching a training dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547044243787485246)
- **stat priority for sneaky lockpicker**: For a sneaky lockpicker who does not melee mobs, Intelligence is generally more valuable than Dexterity because the extra mana supports heals and emergency invisibility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550369468809482261)
- **stat raising at skill cap**: Stats can still be raised by hitting the battle trainer even when skill points are capped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551101082346983535)
- **stealing from mobs while lockpicking**: The stealing skill lets you pilfer from mobs while moving between chests when lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553264717143867433)
- **stealing unhidden penalty**: There is no longer a penalty for stealing while unhidden; the former -25% penalty was removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545626952738676826)
- **stealth pets at 80 animal lore**: Some stealth-suited pets can reportedly be tamed and used with 80 Animal Lore (tame lore), though the author is unsure which ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549641868868849780)
- **suggested t-map template**: A suggested treasure map template is 120 Cartography, 120 Alchemy, 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 100 Magery, 80 Spirit Speak and 60 Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541533158845980683)
- **summoner build skill choices with necromancy**: For a summoner focused on own spell damage, Spirit Speak can be dropped; to keep followers doing heavy damage, Focus can be replaced with Herding; Focus can replace Necromancy only if the pet model change is acceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548037456907993099)
- **summoner gatherer build**: A suggested summoner-style gatherer build is 110 Lumberjacking, 110 Forensic Evaluation, 100 Magery, 100 Spirit Speak, 100 Wrestling, 100 Resisting Spells and 100 Tracking, with the Summoner's Tome leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547355574121791518)
- **summoner mage upfront cost**: The summoner mage template has the downside of a small upfront cost to train Magery to 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **summoner reagent upkeep**: A Summoner must source reagents for casting once the initial spell stone runs out of charges or is lost, which adds to loadout upkeep costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **summoner's tome codex requirements**: Having 100 Magery and 80+ Spirit Speak opens up the Summoner's Tome codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **supporting skills for combat builds**: Item Identification boosts use of magic weapons and armor, Arms Lore gives combat bonuses, Alchemy boosts explosion potion damage and heal potion healing, and Healing, Anatomy and Magic Resist add survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548573398500646924)
- **swapping skills at the skill cap**: At the skill cap, set unwanted skills to decrease and keep training the skills you want, so the gains in the wanted skills replace the points lost in the unwanted ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551633658945736745)
- **swing delay by harvest type**: Swing delay is roughly 2 seconds for resource maps, 1 second for mining and 4.2 seconds for lumberjacking, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522354275844489246)
- **sword and shield melee build**: A common sword-and-shield melee build uses 100 chivalry, 100 tactics, 100 mace, and 80 each of healing, anatomy, parry, arms lore, and focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457563825709149)
- **swords codex requirements**: 80+ Swordsmanship and 80+ Tactics opens up the Swords Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **swordsman lumberjacking build suggestion**: A swordsman build that includes Lumberjacking is suggested for exploring and harvesting resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929281656950926)
- **tactics requirement for chivalry and codex**: Tactics is needed for the codex, and the Chivalry skill is capped by your Tactics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552345357986439260)
- **tactics requirement for melee skills**: Tactics is required for any melee skill build, including throwing and archery, because it determines damage while the melee skills themselves determine accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552175754337583115)
- **tailoring profitability**: Tailoring is cheap to train and has good societies because leather prices are low, so even a 100 skill tailor is profitable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544308179821920316)
- **tame-release training location restriction**: Tame-release taming training cannot be done in your inn room or in a house you have access to; it must be done elsewhere, such as near a stable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554300474100809832)
- **tame-release-retame method**: The tame-release-retame method only works for a limited time before you must tame a creature with a higher minimum taming skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553404650848522345)
- **tamer 4x taming echoes build**: A tamer build using 4x taming echoes is used for treasure maps and dungeons, and lacking enough echoes forces compromises such as dropping forensic evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539659879151566931)
- **tamer build speed versus summoners**: Tamer is a very slow character to build, while summoner builds such as Necromancers, Nox summoners and Herding summoners get going quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551743193597612145)
- **tamer codex priorities**: A tamer should seek whichever codices they meet the skill requirements for based on their template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159899532787763)
- **tamer double harvesting build**: A Tamer with 120 Taming, Animal Lore, Herding, Veterinary, Mining and Lumberjacking works well for double harvesting skills and avoids needing a separate echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536918480983425065)
- **tamer healer's codex skills**: For a tamer, the healer's codex skill Without Borders (range healing) is recommended, along with Specialist, Over Heal and Triage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554784778614603809)
- **tamer skills for commanding pets**: To command tamed pets, a tamer needs Animal Taming and Animal Lore at a minimum, and ideally also Herding and Veterinary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569693047521402)
- **tamer weapon skill split**: Tamers who also use a weapon typically put 80 points into Tactics and 80 into their chosen weapon skill (e.g. Fencing) so they can use the weapon codex, alongside four 120 taming-related skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778129301012513)
- **taming 120 underdog bonuses**: Having 120 Animal Taming gives more Underdog bonuses when taming creatures with lower taming requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546177189312073889)
- **taming and lore gain from pets in combat**: On UO Outlands, players can gain Animal Taming and Animal Lore skill by using pets in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547367778267168920)
- **taming health requirements**: Neither the player's health nor the creature's health affects whether it can be tamed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552397465817190441)
- **taming skill training**: To train taming, buy the cheapest tamable creature in the 95-105 skill range from the Broker and tame it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493921812455445)
- **taming skill training method**: Taming can be trained up to 120 by repeatedly taming the same pet, provided the pet's taming requirement is high enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554082039517679689)
- **taming training targets**: Any creature close to your current taming skill level works for gaining skill; the wiki recommends various Ostards as targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553027974981484565)
- **tank dexxer skill build**: A common tank dexxer build is 120 Chivalry, 100 Tactics, 100 weapon skill, 80 Healing, 80 Anatomy, 80 Focus, 80 Arms Lore and 80 Parrying; variants use 0 Focus with 80 Alchemy, take Resisting Spells, raise Parrying to 100, or raise Arms Lore to 100 or 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555428454235775138)
- **tank dexxer skill choices**: Parry, Alchemy, and Focus are probably better skills for a tank dexxer to have, though this is a tentative suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554209060151369769)
- **taste identification and cooking stacking**: Having both Taste Identification and Cooking does not give a better food buff than having just one of the two skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554357246454923326)
- **taunt skill requirement**: The game does not allow Taunt to be used until the skill reaches 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554578618217275504)
- **template build speed**: Any template build can be completed in a few days in Outlands, while the custom content that advances a character is practically endless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560617472335883)
- **template statue skill limit**: At first you can only set your 7 main skills to 60 using the template statue, though you can add a few temporary utility skills such as Magic Resist and drop them later when you need the points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548185869075226756)
- **terran stables for taming training**: The stables in Terran are good for taming training because they are small enclosed areas where the animal cannot run off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452748754395278)
- **thief build**: A thief most likely needs a back stabber build, which is complicated to start but safer, though kills are often stolen if you do not deal enough damage and others may think you stole their kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553851707891388569)
- **thief codex skill requirements**: Using the thief codex requires temporarily holding both stealing and snooping, so a couple of other skills must be given up until the codex is trained, after which snooping can be dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544623453645181008)
- **thief playstyles**: Thief playstyles include a backstabber who steals (mugs) from monsters on the first backstab hit, a pilferer who sneaks past and steals from mobs without combat, a dungeon chest picker, and a player thief, all of which can benefit from hiding plus stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711164686311494)
- **thief skill training script**: Thief skills can be trained with a script running overnight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477070403543121)
- **thief tamer skill slot requirements**: A thief tamer build needs 4 skill slots for taming-related skills and 4 slots for thieving skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478380167237764)
- **thief tamer training order**: A thief tamer can train Taming to 100 with Animal Lore 100 and Veterinary 100 first, then train the thief skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477524894126203)
- **thief viability**: Thieves are a viable build, whether grayhand stealing from monsters or redhand stealing from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546710675475271710)
- **thieves codex hiding as snooping**: With Stealing and Snooping at least 80 you can get a thieves codex, and one of its abilities lets Hiding act as effective Snooping once points are invested, so Snooping can be dropped afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553265533384659015)
- **thieves codex rework**: After the codex rework, the Overlooked ability in the thieves codex changed significantly, while the rest of the thieves codex is equally good or much improved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545452116955496520)
- **throwing skill ammo requirement**: The Throwing skill does not require a quiver or arrows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545095230951399554)
- **time to master crafting skills**: Mastering tailoring, tinkering, carpentry and blacksmithy took one player about 70 days, and harvesting all the boards and ingots required 111 lumberjacking and 108 mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545844015101124729)
- **time to reach t15 harvest aspect via lumberjacking**: One player reached T15 Harvest aspect through lumberjacking in about 60 days by chopping roughly 3 hours per day, so the time required varies with playtime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525907079217418270)
- **timing of replacing musicianship with self taught**: A bard should wait until all 20 codex points are spent before removing Musicianship in favor of Self Taught. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936771056926842)
- **tinkering bead gem cost**: Beads crafted while training Tinkering require gems as a material, which makes this training method expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217633708220442)
- **tinkering leveling order for trappers**: For a trapper build, the preferred tinkering leveling order is lanterns, then lockpicks, then trap detonators, then candelabras. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551216353560633385)
- **tool quality effect on harvesting**: A higher-quality (exceptional or colored) tool gives only a very small increase in the chance of harvesting quality material, so a normal iron or copper tool is fine for training Mining and Lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544394198881542237)
- **tool quality effect on skill gain**: It is unconfirmed whether higher-quality tools or harvested materials speed up harvesting skill gain, and any effect is likely very small. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544396950898606130)
- **total skill cap**: The base total skill cap is 700, and eating 20 skill mastery orbs raises it by 20 points to a maximum of 720. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971275167015056)
- **tracking arrow**: If the tracking arrow disappears, stop tracking and start tracking again to restore it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551699261190570005)
- **tracking at 120 skill**: At 120 Tracking a player can recall around to locate targets easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533027434268459018)
- **tracking detect hidden target filter**: To make Tracking or Detect Hidden detect all players (blue, gray, red), click the left/right arrow next to the three figures icon until it shows three white figures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555581064075018344)
- **tracking for single resource maps**: Tracking is not needed for single resource maps because summons can tank anything in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **tracking people inside houses**: Tracking can be turned on to detect people inside houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533091159981953217)
- **tracking skill bonuses**: Players always receive their Damage and Barding Skill bonuses from the Tracking skill even if they are not currently Hunting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544154142262558810)
- **tracking skill effectiveness against pks**: At 60 Tracking, a PK can cover about 55 tiles between tracking ticks while Tracking extends detection only about 42 tiles beyond the 18-tile sight distance and fails 40% of the time, so for survival against PKs 100+ Tracking is great, 90 is okay, and 80 or less is about as useful as none. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **tracking skill for miners**: Tracking is considered the most important skill for a mining build because it detects nearby PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664819060146226)
- **tracking skill in two-harvesting-skill template**: When running two harvesting skills, Tracking does not fit in the skill template, but treasure maps can still be done without Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536828371403546784)
- **tracking skill mechanics**: Tracking checks run once every 5 seconds, and the Tracking skill value sets both the chance to detect players and the range in tiles (for example 60 skill gives a 60% chance at up to 60 tiles). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **tracking skill usage**: Tracking is not passive; it must be actively used, and a player can switch between tracking blue players and red players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533091159981953217)
- **tracking skill usage**: To use tracking, open the skill scroll, go to the wilderness category and drag Tracking onto the viewport to create a tracking bubble; double click it and turn on hunting mode, then use the slider to track red, orange or grey players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570328400830477)
- **tracking target setting system message**: A system message tells you what you are tracking whenever you change the tracking target setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555582288543219783)
- **tracking trainer on shelter island**: On Shelter Island, the Ranger near the moongate teaches Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559951382872175)
- **tracking versus detect hidden**: Tracking detects hidden players when they are nearby, while Detect Hidden only increases the range at which they are detected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521200154911309935)
- **tracking warning chance**: With 60 Tracking skill there is a 60% chance of being warned about someone 60 tiles away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542041718654898226)
- **training bard skills with self-taught**: With Self-Taught, macro-train Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance to at least 80 each before farming again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551666723797860484)
- **training fishing with nets**: Throwing nets at fishing spots at sea is a much faster way to train Fishing than regular fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548464821437988965)
- **training herding afk**: Herding can be trained AFK by repeatedly using a shepherd's crook, and it is about as easy to AFK as Animal Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478172813299834)
- **training hiding to 80**: Hiding can be trained to 80 quickly inside NPD. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452222079828100)
- **training hiding, stealth and animal lore in shelter**: Skills such as hiding and stealth can be trained to 80 in the Shelter dungeon, and lore on your mount there can raise Animal Lore to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549594674501652521)
- **training magery to 80 and 100**: Use a max spell charge stone to get magery to 80 for free; reaching 100 magery then requires spending gold on reagents and a full spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555708144737591417)
- **training magic resist**: To train Magic Resist, find a spot with caster mobs and let them cast spells at you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544550134048620554)
- **training parrying to 80**: To train Parrying to 80, pull a group of weak mobs such as birds and set up a macro to heal yourself, or train in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551305045327224865)
- **training pets and lore**: To train pets and Animal Lore, make your pets attack a battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478663169515541)
- **training provocation quickly**: To train Provocation quickly, drop music, train Provocation to 50, then provoke mobs in the shelter dungeon up to 80 before farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553894549607153705)
- **training taming to 120**: A nightmare or a wisp can be used to train Animal Taming up to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493862777626756)
- **training tracking skill**: Train tracking by tracking mobs in the Shelter dungeon until 80 skill, then track anything in a town afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546116620676505611)
- **trap avoidance on chests**: With 120 Lockpicking, 120 Detect Hidden, Level 1 Harvester Aspect and a Mastercrafted Agapite remove trap tool, there is a 100% chance not to set off a trap on chests up to level 6. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **trap kit**: The Trap Kit gives bonuses to ground traps, and using it effectively requires Tinkering and Detect Hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547024047873986620)
- **trapper build and mapper build skills**: After a recent patch, the trapper build deals much more damage and lockpicking downtime is no longer needed to skin, so Forensic Evaluation can be dropped from a mapper build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542360904094720092)
- **trapper skill requirements**: A trapper needs more than tinkering, including likely alchemy for its bonus to trap damage percent and detect hidden, though this is recalled with uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550068332751749182)
- **trapper template**: One possible trapper template is 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 100 Magery, 100 Poisoning, 100 Taste Identification, 100 Meditation or Evaluating Intelligence, and 80 Spirit Speak, leaving no room for Necromancy if Detect Hidden is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545583699012091956)
- **treasure map builds**: Suggested builds for treasure maps include tinker trapper, mage tamer, bard tamer, dexxer tamer and necro summoner, though some are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550789180970500157)
- **treasure map mapper template**: A common mapper template is 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 120 Cartography, 100 Tracking, 100 Magery, 80 Spirit Speak and 80 Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541775867737542797)
- **treasure map xp after patch**: Treasure maps still give XP after the patch; only the mechanics of the maps changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536744478629437490)
- **treasure map xp and time**: Tier 4 treasure maps give about 200 XP and take around 5 minutes to complete, while tier 3 maps give roughly 160 XP (less certain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541205891133476925)
- **treasure map xp history**: Treasure maps were very good for xp until the Wildlands expansion, after which xp shifted to other activities unless you mass rush tier 8 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531369146405621961)
- **tri bard alternative build**: Some players skip the full tri bard and take just one bard skill plus musicianship instead, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548697123019690085)
- **tri bard codex abilities**: A tri bard using the Bard Codex has peace, provocation and discord available without needing the music skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555015006209187862)
- **tri bard templates**: A solo tri bard template is 120 chivalry, 100 tactics, 80 provocation, 80 peacemaking, 80 discordance, 80 weapon skill, 80 healing, 80 anatomy and 20 camping, while a group tri bard template is 120 chivalry, 100 tactics, 90 provocation, 90 peacemaking, 90 discordance, 85 weapon skill, 85 focus and 60 camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548702180024786976)
- **typical build skill count**: Most builds focus on 6 to 8 skills and leave all other skills at zero. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551632810706600028)
- **typical pvm defensive build**: A typical PvM build that can defend itself includes 100 weapon skill and 80-100 Resisting Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553450035700834406)
- **using animal lore at zero skill**: Animal Lore can be used even at 0 skill, either by clicking the skill on the paperdoll or by single-clicking the creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145071742484605)
- **utility character for item identification**: Putting Item Identification on a utility character on another account works well for identifying items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553527042010521611)
- **vengeful spirit ability for daemon summoners**: A summoner who wants to keep daemons can ignore the Vengeful Spirit necromancy ability and still benefit from Necromancy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548028228898127917)
- **veterinary training method**: To train Veterinary, use a tank pet and a low-damage 1-slot pet, have the 1-slotter attack the tank pet, and bandage the tank pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549462317882802362)
- **veterinary training method**: Training Veterinary by AFK bandaging is slow, but it can also be leveled while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549972971236495391)
- **veterinary training with magical wizard hat**: Training Veterinary with a magical wizard hat would be a waste of veterinary supplies, because bandages are plentiful, cheap and easier to get in bulk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549471366623793155)
- **weapon skill above 80 bonuses**: Weapon skill above 80, such as archery, grants accuracy and melee defense bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553523965962489937)
- **weekly wilderness harvest xp bonus**: Harvest skill experience gained in the wilderness rises 20% faster during the week of 2026-07-13. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526134135184166932)
- **wiki crafting training guides**: The wiki has training guides for every crafting skill at the bottom of each skill page, and these are generally the best ways to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553100377493213246)
- **wiki skills and stats npc trainer list**: The Outlands wiki 'Skills & Stats' page lists which NPC teaches each skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559973361033277)
- **without borders trait value**: The Without Borders trait of the Healer Codex is considered a game changer for veterinary supplies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547232442115428412)
- **wizard satchels for magery reagent costs**: Wizard satchels can be used to reduce reagent costs when training or using Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666638985437239)
- **wrestling for mages**: Wrestling is not strictly required for mages unless they are arcane mages, but it gives melee defense and perks such as a mana refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553520623618232415)
- **wrestling gain absence at skill cap**: If the fighting animation plays but Wrestling does not gain, the character is likely at skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549672088103817269)
- **wrestling recall protection**: 100 Wrestling gives a 50% chance to prevent Recall from being interrupted by physical damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **wrestling training and trainer**: Wrestling is trained by fighting with bare fists, and the Wrestling trainer NPC in Shelter is named Beaman. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669695542657025)
- **wrestling weapon skill gain**: Using a wrestling weapon likely gives an accuracy bonus, but wrestling skill gain is probably the same as when using fists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551191287728705678)
