- **zoo monsters for skill training**: The zoo monsters are unkillable, so players can train skills on them whenever they like. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341828337860659)

## Harvesting & resources

- **harvest aspect armor requirement**: The Harvest aspect only needs to be on worn armor to give the double proc and aspect experience; aspecting pickaxes or hatchets does nothing, and skinning gives aspect experience except in Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555364762815303713)
- **harvest aspect double procs**: The Harvest aspect gives double procs (shown as a green oval animation) that double the resources gained, and these work on skinning but not directly on fishing spots, so fishers should also skin. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553123105587855461)
- **harvesting aspect importance**: Players broadly consider the Harvesting Aspect the most important investment for harvesting such as chopping and mining, and something to level quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **resource map decoding after patch**: After the patch, resource maps are undecoded again: players must travel to the location and follow an arrow during a roughly 15 second base decode timer, and the recent patch also limits players to one resource map at a time with delays between maps, though maps already started may be handled differently. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544439648535842867)
- **resource map skill requirement**: Resource maps do not require Cartography; only the relevant harvesting skill (effective harvest skill, including bonuses) is needed to use them. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549747234437070929)
- **resource maps and normal harvesting**: Normal non-map harvesting is unchanged by the patch, while resource maps changed: newly generated maps now have a static default total harvestable amount instead of a randomized one, and players commonly say maps are only worthwhile for skill gain after 100 skill, though it is unclear whether the patch changed that. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544398946804170772)
- **fishing map resource values after patch**: After the latest patch, fishing maps were consolidated and rebalanced so they no longer carry static per-quality resources; lower-quality maps like dullscale yield far more resources than before, and stored map counts were reduced to compensate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542757612838195220)
- **harvest skill links value**: Harvest skill links are generally not worth buying, except for fishing on the ocean; for skinning they are marginal, and for lumberjacking and mining they are not worthwhile, since leveling skill naturally is more cost-effective, and links are a separate system from the Harvest aspect even though both give effective harvesting skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538293174059929772)
- **lumberjacking versus mining yield and value**: Lumberjacking gathers logs faster than mining yields ingots, but ore and ingots sell for more than logs, so income from selling lumber and from mining ends up roughly similar. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551634942855745597)
- **outlands butler harvesting calculator**: The Outlands Butler website at outlandsbutler.com/harvesting is a calculator where you enter aspect level, skill, tool and harvest links to see which ores or nodes you can harvest and how close you are to never failing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536826670248497282)
- **resource map location lookup**: The new resource map system guides players to the map location, so they no longer need an external lookup tool or to search Explore Outlands, and locations can include nodes that did not exist before. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544771569962852423)
- **shelter island gathering penalty**: Gathering on Shelter Island is possible but is penalized to 50% of normal gathering rates. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554353639282180218)
- **summoner for resource maps**: A summoner harvester is well suited to resource maps because summoned creatures soak aggro and fight off monsters while the player harvests. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546222802883977327)
- **dungeon mining in nusero**: Forges were added to Nusero so mining can be done inside the dungeon; it is less profitable than harvesting or PvM alone but is a fun way to combine them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536195794842161203)
- **fishing resource map yields**: Fishing resource maps now yield the average of the old range, so higher tier maps give fewer resources and lower tier maps give more, with roughly the same total over time. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349879478980689)
- **harvest aspect proc source**: Harvesting bonuses come from armor, not weapons or tools, so aspect crystals, which proc the weapon, do not add harvest double procs, and a Harvest weapon proc is not worthwhile. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545834958906597386)
- **mining skill needed for 100% avarite**: Reaching a 100% chance on Avarite ore depends on effective Mining skill (printed skill plus harvest aspect plus tool bonus, about 139.1% needed); for example 120 Mining with Harvest aspect 15 and a Shadow Iron tier exceptional tool is reported sufficient. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536826568524038154)
- **resource map timers**: The new resource map system adds waiting timers (about 15 seconds per wait, roughly 30 seconds of extra delay per run) and about 5 clicks every 2 minutes, though its loading delay is still faster than finding map locations by hand under the old system. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544493514212122635)
- **resource node respawn time**: Resource nodes respawn after a random time of roughly 30 to 60 minutes rather than a set time. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523053943540678766)
- **smart harvesting**: To smart harvest, double click the harvesting tool and target yourself; it harvests everything in range for mining, lumberjacking, skinning and fishing, and for lumberjacking it chops all trees in range and tells you to move when they are empty. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424842977710130)
- **avar resource maps after update**: Avarite, avarscale, avarhide and avarwood maps remain worth doing one at a time by following the arrow minigame after the update. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530729892608610526)
- **avarite harvest map ore yield**: A tier 14 harvester has obtained 80+ Avar ore from a single map, and four post-patch Avarite maps are expected to yield about 240 ore plus harvest procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540473979746390038)
- **boat fishing node locations**: Boat fishing nodes have been seen spawning in rivers connected to the ocean but have not been seen in large lakes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548303038932852897)
- **bulk resource map decoding**: Resource maps can currently be decoded in bulk while the player is away, such as overnight, and each decode has a 15 second wait time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528885838673481748)
- **collecting dungeon leather with blank commodities**: Skinning mobs in dungeons yields plain leather, which can be collected as commodities by bringing blank commodities along. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677766417059981)
- **dangerous ore map destinations**: The Tarsands Tarpits and Fury's Caldera are very dangerous ore map destinations with constant PvM combat and AoE attacks, so players may need to bring a group under the new ore map system. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533488526438699079)
- **effective skill and 2x procs on resource maps**: Effective skill does not affect the chance of 2x procs on resource maps; only the harvest aspect determines it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540481576293507152)
- **guild favor harvest buffs on maps**: Guild favor harvest buffs, including the 25% chance for 2x harvest, do not affect treasure map chests or resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540907958781878404)
- **harvest map tier yield**: Higher-tier harvest maps have more casts and net more resources overall (roughly 30% more on Avarscale than Dullscale, an uncertain estimate), while lower resource maps were best for special fish. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534352671064981544)
- **harvest quantity per node**: The quantity of resources obtained per node on a successful harvest is determined only by a harvest proc, and effective harvest does not otherwise affect quantity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554540490085371965)
- **harvester pk risk**: Harvesters earn good money but are high-value targets for PKs and thieves, so carrying lots of ore or wood is risky. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553997704395235349)
- **harvesting map requirements**: Using a harvesting map requires only the relevant harvesting skill and an explorer's pack, which is consumed when the map is used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **iron pick sufficiency for avarite**: With about 139.1-139.25 effective harvest skill, an exceptional master crafted iron pick (0.08 bonus) reaches 100% success on Avarite, so better picks only add charges. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **lumberjacking nodes and trees**: Lumberjacking resource nodes are tied to actual trees, though not every tree, which makes them easier to locate than mining nodes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522715322078072903)
- **mining and lumberjacking optimization**: For mining and lumberjacking, skill plus the harvest aspect is sufficient, and further improvement comes from choosing better tools rather than links; lumberjacking may be a better choice than mining for leveling harvest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394045929914551)
- **mining and lumberjacking xp contribution**: Mining and Lumberjacking (chopping) do not contribute to Mastery Chain, Redline Mastery or Codex XP, whereas harvesting from chests does. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550849277813588032)
- **mining from horseback**: Mining can be done while mounted on a horse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551620569827385369)
- **ocean fishing spots**: Fishing spots spawn on the ocean where nets can be tossed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668874133512225)
- **ore smelting**: Smelting ore cannot fail, so smelting a whole pile at once is as good as one piece at a time, and because ore is heavy players must periodically smelt between mining. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555006395118653553)
- **rare leather chance modifiers**: Per the wiki, only the carving knife increases the chance of rare leather; 120 Forensic Evaluation instead of 110 gives only more damage bonus and slightly more leather amount. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546251861466808381)
- **resource map average yield**: A resource map yields on average about 213 resources (ore or wood), and with the T15 harvest aspect the expected yield is about 1.38 times the base amount. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540485214898356305)
- **resource map changes**: The resource map changes make maps safer, with a very low knowledge requirement and trivial completion, so players can pick up and go without third-party tools. They keep maps to specific locations valuable and prevent multiboxing and stockpiling thousands of maps for scripted runs; a camping requirement seen on test was a bug believed fixed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536003805374709760)
- **resource map decoding requirement**: Decoding resource maps requires an explorer pack in the backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551087304486035538)
- **resource map hiking dances**: Hiking to a resource map involves the character dancing twice for 15 seconds each, with a jog between the dances. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536822591833120799)
- **resource map picture lookup removal**: The resource map overhaul removes the picture-lookup step on exploreoutlands, so players no longer need an external website to decode maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536406270674739261)
- **resource map purpose**: Resource maps are used mainly to obtain a specific type of ore or lumber rather than to maximize gold, and are mostly used for ore rather than wood; hitting regular trees yields more gold for less effort. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531360069688758403)
- **resource map rewards**: The resource map overhaul adds no extra loot or XP; the reward is still colored ore and skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536756884642472057)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Under the new resource map system, a harvester only needs the harvesting skill related to the map type, and cartography and camping are not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534359142758613192)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Opening mining or lumberjacking resource maps requires explorer's packs and the matching harvesting skill (mining or lumberjacking), and cartography is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554894315082490078)
- **resource map spot monster spawns**: Resource map spawn locations were moved out of monster range, so the first trip to a spot is relatively safe, but spots can still have unrelated monster spawn around them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554894433768570932)
- **resource map steps**: Decode the map (1 Explorer Pack, 15-second wait), travel to the area (60 Camping or Cartography), follow the arrow to the location, reveal the camp (1 Explorer Pack, 15-second wait), then harvest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536752443239436378)
- **resource maps and colored resources**: Colored ore and logs come from random chance in normal gathering, while resource maps let you harvest a guaranteed amount of one specific color; you must meet that color's minimum requirements to use its map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544630120264900608)
- **scavenger leather gathering**: A single scavenger character can bank enough leather for a tailor crafter and can also serve as a fund raiser for other characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367268375232553)
- **skinning leather yield**: For skinning (Forensic Evaluation harvesting), higher effective harvest skill, including from harvest links, yields more leather per skin. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **sorting harvest maps by location**: To group harvest maps by location, sort them by hand into separate tomes by picture, then by zone, then by individual node. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534650830706442343)
- **t8 treasure chest opening time**: Picking a T8 treasure chest can take around 10 minutes even with T15 harvest, 115 lockpicking and avarite tools, while the chest becomes publicly open after 2 minutes, so it can be blown up faster. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537952379364974704)
- **taming-based gatherer build**: A gatherer build using 4x taming skills lets pets handle combat while harvesting, and one such build survived being dropped into the middle of Fury's Caldera better than other builds tested. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532872864200654919)
- **time to mine 213 ore via resource map**: Completing a resource map for about 213 ore currently takes a little over a minute, compared with roughly 3 minutes (about 2m40s for a top Tier 15 miner) to mine the same amount the traditional way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528214152580038707)
- **tool choice for resource maps**: For resource maps, only an iron harvesting tool is needed because the coloured item is guaranteed anyway; using any other tool is a waste. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535991596552687646)
- **treasure map 2x yield chance**: After the latest update, treasure maps still grant a 2x yield chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539396264838299648)
- **unminable rare-looking ore vein**: The rare-looking ore vein that cannot be mined is related to the Ruined Lyceum Library quest and still needs to be researched. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549866878032158751)
- **8x8 grid in caves**: In caves, the 8x8 grid can be turned on with the 'trees as stumps' option in options, but it does not always work in every cave and the nodes may not have all loaded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522989605933158460)
- **Avar/Vale node links**: Avar/Vale nodes are rare, so investing in links is not worth it while leveling skill and aspect, as they won't matter once skill and aspect are high. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521374175363596390)
- **active resource map binding**: When a resource map becomes active it is blessed and bound, so it is not lost if the player is forced out; the player must wait for the threat to clear or intentionally abandon the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528899393611370557)
- **aegis keep level 4 chests**: Aegis Keep level 4 (AK4) has about 20 level 6 chests in a relatively small dungeon level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045536842879078)
- **announced lumberjacking spots**: Announcing a lumberjacking spot publicly invites player-killer ganking, so players should avoid spots that others announce. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547877627606339635)
- **arcane essence and harvest armor bonus**: Running out of arcane essence can stop harvest armor's bonus from working, which can prevent mining avararite maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935882629320877)
- **arcane essence on test server**: On the test server, obtain arcane essence by using the stockpile in Prevalia, which stocks it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548692374371442739)
- **arcane essence stockpile on test center**: Arcane essence can be obtained from a stockpile, which on the test center is available from the same statue and can be locked down in an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555558870540091444)
- **aspect choice for special fishing nets**: Fortune aspect is the better choice than harvest aspect for throwing special fishing nets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536085282489639103)
- **automating mining and fishing**: Mining and fishing can be automated with a script, macro, or hotkey on a loop, leaving the player to move, run from reds, and fill out captchas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554258983668293726)
- **avar resource skill requirement**: Avar resources are expected to require 110 skill, counting effective skill from bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532863106223575293)
- **avarite map drop rate**: Avarite maps rarely drop as loot while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531063505267065062)
- **avarite never-fail threshold and treasure maps**: The tool-based never-fail threshold for Avarite applies only to traditional harvesting and does not help with treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **avarite pickaxe base ratio**: An avarite pickaxe has a base ratio of 0.18. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825233779069115)
- **avarite pickaxe success rates**: With 120 mining, T15 Harvest, exceptional mastercrafted tools and zero links, an iron pickaxe has a 98.6% success rate on Avarite, and Shadow Iron may be needed for 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538996139070853210)
- **avarscale fishing map yield cap**: After the new harvest map changes, the Avarscale fishing map's resource yield appears capped at 35. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534350730067050496)
- **backstabber template for harvesting while killing mobs**: A backstabber is about the only template that makes harvesting while killing mobs work well, excluding skinning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530286296793223229)
- **batch running resource maps**: Under the new resource map system, players typically collect resource maps from PvM and run them as a batch once they have enough to justify switching echos. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544387268913930382)
- **best harvesting activity for guild caravan gauge**: Lumberjacking is the most efficient harvesting activity for filling the guild caravan gauge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542914413969809531)
- **best hatchet for lumberjacking**: The best hatchet depends on your Lumberjacking skill and harvest tier; aim for as close to a 100% chance to get avarwood as possible, since any chance beyond that is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **best resource maps**: Fishing maps are considered the best resource maps because they yield all three resource types and have a high ore count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538689552699490357)
- **blessed traveler's lantern source**: Blessed traveler's lanterns come only from ore maps, though a player vendor might sell them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549648095179055137)
- **boat fishing spots**: Fishing spots on a boat have no timers and are pretty competitive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534882548260405308)
- **boat hold leather storage**: A boat hold can store leather gathered while fishing at sea, so character weight is not a concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527453077928677407)
- **bugged fishing treasure map spots**: If a fishing treasure map has a bugged, unreachable spot, put the map in your bank and submit a help request, after which staff give you a different map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520975397737467955)
- **caddelite ore use**: Caddelite Ore, found at the meteor impact sites, is decoration only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533927048576368701)
- **camping for lumberjacks**: Camping is mostly useless for a lumberjack under the current rules. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530273007195656425)
- **camping links for miners**: Camping links are an option for a miner because they let the harvester hold more ore, while follower defensive/offensive links are an option for a summoner route. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528480933215473776)
- **cannot produce any wood message**: The message 'you cannot produce any wood from that' means the tree was recently harvested and is out of wood, so move to a different tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525056537998004294)
- **captcha harvesting timeout duration**: The harvesting timeout for missing multiple Captchas is 6 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527637429014499328)
- **carry capacity risk while mining**: Reaching your carry capacity while mining leaves you vulnerable, and a PK can kill you and take some of your ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526218597356142592)
- **character for collecting hides**: For collecting hides and similar materials, a dexxer (backstabber or regular) with Forensic Evaluation is recommended, since a pure dungeon-crawling harvester is less efficient after the recent gold decay nerf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550617182461886579)
- **cheaper hatchets at high skill**: With high harvest tier and roughly 110-120 Lumberjacking skill, using a lower-end hatchet is cheaper because you still keep the maximum chance to get colored wood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **checking for blue players while gathering**: While gathering, periodically use Tracking to check for blue (non-criminal) players nearby so you are not sneaked up on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205912015831052)
- **chest loot and recycling**: It is worth taking everything from chests, and unidentified items can be recycled for materials including essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550870515063726195)
- **colored leather rarity from scavenging**: Scavenging mostly yields dull through roughly gold-tier leather, and only occasionally; rose through avar leather is practically never found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551001475109490811)
- **colored node discovery**: Your tool, skill, and aspect have no impact on how many colored resource nodes you find; they only affect harvesting results once a node is found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored node harvesting below skill requirement**: If your effective skill is below the requirement for a colored ore node you found, harvesting from it defaults to iron ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored node swing success chance**: Once you have found a colored node, the chance of a successful swing is calculated from your skill plus your tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored ore acquisition rate**: Colored ore comes in slowly unless you invest in ore maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544716281180192878)
- **colored ore gather amount**: The amount of colored ore gathered is not fixed and depends on the player's skill and the colored axe used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526777445867454474)
- **colored ore node yield mechanics**: Mining node colors spawn randomly and cannot be predicted or altered; on a colored node each swing has a 50% chance to yield colored ore and a 50% chance to yield iron, so later swings can still yield colored ore after iron swings, and at 107 Mining roughly 18% of nodes are colored (uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533142646514516188)
- **colored pickaxes harvesting success**: Colored pickaxes improve the success chance of harvesting ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740313182732470)
- **combat skills versus summons for harvesters**: Giving a harvester combat skills instead of summons costs harvesting time because the character spends it fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526693929947369544)
- **combining partially harvested maps**: Partially harvested maps placed in a tome combine into new, untouched maps once the change goes live, provided the numbers are large enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534378795556012145)
- **cooking meat sources**: Meats for cooking must be obtained by hunting monsters, and Forensic Evaluation yields better meats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554329141015486508)
- **crafted hatchet durability**: Crafted hatchets last longer than vendor hatchets, and a mastercrafted iron axe has 1000 uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549010564766892106)
- **crafted shovel use after patch**: After the latest patch, crafted shovels reportedly have no use other than digging dirt clumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541785473666785301)
- **decoding fishing resource maps**: To use a fishing resource map, decode it using the fishing skill plus an explorer pack and wait for the decode to finish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **defensive harvester setup**: A good defensive harvester setup is 120 hit points and the resist spell, with tracking kept up to spot reds, then running or using a hike macro when a red appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535322218890797087)
- **delectable food and harvesting**: Eating delectable food gives no harvesting bonus; it only provides mana regeneration and swing speed increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544450663386456094)
- **detect hidden value while gathering**: Detect Hidden is valuable while gathering because thieves and sneaky blue PKs using Chivalry gate are nearly as dangerous as openly hostile PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554206573927337985)
- **digging up resource map nodes**: At the exact spot of a resource map, dig up the resource node, which also consumes an explorer pack, and then harvest it with the normal tool (a fishing rod for fishing maps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **double harvest procs**: Double harvest procs occur frequently, giving a seed together with ore in the same swing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547931043007430677)
- **dull copper ore weight**: Carrying a large amount of dull copper ore, such as 400, is heavy, so it is better to go home and unload it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349558031585352)
- **dull copper pickaxe avarite success**: With 120 mining skill and T15 Harvest aspect, an exceptional mastercrafted dull copper pickaxe with zero links has a 100% success rate on Avarite nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **dungeon chest harvesting experience**: Each dungeon chest reportedly gives a fixed amount of harvesting experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537509383095980052)
- **dungeon locked chests**: Every dungeon floor has locked chests that drop loot, and you can stealth, lockpick and disarm traps on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479704363532483)
- **dye drops from resource map digging**: Dyes found while digging on resource maps are not looted as items; they simply appear with a small audible cue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535056884799635581)
- **earth elementals for map protection**: Two summoned earth elementals are enough protection against PvM threats in almost all places when running resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528897759103680692)
- **earth elementals tanking for harvesters**: With 80 spirit speak, 100 magery and a leveled summoners codex, summoned earth elementals can tank for a harvester until the player moves off screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530286252027281619)
- **effective skill target for skinning**: An effective skill of about 110 is probably enough for Skinning, though going higher yields slightly more leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526795418787385355)
- **empty treasure chest drop**: After the patch, destroying a treasure map chest reportedly still gives a chance to receive an empty treasure chest item, though this is secondhand and unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545550202444718131)
- **escape methods for gatherers**: Use both a hotkeyed Atlas hiking script and recalling for escapes, and keep your rune book fully charged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554208197819109528)
- **escaping weak harvester pks**: Against weak harvester PKs, you can outheal their damage, finish your harvesting, and then recall away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549832994783760385)
- **event seed growth**: Event seeds grow in a few hours with no extra steps needed, though the displayed progress may update slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075903666888747)
- **event seed growth progress**: Event seeds progress faster the closer their conditions are to optimal levels, which can be checked with a character that has Taste Identification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075739250294805)
- **exceptional tool bonus for mining**: Exceptional and master crafted mining tools give a tool bonus that increases the chance to mine colored ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554845818383503471)
- **farming skill setup**: One player farms using camping and 120 herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539661012050116616)
- **faster gathering technique**: To gather faster, start the next gather action immediately instead of waiting for the system message confirming the previous one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534315282951311541)
- **filleting fish for cooking**: To get cooking use from a fish, double-click your dagger, target the fish, and choose the fillet option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537178208766787705)
- **finding harvesting spots**: To find good harvesting spots, use the map at exploreoutlands.com and avoid locations close to towns and dungeon entrances or that are overly convenient, since those tend to be crowded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543053075239927909)
- **finding lumberjacking spots**: To find good lumberjacking spots, avoid popular places and use the Explore Outlands feature to discover less popular locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547878600739393547)
- **fishing and messages in bottles**: Fishing and messages in bottles (MiBs) on the ocean produce valuable finds that you do not get from mining rocks or chopping trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525618079340429352)
- **fishing aspect setup**: While fishing, put the Harvest aspect on your armor (even tier 0 is fine) and a higher-level aspect on your weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **fishing crew composition**: Crew composition matters little for fishing; the useful crew are someone to speed-cap the boat and a carpenter to keep it repaired. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524615491203895436)
- **fishing link priorities**: For fishing, the recommended links are 10 harvest links first, then 20 special/rare loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212957315596309)
- **fishing pole on boats**: A second character on a fishing boat can fish with a pole, but it is nearly worthless compared to nets; a skinner could ride along to process catches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549702171962908725)
- **fishing rewards**: Fishing can yield fish meats as a reward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549393892497948764)
- **fishing spots and castaway routing**: Fish every fishing spot you see; when you find a castaway, head toward the town they want to go to and fish all the spots you encounter along the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540253442667446293)
- **fishing treasure map harvest timing**: Fishing treasure maps use a 1,850 millisecond harvest timing, which was not changed by the patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930709464420363)
- **fishing without a boat**: Fishing can be done without a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554358723105787916)
- **fortune versus harvest loot bonuses**: Running Fortune instead of Harvest still gives a 40% special rare loot bump but not the 38% chance at double loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538221296217755749)
- **gathering profitability and safety**: Gathering is lucrative and much more relaxed if you know how to protect yourself against thieves and murderers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548971740959604849)
- **gemstone availability**: Gemstones are very common. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545504717252206742)
- **growing zucchini**: Grow zucchini the same way as seeds, using a pot, as described on the wiki's Plant Growing page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553171809149526100)
- **growth serum replacement in planter**: A growth serum already applied in a planter likely cannot be replaced with a better one until the weekly cycle passes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552806564220375111)
- **guild favor harvest bonus roll**: Guild favor harvest bonuses grant a second roll only if the first roll fails, which raises the proc chance rather than stacking bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529046251906269285)
- **guild harvest buff and leather yield**: An active guild harvest buff can make mobs drop double leather, but it applies only to regular materials (regular leather, wood, ore), and higher effective harvest skill gives slightly more leather when skinning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535053482888011786)
- **handling fish that will dry out**: When you get a fish that will dry out, first check whether it is a [cotw fish, then chop it or add it to your fish tank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538253884521324586)
- **handling of caught fish**: Caught fish are mostly chopped up, with a few sold to players filling fish tanks, apart from the catch of the week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549701970804220027)
- **harvest and chromatic cores**: Harvest cores and chromatic cores drop from PvM and can be sold or used to unlock Harvest Aspect progressively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532815670717186181)
- **harvest armor bonus scope**: Harvest armor boosts the base harvest bonus but does not boost harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537313841560682506)
- **harvest aspect chest running**: A PvM account with the Harvest aspect gives a nice boost to dungeon chest running, allowing 2-3 effective chests to be run for the higher tiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544625246630584400)
- **harvest aspect crystals**: Harvest aspect crystals only provide a PvM bonus and do not affect harvesting, because harvesting does not proc the weapon, only the armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535086015973302272)
- **harvest aspect delayed bonus**: The +17 bonus from the harvest aspect does not apply until the aspect has been active for over 60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537313738883866745)
- **harvest aspect requirements**: Several characters can harvest at the same time, and harvesting resources (not chests) only requires the harvest aspect armor to be active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539593457331343442)
- **harvest aspect unlock requirement**: Harvest Aspect must be unlocked to have any chance at double harvest, even at tier 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532808968320188446)
- **harvest aspect while mining**: Mining works without a harvest aspect, but wearing harvest aspect while mining is worthwhile even at tier 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539588848680439859)
- **harvest attempt rate**: A lumberjacking harvest attempt occurs about once every 4 seconds, while a mining attempt occurs about once every second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554899188632785008)
- **harvest build requirements for map types**: Harvesting requires up to four different harvest builds if you want to run all the resource map types, unlike treasure maps which use one build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531095790099890317)
- **harvest cooldown after teleporting**: Normally you cannot harvest for 1 minute after teleporting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540483945303380069)
- **harvest double yield chance at t14**: At T14 Harvest there is a 34% chance for a chest to give 2x yield, so about a 66% chance of regular loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528495258332172308)
- **harvest link tiers**: Ten Bronze effective Harvest links are recommended; Silver and Gold links add little value, and effective harvest skill and effective camping links are the more useful ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949933389058119)
- **harvest links**: Harvest links are used to run lower level harvesting in order to save on essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538657099456708761)
- **harvest links for fishing**: Harvest links are required for Fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526285353923645440)
- **harvest map cast resource chance**: According to the wiki, each harvest map cast has a 20% chance of yielding a resource. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534352579717238955)
- **harvest map changes**: The patch notes say the upcoming harvest map changes will be similar to the treasure map changes, and no detailed notes for harvest maps exist yet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532898815181586663)
- **harvest map downtime**: Players must leave the area after completing each harvest map, and post-patch changes reportedly slowed the pace to roughly 15 seconds of downtime between maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536935538047848540)
- **harvest node depletion time**: A harvesting node such as ore or a tree is drained within about 10-20 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525617942883205230)
- **harvest setup swap delay during treasure map pvm**: When swapping to the Harvest setup while doing PvM in treasure maps, the player must wait 1 minute before the setup becomes active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542130003339120690)
- **harvest skill and resource map yield**: Higher effective harvest skill does not increase the resources obtained from a resource map, and whether harvest aspect plus chain links affects skill gain is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535053482888011786)
- **harvest skills and aspects leveling**: Harvest skills and aspects are slow and painful to raise, so a fisher is best made on the same echoed character as other harvesting characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362106957013136)
- **harvested items and antiquity achievements**: Harvested items do not grant antiquity achievements, as there are no harvest antiquity achievements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533486194208280779)
- **harvested log weight**: Harvested logs weigh very little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555006262834503752)
- **harvester template tracking**: A harvester template should keep tracking always on, set to look for criminals and murderers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570036430868490)
- **harvesting area blocked by mobs**: A harvester without a means of fighting enemy mobs has to flee when they appear, which can leave the area unharvestable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526693816181198949)
- **harvesting aspect double yield**: The harvesting aspect gives a chance for harvesting attempts to yield double resources, so Resource Maps can produce more materials than the listed amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536798239909744801)
- **harvesting axe tier for avar maps**: The ore tier or color of the harvesting axe, such as a valorite hatchet, has no effect on harvesting an avar map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535707720500514907)
- **harvesting chance calculator**: Outlands Butler provides an interactive calculator for harvesting chances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162211049836544)
- **harvesting gameplay depth**: Outlands harvesting involves little active decision-making and is described by one player as 'Riding Lawnmower gameplay'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527357337931616386)
- **harvesting info image skill recommendations for treasure maps**: Since the latest patch, the skill recommendations on the community harvesting info image are incorrect for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539256684269019257)
- **harvesting location tradeoffs**: Harvesting near cities lets new players run back to safety and drop off boards often, while harvesting far from cities makes PKs and thieves less likely to bother you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532229200524869692)
- **harvesting map spawn risk**: Harvesting maps can place a player at nearly any location, so the encounter depends on the spawn there, and you need a way to deal with the spawn to avoid wasting the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **harvesting node markers on world map**: Players have so far only found a way to use harvesting node markers via the world map, keeping the world map open on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522717618652319784)
- **harvestmaster event plant growth time**: During harvestmaster events, plants grow much faster and more easily than normal plant growing, taking about 6 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550567213314998324)
- **hatchet type thresholds for no failed swings**: At a combined 139.1 (skill plus aspect), Iron hatchets give no failed swings, and at roughly 138 (120 skill plus T15 aspect) Dull Copper hatchets are believed to give no failures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521374175363596390)
- **high ore mined totals**: Players reach very high ore-mined totals by buying low-level ore maps and running macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545423247242297364)
- **hollow hills mining competition**: The Hollow Hills have low competition for mining because other harvesters don't usually go there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529945032671494255)
- **horseshoe bay mining training**: Horseshoe Bay is a good mining training area because it is close to town, so you can run in and call guards on PKers; any grey stone there, even small bits or along the path, is mineable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629515441930300)
- **hostile monsters at resource map locations**: Players hiking to resource maps can arrive in the middle of hostile monsters, such as a colossal strider that uses area-of-effect stomps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536830669408309288)
- **ingots to ore and node conversion**: 1,500 ingots corresponds to about 750 ore, which is roughly 50-75 mining nodes depending on aspect tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533140720515416085)
- **iron skinning knife vendors**: Iron skinning knives are sold by tinkerer NPCs and provisioners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546085853280079964)
- **leather left behind by forensic evaluation users**: Many players who use Forensic Evaluation leave leather on corpses, so a scavenger can accumulate large amounts of leather they did not carve themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000897902088193)
- **leather yield from skinning on level 4 oss map**: On the changed maps, leather quantities from skinning mobs in the level 4 map (Oss 4) are low enough that skinning is only worthwhile for avarhide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536807829317492737)
- **level 5 treasure map drops**: Level 5 treasure maps can drop randomly from mobs on dungeon level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546132792297918494)
- **log and leather yield from lumber and leather maps**: Lumber maps yield logs at about the same rate as normal lumberjacking, while leather maps yield poorly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522360474480410735)
- **log weight**: The developers have adjusted the weight of logs, so earlier weight-based macro setups may need rechecking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526241432401350866)
- **loot bonuses and dye chance**: Special or rare loot bonuses probably do not improve the chance of digging up dyes on resource maps, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535056735486873661)
- **low-level maps value**: Low-level maps such as tier 1 maps and low-level skinning maps are considered throwaways by at least one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528547265839370363)
- **low-tier map rewards-to-time ratio**: Maps below valor-avar tier are reported to have a poor rewards-to-time ratio after the new changes, though this is an uncertain opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534387498854125688)
- **lumberjack focus with board commissions**: Gathering leather, reagents and boards yourself suits a scavenger with lumberjacking, but focusing on Lumberjacking and using board commissions to sell boards and buy reagents and leather is faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547355574121791518)
- **lumberjack log weight**: Mined ore is heavy and must be smelted to lighten it, while lumberjacks currently have no equivalent requirement such as a sawhorse to turn logs into lighter boards; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530315807039557764)
- **lumberjack weapon skills**: Most lumberjacks do not run any weapon skill other than wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530275931422200008)
- **lumberjacking and mining maps**: Lumberjacking and mining maps require two explorer packs: one to decode the map and one to reveal it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777015737979014)
- **lumberjacking income rate**: Lumberjacking is reportedly the harvesting skill that earns the most money in the least time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **lumberjacking nodes for adjacent trees**: If two trees are too close together, they often count as a single tree for lumberjacking nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522716745922646169)
- **lumberjacking outside andaria**: Lumberjacking outside Andaria is reportedly workable, though this comes from a single uncertain player claim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548072880766586911)
- **lumberjacking resource maps**: Lumberjacking resource maps have no fail chance, yield colored wood, and are safer than chopping trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529591171612693)
- **lumberjacking yield per tree**: Trees yield about 5-10 logs per swing and take about 2-4 swings to deplete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530666777561006251)
- **manual anti-harvesting captchas**: Manual anti-harvesting (MAH) captchas apply to all overworld gathering skills: lumberjacking, mining, forensic evaluation (skinning), and fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474912285364358)
- **manual node movement while mapping**: Even with scripts, mapping requires manually moving between resource nodes, and consecutive maps only chain together if the next map's location lines up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536935766490353744)
- **map system player suitability**: The new treasure map and resource map system is a PvM/harvester hybrid activity that requires combat skills and is no longer suited to pure harvesters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532098400714096720)
- **melee damage while harvesting without tactics**: Without tactics and high dexterity, a harvester's melee damage is very low, limiting kills to roughly polar-bear-level creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530285519542554854)
- **meteor site locations**: Meteor site locations are random and there is no built-in way to locate them, though players may be compiling external databases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547368700993081344)
- **miner camping skill and pack animals**: Miners can skip the Camping skill if they use pack animals, because ore is heavy and the animals carry it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **miner link choice**: Summoner is probably the most common link choice for a miner, because summons distract mobs while the miner keeps swinging the pickaxe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528480798662201455)
- **mining achievement ore requirement**: The mining achievement Leechy received requires 21,200,000 ore gathered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533907877956292701)
- **mining and lumberjacking fallback mechanic**: A fallback mechanic exists when mining or lumberjacking, and its code snippet was obtained from the developer Luthius by Elderstone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531094471016452106)
- **mining echo arrow setting**: The mining echo has an arrow setting that can be turned up, and players should check it is raised before mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533195310992457759)
- **mining effective skill boosts**: Mining success can be improved by using a higher quality pickaxe, enabling the harvest aspect, and adding harvest links, all of which raise effective skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555542430286086145)
- **mining in dungeons**: Mining is possible in some dungeons, but it is dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549596808127193099)
- **mining limitations**: Mining only works on rocks and walls, raw ore is very heavy, and forges must be nearby to keep going, so a miner gathers less than a lumberjack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549701611071213570)
- **mining locations**: Ore can be mined from any mountain edge, not only inside mines, so there are many mining spots on the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549618537822421063)
- **mining node 8x8 grid on map**: The 8x8 resource grid on the map for mining nodes can be quirky but generally works for locating nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522714545238446232)
- **mining node grid along mountainsides**: Along mountainsides the mining node grid is inconsistent; harvesting may depend on proximity to adjacent nodes and on the character touching the mountain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522714545238446232)
- **mining node grid inside caves**: Inside a cave the mining node grid is more accurate: standing within 2 tiles of a grid intersection lets you reach all 4 surrounding nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522714545238446232)
- **mining pack horse advice**: When mining, players are advised to bank often instead of bringing a pack horse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615105904484353)
- **mining speed and ingot demand**: Mining is slow, but ingots have a very large market. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **mining speed and pickaxe color**: Mining speed is the same regardless of pickaxe color, and getting only a couple of attempts at a node means it was recently harvested and has not fully refilled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740614153281587)
- **mining success chance for iron ore**: At 100 Mining skill the chance to successfully harvest basic iron ore is 100%, and below 100 skill a colored pickaxe improves the success chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740481596493844)
- **mounts and gathering animations**: Mining and woodcutting can be done on foot, showing the harvesting animations, whereas mounts were not allowed for gathering in original UO. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533259508154106058)
- **multi-harvester efficiency**: Each additional simultaneously run harvester is less efficient than the previous, with estimated efficiency of about 90% for the first, 75% for the second and 60% for the third. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527359271044517909)
- **multi-map harvest volume per season**: Players using the old multi-map gathering style could harvest around 30k-40k resources a season. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544487515975590008)
- **multiboxing gatherer efficiency**: Running three gatherers at once yields only about 200-225% of a single gatherer's efficiency, not triple. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532816965779849397)
- **multiboxing harvesters time loss**: When running three harvesters visible on one screen, the main source of lost time is character movement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527359440515371028)
- **new map system throughput**: Under the new map system, the theoretical maximum with no delays or interruptions is about 39 maps per hour, and one tester reaches only about 29 maps per hour in practice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544883295790301205)
- **new map system time cost**: The new map system takes about an hour to complete what took about 17 minutes under the old system, according to one player's experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544881131487363142)
- **new resource map process quality**: The new resource map process is described as safer, more streamlined and simplified, needing no external website and fewer supplemental skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536406270674739261)
- **new resource map safety**: The new resource map system is considerably safer and easier than the old one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534774412262375454)
- **node depletion and refresh start**: A resource node does not need to be fully depleted for its refresh timer to begin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523144156929720530)
- **number of resource map spots**: There are reportedly about 8000 resource map spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347906029588661)
- **ocean farming**: Ocean farming gives decent XP and gold, takes place in lawless waters where other players may sink you, and requires assembling a ship crew and learning ship mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548037663884574763)
