- **odd ores and veins in the world**: The odd ores and veins seen in the world, such as terracite veins, exist for Lyceum quests and cannot be mined by harvesters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525506421482065961)
- **optimal harvesting node placement**: Finding the optimal harvesting node position is tricky on a winding z-axis and requires trial and error to reduce overlap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522716745922646169)
- **orc fort map nodes**: The orc guild fort controls 6 fishing map nodes, 3 ore map nodes, 2 lumber map nodes and a couple of treasure map nodes, and the overhaul moves all of these out of the territory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **ore map yield outlier**: Ore is the only resource that is significantly faster to gather with a resource map, and its map yield is out of line with other resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525667965792551023)
- **ore maps versus normal mining**: Ore is acquired much faster in an ore map than by normal mining, so ore maps are the only harvest maps that feel worth using. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522360474480410735)
- **ore per mining node**: Each ore node in Ultima Online: Outlands holds about 7-11 ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526793879351857333)
- **ore to ingot ratio**: One ore yields 2 ingots when smelted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545422663193858208)
- **origin of harvest 2x bonus bug**: The harvest aspect 2x bonus bug is believed to have been introduced when the 60-second harvest cooldown was added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540482007266500680)
- **pack animals for resource maps**: Pack animals are largely unnecessary with the new resource maps; players should only get overweight on a dull copper ore map at high harvest aspect and can otherwise carry the haul home after each map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535330320235106468)
- **pack animals when fleeing**: Pack animals cannot run with the player when fleeing, so they are a liability when escaping PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533113683150901339)
- **parallel miners**: Experienced players can run up to 3 miner characters in parallel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603390110048358)
- **partially used map conversion**: The patch notes mention a conversion for partially used maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537655036824522902)
- **pickaxe quality effect on ore**: Better pickaxes only yield higher quality ore types and do not increase the amount of ore gathered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549607847401361501)
- **pickaxe quality ratio bonuses**: An exceptional pickaxe adds 0.04 to the pickaxe's ratio, and a mastercrafted pickaxe adds another 0.04. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825481813295115)
- **pks watching harvesting channel**: Player killers watch the #harvesting Discord channel and loot harvesters who go to spots suggested there, so popular suggested spots should be avoided or treated as risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543051359354363966)
- **plain iron ore share in mining**: Even with high skill, harvest aspect and good pickaxes, mining yields far more plain iron ore than colored ores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540397121109237831)
- **plain leather farming**: Plain (uncolored) leather is the easiest hide to farm, and many players leave it behind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551766763035955223)
- **planter spade material effect**: The material a planter spade is made of probably affects only its number of charges, similar to wands, but this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550400329206468619)
- **previously decoded resource maps after patch**: After the patch, previously decoded resource maps in backpacks may appear to be gone or undecoded; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536770554990690485)
- **pristine lumber source**: Pristine Lumber is obtained from trade caravans and not from harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524340228515696671)
- **reagent gathering from monsters**: Reagents can be obtained by killing magical creatures in large quantities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364453296799865)
- **reapplying harvest after login**: After a fresh login, reapply the harvest aspect before starting resource maps, because a bug can otherwise prevent the 2x bonus from applying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540481635445641277)
- **reason ore maps outperform other resource maps**: Resource maps were given identical yields across resources, but because 1 ore smelts into 2 ingots, ore maps end up stronger than the others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525668632666050611)
- **redlightning bottle drop rate**: Redlightning bottles do not drop very often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550540759760113727)
- **rescuing castaways while fishing**: Rescuing castaways is worthwhile because you can fish your way to the town they want to go to, with no downside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540252742990438410)
- **resource map activity level**: Under the new resource map system, players must actively press buttons and move from map to map, so it is less AFK than the old system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544470767306276984)
- **resource map area leaving requirement**: After the resource map overhaul, players must leave the area after every map before starting the next one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map carry limit**: A player can carry as many resource maps as they want and can run them one after the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349124508450919)
- **resource map change goal**: The stated goal of the resource map system change was to lower the barrier to entry and increase participation across the server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544060865907658823)
- **resource map character binding**: Under the new harvesting map system, a resource map is bound to a single character, so stealing another player's map gives no benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534348373086441644)
- **resource map completion speed**: After the resource map overhaul there is no knowledge barrier, so all players are expected to complete resource maps at about the same pace of roughly 90.5 seconds per map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536452621609468076)
- **resource map composition**: Each resource map contains 8 categories of tier 1 resources and one category of tier 3 resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531358660440232136)
- **resource map dance timers**: The resource map update added two separate 15 second timers during which the character stands still dancing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788223870439557)
- **resource map decoding skill requirement**: Decoding a resource map requires the minimum skill needed to harvest that map's material, for example 70 Mining for a Shadow Iron map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549166499074150472)
- **resource map design intent**: Resource maps were redesigned to favor casual mapping over professional high-volume mapping, which one player says is what the developers intended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554557890512294009)
- **resource map destination visibility**: With the revamped resource maps, a player cannot see where a map leads before hiking, so the destination may be dangerous and a harvesting/PvM hybrid build is now preferred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536827343975350413)
- **resource map efficiency for high-volume players**: The resource map changes made resource mapping less efficient for high-volume players, especially for cheaper materials such as dullwood, so many of them are expected to stop doing it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544063329415467129)
- **resource map forced delays**: After the patch, each resource map has forced delays between steps (decode and reveal timers, reportedly totaling about 90.5 seconds) during which the character dances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536929127788183623)
- **resource map gump**: Double clicking a resource map opens a gump that streamlines the whole resource map process. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **resource map harvest cooldown**: Resource maps have no harvest cooldown, so they can be used immediately even after teleporting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540483998516772976)
- **resource map harvesting requirements**: On a resource map you never fail a swing, so pickaxe or hatchet material and quality do not matter, and you only need the minimum skill required for that map's color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536849033379979366)
- **resource map hiking input restriction**: Hiking to a resource map location cannot be started with Razor macros or a keypress; the player must manually click each hiking step, as stated in the patch notes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536823438252183583)
- **resource map hunt timers**: The resource map overhaul adds a 15 second timer before the map-hunt minigame starts, a follow-the-arrow step to the right spot, and another 15 second stand-still timer when guessing the camp location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map island locations**: Some resource map locations are on tiny islands, and a player can die there while doing a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544839510121128057)
- **resource map location matching**: The new resource map system no longer requires matching a map image to a location, so an external map website is not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761121426505759)
- **resource map locations**: Resource map locations are more random so players cannot cycle rune libraries to find them, but a harvester can locate the spot by hiking to the map location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535329824598392843)
- **resource map loss rate without tracking**: One player reports completing 452 resource maps since the patch with no Tracking and losing only one map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542271266956910652)
- **resource map loss under new system**: Under the new resource map system a player can no longer lose their resource map, whereas under the old system the map could be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534348147009261710)
- **resource map overhaul**: The resource map overhaul is expected to make resource maps take longer to complete, add extra skill requirements, and have them completed one at a time, though this is not officially confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529563895654780968)
- **resource map overhaul**: An upcoming overhaul is expected to turn sorted resource maps back into unsorted, undecoded ones and make accumulated resource tomes useless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map rewards**: Resource maps currently give zero experience and roughly one fifth of the loot that treasure maps give. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528545578156429342)
- **resource map rng destination**: The new resource map system includes an RNG element in where resource maps lead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544493514212122635)
- **resource map safety**: Resource maps remain relatively safe and take the same time after the patch: open a gate, harvest next to it, and if a red shows on tracking or something appears, go through the gate and return later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537843990458794094)
- **resource map seasonal leaderboard**: Resource map gatherers compete on the same seasonal leaderboard categories, such as lumberjacking, as natural gatherers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531360004630908928)
- **resource map sourcing**: Players commonly get resource maps as PvM loot and run them on other characters or use them for society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554553599630123082)
- **resource map stacking restriction**: Under the new resource map system, maps go through a loading system with a delay between them, so players can no longer stack maps and multi-map at one spot as they could under the old system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544495314940199004)
- **resource map throughput after patch**: The upcoming resource map changes add a timer and a follow-the-arrow step after each map, reducing throughput from roughly 61 maps per hour to about 18-20 per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532071609295437924)
- **resource map time after aspect swap**: The new resource map process adds extra time after the aspect swap, which reduces how many maps can be run per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528171616498876467)
- **resource map yield**: A resource map likely yields a set amount of resources regardless of tool type, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539673014013010001)
- **resource map yields**: Resource map yields are all standard amounts now, and the resources come with no junk, only resources and big fish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536805705938640977)
- **resource maps as loot**: Resource maps can drop as loot distributed from guild treasure map and boss runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544772258126499891)
- **resource maps gameplay**: Resource maps have been overhauled, but the gameplay is the same: go to the map location in the wild, farm the resources, and recall out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629968703852604)
- **resource maps versus treasure maps**: Resource maps and treasure maps are two different kinds of maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968915810385941)
- **resource node refresh timer**: After a resource node receives its first hit, it rolls a random 30-60 minute timer until it refreshes, with the roll random per node. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523144156929720530)
- **running maps without ore**: When not running ore maps, a player can go from spot to spot and complete a couple of maps before backing out and unloading. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538689255302365254)
- **running two ore maps at once**: Carry two ore maps at a time; while running the first map, identify the Witcher number for the next map to save time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522436539538477153)
- **safe mining locations**: Caves attract PKs, so it is safer to mine at the sides of mountains, and lumberjacking has more areas available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603917200105574)
- **saving lumberjacking spots**: To save good lumberjacking spots, mark blank runes at each location and add them to your runetome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532230172596506734)
- **scavenger alt for colored leather**: To obtain colored leather by scavenging, use a scavenger alt that has Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551001475109490811)
- **sea serpent fishing leather**: Fishing sea serpents yields leather, and a double proc on one can give around 250 leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527455151948828743)
- **seed drops on treasure map harvests**: When harvesting on a treasure map, seeds can drop in addition to the normal resources, but not instead of resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547930742263390249)
- **shadow pick harvest bonus**: A master crafted exceptional shadow pick gives a total harvest bonus of 0.12: 0.04 for exceptional, 0.04 for master crafted, and 0.04 for the shadow material. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538655420216770561)
- **shelter island harvest aspect**: Gathering on Shelter Island may require leveling a harvest aspect there, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537467166637695058)
- **shield use while mining**: Wearing a shield while mining gives a small amount of extra armor and damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544441916161007738)
- **shore fishing harvest experience**: Shore fishing probably does not grant harvest experience; harvest experience from fishing likely requires fishing from a boat, which triggers a captcha. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538830802773610516)
- **simultaneous mining and fishing maps**: The resource map update removed the ability to mine on one character while doing a fishing map on another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788725450739784)
- **single-client harvesting macros**: Single-client harvesting on Outlands commonly relies on last object macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525647727474639090)
- **skinning leather from robots and skeletons**: Leather can be skinned from metal robots and fleshless skeletons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553606191463141417)
- **smart harvesting scope**: Smart harvesting (auto node harvesting) applies to gathering skills and not to stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **smelting ore using forges in houses**: While mining, cast Circle of Transparency to find forges inside houses, smelt ore through the wall at those forges regularly, and go home when your pack is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549606584575983738)
- **source of valuable magic items**: Really valuable magic items with multiple high tier bonuses typically come from paragon chests rather than from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **special loot links while spot fishing**: Special/rare loot links only affect the loot dropped by mobs during spot fishing and do not affect sea serpent spawn chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **special nets and messages in a bottle**: Certain monsters can spawn that drop special nets, and using special nets can get you messages in a bottle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551669036520054886)
- **spot fishing duration**: While spot fishing you are stuck at the spot throwing nets for 35 seconds regardless of how quickly you kill the spawned mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **stealth dungeon lockpicker scavenger build**: A stealth dungeon lockpicker that scavenges and skins on the side works well, and is best on a main account character so it can benefit from an aspect such as harvest or shadow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551004324115644448)
- **stealth pk ambushes at mining spots**: Stealth PKs can hide near mining locations and ambush miners, and Detect Hidden on a harvester template helps counter this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521199226749718661)
- **stored fished nets for mibs**: Fished nets can be stored instead of sold and later used to do MIBs (messages in a bottle). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534882548260405308)
- **summon strength at mining spots**: Some common mining locations have tough mobs that quickly kill summons weaker than earth elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554628837512323116)
- **summoner harvesters**: Harvesting with summoned creatures (summoner harvesters) is described by one player as the standard approach in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554604712550993983)
- **summoner hybrid harvest maps**: A Magery summoner hybrid can complete harvest maps by summoning an earth elemental to collect the goods and then recalling home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536917145617703003)
- **summons distracting mobs while harvesting**: Summoned creatures distract mobs so a harvester can keep chopping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **summons tanking while mining**: Summoned creatures can tank mobs while you mine a spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665220572479518)
- **surviving a pk ambush while harvesting**: To survive a PK ambush while harvesting, stay on a mount, hotkey Rope to a meaningful tile, know your escape route, and keep hotkeys for heal potion, cure potion, refresh potion, bandage, and trapped pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533113683150901339)
- **tamer harvester build**: A tamer harvester build works similarly to using elementals but is less annoying, and keeping a stablemaster handy helps when the pet gets lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535319069853749278)
- **terracite veins**: Terracite veins are not minable by players, who can only mine iron and colored ores; the veins are tied to a quest and the wiki has no information on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546276519825907925)
- **test server resource map amounts**: The new hardcoded resource map amounts on the test server are simply the old average amounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534305345432981665)
- **test server resource map node changes**: On the test server, new resource map nodes are significantly easier, problematic nodes were tweaked, many new nodes were added, and players should not randomly land on tar monsters or volcano serpents, while new timers slow progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534384275267387502)
- **testing new resource maps on test server**: On the test server, use one of the statues in Prev to change your skills and obtain a tome of maps so you can quickly try the new resource map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536407030678556742)
- **three-harvester income**: Running three harvesters at once yields roughly 2.25-2.5x the income of a single harvester, not 3x. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527358301099266288)
- **tool color bonus on resource maps**: The overhaul removes the tool color bonus that extended how close a player needed to be to successfully drain a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **tools for normal lumber**: For normal (non-colored) lumber, gold tools are a good choice for lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546124544975179896)
- **tracking and detect hidden for harvesters**: Having 100 Tracking and Detect Hidden plus an auto recall script helps harvesters avoid PKs and saves time lost to deaths. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543051359354363966)
- **tracking skill for gathering**: Tracking helps considerably when gathering by showing nearby players and creatures, but it is not foolproof protection against PKers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629594580328510)
- **travel penalty after hiking to resource maps**: The travel penalty for resource gathering does not apply after hiking to a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536831476648124516)
- **traveling to resource map location**: After a resource map is decoded, travel to the map's location, which drops you near the resource node, then follow the arrow to the exact spot and walk there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **treasure chest harvest aspect requirement**: Players reportedly need to be in the Harvest aspect when opening a treasure chest, though this is recalled from memory and unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546214102509166653)
- **treasure map drop rates by tier**: While farming, T2 treasure maps drop much more often than T3 and T4 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531108563508793394)
- **treasure map location difficulty**: Treasure map locations are likely random, so the chest mobs may be easier than the random wilderness monsters met while traveling to the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544412787852185640)
- **tree harvest node counting**: Trees are not covered by the 8x8 harvest rule; separate trees count as separate harvest nodes unless their bases touch, in which case they count as one tree, and Z-axis mountains can interfere with counting, so more than 4 gathers from a cluster means it counts as more than one tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530763906346123304)
- **tree-like shrubs**: Some shrubs look like trees but cannot be harvested for wood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525056972087365783)
- **undecoded ore map yield**: Since the resource map change, every undecoded ore map gives 105 ore before harvest doubling procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540485525033713754)
- **uses of map decode and reveal timers**: The decode timer on a map can be used to check summons health and duration, mage buffs and resupply, and the reveal timer can be used to identify rope tiles, check the world map for an escape route, and position summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930986766377020)
- **wiki resource maps page**: The Outlands wiki Resource Maps page is player-made and, because the recent update was huge, it will only be updated when someone volunteers the time, so it may be outdated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541416795272126634)
- **wild resource spot count**: There are about 350 wild resource spot locations, and Luthius has mentioned he may add a few more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533496510728372438)
- **wilderness farming with tracking**: Farming in the wilderness while using Tracking to watch for PKs is considered safer than farming in dungeons, and there are plenty of worthwhile mobs on the surface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474767340306475)

## Crafting

- **high circle scroll crafting requirements**: Crafting 7th and 8th circle scrolls requires high Inscription skill (80 Magery for circle 8) plus Arcane Scrolls (one for circle 7, two for circle 8), each costing roughly 1000-1500 gold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554515244305485906)
- **identification wands**: Item Identification Wands, crafted by player Tinkerers, identify a single targeted item at a time, while Container Identification Wands identify an entire bag or chest at once when the container is targeted; both can be found on some player vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548523913137627228)
- **identification wands**: Item Identification Wands, crafted by player Tinkerers, identify single items, while Container Identification Wands identify an entire container at once and can be used until the Item Identification skill is maxed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054416489480203)
- **arcane scroll uses**: Arcane scrolls are used to craft codices, tier 7/8 spell scrolls (usually for society jobs), and item ID wands, so a crafter character will eventually need them. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554578454941270018)
- **recycling magic items**: Setting the tinker tool to recycle all magic items recycles everything magical, so you cannot keep the good items, and recycling works with any tool rather than only tinker's tools, though a poorly written script may require tinker's tools. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553823609913479219)
- **alchemy bonus recipient**: The Alchemy skill bonus applies to the player drinking the potion, not the crafter, so a Greater Heal from an 80 Alchemy crafter is as good as one from a 120 Alchemy crafter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553041783213002855)
- **artisan harvest aspect**: The Artisan aspect gives a bonus to exceptional item crafting chance, which makes crafting exceptional items for societies cheaper, so crafters benefit from Artisan while gatherers benefit from the Harvest aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314670790180907)
- **codex crafting cost**: Player scribes craft codices using 25 arcane scrolls and 1 MCD each. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553802191863681125)
- **codex crafting materials**: Crafting a codex requires 1 Mastercrafting Diagram and about 25 arcane scrolls, though one player reports it as usually 10-20 scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **identifying magic items before recycling**: Identify unidentified magic items first, because they must be identified before they can be recycled; after identifying, either recycle them or hoard them for later. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005944578965555)
- **public magic item recyclers**: Public magic item recyclers are available for anyone to use, including one in the Riverside mall, in many player-owned shops, and in guilds, so buying your own is unnecessary. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550673008312459275)
- **alchemy throwable items**: Alchemy can make explosive potions and smoke bombs, but there are no grenades in the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550417285007802478)
- **arcane essence from salvaging**: Weapons and armor found in the world can be salvaged to obtain Arcane Essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548825145861341236)
- **aspecting armor**: Armor items can be aspected, and new players are advised to use the same aspect on both their weapon and armor for now. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551888496615231531)
- **beds from tailors**: Player tailors can craft beds, while NPC tailors do not sell them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614540111708212)
- **carpentry and lumberjacking**: Carpentry is the trade that uses raw wood from lumberjacking, and there are almost always buyers for wood, though it is best not to combine both on one character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547075038388420678)
- **clothing alteration kit usage**: The clothing alteration kit can be used on any kind of fancy clothing, including items restyled from a leather cap, but not on just any item. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681161656311911)
- **club weapon vendor availability**: The Club, a wooden bat-looking mace weapon, is sold by weapon vendors such as weaponsmiths. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548061582607650929)
- **cowl hood armor**: A cowl hood gives armor equal to an exceptional plain leather cap, and a clothing bless deed can be used on it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553372751178244147)
- **crafting queue system**: Outlands has a crafting queue system, intentionally designed so crafting skills can be trained semi-automatically while the player is away. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536941007021809714)
- **dyeing clothing with rare cloth**: Colored rare cloths can be used in sufficient quantity with a clothing alteration kit to recolor clothing, and fancy clothing can be blessed and dyed, with each piece requiring a set amount of cloth. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588542499954789)
- **early crafting profitability**: Crafting is initially a money pit, and Tailoring and Blacksmithing in particular do not have great returns, though they can be very convenient. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **essence from recycling magic items**: Recycling magical items breaks them down into essence, which is used for aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548841759075868764)
- **explosion potion targeting**: Explosion potions can be thrown at other targets, whereas other alchemy potions can basically only be used on yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551293384424034338)
- **gold versus iron platemail**: Gold platemail is better than iron platemail. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553236447035916339)
- **healing codex**: Healing codexes are player-made through the Inscription skill, and Anatomy and Healing skills make them more useful when healing with a codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548072404524343347)
- **leather cap restyle kit**: A Leather Cap Restyle Kit (deed) transforms a leather cap into a hat while keeping its stats, so players typically use an invulnerability leather cap; the clothing alteration kit is a separate item used afterward to color the restyled cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680606733115493)
- **magic item recycling methods**: Early game, players recycle magic items using tools purchased from NPCs; mid-to-late game, they get a Magic Item Recycler from the Prevalia Merchant, and magic items should be identified before recycling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054434378059807)
- **magical and material spellbooks**: There are magical spellbooks obtained as loot and material spellbooks that are crafted, and players tend to prefer the material ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602573299978312)
- **mastercrafted item id wands tinkering requirement**: Crafting mastercrafted item ID wands requires 120 tinkering skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550564659302629389)
- **obtaining bandages and cloth**: To get more bandages, buy bolts of cloth from an NPC tailor and cut them with scissors to produce cloth for bandages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550537293008478329)
- **phylactery uses**: Phylacteries can be turned into cores, which is preferred over using their aspect proc, since one aspect proc per hour is not very helpful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **recall scroll crafting cost**: Crafting recall scrolls with Inscription from blank scrolls costs only a few gold each (about 3-6 gold), far below the roughly 50-200 gold that NPCs or players charge, though the exact buy price is reported inconsistently. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554507198074462209)
- **separate crafting characters**: Players typically make a separate character for crafting skills rather than putting them on a PvM character, and a PvM character is usually needed to fund the crafter's resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586650599985245)
- **separate gathering and crafting characters**: Crafters are best loaded with crafting skills and parked at home, with gathering and crafting done on separate characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547073856181903381)
- **ship repair kit crafting**: Ship repair kits are crafted with the Tinkering skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549820475125796874)
- **smoke bomb sourcing**: Smoke bombs are player crafted and must be bought from players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549130240054399069)
- **spellbook mana replenishment and regen**: A Potent spellbook gives more chances for mana replenishment procs, while crafted spellbooks give mana regen, which is currently usually more useful than mana refund chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553908064586047529)
- **sticky explosive potions requirement**: Making thrown explosive potions 'sticky' requires 80 alchemy or 80 telekinesis (magery). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550417873715990530)
- **tier 7/8 scroll crafting**: Tier 7/8 scrolls cannot be upgraded from lower scrolls and can only be crafted, which requires pink arcane scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554577173711687691)
- **typical bow wood choices**: Most typical builds use bows crafted from woods between Rosewood and Valewood, with Avarwood as the pricier option, and Rosewood to Valewood is more suitable for newer players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088854687649812)
- **weekly crafting jobs society points**: Doing crafting jobs each week earns society points that can be spent on mastery chain links and other rewards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550050210623787080)
- **wizard hat recycling**: The crafting queue does not recycle wizard's hats made while training Inscription, but they can be recycled by cutting them with scissors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546612722156970035)
- **wizard's satchel weight reduction**: A Wizard's Satchel made from a higher-quality material provides better weight reduction. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551673523972608082)
- **accessory dye usage**: Accessory dye is used on quivers, potion satchels, reagent satchels and shields. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553214690895855617)
- **adornments**: Adornments are craftable decorations, and the food-related ones look like small dinner table settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846295133159555)
- **alchemist phylactery core combining**: An Alchemist can combine 4 phylacteries of the same type to make a core of that type, or 8 of the same type to make a chromatic core. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **alchemy inscription tailoring materials**: Materials for Alchemy, Inscription and Tailoring can be gathered while playing normally, without dedicated gathering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586881597345944)
- **arcane scroll uses**: Besides inscription society use and making spell books, arcane scrolls can reportedly be turned into 25 essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547706724298002463)
- **artisan aspect exceptional crafting bonus**: The Artisan aspect reportedly adds 5% plus 1.5% per aspect tier to exceptional crafting chance, though the author is unsure of the exact numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547993023235756113)
- **artisan aspect priority for crafters**: Artisan Aspect is nice to have for a crafter but is not a top priority early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545165366366568509)
- **artisan effect on ships**: Artisan reportedly has no effect on ships, and 120 carpentry is only needed to eliminate negative stats on boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527321849422282783)
- **artisan xp from crafting picks**: Crafting your own harvesting picks grants Artisan XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538657091655303280)
- **auto-recycling chest**: A chest that automatically recycles items is expected to become available eventually, and a guild may already have one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548845028883959859)
- **backpack recycling risk**: Recycling your backpack with a crafting tool recycles all magic items in it, so you should not carry magic items you want to keep. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677972434821262)
- **bank bag crafting limits**: Crafting directly from a bank bag does not work for blacksmithing because it requires a forge and anvil, but it reportedly works for tinkering, tailoring and carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531495904438128811)
- **best crafts for societies**: The main benefit of crafting is societies, since crafted goods are cheap to buy from other crafters; Tailoring, then Alchemy, then Inscription give the most value for societies, while other crafts are supplemental depending on weekly jobs and their points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **blacksmith vendor goods**: Blacksmith NPCs deal in metal goods and do not sell leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545205768050184194)
- **blacksmithing recycling in dungeons**: Blacksmithing recycling cannot be done in the middle of a dungeon because it requires an anvil, unlike other recycling tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039196204601525)
- **blank scroll sources**: Blank scrolls can be crafted with Tailoring or Carpentry, or bought from Smuggler NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552816088482451478)
- **blessed status of crafted items**: Certain crafted items are believed to be blessed when crafted, but which items is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553558883451019266)
- **boat crafting skill**: A boat is best crafted with the highest possible carpentry skill, and boats have many unusual stat mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534127480909205575)
- **bonus ingots when smelting**: Smelting ore has a chance to yield more ingots than normal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530390248457240718)
- **boombox crafting storage**: Source ingots and the crafted product can be placed in a boombox, and when non-exceptional items are recycled the recycled ingots also go into the boombox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531484569117921480)
- **bulk recycling of magic items**: Set a crafting tool such as a saw or tinker tool to recycle 'all magic' and target your backpack to recycle every magic item in it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677660945096786)
- **bulk recycling of spellbooks**: A bulk recycling tool can recycle many spellbooks at once if the bag is emptied beforehand, but the recycle-all-in-container and recycle-all-in-inventory options did not work for spellbooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549470789802135614)
- **butler for society crafting scripts**: The Butler script tool can be used to set up scripts for weekly crafting society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525627368700379237)
- **cheap crafting professions to level**: Tailoring, alchemy and inscription are cheap to level compared to other crafting professions, so players commonly level them on multiple alts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547990756848050197)
- **chromatic distillation conversion**: A character with 100 alchemy skill can convert a chromatic distillation into any other aspect distillation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544672027712159876)
- **clothing recolor cloth cost**: Recoloring a piece of clothing with a clothing alteration kit requires the same amount of cloth as it takes to craft that item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551520493692133387)
- **codex recipe lookup**: Codex recipes are listed on the Inscription wiki page or can be viewed in game by using a scribe's pen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553515584719822998)
- **colored leather value**: Colored leather is more valuable than plain leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551767137650090106)
- **coloring restyled leather cap**: After restyling a leather cap, use the clothing alteration kit on it; the kit reports how many pieces of cloth are needed to color it, and its gump lets you choose the cloth and the item to apply it to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681008408891423)
- **corrupted link reforging tool**: The Corrupted Link Reforging Tool can be crafted to turn corrupted links into the link you want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545415072061464666)
- **cost of training crafting skills**: Training a crafting skill such as alchemy is expensive and reportedly requires roughly 100k reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364190871789620)
- **crafted high-end material bows**: Crafted bows made from high-end materials are cheap, readily available, and very good in both damage and accuracy, and most builds benefit from the accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088092931002439)
- **crafted rune tome blessing**: Rune tomes crafted by players are not blessed initially. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547403549313339462)
- **crafter placement across accounts**: Most players put crafters on their other accounts rather than the main account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549507698943332353)
- **crafting from bank bag**: You can craft directly to and from a bag in your bank, so resources never enter your backpack and are fully safe from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531486147077738576)
- **crafting from stockpile without carrying resources**: To craft from the stockpile without carrying resources, put regs and empty bottles in the stockpile, set the crafting queue box to stockpile and the crafting queue bag to the shelf, so no regs or items are needed on your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551040850966880278)
- **crafting gump resource error at max weight**: The crafting gump can report that you lack the resources to craft when the crafter character is at max weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039693393629255)
- **crafting queue source and destination**: In crafting queues, set a resource stockpile as the source and the shelf as the destination. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550997958315606069)
- **crafting queue source container errors**: If the crafting queue gives errors, check that the source container is set correctly, such as by targeting your stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210770804449382)
- **crafting queues**: A dedicated house character can use crafting queues to craft loadout sets, and the queues keep running while you do other things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554513694556295290)
- **crafting skill requirements**: Most crafts require only a single trade skill, but some items require a combination of skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547075818197491804)
- **crafting skill requirements for utility items**: Item ID wands require tinkering and item identification, empty potion kegs require carpentry and tinkering, locked boxes require carpentry and tinkering, and inscription crafting needs magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555710233941123113)
- **crafting skill training cost**: Training crafting skills on Outlands costs quite a bit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286681711181885)
- **crafting society paired skills**: Each crafting society has two paired skills that earn points within it, and those points can only be spent within that society; Tailoring and Blacksmithing are paired in one society, and Scribe and Alchemy in another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **crafting use after training**: Once you are done training, crafting is used for soc jobs, for items you or an ally need, or for selling to a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098731040153731)
- **crafting with region bonus using stockpiles**: To craft with the region bonus, move materials to the bank and buy tools there, since tools cannot be pulled back out of a resource stockpile, then bring leftover materials back to your house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549791005144911964)
- **curio dye hues**: Curio dyes are sold in a specific fixed hue and do not let you choose a color when used in a dye tub. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553862917936652350)
- **cutting fish with dagger**: Cutting a fish with a dagger yields delectable fish ingredients. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794404845559870)
- **cutting rare cloth shoes**: Shoes made of rare cloth can be cut with scissors into 6 pieces of that rare cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855051953512600)
- **dedicated crafter character**: Many players use a separate crafter character with inscription, alchemy, and tailoring that does weekly Society jobs for society points and makes potions, scrolls, and leather or bone armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554509770197569647)
- **disposing of unwanted crafted maps**: Crafted maps can be sold to vendors, or unwanted ones can be dropped on the floor of an inn room to let them decay, though this is not fully confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390770685448203)
- **dull copper ore uses**: Dull copper ore is cheap enough to be used to level crafting like iron ingots, to make tools or basic gear sets for newbies, or to be sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535372099689123851)
- **eldritch armor and inscription links**: With Eldritch armor, links are not needed to reach 125 inscription; links are only needed to hit 125 when using armor other than Eldritch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552888342256025651)
- **exceptional avarwood bow bonuses**: An exceptional Avarwood bow gives 12% accuracy and 19% damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552089469027622923)
- **exceptional pickaxe durability**: Exceptional or master crafted pickaxes have more uses than regular ones, for example 4250 for a master crafted avarite pickaxe versus 3250 for a regular one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554843227796803596)
- **exceptional wood crook damage versus avarwood**: An exceptional normal wood crook does about 3% less damage than an exceptional avarwood crook, roughly the damage of one gold link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554170681967779870)
- **explorer pack crafting**: Explorer packs are crafted with Cartography at 100 skill using a mapmaker's pen, 1 blank map, 1 iron ingot, 1 leather and 1 board. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544153687906320384)
- **explorer pack crafting skill**: Explorer Packs are crafted with the Cartography skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536752292550938754)
- **fancy headwear and leather quality**: Fancy headwear, chest and leg pieces bought from Jakesh (the Prevalia Merchant), or bought from players for items he no longer sells, all count as exceptionally crafted base leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681543811797023)
- **fortune armor xp boost**: Fortune armor needs an explicit XP boost among its abilities because gold and doubloon links do not increase XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546649104027746334)
- **gear stat determination**: Gear stats come from the weapon chart for base damage plus magic or crafted modifiers, and outlandsbutler.com offers calculators to add up bonus sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553603418579271751)
- **goldenhide armor crafting**: Once a player has obtained one of the three goldenhide armor pieces, tailors can reportedly craft the pieces themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549753913484251158)
- **grimoire acquisition**: A grimoire can be bought with gold or crafted using skills and goods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547478851117125702)
- **guild repair bench**: A guild offers a repair bench that players can use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500568460173393)
- **hat of the magi**: The Hat of the Magi is likely not present in Outlands and is probably an AOS-era item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546761636654751795)
- **healing potion shattering**: Healing potions cannot be shattered on another player to heal them, reportedly because concussive damage is not in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551293574887505992)
- **hood as leather cap alternative**: A hood can be made as an alternative to turning a leather cap into a hat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925218737455255)
- **house forge weight reduction**: A forge placed in a house one tile from the wall can be used for smelting and reduces weight a lot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553985600619814944)
- **identify wand types**: There are two types of identify wand, one of which is labelled 'item identification wand'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544497827873296435)
- **ingot and board yield per resource**: In Outlands, one ore yields 2 ingots and one log yields 1 board. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551252642036977785)
- **ingots for blacksmith society turn-ins**: Mined ingots are needed for blacksmith society (BS Societies) turn-ins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520930297745637476)
- **inscription refund chance for circle 7-8 scrolls**: With 125 effective Inscription, spell scrolls of circles 7 and 8 have a 100% chance to be refunded when crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549153176593109005)
- **instrument charges at zero**: An instrument that reaches 0 charges is lost like a tool, so it must be repaired before charges run out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554847920858341407)
- **instrument repair**: Musical instruments can be repaired to restore full charges, but this must be done before charges reach 0, because an instrument at 0 charges is destroyed like a tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554845345660412110)
- **invulnerable leather caps**: Invulnerable leather caps can be turned into a variety of cosmetic head wear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547602104267313163)
- **iron ingots for crafting leveling**: Iron ingots can be used to level crafting skills such as tinkering and blacksmithing if you plan to have a crafter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544713592753094738)
- **item id wand crafting requirement**: Making item ID wands likely requires Tinkering together with Item Identification, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474107784429710)
- **katana cutlass scimitar differences**: Katana, cutlass, and scimitar appear to differ only cosmetically according to the wiki weapons chart, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525936143142943)
- **large boat quality**: Boats larger than a medium crafted so far have often turned out junk, because shipcraft is difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534128053951791205)
- **leather surplus with society jobs**: A player running three crafters with 15 society jobs each per week, without forensic evaluation, still gains leather overall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525676626178871508)
- **leveling artisan with boats**: Crafting boats is a good way to level the artisan aspect up to T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527326599412846682)
- **loose armor parts from npc vendors**: Loose armor parts can be bought from NPC vendors under Npc / Armor, but NPCs do not sell colored versions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549752605171912786)
- **magic item recycler**: A magic item recycler is a chest into which you place items; it has a menu where you choose settings for what to recycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655577544200195)
- **magic item recycler filter checkboxes**: In the Magic Item Recycler filter settings, green ticked boxes are recycled and unticked red boxes are kept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544764696068168)
- **magic item recycling rate**: Most magical items a player finds, roughly 95%, end up being recycled rather than used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551078052308459662)
- **magic recycler and spellbooks**: The Magic Recycler will not recycle spellbooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549470403125190710)
- **maker's mark checkbox**: The crafting menu has a per-craft checkbox for the maker's mark that toggles whether the crafter's name appears on the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546906549421604894)
- **making bandages from bolts of cloth**: Buy bolts of cloth from tailors, cut them with scissors to get cloth, then cut that cloth again with scissors to make bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549351879811665971)
- **making bolts of cloth**: To make bolts of cloth, get wool from sheep and use a spinning wheel and loom in your room; bolts are cut twice to make bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554615357594009643)
- **map maker near bank**: One town has a map maker close enough to a bank that you can craft maps out of your bank and sell the maps back to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390732315959357)
- **mastercrafted blessed spellbooks**: Being mastercrafted offers no benefit to blessed spellbooks, and the mastercrafted state requires 120 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546904209641840710)
- **mastercrafted spellbook function**: A normal spellbook only holds spells, and whether it is mastercrafted makes no difference to that function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602232852648057)
