- **mastercrafted tool and lockpick bonus**: Mastercrafted harvesting tools and lockpicks give +5, in addition to the +5 from exceptional quality, and the lockpicking chart lists both together as 'GM tools +10'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523501585685020813)
- **mastercrafted tools for chests**: Mastercrafted tools help significantly when opening locked chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546288113309978694)
- **mastercrafting diagram**: A Mastercrafting Diagram is an uncommon drop used in several crafting recipes, such as the codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553467782497050687)
- **mastercrafting skill requirement**: Mastercrafting requires 120 skill, and various items receive bonuses for being mastercrafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546904542413590548)
- **mcd abbreviation**: MCD stands for Mastercrafting Diagram, an item used in many crafts such as making codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545193480689815646)
- **meat sources for cooking**: Cooking meats can be gathered by fighting monsters, bought with gold, or obtained as fish steaks from fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362631341608993)
- **meditation for scroll crafting**: Making spell scrolls with Inscription on Outlands does not require meditating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549208436892373203)
- **mortar and pestle for recycling magic items**: The mortar and pestle may not work for recycling magic items in the field, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039757989679115)
- **necromancer staff**: The Necromancer staff is one of the arcane staves and is only useful if you have the Arcane skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554253106525507697)
- **non-red crafting margins**: Getting non-red crafting margins requires 10 corrupted links and crafting during the weekly town exceptional bonus, and thieves are a concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531367167130472559)
- **ore to ingot smelting ratio**: Ore may smelt into ingots at a 1:2 ratio, but this is unconfirmed and the author was unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541094396668158012)
- **power-only weapon vs crafted averite weapon**: A power-only magic weapon adding 20% damage is significantly worse than a crafted averite weapon, which gives 19% damage and also +12% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550062651332366407)
- **pre-blessed crafted progression items**: Craftable progression items and items like the adventurer's satchel are already blessed when crafted, with no extra steps needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545489586862694502)
- **profitable crafter specialties**: Alchemy crafters make potions, inscription crafters make recall scrolls and codexes, and blacksmithing crafters make weapons and GM armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051103222140990)
- **quiver arrow consumption**: A quiver reduces the number of arrows an archer consumes, and it is probably only available as a player-made item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547677672145031168)
- **quiver blessing**: Quivers cannot be blessed with a clothing bless deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554328494631161860)
- **reagent bags**: Reagent bags such as the Wizards Satchel are not required, but one made with coloured leather gives increasingly lighter-weight reagents and a chance to not consume reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553569603035070476)
- **recoloring blessed robe or hood**: To recolor a blessed robe or hood, use hued cloth of the desired color together with a clothing alteration kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551520335273402369)
- **recovering cloth from dyed items**: To recover cloth from a dyed item, cut it up; if the item is blessed, first use an unbless deed, then buy a clothing bless deed again, and remake the item in a different hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552320155911065712)
- **recycling a magic item**: To recycle a magic item, identify it first (for example with a player-crafted ID wand) and then use a sewing kit or saw on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550665985793728593)
- **recycling backpack requirement**: Items may fail to recycle if they are not in your main backpack rather than in a sub-container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548843042851520513)
- **recycling hats**: Hats cannot be recycled with the crafting tool and must be cut up with scissors instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549838469491064834)
- **recycling restyled leather cap**: Recycling with a sewing kit may be a way to deal with a restyled leather cap that cannot be cut, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545153519923761152)
- **recycling tool requirement**: Any crafting tool is good enough to recycle items in the early game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547972225968111668)
- **recycling tool requirements**: Recycling with blacksmith tools requires a forge and anvil, while a sewing kit or saw works anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553527158993977506)
- **recycling with crafting tools**: Most crafting tools, such as a sewing kit, can be used to recycle identified items, but not all of them can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546348663792607292)
- **recycling with id wands and crafting tool**: Items can also be recycled using ID wands and a crafting tool, but this is not efficient when starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655577544200195)
- **reforge tool**: A reforge tool is a one-time-use item that, when used on a mastery chain link, changes that link's bonus to any other type of link bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655343135424533)
- **regular poison acquisition**: Regular poison must be crafted, for example by a crafter character, or bought from other players, since the top row of vendor stock is greater poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549874247726538853)
- **remove trap tool tiers**: Better remove trap tools are made of gold or the next tier up, agapite, which is probably the equivalent of rose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544622757730320394)
- **removing aspect color from item**: To avoid the aspect color on an item, check the material box and then reapply the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549977159974522902)
- **repair bench charges**: Repair kits are used to add charges to repair benches, which the benches then spend when repairing items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299295523217479)
- **repair bench function**: Repair Benches hold charges from repair kits, require no skills to use, and restore the durability of all equipped gear and all gear in your inventory when double clicked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554846223096356997)
- **repair bench recharging**: The repair bench is recharged with repair kits, and a kit made by a scribe, smith, carpenter or tailor will work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991590576234518)
- **repair kit charges**: Each repair kit adds 10 charges to the repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992386424315915)
- **repairing items with repair kit**: To repair an item with a repair kit, place the item in a bag (any container, not only your own backpack) and target that bag with the repair kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299669311455283)
- **resource stockpile crafting queue**: The Resource Stockpile interacts with the crafting queue, making it much easier to craft large amounts of items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **restyled leather cap and scissors**: A blessed restyled leather cap cannot be cut with scissors, even after unblessing it; the scissors report they cannot be used on that item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545152391987470417)
- **restyled leather cap blessing**: A cap restyled with the Leather Cap Restyle Kit should be blessed with a clothing bless deed from the Prevalia vendor, otherwise it is lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548901457275658331)
- **saving dye hue on items**: An item's dye hue cannot be saved, while hair hue can be saved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552319075273937129)
- **saving money on thieves codex**: To pay less for a Thieves Codex, buy the required materials cheaply and add any you gather yourself, then hire a crafter through the crafting services channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **saw requirement with non-stockpile source container**: If you target yourself or another container as the crafting source container, you must also carry a saw on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549212008488894567)
- **scissors on boots**: Using scissors on boots produces six cloth, which makes dropped boots worth keeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160518019457144)
- **scythe restyling**: A scythe cannot be restyled or flipped until the next patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553802016139251783)
- **selling crafted maps to npc**: Crafted maps can be sold to an NPC mapmaker for a small amount of gold, which also clears them from the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549545396257292380)
- **shield transmog with shield cover**: To transmog a shield, double click a shield cover and target yourself; any shield you equip then takes on the cover's appearance, and shields and covers can be dyed with accessory dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551629615506661497)
- **ship crafting**: Ships are crafted by players using the Carpentry skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550974525770825778)
- **ship crafting with crafting queue**: To craft ships with the crafting queue, put loose ingots, board commodities, saws and loose cloth in a bag, set the bag as both source and target container, and keep a saw on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219102403596371)
- **skill for crafting exceptional sewing kits**: Exceptional sewing kits for a storage shelf are probably made with the Tinkering skill, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544344695566499991)
- **smelting while hidden**: Smelting ore at a forge may be possible while hidden or invisible, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537581525569372221)
- **smoke bomb crafting cost**: Crafting 25 smoke bombs requires 50 iron and silk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549141704806760681)
- **smuggler empty bottle price**: Smugglers sell empty bottles in bulk at 500 for 3k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551042079382175747)
- **society crafter skill requirements**: A society crafter with 100 skill gets a decent number of society jobs each week, though 120 is eventually wanted in most skills on all 3 accounts, which takes a very long time, especially for blacksmithing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **society crafter skill set**: A society crafter is usually just tailoring plus alchemy and possibly inscription, because other crafting skills cost more to raise and typically earn less profit from societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634174045126687)
- **society points maximization order**: To maximize society points per week, expand crafting capabilities slowly by alternating skills, for example 100 Tailoring, then 100 Alchemy, then 120 Tailoring, then 100 Carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **sources of effective inscription**: Effective Inscription can come from the Eldritch aspect, links, printed items, or a combination of these. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549153312178315275)
- **spellbook requirement for scroll crafting**: According to the Outlands wiki, crafting circle 1 to 6 spell scrolls requires having the spell in your own spellbook and enough Magery to cast it, while circles 7 and 8 do not require having the spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210179642466366)
- **spellbook types and bonuses**: A basic spellbook holds your spells and is required to cast but gives no bonus; crafted material spellbooks increase mana regeneration when held in the character's hands, and magic spellbooks can increase spell damage or mana refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550029827808043081)
- **stockpile commodity conversion**: The Stockpile may convert commodities into loose items when they are placed in it, which would make it unsuitable for ship crafting that needs commodity boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219788956368907)
- **tailor society jobs**: A 100 skill tailor can perform non-coloured leather society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544315554981216346)
- **tailoring leveling cost**: Tailoring is much cheaper to level than the other crafting skills, so most players get all 3 accounts to 100 Tailoring first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **tailoring skill for ship crafting**: The wiki indicates tailoring skill should not be needed to craft ships, although the author had 120 tailoring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219102403596371)
- **tall straw hat aspect**: A Tall Straw Hat can get an aspect by using a Leather Cap Restyle Kit on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548901121316094003)
- **terran dye skill requirement**: According to the Outlands wiki, crafting Terran dye has no skill requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544072571304153119)
- **thieves codex crafting difficulty**: Many players have the skill to craft Thieves Codexes, so crafting one is not difficult, and the price mostly reflects material costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **tinker tools not added to resource stockpile**: If tinker tools are not being added to the resource stockpile, open the stockpile settings and tick the grab tools box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545755741770612737)
- **tinker's tools purchase**: Tinker's tools can be bought from a tinkerer NPC in any town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553836332621496351)
- **tinkered candelabras**: Candelabras crafted by Tinkering are decoration only and have no gameplay use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217394788212737)
- **transcriber book copying requirement**: The book being copied with a transcriber must be in your inventory and not locked down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553221379883671573)
- **trap removal tools**: Traps on chests are removed using trap removal tools, not lockpicks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546285139506634882)
- **treasure maps source**: Treasure maps (T-maps) cannot be crafted by players and are obtained only as loot drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544350914356445337)
- **turning logs into boards**: Double-click your axe and then click the log to turn it into boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554354006716063837)
- **using a locked down recycle box**: If a recycle box is locked down instead of secured, use its buttons to put items in and take them out, and remove the recycled materials after recycling, for example into a resource stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550041911379890247)
- **vet supplies sourcing**: Vet supplies are crafted by tailors or can be bought from other players or player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274768320307211)
- **weapon and armor modifiers reference**: The magical properties of weapons and armor are listed on the Outlands wiki Modifiers page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552938115235319859)
- **wooden lock boxes and copper keys crafting**: Wooden lock boxes and copper keys are crafted by players who have both carpentry and tinkering skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555726621569450075)

## Combat & pvm

- **creature damage resistance**: Since the August 11, 2026 patch, creatures receive a small amount of Damage Resistance that varies by creature and largely scales with the creature's Difficulty Value. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1536748638750122004)
- **damage resistance exemptions**: The new creature Damage Resistance does not apply to Followers, Player Ship Crewmembers, or Battle Trainers. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1536748638750122004)
- **pvp thief inventory mechanic**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 adds an intentionally designed mechanic for PvP thieves to sift through player inventories, which is needed because the Razor item delay is completely removed. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **codex weapon ability hotkeys**: Codex weapon abilities cannot be set to auto-cast, but you can bind a hotkey or macro that says [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 or [WeaponAbility3 to toggle them on; the Outlands wiki Commands page lists these commands. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554226581063336027)
- **tracking skill for avoiding pks**: The Tracking skill alerts you to nearby PKs so you can escape (e.g. recall) before they reach you, but it should be at 100 because lower values may fail and leave you vulnerable. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554206799509459096)
- **cartography damage bonus**: Cartography increases the player's own damage dealt by 25% * (Effective Cartography / 100) against creatures from treasure map chests, trade caravans, or while on a ship. It is multiplicative and covers melee, spell, poison and trap damage, but not followers or ship cannons, and it gives harvesters nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361298198855741)
- **challenger dungeon difficulty and rewards**: Challenger dungeons have harder mobs (boosted MR/AR, with HP increases not proportionate to the rewards) and give more XP and gold than normal dungeons, with loot and XP derived from difficulty. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550783849535897693)
- **parrying with two-handed weapons**: Parry works with two-handed weapons without a shield, Parry Codex benefits also apply, and paired weapons such as martial manual weapons count as two-handed for parrying. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380658655137913)
- **summoner codex choices from quest**: A spell-damage summoner should get the Summoner's Tome from the codex bundle quest as soon as possible and can buy the Wizard's Grimoire later once funds allow. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554325333929623604)
- **tamers running treasure maps**: A tamer with cartography can run treasure maps without explore and witcher, and it works well with the new map setup, though some players find it slower than other builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968357502394469)
- **veterinary supplies**: Veterinary Supplies heal pets in an area of effect, making them most useful when multiple pets are taking damage, such as from AOE attacks in harder content. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974494796578929)
- **best aspect for treasure maps**: Treasure maps are meant to be done in the Harvest or Fortune aspect: Fortune is better for maximizing experience, and Harvest is better for maximizing material wealth. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540035415711555625)
- **caldera's fury with no links**: Caldera's Fury treasure maps can be done with no links by using summons to absorb damage; Summoner's tome earth elementals survive long enough. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546055157715024)
- **chivalry gate ambush trick against harvesters**: Players ambush harvesters by stealthing next to a target, marking a Chivalry (Sacred Journey) gate beside them, then gating in from elsewhere; the gate cannot be seen, and players expect the trick to be nerfed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533029564723367956)
- **explosion potion alchemy bonus**: The high-Alchemy benefits to explosion potions, such as automatically sticking to the target and larger explosion size and damage, apply only against creatures (PvM) and not against players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551626277474017322)
- **frost aspect**: Frost is a well balanced, fairly cheap aspect that suits melee builds, with good survivability, an AOE damage proc, and a damage boost once chill is stacked, and it gives worthwhile bonuses early. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553331663973392465)
- **mind blast for arcane mages**: Mind Blast is a useful low-mana damage spell for mages, helpful when mana is low and effective against high-AC mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547643408430923919)
- **parrying with arcane staves**: Arcane staves count as two-handed weapons, so the Parrying skill works with them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327507434115092)
- **progressive spawn loot**: Progressive spawns do not have better loot rates than normal mobs, though some have a higher difficulty value that can yield better loot, and loot ownership depends on the initial hit combined with damage dealt. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547722954236887231)
- **spell interrupt prevention sources**: In PvM, 100 effective inscription, 100 resisting spells, or 100 combined arcane and wrestling prevents spell interruption even when hit; in PvP this does not apply and the only way to avoid interruption is not being hit, so wrestling matters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555038008288477215)
- **summoner mage aspect choice**: Eldritch is the most commonly chosen aspect for caster-focused summoner mages because it provides mana sustain, while Void, Death and Blood are also common and follower-damage builds favor Frost or Command. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553876881324118099)
- **thrown explosion potions**: Explosion potions can be thrown for substantial extra damage, especially against groups of provoked monsters, but missing and hitting a player turns you grey. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029947973996616)
- **treasure map lockpicking**: Treasure map chests no longer require lockpicking: the chest opens instantly once the mobs are defeated and there is no lockpicking timer, which makes completing maps faster, especially harder ones. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968159195963514)
- **air aspect swing speed**: The air aspect increases swing speed, all aspects reportedly increase accuracy, and better weapons also help, so air with dual weapons may be a good option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554432774188965950)
- **arcane and summoner build compatibility**: Arcane abilities do not work while the player has active summons, so arcane and summoner builds are mutually exclusive in practice. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546224519327522948)
- **arcane and summons incompatibility**: Arcane and summons cannot be used together: having summons out disables arcane, and an arcane mage cannot use summons because there is no arcane build up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545733339669864468)
- **arcane staff features**: An arcane staff lets you cast while holding it without spell interrupts, can parry with Parrying skill, has its own unlockable codex with its own bonuses, and can trigger aspect procs on hit, while arcane buildup boosts spell damage and damage resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546331911922909215)
- **archer and dex tamer pvp survivability**: Archer Tamer and dex tamer templates have fairly limited escape and survival options in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **archer bard template**: Archer bard is a viable template that was possibly nerfed somewhat; archers must also maintain arrows or bolts, which costs less than maintaining reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609279672877076)
- **aspect crystals effect**: Carrying aspect crystals that match your weapon or spellbook aspect boosts damage and increases the chance of aspect procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554634614088273933)
- **attack speed with redline and air aspect**: With the Redline and Air Aspect, a character can reach 70 attack speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552326445601390613)
- **backstab archer template**: Backstab archer requires giving up bard skills and is slow at first, but with enough progression backstab one-shots most mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615572525711491)
- **backstabber weapon choice**: A War Hammer is a solid weapon for a backstabber build because it is slow with high damage; burst-type weapons or a quarterstaff are also recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548581866204823642)
- **bard codex upgrades and tamed followers**: Bard codex upgrades such as Ensemble do not give their damage bonus to a tamer's tamed followers, and effects that do not explicitly mention followers generally do not apply to them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546629265901223986)
- **bard song buff targets**: Bard song buffs apply to the bard, their party, and nearby allies (even if not partied), but not to random unaffiliated players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292651116961833)
- **best character setup for tmap**: A tamer or trapper echo with Cartography is a suitable setup for the new tmap system, with the tamer considered stronger, though the trapper may benefit more from the Cartography buff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532107609455460466)
- **bleed damage tick interval**: Bleed damage, including that from the Swordsmanship weapon special, is dealt in ticks every 3 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544431321567338588)
- **boat passenger roles and xp**: Two people can be on a boat; a non-captain can only heal themselves, and receives party XP for the captain killing mobs but not for the captain sinking ships. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548377442945597511)
- **casting and attacking at set target**: To cast a spell at your set target, use the Last Target command when the targeting cursor appears; to attack with a weapon, use Attack Last Target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548100814042702007)
- **classicuo vs razor spell delay**: Setting spells through ClassicUO resolves faster than through Razor, which adds roughly 100-120ms of delay; this matters mainly for PvP or high ping. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546566071539204218)
- **cleave attack hit count**: Cleave counts as a single hit with some bonus damage applied to the side, not as a double hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549572275714531479)
- **clothing replacing armor pieces**: Some clothing items count as armor, so head, neck and hands armor pieces can be replaced with (blessed) clothing items to keep an outfit look while retaining the armor aspect, at the cost of some AR; plate is typically worn only on legs, chest and arms. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550988975102234666)
- **codex abilities in pvp**: Codex abilities do not work in PvP, so codex should not be relied on for PvP and a PvP character gains nothing from it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554602446242971789)
- **codex and pressure points on ranged damage**: Healing Codex and Pressure Points apply to ranged weapon (bow and throwing) damage, because all physical damage, including ranged, counts as melee damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547697561203380255)
- **creature damage resistance**: Since the August 11, 2026 patch, creatures (excluding Followers, Player Ship Crewmembers, and Battle Trainers) have a small amount of Damage Resistance that varies by creature and largely scales with their Difficulty Value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215674681106543)
- **disarm effect**: Disarm removes anything equipped in the hands, including shields. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551720225429266473)
- **dispel field versus gates**: The Dispel Field spell can dispel moongates and gates, and players script it as a macro for this purpose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536527078042767440)
- **dungeon pet setups**: Manticore and bonehorn are preferred over a strider and 2 oozis as dungeon-running pets, and 5 cryptwings also work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539661437511933992)
- **escaping pkers with recall macro**: Keep a runebook with a rune set to a safe spot in town and a stock of recall scrolls, and make a macro (such as [recall to that rune) so a single button recalls you to safety when attacked by PKers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554335571948732417)
- **explosive potion area damage**: Without the sticky effect, explosive potions are area-of-effect and can hit nearby players, which flags you criminal, and mobs may move away from the explosion. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550419149950418975)
- **finisher activation**: Once enabled, finishers trigger automatically on a random chance and do not need to be activated manually. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093758027276359)
- **frost aspect**: The Frost aspect at tier 0 provides frost shell, which helps any archetype avoid being one-tapped, and grants about 28% damage after a few hits, which no other aspect does at tier 0, though it is expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551890523071979575)
- **greater heal heal-over-time in pvp**: The heal-over-time effect from Greater Heal comes from a codex that is disabled in PVP, so the healing ticks do not work once PVP has begun. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532073482005778773)
- **guild and alliance boss runs**: Guilds and alliances commonly run bosses together in large packs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546192056173469807)
- **harvester pk target selection**: Harvester-killing reds typically cannot kill players who fight back, so they target softer harvesters who do not resist. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549790323775905883)
- **invisibility and escaping pks**: Invisibility ends when you move, so escaping PKs by staying unseen requires the hiding and stealth skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553509622004973652)
- **kraul hive difficulty**: Kraul Hive is one of the hardest regular-content dungeons; characters with around 80 skill levels should choose a different sanctuary dungeon, follower templates (tamer or summoner) can try it but it is risky, and dexxers should avoid it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554450202960855092)
- **kraul hive vinekin threat to tamers**: Vinekin in Kraul Hive hit fairly hard but pose little threat to a tamer, especially a bard tamer with higher defense. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078509781024880)
- **lightning aspect for archers**: Lightning aspect is a strong archer choice, giving the best DPS and good survivability, and is especially good for group play. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988006200123523)
- **links damage bonus vs barded creatures and pets**: The links damage bonus against barded creatures does not apply to your pets' damage against a barded creature. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550542526652485634)
- **loot rights when sharing a monster**: When multiple players fight the same monster, the player who deals more damage gets loot rights, but the first attacker gets a bonus of about +15%, so a later player needs roughly 40% of the damage to claim the loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547411602490523700)
- **madness aspect**: The Madness aspect gives the highest multiplicative damage boost of any aspect but has a chance per second to drain 5 HP after dealing damage, which is unavoidable, so it is risky and not recommended for beginner builds; it works best with progression, crystals, group content with a healer, or when used only on the weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553328906285879307)
- **mage spell damage bonuses**: Even fresh mages already have spell damage bonuses from Evaluating Intelligence, their aspect, their staff, and their spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328428549410856)
- **mage versus tamer farming speed**: Tamers generally farm much faster than arcane mages unless the arcane build is pushed to its limit, so mages are relatively weak for farming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326277475700746)
- **magic reflection spell**: Magery provides the Magic Reflection spell, which is useful as protection against PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **melee aspect proc chance**: Melee aspect effect chance is rolled only on hits, not on missed swings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545066805217722459)
- **message in a bottle gameplay and rewards**: Message in a Bottle (MIB) gameplay has a low barrier to entry, is very safe once learned, and needs no manual sorting; rewards include all normal special and rare loot, but much of the profit comes from ship upgrades and crew rather than loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212813086326865)
- **multi-poison damage penalty and airborne perk**: The more targets you have poisoned at once, the less poison damage you deal to each; the Airborne perk (ranks 1/2/2) reduces that penalty by 10%/30%/50% of normal, halved when resolving multiple ticks simultaneously. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555246748895543398)
- **necromancer pet herder armor aspects**: Death, Eldritch and Command are viable armor aspect options for a necromancer pet herder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554563160940347393)
- **necromancer summoner pets**: Common necromancer summoner pet choices are the mummy (earth), which serves as the tank, and the lich (fire), which serves as the single-target damage dealer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545995964282708079)
- **next target hotkeys**: The Next Target hotkeys only change which mobile is selected as your target; they do not attack the target or cast a spell. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548100442712576021)
- **paladin healing options**: A paladin can be healed with Holy Light, Noble Sacrifice, bandages, and potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547489427490734101)
- **pets while owner is dead**: While you are dead, your pets follow your ghost, and you cannot command them except with the 'all stay' command. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552066380759568487)
- **pit trials**: Pit trials are mainly the domain of tamers and trappers and can be done once per week. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988887746351144)
- **pk frequency by dungeon**: The frequency of being PKed varies by day and time, with PKs active from all time zones, and dungeons with a loot bonus are more likely to have frequent PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359591035670679)
- **pk gate trick against harvesters**: PKs use a second account or client to gate next to solitary treasure mappers, fishermen and miners and attack at once with lethal poison; having a gate bot gate right next to your harvester counters the chivalry gate trick. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531957493956218950)
- **poison archer template**: Arrows cannot be poisoned, so a poison archer template does not exist; a lightning archer is the available option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584951683711057)
- **progressive spawn changes**: Many of the original progressive spawns were removed, and new ones such as orc and undead spawns (including in graveyards) were added recently and are not listed on the EXPLORE OUTLANDS map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725379509424179)
- **red player looting behavior**: Red (murderer) players loot victims regardless of how little the victim carries, since their goal is griefing rather than loot value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536939578748051476)
- **sanctuary dungeon death lockout**: Dying in the Sanctuary dungeon locks a Red Hand member out for a period; switching to Grey Hand avoids this lockout in the future. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548420208648130753)
- **sanctuary dungeon loot reduction**: Sanctuary dungeons reduce loot to 66% of normal (not by 66%), and this should also apply to chest loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550410556706660403)
- **smoke bomb use during cooldown**: Trying to use Smoke Bomb while it is on cooldown only shows a system message with the remaining cooldown and carries no other penalty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544056648866332703)
- **spell aspect proc chance**: Spell aspect special chance is (mana cost / 10) + ((mana cost / 100) * aspect tier) percent, so it scales with the spell's mana cost; for example, Explosion at 20 mana gives about 2% and Flamestrike at 40 mana gives about 4% at tier 0. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551024342886776863)
- **spell range**: The range of spells is 12 tiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545914543241437184)
- **spell scroll casting bonuses**: When casting spells from a scroll, magical or crafted spellbook bonuses still apply. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554229973114425415)
- **spellcaster mob loot**: Spellcaster mobs drop magery reagents and gold that players can loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549604036741828689)
- **staff requirement for arcane**: A staff is required to play an arcane mage, and arcane cannot be used without one; mages not playing arcane do not need a staff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586273600151593)
- **stamina restoration potions**: A Total Refresh potion (the red potion) restores stamina, which is useful for regaining stamina after being hamstrung. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109600338378873)
- **summons while harvesting**: Harvesters can summon creatures such as earth elementals, or demons and fire elementals, to fight mobs while they keep harvesting, gaining loot and XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554604712550993983)
- **telekinesis versus sticky explosion potions**: Casting Telekinesis on a target makes thrown explosion potions stick to that target for 30 seconds, and casting it on yourself prevents a potion thrower from sticking a potion to you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550152093900476447)
- **treasure mapper chain links**: Most treasure mappers use chain links for special loot and gold rather than for damage, so other builds are better off focusing on damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547664204800983071)
- **undecoded treasure map locations**: Undecoded treasure maps hide their location until decoded, so players travel to the spot without knowing which mobs they will face, such as Cauldara mobs or horse thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531113051774783568)
- **urukton bluffs progressive spawn**: A progressive spawn sits right outside the Urukton Bluffs dungeon entrance and players lure its mobs to the entrance to kill newer players; in the orc version the Blood Lord is the boss rather than the champions, and this undead/orc spawn also exists at Orc Rock, Orc Fort 2, Orc Fort 3 and Verdentia Orc Fort. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725026986565673)
- **warning ravens on dungeon murders**: Warning ravens are sent when a murder occurs on dungeon level 1 (sanctuary), and on level 2 there is a 25% chance they are sent when a blue player is killed; the surface outside a dungeon is Wilderness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545564550391275532)
- **wilderness recall farming spots**: Good wilderness recall farming spots include human spawns that nobody touches (such as Old Pap), barbarians, sunscales, and Minax. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525626427154759690)
- **wrestler versus archer strength**: Wrestler is very strong at present and performs better early on, while archer is better at high aspect and links; lightning aspect can take a while to turn on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553585142671482982)
- **1h bow accuracy bonus**: A 1H bow is slightly slower than a 2H light bow but reportedly grants 10% accuracy, or 25% depending on whether a shield is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546377077492682814)
- **2x loot chance on chests**: The chance at 2x loot can double the contents of dungeon or treasure chests when opened, but paragon chests are not affected; a visual and sound effect plays unless the player is hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536798239909744801)
- **activating smoke bomb**: Activate Smoke Bomb by typing the command [smokebomb or by using the Razor hotkey for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544056408419344406)
- **activities combining pvm and harvest aspect**: Fishing and MiBs (Monsters in Boats) are activities that combine PvM builds with harvest aspect progression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521380652212162633)
- **aggressive stance swing speed with swords**: Using aggressive stance with swords already gives 50% swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555481606008086549)
- **air aspect for mana**: Running the Air armor aspect is a go-to choice for an Arcane mage to avoid running out of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399295187517531)
- **air aspect for wrestling**: Air aspect is reportedly great for wrestling, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778350491959468)
- **alchemy for pure pvm characters**: Alchemy can fit into a pure PvM character because it unlocks a codex that grants several PvM benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286681711181885)
- **alchemy health boost versus weaken**: Alchemy can be used to boost health to 120 to avoid a PK's Weaken effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531422889369407488)
- **all guard command behavior**: The "all guard" pet command stops when you pass through a transition such as recalling, changing dungeon levels, or entering or leaving a dungeon, so it must be reissued afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536981398290623)
- **all guard command in pvp**: The all guard command does nothing in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550585176831295562)
- **all stay command for pets**: The 'all stay' command stops pets and minions from attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554591508181688363)
- **animal lore on summoned demons**: Using Animal Lore on a summoned demon makes it attack at range instead of in melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144883284025345)
- **antediluvian dragon near urukton bluffs**: An antediluvian dragon spawns inside the cliff mini dungeon in the area near Urukton Bluffs and has dropped a scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547011983516377098)
- **aoe taunt macro**: Adding a target-self step to the taunt macro performs an AoE taunt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820249063690311)
- **arcane as mage mana source**: Outlands implemented arcane as a mana source to bridge the gap that kept pure mages PvP-only, and playing a PvM mage without arcane is difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546333017285595291)
- **arcane codex accuracy bonus**: The Arcane codex can be used to improve accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553678738393272431)
- **arcane mage armor aspect choices**: For an Arcane mage, lightning or blood armor aspects give maximum damage, void and air are excellent for mana recovery and defense, fortune suits treasure mapping and easy dungeon runs, and unlocking the cheap Arcane staff aspect and Blood armor aspect is recommended first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546226094057722006)
- **arcane mage buildup**: The arcane mage build uses a slow arcane buildup (momentum build), and that buildup does not matter for bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545468463903015013)
- **arcane mage dexterity and armor**: Arcane mages benefit from extra Dexterity for arcane procs and use blood armor; the build is a glass cannon that could use more defense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327853879566356)
- **arcane mage dexterity for mana thief**: An Arcane mage with about 40 dexterity notices the swing speed boost when using Mana Thief, and flamestrike is only cast above roughly 50-60 mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544398746735869952)
- **arcane mage difficulty**: Arcane mage is very difficult to play until you have a higher link count and aspect level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552703985113239553)
- **arcane mage endgame tanking**: At endgame an arcane mage can face tank most mobs, but must kite any mob with a nasty special ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552682723494068417)
- **arcane mage flame strike mana thief loop**: Arcane mages typically spam Flame Strike to trigger the mana thief refund loop, where chained Flame Strikes allow even more Flame Strikes to be cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545325832967290920)
- **arcane mage mana return from energy bolts**: Arcane mages can time their Energy Bolts to regain mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326165760282695)
- **arcane mage mana upkeep**: Keep mana up as an Arcane mage by continuously moving to fresh mobs and feeding momentum so hit-based mana procs overlap; expect occasional 15-30 second gaps in procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399261150617720)
- **arcane mage mapper build**: An arcane mage mapper build in fortune aspect with 20 special/rare loot links can reportedly facetank level 6 treasure map mobs, and with magic resist and wrestling can easily escape or fight PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537620056362590280)
- **arcane mage pet and summon restriction**: An arcane mage cannot use pets or summons to stay safe from mobs while casting, so it plays without that protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587606717857863)
- **arcane mage progression**: Arcane Mages rely heavily on higher-tier Aspects and their Mastery Chain links, so they can be slow going at the start, especially when solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555292094971510866)
- **arcane mage recommended gear**: For an arcane mage, blood armor and the arcane staff are recommended gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683374316093454)
- **arcane mage top build**: A suggested top Arcane mage build pairs a T15 Arcane weapon with a T15 armor aspect such as blood, lightning, air, void or fortune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544397735669661706)
- **arcane staff hex special for caster pets**: For tamers with caster pets, an Arcane Staff helps with the Hex special, which reduces resist by 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314386743656529)
- **arcane staves and summoners**: Arcane staves work specifically with the arcane skill, which a summoner mage does not use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680198635589663)
- **archer mastery links**: Most archers use 15x Damage Dealt by Player and 15x Melee Damage/Ignore Armor Chance links via redline if possible; archers without a redline (15-link limit) can use melee special chance/damage links instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544769850264518666)
- **archer stabber power cap**: Archery builds can backstab, and an archer stabber becomes capped in power after enough chain links and aspect tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550091068324970518)
- **archer tamer pet suggestions**: Cave gorger and sabertooth are suggested pets for an archer tamer, but they have fairly high minimum taming skill requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569517314576404)
- **archer third link row**: There is currently no great third row of links for archers; melee special chance/damage or melee aspect effect chance are probably the best options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544772085669171273)
- **archer weapon and armor recommendation**: The wiki weapons chart reportedly recommends medium armor and weapons or burst weapons for archers, and burst weapons appear to be two-handed archery weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553631227595067493)
- **archery skill reduction and accuracy**: Lowering Archery skill does not reduce accuracy much, and a better weapon and higher aspect level can compensate for the loss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553678668780408863)
- **archery stance quality**: All archery stances are very good except Incendiary, which is the only one players won't use much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553902121060139059)
- **archery stance roles**: Maiming is the archery single-target damage stance, Longshot is the utility stance, and Incendiary is the multi-mob damage stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546867957869838456)
- **archery versus macing early game**: Archery carries an extra loadout cost for arrows or bolts, while macing has somewhat higher DPS in the early game, but archery remains viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553266871401447505)
- **armor meditation penalty**: Armor heavier than leather imposes a meditation penalty, which matters for mage characters such as necromancers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548815585519865998)
- **armor versus weapon for kill speed**: Armor improves only defense and not DPS, so a better weapon is what speeds up kills, and a single weapon costs less than a full armor set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767806063906817)
- **arms lore for dexxers**: Sword or bow dexxers want Arms Lore to use their special move more often, while macing dexxers can take another skill instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225125974016081)
- **arrow and bolt types**: Only regular arrows and bolts exist in Outlands; there are no special ammunition types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951173432418335)
- **aspect crystal consumption**: Aspect crystals (spell stones) are used up as you fight, at the same rate as arcane essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160099645886475)
- **aspect effects in pvp**: Aspect effects, such as lightning armor melee arc procs, do not work in PvP, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554165858459328587)
- **attack speed sources**: Attack speed can be increased with delectable food, skills, dexterity, links, and Chivalry's Divine Fury, with air armor as another option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554250907380621343)
- **attacking another guild's boss**: If you attack another guild's boss, that guild can freely attack you, even if you only auto-retaliated against the boss after it hit you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599683177324634)
- **attacking targets**: To attack, enable war mode and double click any target that does not have a yellow name, or set up a targeting macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567744201793546)
- **attacking with harvesting tools**: A gatherer can attack mobs with a pickaxe or hatchet, which deals a small amount of damage and may trigger an aspect proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532881939428806656)
- **auto retaliation in peace mode**: A character may keep attacking automatically because of auto retaliation even in peace mode; unequipping the weapon or toggling war/peace mode repeatedly stops it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550796945524793357)
- **auto self-heal setting**: There is no in-game setting to auto cast heal spells on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **auto-attack spellcasting**: There are no auto-attack spellcasts; spells must be cast manually and a target chosen, which can be streamlined with hotkeys for each spell plus a Last Target hotkey pressed once the target reticle appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680198635589663)
- **avadon mob difficulty**: The average mob encounter across Avadon can probably be killed by a couple of daemons, though this is an uncertain estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554628837512323116)
- **avarite map danger**: Avarite maps are dangerous because Flame creatures can ambush a player on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528896722284183582)
- **backstab from spell invisibility**: It is unconfirmed whether you can backstab from spell invisibility; if not, use a smoke bomb, or cast invisibility and then use the Hiding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550788455192330306)
- **backstabber aspect choice**: Backstabbers mostly play with the Fortune or Shadow aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879211811741767)
- **backstabber build pacing**: A backstabber build has a slower start but becomes very strong later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550142589561348149)
- **backstabber codex requirements**: The Codex of Macing is considered essential for a Backstabber build, in addition to the Thieves Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548580926320156764)
- **backstabber template hiding**: A backstabber template is reportedly hidden about 95% of the time, which can help players dealing with high latency or lag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545963535689850962)
- **backstabber weapon and smoke bomb use**: A backstabber can use a quarterstaff for more speed, and should use a smoke bomb to hide again if the next non-hidden hit will not kill the mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549061301492518945)
- **bandage healing**: Bandages restore health, take time to resolve, and heal a substantial amount of HP, so players must learn to time them early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547565332720517180)
- **bandage theft prevention**: To prevent bandage theft in dungeons, hide bandages in trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548535727992610877)
- **bard archer build order**: For a bard archer, a suggested order is to unlock the Repeater special ability first, then put 1 point in Arcane stance, then 5 points in everything else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553433941426569278)
- **bard archer codex choice**: A bard archer should take the archery codex, the bard codex, and whichever of the alchemy or healing codex is used to keep themselves up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676366764249218)
- **bard buff range**: Bard song buffs last only while the buffed player stays within range of the bard, which is reportedly about 50 tiles now (older 2018 notes said 12). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292152137650248)
- **bard defensive barding**: A bard who attacks loses the defensive barding resist and wrestling benefits, so a bard is generally better off running away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551759746275475478)
- **bard paladin build strength**: The bard/paladin ('peacadin') build is very powerful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547361770132344943)
- **bard provocation onto players**: A bard can provoke mobs onto other players, but doing so loses defensive barding benefits and flags the bard for PvP, preventing moongate use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551830705879908353)
- **bard role in group play**: In group play a bard acts as a support player who stays out of the way of melee players, uses Discordance or Provocation on monsters, and hinders or finishes targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550853213949792458)
- **bard single-mob survivability**: Against a single mob, discordance and provocation alone are not enough, so you still take hits and need to kite unless you also level peacemaking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610748073676811)
- **bard support role**: Bard is generally the only or main support function players use to support others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551289547692965900)
