- **bard tamer disarm against reds**: Bard tamers should fully disarm when attacked by a red (murderer) to keep the effective wrestling from defensive barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554122458309861387)
- **bard tamer power level**: Bard tamers were at their peak power on Outlands as of the discussion in September 2026, though balance may change with patches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551269552245964963)
- **basic dagger usefulness**: The basic dagger is a fencing weapon whose damage is so low that it is essentially useless, comparable to a training weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555728921083912354)
- **benefits of 120 chivalry**: Having 120 Chivalry provides more holy symbols (seals), a large increase in swing speed, and more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546678633115029575)
- **best armor type for non-casting melee**: Platemail is the best armor type for a melee fighter who doesn't cast, unless you prefer another look or have better quality, magic, or material armor in a lower armor type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547671086701740102)
- **best bow choice**: The 2H light bow is generally considered the best bow choice unless you need more accuracy or damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546377520474226709)
- **best fencing weapons**: Short spear and pitchfork are the best fencing weapons by average DPS, but both are two-handed and cannot be paired with a shield for extra armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553401457666039858)
- **best mage build**: Arcane mage is probably the best mage build, though it is unclear how worthwhile Necromancy is after the nerfs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327214126563389)
- **best pet team**: There is no single best pet team, because different content and mobs call for different pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553574852261191786)
- **best tank aspects**: Earth or Void are considered the best tank aspects depending on the situation, while Temporal aspect is rarely used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554320096418070539)
- **best weapon skill for pvm**: Wrestling is currently considered the best melee weapon skill for PvM, with players able to drop weapon skill to 80, though it may require a wizard hat or playing drunk; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555428454235775138)
- **bless and arch protection area of effect**: Bless has no area-of-effect, whereas Arch Protection is a base spell with inherent AoE unlike normal Protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525132288008192)
- **blessed spellbook requirement with arcane staff**: A normal blessed spellbook must still be in your inventory when using an arcane staff, since it holds your spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546669231167512626)
- **blood aspect**: The Blood aspect is considered good on dexxers and meta on arcane mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988427983659099)
- **blood aspect self healing**: Blood aspect does not include self healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546294743829446696)
- **boat fishing mob difficulty**: Mobs encountered while boat fishing are not very difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409534826061954)
- **boat speed upgrades safety**: A fishing boat with all the speed upgrades is very safe on the ocean, with players going months without being killed despite hours of daily play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549785556970512416)
- **boombox and thief interaction**: The developers reportedly want to give thieves a way around Boomboxes and may tweak Boomboxes as a result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **boss loot sharing and helping**: Many guilds share boss loot equally, and a non-member can help a guild by dealing with small side mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601650729517067)
- **boss room flagging**: Hitting another group's boss, or even lingering in the boss room, flags you orange to that group. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546197930065526854)
- **boss room loitering risk**: Players in a boss room can be mistaken for thieves trying to steal a boss token, so watching another guild fight a boss from inside the room is risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599947141386271)
- **boss room mini-boss**: The mini-boss in a boss room has no loot and is not a mob or boss; it exists to stop anyone from hiding in the boss room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546120181678473258)
- **broken weapon damage**: A broken weapon (zero durability) is reported to deal less damage, though this is a question-derived claim and not confirmed by any official source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549781520519139349)
- **bronze link melee special**: The bronze link melee special is described as Outlands' version of critical strike and is good to scale for a Holy Paladin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544898632845627453)
- **butler resistance calculator**: Butler is the best tool for calculating resistances, because the in-game [stats command is not reliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547221749848875028)
- **caddelite elemental resistances**: The caddelite elemental is highly resistant to physical damage, though this is recalled from memory and may be imprecise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533932464769204465)
- **caddelite elemental solo difficulty and drops**: The caddelite elemental takes a very long time to kill when fighting solo and has a very small chance of dropping anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533929196454281296)
- **cartography damage bonus and resource map mobs**: The Cartography damage bonus does not apply to resource map mobs, so it does not help a resource mapper dropped into a dangerous area such as the middle of Fury's Caldera. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531405580923830282)
- **cartography damage bonus vs mib treasure map monsters**: At 120 Cartography the new damage bonus lets a player kill monsters from Message in a Bottle treasure maps roughly twice as fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531404944819749008)
- **cartography damage bonuses**: Cartography damage bonuses apply only against mobs spawned from treasure maps or on the ocean, and give nothing against regular land mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529272418609397991)
- **casting from scrolls**: Casting from scrolls requires no reagents, weighs less to carry, and with Inscription gives damage bonuses to offensive spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554521536369659946)
- **challenger dungeon crowding**: The Challenger dungeon tends to have fewer players, PKs and thieves than the experience dungeon, meaning less mob stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546646600133255289)
- **charged spells and aspect specials**: Charged spells work similarly to critical hits, while Aspect Specials are procs from the aspect applied to a spellbook and are governed by the 'spell aspect special chance' stat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545887432661008497)
- **checking hit accuracy**: Open the Help menu and choose Player stats to check your hit accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548227889961500743)
- **chivalry gate ambush tactic**: Players mark a Chivalry gate beside a target and then gate in, a tactic used in much PvP content, especially factions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533040608619401258)
- **chivalry gate buff range**: A chivalry gate buff only works if the gate caster is in the dungeon with you and within about two screens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546144556607606794)
- **chivalry gate re-marking by attackers**: Attackers using a Chivalry gate can simply re-mark the gate to a new target location as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533035884327473276)
- **chivalry healing resource limit**: Chivalry healing is limited by its resource, which regenerates only 1 point every 5 seconds, so chivalry alone can struggle against ranged or mage mobs but is fine against mobs that deal no ranged damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552028233397043341)
- **chivalry healing usage**: Chivalry healing is not needed unless you are threatened or taking damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553149212852621417)
- **chivalry holy symbol uses**: Chivalry holy symbols fuel healing and Cleanse by Fire, along with permanent Divine Fury, though Chivalry 100 is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546686159625658498)
- **chivalry in combat**: Chivalry adds an extra element to combat because it works like a set of castable spells, and several of them are wanted on constantly, so players usually tick the box to auto-use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553893062718132265)
- **chivalry poison mitigation**: Chivalry provides poison mitigation abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029186716340328)
- **chivalry sacred journey uptime**: The Chivalry Sacred Journey gate can be cast every 30 seconds and lasts 30 seconds, giving theoretically 100% uptime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532077224679706755)
- **chivalry swing speed for archer bards**: Chivalry gives swing speed, so an archer bard who can survive with chivalry alone deals better damage than one relying on healing and anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552027933596455053)
- **codex collection for pvm**: A character that will do any PvM should have every codex it has the skills for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547608198574514237)
- **codex finisher triggers**: Codex finishers like Pincushion trigger automatically; at rank 1 they trigger only when the target is at 5% HP or less, and at rank 5 when the target is at 25% HP or less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552887038062235739)
- **codex options and poison damage**: After the poison damage formula rework, codex options have little effect on poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537140410810507316)
- **codex points per summon**: In the codex, you can earn up to 20 points for each summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546920769433510040)
- **codex stance damage bonus**: A codex stance grants 3% bonus damage per rank, and a moving throw doubles it, so a rank 5 stance gives 30% more damage on a moving throw. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891368285642825)
- **command aspect trigger via pet heals**: The Command aspect can be triggered by casting heals on your pets if you have Magery, while all other aspects require a weapon or offensive spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549287954759946241)
- **common chivalry ability usage**: A common chivalry approach is to auto-enable Divine Fury for swing speed and use other abilities as needed, such as Consecrate Weapon for special damage or a defensive ability when threatened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553149212852621417)
- **confirming a thief with detect**: A thief hunter can confirm that a player chasing a victim is a thief by using Detect Hidden with a lens on them; when the hunter then attacks the thief, the thief turns grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144756880154786)
- **consecrate weapon and bleed**: Consecrate Weapon, a Chivalry ability, is likely to affect bleed special damage, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546975414684098681)
- **contested boss room pvp**: When a boss is contested, the whole boss room is fair game for PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599683177324634)
- **corpse looting likelihood**: Corpses are more likely to be looted when you die in high-traffic areas or wear valuable gear such as a full valorite or avarite set, compared with low-value gear like bronze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550751996653346827)
- **cortina quest on shelter island counting**: The Cortina quest on Shelter Island probably counts only mobs killed, based on mob value, and not looted gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554387498480963625)
- **crane stance healing**: Crane stance in the wrestling codex heals 1 health per rank per combo, according to its in-game description. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546293865848381460)
- **crossbow ammo consumption**: A crossbow consumes less ammo than a faster bow, with slower attacks and bigger hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547985223231213693)
- **cure potions for poison**: Players without a reliable poison cure in their build can carry cure potions to cure poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551656914289430569)
- **curse and mana drain use**: Curse is used for more spell damage, and Mana Drain is used when a higher mana refund chance is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586088415428803)
- **curse and poison sting interaction**: Curse probably does not affect poison sting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551002610733949051)
- **curse spell effects**: Curse increases the caster's spell damage and lowers the target's spell damage, melee damage and attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551002610733949051)
- **curse versus damage spell tradeoff**: Whether to cast Curse depends on whether its mana cost and bonus damage beat casting another damaging spell; for example, the Fireball damage-over-time may deal more total damage than Curse's bonus damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546985370925793352)
- **damage calculators**: Stats are unreliable for judging damage, and outlandsbutler.com offers the most comprehensive set of calculators available to players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552169615973548123)
- **damage resistance cap**: Additional damage resistance provides no benefit once you are already at the damage resistance cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547221880879063040)
- **damage tracking command**: The status page is an unreliable source for damage information; the [damagetracker command shows total damage and has a display for poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550688467334467685)
- **defensive barding**: Defensive barding only applies against players and turns off if you attack back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530275542870261800)
- **defensive links survivability**: Defensive links combined with parry, healing and alchemy make a dungeon skinner/scavenger very durable; with 32 defensive links one can stand still in level 3 dungeons and outheal incoming damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527331052836753529)
- **detecting treasure map diggers**: Treasure map diggers can be detected by tracking players who stand motionless at about 100 tiles from a dig site, which is a sign of scouts watching it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **dex tamer pk escape weakness**: A dex tamer template is very bad at escaping PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **dexterity potion effect on bandage timer**: The dexterity potion also affects the bandage timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475622145859677)
- **dexxer armor choice**: Plate armor is better than leather for a dexxer, while leather is intended mainly for mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550989104529932309)
- **dexxer mastery chain link priority**: For a dexxer, mastery chain links are best spent on melee damage and ignore armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555476330693402657)
- **dexxer special chance links**: Most other weapon skills benefit more from special chance/damage links than from the MD/AI links, so special chance/damage links are useful for other dexxer builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544772525387419708)
- **dexxer template similarity**: Most dexxer templates share a similar build and differ mainly in weapon skill and aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548224655255535627)
- **dexxer weapon choice**: A two-handed weapon gives a dexxer more damage, while a one-hander with a shield gives somewhat more durability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213774601097307)
- **dexxer weapon skill recommendation**: Wrestling is currently recommended over swords for a dexxer, according to a single player's opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553014324736303105)
- **disarm mechanic**: A separate mechanic from Hamstring disarms opponents, unequipping shields and weapons, and these abilities are based on certain skills and activated by a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109910615957555)
- **discipline aspect for dexxers**: Discipline is an excellent first aspect for a new dexxer, and a discipline wrestler is currently really good for solo farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553775013813952523)
- **discipline aspect pvm build**: The Discipline aspect PvM build works well with any weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548549439008804906)
- **discordance resistance bonus**: Discordance gives players and their followers a damage resistance bonus of 5% multiplied by (effective Barding skill / 100), according to the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539054203412511)
- **disease damage scaling**: A disease applied by necromancy or pets deals a percentage of the damage that triggered it, so a stronger trigger such as flamestrike applies a stronger disease than magic arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551930468579016705)
- **disease effect stacking**: Each application of the disease effect, whether applied by the player or the player's pets, is completely separate and does not interfere with or override the other applications. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551932769687572554)
- **disease stacking**: Diseases do not override each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551930579426082879)
- **displaying weapon abilities on screen**: Type [abilityhotbar to display weapon abilities on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545806239932620852)
- **distraction flanking damage bonus**: Distraction gives a damage bonus when attacking a mob from its side or rear by increasing Stealth skill for the damage calculation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549051643314700449)
- **dps test window**: To open the DPS test window, use the Damage Tracker entry in the Help menu on the client's top toolbar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555377889996968022)
- **dragging mobs from spawn**: Mobs can be dragged a little way from their spawn location, possibly farther in the wilderness than in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545496128135372860)
- **dual weapon skill pvp setup**: A PvP character with both a close-range weapon skill and Archery can fight with a sword or mace and switch to a bow when the opponent runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555274705584398407)
- **dual wielding viability**: Dual Wielding can be good but may need more links to work out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545095283854147616)
- **dungeon boss spawning**: Guilds summon dungeon bosses, and random boss spawns also occur roughly every 12-24 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553157808449519727)
- **dungeon chest picking as loot source**: Dungeon chest picking is a way to obtain loot comparable to PvM without killing monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550327206952181791)
- **dungeon level 4 danger**: Dungeon level 4 can be dangerous if you are not careful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045808063356959)
- **dungeon mount restriction**: In dungeons players are forced off their mounts, which reportedly gives a better fighting chance against PKs than in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664481657888779)
- **duo t8 treasure maps with prestige drop**: Duo T8 treasure maps are still well worth doing once the prestige drop is added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529903284402258102)
- **early pvm for summoners and tamers**: Summoners and tamers have an easier early PvM experience because their pets hold aggro and absorb damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547616536850604092)
- **earth elemental earthquake immunity**: Earth elementals are believed not to be immune to earthquake, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553606484712230913)
- **earth elemental summon duration**: A cast earth elemental summon lasts about 2 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551148450115092551)
- **elder daemon summoning**: Elder daemons cannot be summoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549912432682602559)
- **eldritch aspect energy surge**: The Eldritch Aspect special Energy Surge deals (600 + 60 * Tier Level) damage split among creatures within a 6 tile radius, reduces their Magic Resist by (25 + 2 * Tier Level) for 30 seconds, and creates a 30 second Mana Well providing (10 + 2 * Tier Level) mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545887432661008497)
- **elemental tanking roles**: Earth Elementals are likely better at tanking enemies that deal physical damage, while Water Elementals are likely better at tanking enemies that deal magic damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547226998072672350)
- **energy bolt on dying mobs**: As a mage progresses, Energy Bolt should be used when mobs are about to die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546979352271519845)
- **escaping a mob**: To get away from a mob, paralyze it and move off screen, or run the mob off first and then paralyze it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528920357111730236)
- **escaping pks camping a dungeon**: When PKs camp a dungeon, run out, wait about 5 minutes until they finish, then return, and run again about 20 minutes later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474976883548262)
- **escaping reds while mapping**: When a red (PK) attacks while mapping, a player can outheal their damage and run them 100-150 tiles away, then rehike to map with a new setup, so losing a map is hard unless ganked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542360530243821568)
- **evil omen damage bonus**: Evil Omen grants additive damage, so a 20% additive bonus yields only about 8% extra damage for a mage who already has other damage sources, and it carries a drawback and requires switching d2d links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328072859975722)
- **explosion potion area damage**: An Explosion Potion thrown at one monster also damages other monsters near it through its area of effect, which is normal behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033183749087274)
- **explosive potions in pvm**: Explosive potions are very effective in PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553928938269446276)
- **extra chivalry seals effect**: The two additional seals from higher Chivalry boost the other abilities in the Chivalry book, giving more damage, more special damage, more swing speed, and a higher chance for Dispel Evil to reflect spells and attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680694644805784)
- **extreme survivability build**: Extreme survivability can be built through item identification, parrying, inscription and water aspect armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547591416966811678)
- **fencing build poison use**: Fencing is meant to be used with poisons, and using it without poisons is considered suboptimal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555481606008086549)
- **fighting harvester pks with a dexxer**: A dexxer character can fight back against harvester PKs, who are generally poor fighters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549830751426453515)
- **fighting provoked mobs**: When fighting provoked mobs, alternate damage between them so their health percentages stay roughly even, so when one dies the remaining mob has less HP left. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547611700050657310)
- **finisher bonus from stances**: A finisher may receive a bonus for each stance raised to level 5, so upgrading unused stances might improve it, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540333824774328)
- **finisher cooldown**: A player can trigger only one Finisher on each mob (infinite cooldown), but can trigger a Finisher every 60 seconds on a Boss-Type Creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **finisher documentation**: Finisher mechanics are documented in the Finishers section of the Weapon and Parry Codex page on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553075281810555000)
- **finisher proc timing**: A finisher is a separate attack from the auto attack, so it can still proc after an auto attack drops a mob below the 10% HP threshold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553080880980041799)
- **flame strike spam risk**: Spamming Flame Strike is a gamble because a mage may only have mana for about 2 casts and is stuck without mana if the refund does not proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545325993038708756)
- **flamestrike damage and mana cost**: Flamestrike deals heavy damage but costs a lot of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549655525115830383)
- **flamestrike mana cost**: Players with higher-tier aspect, links and codex levels use Flamestrike because their levels can support its mana cost; a new character probably cannot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586244812378123)
- **follower damage links on summoner builds**: A spell damage necromancer summoner build does not have follower damage links, which apply to a follower-damage build such as 120 necromancy, 120 spirit speak and 120 herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555703641929678909)
- **food buff for arcane build**: Food is a strong, inexpensive buff, and for the Arcane build it provides both a mana regeneration buff and a swing speed buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545337420399116349)
- **forensic evaluation in pvm builds**: Forensic Evaluation is most commonly added to PvM builds for extra value, and scavengers are the closest thing to dedicated skinners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529654863431209120)
- **fortification armor**: Fortification armor is worth keeping in addition to invulnerability armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550062305553686639)
- **fortune armor with pets**: If the player wearing fortune armor has pets doing the damage, the fortune armor bonus still applies to mobs the pets kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551779227588755539)
- **fortune aspect damage buff**: The Fortune aspect gives a chance at a 50% damage buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538220909624565901)
- **fortune stabbing viability**: Fortune stabbing is only good when the character is very highly progressed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879720752783411)
- **frost aspect for dexxers and tamers**: Frost aspect is very strong for dexxers and also very strong for tamers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552975903326339155)
- **gathering skill weapon damage bonus**: Mining skill adds a damage bonus to maces and lumberjacking skill adds a damage bonus to axes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535316221543710832)
- **gear versus aspect damage**: Better gear increases damage before an aspect is unlocked, but unlocking an aspect greatly boosts damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545347919907913768)
- **gem elementals difficulty**: Gem elementals such as diamond elementals are strong enemies that are difficult for weak characters to kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541207692677230)
- **gold farming with poor stat pets**: A pet with poor stats can still farm gold effectively, though it will not deal maximum DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461354185228420)
- **greater paragon chest opening**: Lockpicking and Detect Hidden alone may not be sufficient to open greater paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553475877457891391)
- **group approach to t8 treasure maps**: To make T8 treasure maps manageable, run them with a small group in which each member contributes one map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529903148435636364)
- **guild boss summon cooldown**: A guild can summon a boss again 5 minutes after the previous boss dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553158672044265567)
- **hamstring from chivalry**: Hamstring is an ability gained by taking Chivalry, and it is considered very important in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553451622087004354)
- **hamstring mechanic**: Hamstring is a mechanic that drains the victim's stamina, forcing them to walk instead of run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109457329135637)
- **hamstring pvp skill requirements**: Hamstring in PvP reportedly requires Wrestling plus one of Anatomy, Arms Lore, Forensic Evaluation, or Tracking, so Wrestling plus Anatomy is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546510922393198662)
- **hamstring stamina drop duration**: Hamstring drops the target's stamina to 0 for about 3 seconds, enough for a mage to cast Weaken, Explosion and Teleport or throw an explosion potion, then switch back to a halberd to finish the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547112613786157077)
- **hamstring weapon requirement**: Hamstring may need to be used with a fighting weapon such as a quarterstaff rather than a harvesting tool, and it must be set up to toggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554268619746181246)
- **hard cast mage gate ambush**: Some players hard cast Mage Gate outside of render range to ambush targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539699689941770342)
- **harvester build with links and thralls in fury's caldera**: A harvester build with 30 links and two thralls could not kill the mobs in the worst part of Fury's Caldera in a reasonable amount of time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531424046896513195)
- **hiding and combat state**: Hiding automatically takes you out of combat so your character stops swinging, and a smoke bomb does the same instantly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550797346600914945)
- **high damage mage weapon choice**: High damage mages generally use arcane staffs rather than spellbooks at present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553906159273115689)
- **hit-and-run cycle**: Hit-and-run cycle: hide, stealth, attack, run, then hide again; this stops you swinging at the target, and the target can walk over you without you attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550797475361853563)
- **hotkey setup for targeting**: Bind commonly used skills, spells and items to hotkeys, bind a target-cycling hotkey that sets the chosen mob as Last Target, and bind Last Target and Target Self hotkeys so the reticle can be applied to either. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549455207845339197)
- **immobile mobs in shelter island dungeon marsh**: In the marsh area of the Shelter Island dungeon, some mobs cannot move, so players can attack them and back away when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547266033872543817)
- **important pet stats and good thresholds**: For melee pets the key stats are attack speed, damage and wrestling, and good ones have at least +4% speed, +9% attack and +8% wrestling; caster pets use the same thresholds without wrestling and prioritize attack speed and spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555660860720943225)
- **individual pet aggro setting**: To change an individual pet's aggro behaviour, use Animal Lore on the pet, click Abilities, and use the top-left option, which is aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555585797120327763)
- **inscription mage scroll casting**: Inscription mages cast damage spells from scrolls to get higher damage, but they still need to carry reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552977214822289490)
- **invisibility detection by pks**: Invisibility may work if PKs pass by, but PKs with tracking or detect hidden, or who run over you, will find you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553509893435035664)
- **item identification for time dungeon tank**: A Time dungeon tank build may use Item Identification for its bonus to magic items to reach maximum armor, though this is not a new-player build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366180483371071)
- **last summon slot choice**: For the final summon slot, Summon Creature can yield a ghoul, and a ranged summon such as a skeletal marksman is an alternative that avoids constant resummoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546000522803155054)
- **leather armor tradeoff**: Leather armor makes a character somewhat less durable than plate but removes most mana concerns for the wearer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532227426959233114)
- **lethal poison charge usage**: Applying lethal poison to a weapon reportedly does not consume a whole charge per application in PvE, though it may against players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550233309127376917)
- **lightning armor aspect strength**: The lightning armor aspect is considered very strong, letting an Arcane mage out-damage many lightning archers in groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544400918513197067)
- **lightning hindering mobs**: Lightning can be used to hinder mobs if it is selected in the Wizard's Grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552704761189376021)
- **llama aggro as pack animal**: Llamas draw less aggro than bears when used as pack animals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538275138909249636)
- **low evaluating intelligence spell damage penalty**: Low Evaluating Intelligence applies a negative modifier to spell damage, which is why many summoners cast no damaging spells at all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544888791028863026)
- **low level arcane blood mage rotation**: A low level Arcane/Blood mage should use flamestrike and the low level rotation (harm, lightning, etc.), and use timed energy bolts to recover mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546974946817745041)
- **mace dexxer with air aspect**: A Mace Dexxer build using the Air Aspect is considered very good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548494943872352372)
- **macros and hotkeys in combat**: Macros and hotkeys save time in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554211069629698100)
- **madness aspect for archers**: Madness aspect is a good swap for archers if AoE aspects become an issue in group content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988221011529801)
- **madness bleed self-damage**: Bleed damage can proc the Madness self-damage, which is reportedly limited to one instance of 5 HP per second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553331357965484045)
- **mage aspect stat choice**: Mages wanting aspect specials should seek 'spell aspect special chance' on gear rather than 'spell proc chance'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545888042580189274)
- **mage build archetypes**: Mages in Outlands generally either use summons to absorb damage while they deal damage, or play with a staff, which forms one of the tankiest builds in the game, and just cast spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550148843507552338)
- **mage fighting with spellbook equipped**: A mage with a spellbook equipped will still swing at the first monster that aggros them when they have no aggro, but does little damage with fists while holding a spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554679742609756261)
- **mage mana and damage boosts**: Ways to improve a mage's mana and damage in Outlands include the Meditation skill, a wizard grimoire, and a magic spell book that gives a mana refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550147311055937649)
- **mage support setup**: In a mage support setup, use blade spirit to aggro, provocation for crowd control, and flamestrike, curse, mana drain and mind blast from a grimoire/Eldritch book, and use invisibility to drop line of sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549957344752836681)
- **magic potions in pvp**: Magic potions have no effect in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535321131928522832)
- **magic weapon drops and identification**: Mobs drop magic weapons that must be identified before recycling, although using a weapon yourself reveals its properties through your player stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549613514493272155)
- **magical slaying bows rarity**: Magical slaying bows are valuable, but it is very rare to find one with both high bonus damage and a decent accuracy modifier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088092931002439)
- **maiming stance effects**: Maiming stance increases hinder duration and overpowered hinder damage, but at low tier players cannot rely on hinders and lightning shocks to keep mobs off them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553901539733671997)
- **mana refund chance cap**: The mana refund chance cap is easy to reach, so good magic spellbooks are generally not needed, and the Eminently Potent prefix's 15% mana refund chance is mostly useless at present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553905854636625952)
- **material spellbooks with arcane staff**: When casting with an arcane staff, a material spellbook is not needed; material spellbooks are mostly intended for mages who do not use arcane. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546668914421792931)
- **melee aspect special proc rate**: The melee aspect special proc rate is normalized by weapon speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553951872556204143)
- **melee links for arcane staff mage**: Melee special chance and special damage links work for the arcane staff mage build, but they are probably not worth using. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545469305989234838)
- **melee poison sting**: When a player lands a melee hit with a poisoned weapon on a creature already poisoned with the same poison type, they have a chance to trigger a Melee Poison Sting that immediately resolves 1 Poison Tick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544062805450293311)
- **melee special links and codex finishers**: Melee special chance and special damage links do not affect Codex finishers, because special attacks and finishers are separate mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546582564410761336)
- **meta aspects for fastest experience**: The fastest experience is usually obtained by using the meta aspects, and Lightning is one of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552986989282852875)
- **meteor site alien creatures**: The alien creatures at a meteor site are likely immune to physical damage and are best fought with a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541058958594089)
- **mind blast against high armor**: Mind Blast is worth considering against high armor targets, provided you are in an area with a good number of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546981810381004930)
- **mining skill damage bonus to macing**: Mining skill adds bonus damage to mace weapon attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521386825095315486)
- **mob damage resistance buff**: Mobs recently received a damage resistance (DR) buff, which makes them feel stronger than before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548723765414731858)
- **mob respawn timer visibility**: A mob's respawn timer is not visible to players, so it must be worked out by observation, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544694972614180864)
- **mob stealing rules**: Attacking a mob that another player is already fighting is not against the rules, because players do not own mobs or dungeons and attacking mobs is not a criminal offense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554993542508707841)
- **mobs before tmap chest**: With the new tmap system, mobs such as sunscales can be encountered before reaching the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532106905240080554)
- **monster difficulty and first aspect**: Monsters in Outlands are tough, so a character without Codex, Aspect and Chain progress is weak, and unlocking the first Aspect gives a noticeable boost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546332332099772457)
- **monster hp visibility**: Animal Lore can be used on a monster to see its exact HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546254547691774052)
- **monster resistance to barding skills**: Monsters have a resistance to Barding skills, so peacemaking can fail even with high skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554920951911555196)
- **movement while casting**: You must stand still while channeling a spell, but once the targeting cursor is up you can move. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548101800144408756)
- **multiboxed pk against hidden chivalry gatherer**: A player can multibox a PK character to kill a gatherer who is protected by a hidden chivalry mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529892472355033148)
- **multiple-target stances and backstab**: Multiple-target weapon stances such as Cleave do not work with backstab attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547767593434218617)
- **murder tagging**: Killing enough blue (innocent) players tags you as a murderer in Outlands PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551091829708038166)
- **natural boss spawn cooldown**: Natural boss spawns have a cooldown of about 12 hours for mini bosses and 24 hours for main bosses, after which they reportedly spawn randomly within a 12-24 hour window; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553159509604827139)
- **nearest target cycling usefulness**: Cycling to the nearest target works for PvM but not for PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549455207845339197)
- **necromancer dps setup**: When doing DPS as a necromancer, one player rarely uses aspects and instead relies on the madness book and earth armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551567063879786539)
- **necromancy damage bonus**: Necromancy benefits summons and also provides straight damage buffs to spells you cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339360048554055)
- **necromancy disease damage over time**: Necromancy causes offensive spells to apply a disease damage-over-time effect, and some necromancy abilities increase overall offensive spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548027807441879071)
- **necromancy disease stacks**: Necromancy disease stacks still deal extra damage over time without requiring additional mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326044599558165)
- **necromancy free mana ability**: A Necromancy ability grants roughly 50 free mana every 30 seconds that can be spent on non-offensive spells such as summoning, buffs, heals and revives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548027924014301335)
- **necromancy mummy form hit points**: Necromancy mummy form never regains the hit points it loses, so it becomes brittle after being used for some time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554261214803267645)
- **npc and monster ships on the ocean**: There are NPC and monster ships on the ocean that can be farmed like a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668839941546135)
- **nuking resource maps**: Players can nuke a resource map to clear out its spawned monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528173673075441785)
- **ocean fishing risk**: Ocean fishing is a viable activity, and the main risk is other boaters coming to sink your boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536933090872791090)
- **one-handed crossbow and shield**: A one-handed crossbow lets the wielder equip a shield for a higher armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547989561974464616)
- **pack animal against harvester hunters**: A pack animal helps against harvester hunters because its moo warns that something is nearby, and hits it takes are hits not landing on the player, since wilderness reds using scripts often hit it accidentally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535335109299802243)
- **paragon chest loot**: Paragon chest loot is roughly the same as regular monster drops: magic items, gold, a core or two, and occasionally a MCD. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545188988950945822)
- **paragon monster journal text**: Paragon monsters appear with golden text in the journal when you pass them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544214146827026523)
- **paragon spawn chance**: Almost every mob has a fairly low chance to spawn as a paragon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545495080998150195)
- **paragon spawn mob type**: A paragon spawns as the same mob type as its spawn location's normal mob, so unusual mobs nearby were likely dragged in or came from a progressive spawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545496128135372860)
- **paralyze against mobs**: Paralyze is effective for holding mobs, is underused by players, and costs no mana when used to re-paralyze a held mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528920391752618024)
- **paralyzing mobs as resource mapper**: Resource mappers can paralyze the mob as a fallback if their summons go down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **parry with bare fists**: If you fight with plain fists and no wrestling weapon, you need a shield to parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549384076106928269)
- **parry-capable equipment**: Players may parry melee attacks with shields, two-handed weapons, paired weapons (wrestling/dual wielding) and parry daggers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551307831028752585)
- **peacemaking while running past mobs**: Peacemaking can be used while running past a mob to stop it from fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548070676190068807)
- **pet aggro option colors**: In the pet aggro option, red means the pet gets aggro and gray means it does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555585891702018212)
- **pet aggro setup for ranged and non-tank pets**: It is good practice to set ranged and non-tank pets to not get aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555586143930687729)
- **pet attack command**: To make pets attack first, type 'all kill' (default keybind 3) and then target the mob they should attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536727009820733)
- **pet damage and aspect procs**: Damage dealt by pets does not trigger the owner's aspect weapon procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551779227588755539)
- **pet damage bug in pvp**: A known bug lets a thief or PK deal over 200 damage in one hit to a pet in PVP, and admins have said it needs a complicated fix. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532136163454746717)
- **pet guard command**: Typing 'all guard' (default keybind 2) makes pets guard you and attack back when you attack or are attacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536665366007880)
- **pet healing with poison field**: Standing pets in a cast Poison Field while healing them is suggested over basic bandage heals, which are slow; curing poison and resurrecting dead pets is much faster than basic healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974175261663353)
- **pet strength by level**: Pets become strong at levels 10-15, and level 10 is quick to reach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553464972280078520)
- **pets for thieves**: For a thief, pets serve mainly to tank and to give the appearance of not being a thief, so they can be sub-par pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477641348849796)
- **pets in pvp**: Pets in PvP on Outlands are restricted by a max hit cycle, so pet level has little effect, although some pets perform somewhat better than others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544134726695133305)
- **pets in pvp**: Pets are mostly ignorable in PvP because of the damage cap, and melee pets move at 80% speed in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550583825543725198)
- **pickaxe damage for defense**: A pickaxe can deal up to 32 damage, so a defensive miner can use it to chase off attackers who do not expect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531439635165614100)
- **pit trials gear**: Survival gear is used for Pit Trials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555040118761463832)
- **pk approach methods against map runners**: PKs approach map runners using stealth or a blue gater, meaning a blue-flagged character arriving through a gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542083294089449472)
- **pk chivalry gate ambush**: A PK can stealth in, set a chivalry gate location, stealth off screen, recall home, then chivalry gate back and relog so the gate opens next to the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539699002529026048)
- **pk encounter rate factors**: The number of PKs you encounter depends on the day and time, the weekly regional dungeon bonuses, whether you farm in a bonus dungeon, and your activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552158705565310997)
- **pk guild activity schedule**: PK guilds tend to run almost nightly during a window of a couple of hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554370558601203763)
- **pk locations and harvester routes**: PKs are mostly found at PvP points of interest, near towns like Prev, and on routes where harvesters are common, so harvesters may avoid them by choosing different routes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535343990105317437)
- **pk looting under new tmap system**: Under the new tmap system, PKs are expected to rarely loot a chest because the setup makes looting difficult, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531109850690490408)
- **pk mounted movement speed**: A player killer on a mount can move about 11 tiles per second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542041718654898226)
- **pk risk for treasure map runners**: PKs rarely attack treasure map runners in the wilderness; one player reports about one PK encounter per 50 T-maps without tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531425331875942410)
- **pk risk while picking chests**: While stealthily picking dungeon chests, only PKs using Tracking (which many run) can find you, and keeping enough mobs between you and PKs keeps you safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546173165820969010)
- **pks spotted by 60 tracking**: PKs spotted with 60 Tracking are mostly ones not running toward the player, so they are not a threat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542042038244089896)
- **plate armor and mana regeneration**: Wearing plate armor for its defensive perks makes you regain mana very slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532227426959233114)
- **plate armor without head piece**: You can wear plate armor without the plate head piece to keep your preferred headwear, at the cost of some armor rating (AR). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925399004184647)
- **player damage boosts and pets**: Effects that boost your own damage often do not boost your pets' damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547231941990813787)
- **player killer encounter rate on treasure maps**: One player reports meeting a player killer about once in every 50 treasure maps when running without Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536828371403546784)
- **player poison damage**: Player poison damage depends on the poison tier inflicted and the poisoner's Taste Identification, and weapon damage does not change how much damage the poison does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550205500354723963)
- **player spell interruption**: Player-cast spells interrupt a caster regardless of wrestling skill or other interrupt-avoidance measures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546655868500705422)
- **poison codex tick upgrade**: An entry in the poison codex grants an extra poison tick when upgraded, so casting poison a couple of times may do more damage rather than less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554443780839575585)
- **poison dexxer solo build**: A poison dexxer is a high-quality build for solo play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548550712273670196)
- **poison hit resolve stacking**: A single poison hit can resolve several effects at once: the tick, the sting, and bane (3x resolve), totaling 5 resolves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544062619478921346)
- **poison kit codex**: The Poison Kit is the codex for poison and gives damage and damage reduction buffs against poisoned creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550226193331257385)
- **poison kit damage bonus**: The poison kit adds a 15% damage bonus against poisoned creatures, including damage from traps and explosion potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553190945082712156)
- **poison sting frequency limit**: By default a player can inflict a Poison Sting (melee or spell) at most once every 5 seconds, per the August 11 patch notes, so weapon choice for a poison fencer is mostly about look or sound. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550205730643120301)
- **poison summoner build approach**: For a poison summoner, max the Dismissive, Purification, Spirit Pact and Stagnant traits, throw summons into groups of mobs, poison them, let them die to recover mana, then resummon quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547231069009354783)
- **power and vanquishing weapon rarity**: Power and Vanquishing magic weapons are rare drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544565445918862)
- **progressive spawn rare drops**: Any mob during any phase of a progressive spawn can drop the spawn's rare item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723951549980854)
- **push through blocking enemies**: Two rows of enemies can block you from pushing through, but you can still push through a single row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544713614714478603)
- **pvm armor choice by stat build**: PvM characters typically wear leather armor with 100 INT and plate armor with 100 DEX. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359420264841248)
- **pvm ship combat requirements**: PvM ship content requires a character suited to water combat plus a boat, supplies and crew; logging into the portal and verifying lets you talk to ship players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553559472545341502)
