- **pvm skills while pvp flagged**: Skills that excel in PvM builds, such as Chivalry, Arms Lore, Parry and Focus, do not work at all or are diminished while PvP flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555272363250155560)
- **pvm spell damage choices**: Flamestrike, or the smaller spells that the grimoire buffs on rotation, are commonly used for PvM spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547643365997281331)
- **pvm template cost**: Every PvM template other than a dexxer is reportedly expensive to set up and maintain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **pvm threats to fishing ships**: Fishing ships are often attacked by PvM threats on the ocean, but staying fast and attentive usually keeps you safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549703228336373841)
- **pvm xp progress for pvp characters in dungeons**: A PvP-focused character with progress in the PvM XP systems survives better against dungeon mobs, and deeper dungeon levels have mobs that can crush a character with no such progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547614316658688111)
- **pvm xp sources**: PvM XP in UO Outlands is earned from killing mobs in the overworld, dungeons, and on the ocean, as well as from lockpicking chests, treasure maps, dungeon chest picking, and stealing from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378717981020261)
- **pvp availability**: Outlands has plenty of PvP: open-world PvP in the wild, structured events every hour on the hour, Strangelands a few times per week, and factions available at any time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545243493054808094)
- **pvp damage testing dummy**: There is believed to be no PvP dummy for testing damage, but damage can be tested on the test server using two characters or with a friend. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588796561662044)
- **pvp events without item drops**: Some PvP events do not drop players' items as long as they are using basic gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545193425945497600)
- **pvp full loot and blessed items**: Outlands PvP is mostly full loot; a handful of progression items and some fancy clothing can be blessed and cannot be taken, but weapons cannot be blessed and several armor slots have no blessed alternative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545192816022528050)
- **pvp versus pvm character specialization**: Because of the skill cap, a character is tailored to either PvP or PvM and is less effective in the other, so pure PvM characters tend to be glass cannons in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615073290158080)
- **pvp weapon damage classes**: PvP players typically use swords and archery and carry weapons of every damage class (interrupt, light grinding, heavy grinding, and burst), alternating them as swings become available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550278355419664496)
- **ranged summon creature option before tome leveling**: Before the Summoner's Tome is leveled, the ranged option for the summon creature spell is Ghoul. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161428238172161)
- **ranged weapon types for archery**: One-handed crossbows have the highest average DPS and allow a shield for slightly more armor rating, while two-handed burst bows deal better damage on finisher shots and repeater; both have 2 tiles less range than two-handed interrupt bows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553900180766457888)
- **ransack stealth step damage bonus**: Ransack gives a backstabber a damage bonus based on remaining stealth steps, up to 10 steps, so 10 or more steps count the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549051643314700449)
- **ransack versus distraction damage**: Ransack with 10 or more steps remaining does slightly more damage than Distraction, but only by a couple of percent, and it requires managing stealth steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549052731338002536)
- **recall escape from harvester pks**: Standing still and recalling away repeatedly is a way to escape pursuing harvester PKs; defensive barding gives about 60 effective wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549909154703999087)
- **recall farming method**: Recall farming means recalling nonstop between wilderness PvM spots, killing monsters, looting gold and skinning everything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525626260703940698)
- **recent adjustment in upcoming patch**: In the upcoming patch discussion, the only thing reportedly adjusted was the healing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531092499693572167)
- **recognizing progressive spawns**: A progressive spawn can be recognized when, after you kill a spawn, more mobs appear a few minutes later casting flamestrike; its mobs may also cast other spells such as explosions and have unusual names, especially at the higher end. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546929120984694844)
- **red hand lootability and attackability**: Red Hand players are freely attackable and their corpses are freely lootable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548924715513413663)
- **red player presence at necromancer island map**: A red player typically arrives within 3-4 minutes at the necromancer island map location, even late at night. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528899138232520794)
- **red players and treasure chests**: Because the treasure chest opens on boss death, red players can kill the boss and loot the chest without first killing the blue players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528891318787379262)
- **reducing spell damage**: The Resisting Spells skill reduces spell damage, and other reduction methods exist depending on skills, aspect, codices and links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552376584185323683)
- **repeater hit weapon swap**: For Repeater hits, players switch to a heavy bow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553434186210091039)
- **resource map pop location**: Under the new resource map system, the location where a map will pop is not known in advance, so players should have summons up and be ready for mob aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544470767306276984)
- **ricochet versus pincushion**: The Ricochet archery ability is much stronger than Pincushion on multi-mob pulls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546868162677706772)
- **sanctuary dungeon corpse looting**: In a sanctuary dungeon, only players who are green to you (guild, ally or party members) can pick up items from your corpse before it turns to bones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544123814126821446)
- **selecting weapon finisher in codex**: To use a weapon finisher in Ultima Online: Outlands, select the finisher in your codex; after that no manual activation is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545566684499284038)
- **self-heal methods**: Most players heal themselves with a one-button Razor hotkey or an in-game macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **setting ranged summons to ranged attack**: For ranged summons such as fire elemental or lich, use animal lore on the summon, open the abilities page, turn off aggro (top-left circle black, not red), and set the summon to ranged attack (top middle). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161754467074142)
- **shadowspire gargoyle danger**: In Shadowspire, gargoyles that target you will likely one-shot you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078357313626137)
- **shelter dungeon rewards**: The Shelter dungeon gives 75% of the normal exp and gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330489823596575)
- **shelter dungeon second floor difficulty**: The second floor of the Shelter dungeon is noticeably harder than the first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850297705304155)
- **shield damage resistance**: Equipping a shield gives 10% damage resistance, independent of the Parry skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381196671098951)
- **shield use with one-handed ranged weapons**: A shield can be used with a one-handed ranged weapon without needing Parry, and one-handed weapons are a bit quicker in speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553900035375235114)
- **skills on mobs**: Mobs have special abilities, and skills do not work on them exactly as they do on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555049485720227882)
- **solo pit trial builds**: Trapper or poison necromancer builds are likely still the go-to choices for solo Pit trials, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547172861779644528)
- **solo stealth archer viability**: A solo stealth archer gives up about 200 skill points for Hiding and Stealth, making solo kills difficult, but the build can work with a partner where both are hidden and attack together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550286678910967860)
- **solo versus group content**: Most Outlands content is solo and is generally more efficient than group play, while group content is mostly bosses and omnis and is considered a chore by some players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552993224379859146)
- **special spellbook drops**: Special spellbooks, such as ones affecting mana regeneration, are loot items that drop from mobs with a certain chance, and the chance is reportedly lower on Shelter where enemies are easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602692267483208)
- **spell damage increases**: Spell damage can be increased with a Wizard's Grimoire, Evaluating Intelligence, and aspects; some players also use Inscription and cast from scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549648573757530243)
- **spell stone depletion**: A spell stone disappears once it runs out of uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196326558638141)
- **spell targeting timing**: A spell only goes off if the target cursor is up, so pressing the last target key too early may not queue the spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548101809761943613)
- **spellbook mana versus arcane mana**: Spellbooks provide a stable, predictable source of mana, whereas arcane mana recovery is chance-based. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546330355420766281)
- **spellbook modifiers in pvp**: Spellbook modifiers, including item ID skill bonuses to spell damage, do not apply in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555246791740498001)
- **spot fishing mob difficulty**: The mobs spawned at fishing spots are easy enough to kill without needing loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **starfall meteor site activity**: At Starfall meteor sites players kill the monsters including the Omega, which may drop unique decorations; a Lyceum quest may involve them, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550962677281456190)
- **stealing while looting own corpse in town**: Other players can hide next to you in town and steal from you while you loot your own corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546036846117527663)
- **stealth archer backstab bolt damage**: With enough aspect and links, a stealth archer's backstab bolt can deal 10,000 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550291995170177048)
- **stealth pets in dungeons**: Other players who see tamed pets walking around a dungeon may assume they are following a ghost, which is why stealth pets suit a stealth build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549643448682815549)
- **stopping attacking minions**: To stop minions that are attacking you, you must also stop attacking them by toggling war/peace mode twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554599801914400842)
- **strength potions vs pks**: Strength potions increase maximum health, which helps you outlast PK attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **summon choice by build**: Earth elementals are the typical choice for pure tanking and spell-damage builds, daemons for melee damage and follower-damage builds, and liches for ranged damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551198126663143478)
- **summon creature tanking**: Casting Summon Creature creates creatures that tank mobs for you in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549604306888687659)
- **summoner and necro staff requirement**: The staffs named 'summoner staff' and 'necro staff' are not required for summoner or necromancer builds; they are only cosmetic looks for non-arcane mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586478810669067)
- **summoner codex effect on necromancer pets**: The Summoner Codex boosts necromancer pets as well as other summoned pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554163558223454249)
- **summoner damage link setup**: Summoners reportedly run 10 follower damage links, though the purpose of the remaining slots is unconfirmed and may be spell aspect links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147018103066805)
- **summoner dungeon choices**: Dungeons other than Shadowspire Cathedral are easier places for a summoner mage than Kraul Hive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553787019279470626)
- **summoner mage casting tool**: Summoner mage variants use spellbooks rather than staves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586335696822324)
- **summoner's tome for harvesters**: A Summoner's Tome on a lumberjack or miner lets the character still kill some enemies while skinning in dungeons, and beefy summons benefit the scavenger playstyle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547356332405956688)
- **summoner's tome leveling**: Leveling the Summoner's Tome increases the strength of summoner followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554146543114920067)
- **summons tanking in fury's caldera**: Summoned creatures such as earth elementals can tank all mobs in the worst part of Fury's Caldera for a player with T15 harvest and no links who is dropped there via the [go menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531424046896513195)
- **surviving pk attacks**: To survive PKs, use greater strength and magic resist potions and a script that pops potions and runs to the red gate instead of fighting reds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784341006385254)
- **swing speed and weapon proc chances**: Increasing swing speed, such as through Arms Lore, gives more proc chances because proc chance is scaled by weapon speed (swing delay), unlike spell casting speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555525383959347243)
- **swing speed cap**: The swing speed cap is typically 0.50 (50%) unless altered by the air aspect or redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550423632637984820)
- **swing speed cap with aspect**: The swing speed cap rises above the 60 shown on the Outlands Butler when an aspect is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329914533806111)
- **sword codex tactics requirement**: The sword codex is believed to depend on printed (base) Tactics skill rather than skill gained from weapon or aspect bonuses, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554599374577999876)
- **sword mastery link bleed damage option**: Sword users can put mastery links into damage to bleeding instead of damage dealt by the player, which is better with bleeds but loses flexibility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555482088571146271)
- **sword weapon special bleed total**: The Swordsmanship weapon special causes the target to suffer total bleed damage equal to the damage dealt by the hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544430213004529755)
- **t-map boss health**: After the T-map update, the T-map boss has almost 3x its previous health. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **t-map chest opening**: After the T-map update, the chest opens when the boss dies, which suits raids, and the chest carries the player's name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **t8 frequency with tracking**: Players recalling around with 120 tracking typically find only a couple of T8s in progress per day. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537841111077355610)
- **t8 map travel requirement**: After the patch, T8 map owners must travel to the map location or lose the map, so raiders can camp one to three spots and wait for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537841454469095496)
- **t8 treasure map digging raids**: T8 treasure map digging parties can be raided by other players, and since a patch the treasure map guardians take longer to kill, giving raiders a larger window to catch diggers still at it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **t8 treasure map monster health change**: An upcoming change doubles T8 treasure map monster health, making T8s slower, though they remain a good fit for duos. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529902056788201604)
- **t8 treasure map raiding guilds**: Roughly 4-5 guilds on Outlands raid T8 treasure map diggers as a hobby, and most of them use scouts (dedicated scout characters or blue characters farming) positioned around the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **tactics skill codex and defensive stance**: Without the Tactics skill you lose access to the Tactics codex and its defensive stance, which players consider good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629915263729685)
- **tactics skill for damage**: Without Tactics a character deals noticeably less damage and is not very effective in combat, though Tactics can still be used to interrupt spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549235694067650652)
- **tamer aspect choice**: Tamers want the Command aspect for its many follower buffs, which leaves little room to use other aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778011378286654)
- **tamer command aspect without combat skills**: A tamer without combat skills can equip a Throwing Weapon or an Arcane Staff and activate Command; against peaced creatures, roughly 20-30% accuracy is enough to proc specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314386743656529)
- **tamer damage sources**: On a tamer, pets deal about 90% of the damage, and bows are mainly used to proc abilities and possibly disarm or hinder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629304468209737)
- **tamer harvest armor with command weapon**: A tamer can use a command-aspect weapon together with harvest-aspect armor, and the harvest armor grants a decent damage resist bonus while skinning things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521057159620726835)
- **tamer survival tactics**: Tamers survive by learning threat range and keeping all guard up on pets when within a mob's range; mobs instantly target pets, and you tell pets to follow again once the mob is attacked, though AoE damage can still hit occasionally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547585863968358410)
- **tamer treasure maps in harvest aspect**: Treasure maps up to level 6 can be done by a tamer while in harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521075460165992528)
- **tamer weapon setup**: A one-handed crossbow with a shield is probably the best weapon setup for a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553749290147381269)
- **tamers in pvp**: Tamers are poor at fighting PKs because tamed pets have many drawbacks during PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551656079207825429)
- **taming power level**: Taming is considered pretty overpowered, so pet choice can be made largely by preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569339257983036)
- **tarsands tarpits center spawn**: The spot in the middle of the Tarsands Tarpits has about 5 mobs that respawn around you at any time, with ranged abilities, AoE abilities and hard-hitting melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533488925539307561)
- **taunt armor rating bonus**: Taunt grants an armor rating bonus equal to 25 × (Effective Parry / 100) for 15 seconds after a taunt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502133217370263)
- **teleport spell with rope**: While a Teleport spell is being cast, you can use a rope, and the spell still teleports you when casting finishes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554820850820059149)
- **testing spell damage without randomness**: Use the command [TestMaxSpellDamageRolls to test spell damage without random variation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553086435588964353)
- **testudo mirror against magic mobs**: A Testudo mirror is recommended when taking heavy damage from magic-using mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332281561616446)
- **thief supply habits**: Many thieves carry few supplies such as cure potions, trapped pouches, and armor, so a player can exploit whichever key supplies a given thief lacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547374760449675284)
- **tier 4 treasure maps with harvest aspect**: One player runs tier 4 treasure maps using the Harvest aspect with no damage links and relies on traps, and a tamer or summoner class can handle resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546613012856842)
- **tier 8 treasure maps solo**: Tier 8 treasure maps are not intended to be soloed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537102251875635323)
- **toggling war and peace mode**: Press Tab to toggle between war mode and peace mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547550652740149298)
- **top-tier pet stat thresholds**: A top-tier pet has at least +4% speed, +9% attack and +8% wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461731810877511)
- **tracking refresh interval**: Tracking refreshes every 5 seconds, so missing a single update within that window can leave a red player directly in front of you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536918752304562278)
- **tracking use while treasure mapping**: Players who run Tracking while treasure mapping typically use it to bail out when reds (PKs) appear, and some set an auto-recall to trigger from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542363680212262972)
- **trapped pouch corpse protection**: Placing valuables in a trapped pouch nested several layers deep in your pack, with nothing in the first layer, makes looters spend time rummaging through your corpse and raises their risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550749641996247173)
- **trapped pouches against paralyze**: Players carry red trapped pouches and pop them to take at least 1 damage, which interrupts the paralyze effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545656527082496170)
- **trapper aspect for regular treasure maps**: For regular treasure maps, a trapper-aspect character is useful because it kills mobs quickly with area-of-effect damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550497085760077908)
- **treasure chest guards**: Once the mobs guarding a treasure chest are killed, the chest can be opened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555030502963023884)
- **treasure map bosses after patch**: After the patch, treasure map bosses are a wild mini-boss without adds, and the changes mostly affect solo players and small groups rather than larger guilds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528891675559334009)
- **treasure map build**: Treasure map mobs are easy, and a suggested build is command armor, a 4x tamer setup, 120 Forensic Evaluation and Cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546228982939123753)
- **treasure map character types**: Any character with multi-attack or area-of-effect damage makes a good treasure map character, and tamers are recommended to use five 1-slot mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546230375091671162)
- **treasure map combat limits**: Treasure map chest mob combat is limited to one character, and in ocean content only the boat owner can attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548517554115579995)
- **treasure map destination**: In the new treasure map system the destination is unknown in advance and players may be dropped randomly among monsters in the open world, so they must be ready to fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532097979538997370)
- **treasure map meta template**: The meta template for running treasure maps is probably still the trapper build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541530759884705792)
- **treasure map nuking**: After the recent changes, a treasure map can reportedly be nuked from anywhere rather than only from nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528902294077308928)
- **treasure map templates with cartography**: Cartography is powerful enough that any template can run treasure maps by swapping a DPS skill for it; level 6/7 maps have been run on an arcane mage (Necromancy swapped for Cartography) and a tamer (Herding swapped for Cartography). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544393684525654117)
- **trial pit group sizes**: Trial pits have no 2 or 4 person option, so two players must use the 3-person pit trial, and some players do it solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552294299000119309)
- **tribard stance redundancy**: For a tribard using provoke, the Fowling stance is redundant because provoked mobs do no damage to you, and Arcane is redundant as a single-target damage stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546867957869838456)
- **trolls difficulty**: Trolls regenerate and are very hard to kill without an Aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549247066465640519)
- **two-character approach for t8 treasure maps**: After the patch, a suggested approach for T8 treasure maps is to use two characters: a PvMer kept for maximum DPS and a separate cartographer/scout/harvester-aspect character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550497085760077908)
- **typical summoner team composition**: A typical summoner team is fire elemental, earth elemental, and summon creature; as a necromancer the elemental summons become lich and mummy respectively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161092484407368)
- **undead progressive spawn boss**: The boss of the undead progressive spawn is a tier 8 treasure map miniboss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547724389028470915)
- **vinekin in kraul hive**: Vinekin mobs in Kraul Hive stealth and backstab players, dealing heavy damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553538395974930483)
- **void aspect for group play**: Void aspect armor is sometimes used for level 4 group play, mainly for its leech. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399789016223784)
- **war aspect bonus scope**: The war aspect bonus is valid only in player versus monster combat and does not apply in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549346877764280331)
- **warding against diseases and poisons**: Warding is recommended when afflicted by nasty diseases or poisons that the alchemy codex cannot cure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332281561616446)
- **warrior versus flaying stance choice**: Players reportedly recommend the warrior stance when accuracy is below 100% and the flaying stance when accuracy is 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552805686285570120)
- **water aspect for archers**: Water aspect is a poor choice for an archer because the extra hinder from increased weapon special chance is meaningless, and lightning or madness give more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551886429527998495)
- **weapon ability hotkey commands**: To bind a hotkey to a weapon ability, use the commands [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 or [WeaponAbility3, depending on which ability you want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545806592669261854)
- **weapon aspect proc conditions**: A weapon aspect cannot proc from bleed ticks (such as swordsmanship bleeds) or poison ticks; it requires a direct weapon hit or a spell cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549563527977500764)
- **weapon aspect procs**: Among weapon aspect procs, Void is notable for bosses, Discipline for dexer farming, and Artisan is expensive but good for both group and solo play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **weapon choice by average dps**: Most builds benefit more from weapons with the highest average DPS than from those with the highest single-hit damage, and medium grinding weapons tend to have the highest average DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553401286869913664)
- **weapon codex features**: Weapon codices provide stances with bonuses such as damage, accuracy and defense, a finisher ability that can trigger when a mob's health is low, and abilities dependent on the melee skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612484561670175)
- **weapon finisher chance**: When a creature is reduced to its Finisher Threshold, a Weapon Finisher has a base 10% chance to occur, scaled by weapon speed and increased by Anatomy skill to 10% + 10% * (Anatomy/100). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon finisher damage resolution**: A Weapon Finisher first resolves the original hit as normal, then uses that hit's damage as the baseline damage for the Finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon finisher damage scaling**: Weapon Finisher damage scales from +0% (Heavy Crossbow) up to +250% (Kryss) based on the weapon's printed Average Damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon finishers activation**: Weapon finishers in Ultima Online: Outlands activate automatically as a chance on hit while the target creature is below a health threshold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545566588571361430)
- **weapon selection criteria**: When choosing a weapon, single hit damage matters more than weapon speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549084556865568799)
- **weapon statistics lookup**: Detailed weapon statistics are not available in game, so players should consult the official wiki's Armor & Weapons page for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553400508834779156)
- **weapon swing speed chart**: The Outlands wiki 'Armor & Weapons' page has a Weapons Chart listing weapon swing speed information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555377310113337509)
- **weekly dungeon rotation**: A weekly dungeon rotation exists and can be checked to decide which dungeons to avoid or focus on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **wizard grimoire bless trait targets**: The wizard's grimoire Bless trait allows up to 10 targets; whether they must be party members is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525604381818940)
- **wizard grimoire curse and field damage**: The Wizard Grimoire curse increases spell damage, but testing suggests it does not apply to fire field damage and probably not to paralyze or poison fields either. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553086180516696145)
- **wizard's grimoire in pvp**: The Wizard's Grimoire does not work in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547607937067913256)
- **wrestler fistblade, cestus and martial manual**: The Fistblade, Cestus and Martial Manual have no functional difference for the wrestler; they only look different. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552771213812834415)
- **wrestling defense against pks**: Against a PK, 100 Wrestling versus the attacker's 100 weapon skill is reported to give a 50% chance to avoid being hit, which helps avoid cast interruption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546655868500705422)
- **wrestling dragon codex stance armor ignore**: The dragon codex stance of wrestling has built-in armor ignore, which helps dexxers who have few other sources of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555731093292974093)
- **wrestling weapon choice**: For Wrestling, the Martial Manual, Cestus and Fistblade reportedly have identical stats, so the choice between them is cosmetic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553017159289143448)
- **wrestling weapons and parry**: All wrestling weapons are two-handed, so you do not need a shield to parry while wearing one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549384274384388178)

## New players

- **shard and client access**: The Outlands test shard can only be accessed with the beta client, and the live shard can only be accessed with the live client. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **character creation starting skills**: At character creation you pick 8 skills that start at 60 instead of 0, which affects only starting values and gear; the 8th skill must be taken but skills and stats can be changed or dropped later. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554373511177306153)
- **new player dungeon progression**: On Shelter Island, complete the single newbie quest, raise stats to 100 and skills to 80 (the new player dungeon caps at 80) in the dungeon, then leave the island; all characters, even those who have left, still get the skill gain bonus in the New Player Dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366331755012191)
- **new player quest rewards**: Completing the new player quests rewards a runetome (reported as blessed and preloaded with commonly traveled places) plus items for your aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554346530213855325)
- **new player quest rune tome reward**: The first new player quest, which starts on Shelter Island, rewards a free blessed rune tome with several locations already saved, usable to recall back to town. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452722336956467)
- **starting inn room rent credits**: New characters receive an inn room credits deed worth about 2 weeks of free rent on a small inn room that can store items; the first character on each of up to 3 accounts gets one, and a one-time new player quest gives another, for roughly 8 weeks total. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615193762566236)
- **summoner versus arcane mage builds**: Mages commonly choose between a summoner build, where summons tank and deal damage while the player casts with a spellbook and Spirit Speak, and an arcane mage build, which uses no summons, casts constantly with an arcane staff, and is a little trickier to play. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555289971643129917)
- **tamer starter template**: Tamer is considered a good and easy starter template for new players, though tamer core items are expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547970588583272550)
- **dexxer template definition**: A dexxer is a warrior-style character built around high dexterity, which affects weapon swing speed, typically using melee weapons such as swords, maces or fencing, and possibly archery. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553771155939131423)
- **new player quest bonded horse**: The new player stable quest, the second new player quest, is a very simple quest that rewards a free bonded horse, which stays as a ghost and can be revived if it dies. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553207208572100669)
- **new player quest chain rewards**: The new player quest chain gives useful rewards, including a chain, a link and a tool, and is worth completing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147508509347861)
- **new player quest codex reward**: The new player quest (NPQ) lets you choose a free codex as your first codex, and a player reports it can be traded to another character after being picked. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553592407281635349)
- **new player spending priorities**: New players are advised to sell commodity boards for gold and spend it first on quality-of-life items (strongbox, magic item recycler, shelf, resource stockpile) and harvesting cores. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529828424825180301)
- **outlandsid account limit**: Each player is allowed one OutlandsID, which may contain up to three game accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553492320626802811)
- **running outlands on linux**: UO Outlands runs on Linux either through Lutris like any non-Steam game, through Steam by adding the patcher as a non-Steam game and forcing Proton in its properties, or via the Faugus Launcher or the proton tutorials on the wiki's Install_UO_on_Linux page. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554479020744114207)
- **shelter island npc access after losing young status**: Once a player loses Young status, they can no longer use the NPCs on Shelter Island, including the bank and vendors, though they can still return to the island. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850036408549517)
- **tank dexer starting build**: A tank dexer is a solid, simple build to start with; it starts a little slower early on but plays well later, and a Magery character can use Summon Creature to kill things. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554355357365837847)
- **verified player discord role**: Trade, PvP and some other channels such as ships PvM on the Outlands Discord require the VERIFIED PLAYER role, which is obtained by logging into the Outlands Portal with your OutlandsID credentials and linking your Discord account on the account page. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554846034314661979)
- **wiki templates and training guides**: The Outlands wiki has a Templates page at wiki.uooutlands.com/Templates linking to builds for each main archetype, and each skill page has a training guide at the bottom. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554287200148131922)
- **young status after leaving starter island**: Leaving the starter island (Shelter Island) causes a player to lose Young status, after which they can no longer buy from or interact with NPC merchants and mages there, and must use the bank and shops in another city. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355998408048721)
- **action bar item keybinds**: Items can be placed on the action bar, and right clicking an item's cell lets you set a keybind for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547566085996417024)
- **adding spells to spellbook**: Buy spell scrolls from the Mage NPC and drag the scrolls onto your spellbook to add the spells to it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282336391004252)
- **avoiding already logged in message**: To avoid the 'another character is already logged in' message, log out inside an inn, a guild house or a friendly house; no inn room rental is required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553393113270329439)
- **bot commands for new players**: The community bot commands !npq and !dungeonpath reportedly provide information on new player quests and the dungeon progression path. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550138869058637947)
- **client download location**: The Outlands client can be downloaded from the official Outlands website at uooutlands.com/connecting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552298186092322847)
- **companionbot templates command**: Type !templates in Discord to have the CompanionBot list the Outlands wiki template pages (Starter, Dexxer, Mage, Bard, Tamer, Gathering, PvP, Misc). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532223743676383356)
- **dexxer difficulty for new players**: A dexxer (melee) is a hard starting path for new players because of low accuracy and no links, unless the character is a bard, while a tamer is much easier at the start. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553770787205546136)
- **exitlag for high ping**: Players with high ping can use ExitLag and should select an Ashburn node as the destination (end) node for best results. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548540314422083645)
- **gathering on shelter island**: Shelter Island has no PKs, but gathering there yields fewer boards and ingots than elsewhere, and it can only be mined for a limited time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603464970109010)
- **horse quest apples location**: In Prevalia, the apples for the horse quest are in a cart in the southwest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553481587310600374)
- **identifying items with an alt**: New players can identify items by making an alt character with 100-120 Item Identification skill, ideally on a second account and kept in the inn room, instead of buying wands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551078219669835888)
- **knight in new player dungeon**: The knight in the new player dungeon is a real player, not an NPC or bot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039767879852136)
- **learning harvesting maps**: To learn how harvesting maps work, buy a Dullwood map and run it, since one run answers most questions; maps can also be tried on the test server. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **learning new spells**: To learn a spell you do not have, buy its scroll from an NPC mage vendor and drop the scroll onto your spellbook to add the spell. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045973834961007)
- **losing young status**: Losing Young status means losing access to the vendors, bank, and harvesting in Shelter, the starter area, though this is not a big deal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545085437427585114)
- **missing template menu on new character**: If the initial template menu does not appear on a fresh character and you cannot move, relogging fixes it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554101194727886848)
- **new character starting items**: New characters start with a bag containing another bag with bandages but with no gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564842347667510)
- **new player aspect kit wrong unlock**: A charge from the new player reward aspect kit that was used to unlock the wrong aspect cannot be undone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549571025677717575)
- **new player first goal**: A new player's first goal is to reach 80 in the skills of their chosen template; the wiki has template lists for dexxer, mage, bard, tamer, gathering, PvP and misc builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554678283214397461)
- **new player guide and gameplay basics playlist**: The wiki has a New Player Guide at wiki.uooutlands.com/New_Player_Guide, and the Outlands Gameplay Basics playlist is recommended as the tutorial series, especially for players new to UO. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359958943244411)
- **new player progression**: New players should do the new player quests to learn mechanics, train skills to 80 in the new player dungeon, then leave the starting island and explore elsewhere. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546630461512618044)
- **new player quests rewards**: New player quests exist in Sanctuary and Prevalia, and completing them rewards a codex and an aspects bundle. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553787669899911352)
- **new player route after shelter island**: After the starter island, do the horse quest by the stables, take the moongate to Prevalia, pick up the new player quests there (including the society home quest at its entrance), then fight in the sewers on the north side. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548250903499382876)
- **newbie dungeon duration and gold**: The newbie dungeon takes roughly one to three hours to play through, depending on prior UO knowledge, and is a safe way to earn starter gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669461617934397)
- **newbie-friendly guild leveling**: Joining a newbie-friendly guild or teaming up with other players significantly speeds up early leveling, since guildmates can farm with you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767195176247448)
- **obtaining codices**: A player's first codex is obtained free from a new player quest; afterwards codices are crafted by player Scribes (inscription) and bought from players, via player vendors or the portal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554844948061225053)
- **outlands portal login**: Log into the Outlands Portal using the same credentials (your OutlandsID) that you use to log into the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547797306953171015)
- **paying trainer npc**: To pay a trainer NPC, drag the coins onto the NPC or drop them on his nameplate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019244339466363)
- **player killers in shelter**: Players cannot be killed by player killers in Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549593435445530740)
- **profane character names**: Profane character names are not allowed; the devs decide which words count as profane, and offensive names can be reported. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555635403472637993)
- **progressive spawn list**: No official list of progressive spawns exists; the !earlyspots map marks some of them, though some may have changed since the maps were last updated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546989605146857522)
- **reagent sellers in the mage shop**: Not every NPC in the mage shop sells reagents: scribes sell none, healers sell only some (healing reagents), and actual mages sell the full set. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546863048738869258)
- **rune marking requirement**: Marking a rune requires Magery, reportedly 60 Magery, and runes can be added to the new player runetome, so a Magery alt can mark them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552882084882808954)
- **shelter island after leaving**: After leaving Shelter Island you can still return, for example to train in the dungeon, but you cannot use its vendors, bank or stable because you are no longer young. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552323227093565493)
- **shelter island mage shop restock**: Shelter Island mage shop NPCs that sell out of reagents restock every 15-30 minutes, and only young players can buy from Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546862897064452287)
- **shelter island new player dungeon**: Shelter Island is the new player dungeon, reachable via moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546488035233759324)
- **shelter island resource penalty**: On shelter island all resources gathered are halved, and everything you do there is reduced except skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550135600223355002)
- **society progression order**: Players typically start with monster hunter societies and then move on to crafting societies (tailoring, inscription, then alchemy), with tailoring the cheapest to train and alchemy the most expensive; most players keep a crafter with tailoring, alchemy and inscription on each account and use a main PVM character for hunter/adventure societies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553762025291644959)
- **spellbook requirement for casting**: Casting a spell requires having it in your spellbook along with the required skill and reagents, so a mage needs a spellbook to cast and farm. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550695509558038630)
- **starter island reagent vendors**: The starter island has a mage vendor and an alchemist that sell reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197987997683722)
- **starter island vendor directions**: On the starter island, take the path west from the main plaza and the house straight ahead is the mage's; healers are further north and battle trainers further south. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545198218219094057)
- **stat point allocation**: Characters get 225 stat points with a cap of 100 per stat, so 25 is the lowest value to set for any stat, and an intelligence of 25 is recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553577869144494081)
- **stopping continuous running after releasing right mouse button**: To stop the character from continuing to run after you release the right mouse button, change the relevant setting under Options > Experimental. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547216105632964728)
- **summoner versus arcane mage for new players**: Summoner is an easier mage start than arcane mage, and is probably the better build to run until about 10 links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683306879815832)
- **tamer build dominance**: Many players consider tamer the dominant build on Outlands, and its price of entry is steep. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546670190287126538)
- **tank dexxer starting template**: The tank dexxer template is a recommended starting choice at the new player statue, and a paladin is essentially a dexxer with holy aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564237298073611)
- **training credits for npc trainers**: Training credits can be dragged onto starter isle NPC trainers to pay for training instead of gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545338739381895278)
- **training skills in shelter before leaving**: New characters should train their non-craft skills (including all except Lumberjacking) to 80 in the Shelter dungeon before leaving Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549658898372239414)
- **unstick character**: If your character is stuck, open Paperdoll > Help > In Game Help > Character Is Stuck, which can be used once every 24 hours. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550701922472956035)
- **verified player role on discord**: To get the VERIFIED PLAYER role, which is required to post in channels like Trade and PvP, log in to the Outlands Portal with your OutlandsID credentials and link your Discord account on the account page. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552805811992920135)
- **viewing skills**: To see your skills, open your paperdoll and go to skills, use the Razor skills tab, or type [skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547902570658267147)
- **account character allocation**: The pvm character and most characters belong on the first account, crafters are useful on all three accounts, and the first account's pvm character can use echoes rather than a new character for each build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544664140801380444)
- **account or verification support**: Players with account or verification problems can submit a ticket so staff can look into the issue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604652807458960)
- **account verification code**: The account verification code is sent only once, after the first Outlands ID is created, so players should keep it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604191027167235)
- **age of shadows content**: UO Outlands does not include Age of Shadows content but has a large amount of newly added custom content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377363627540602)
- **alchemy training cost**: Training Alchemy is not cheap for a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896563942756353)
- **always full screen client setting**: Most previously recommended must-have client options are now on by default, but Always Full Screen should still be turned off in Video Options so the black space around the game window can be used for UI layout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554826908313591819)
- **anti-pk guild alliances**: Several anti-PK guilds exist, including two main alliances: KoU-NEW-Sir-DTF-DOPE-MMx and Path-Bear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457938569990255)
- **antivirus exception for connection problems**: New players with connection problems may fix them by adding an exception for the Outlands folder in their antivirus software. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677329032904736)
- **arcane mage early-game demands**: Arcane mage requires a lot of meditating at first and buying reagents, making it more complex to learn than other mage builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587779426713672)
- **arcane template difficulty**: Arcane is a more involved template than others, so new players may want to postpone it until they are up to speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546772285317451816)
- **archer tamer pvm starting path**: Archer Tamer is probably one of the safest and easiest PvM paths for new players to start with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548055624779309139)
- **aspect acquisition**: An aspect is free and is obtained through a quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328541120335923)
- **aspect bundle account scope**: The aspect bundle (starter kit) reportedly works for any character within your OutlandsID, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545823351547633745)
- **aspect quest after codex quest**: Aspect is the next quest in the new player quest chain after the codex quest, and it greatly increases overall character strength. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547613733847699477)
- **aspect starter bundle remaining charges**: The remaining charges of the aspect starter bundle can be used by other characters, for example to unlock Harvest Aspect on a lumberjack or miner, or saved for a different aspect on a main character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548380941666492592)
- **attacking a creature with warmode**: Press Tab to toggle warmode, then double left-click a creature to attack it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545751555817349160)
- **avoiding pks**: PKs are easily avoided with a handful of hotkeys and a little practice, and most players can learn to escape most of the time within hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549446720746819695)
- **bard build for new players**: Bard is a fairly safe build choice for a new player, though monster resistance to Barding can make peacemaking fail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554911312109379696)
- **bard class difficulty and gear risk**: Bard is easy to play, and with skills capped and only NPC-bought gear it can farm level 1-2 monsters, so losing that gear to a PK costs little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546828498998398996)
- **beginner friendly starting builds**: Most players start with a beginner-friendly build whose skills are easy and cheap to train and effective at farming gold to support crafting characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286957297672273)
- **beginner quests**: The beginner quests can be done only once per player; they are not hard and are completed sequentially. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546773502902800384)
- **beginner template difficulty**: The mage is reportedly the hardest beginner template because of reagent costs, followed by the dexxer, while the gatherer is the easiest since it does not need to kill monsters for money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544128330050183238)
- **beginner training credit item appearance**: The beginner training credit item appears as an unrolled scroll in your bag, and single-clicking any item tells you what it is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544972590018465882)
- **beginner-friendly towns**: Prevalia, Andaria, Cambria and similar towns are usually the most reachable for brand new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294435242647622)
- **birds of paradise near kraul hive**: Birds of paradise spawn right outside Kraul Hive near the Witcher rune 325 location and can kill a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553866905155276893)
- **blacksmith npc weapon sales**: Blacksmith NPCs in town sell weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547900107704377435)
- **blessed items on new characters**: Apart from the clothes a brand new character receives, nothing comes blessed, so a stack of disposable clothes is the cheapest option until you can afford clothing bless deeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547295378494464011)
- **blocking spamming players**: To block spamming players, open in-game options, go to the ignore list, add the players, and click apply so the changes take effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550485765031600191)
- **brigands near prevalia**: Brigands outside Prevalia are difficult for weak characters, so the sanctuary dungeons are a suggested alternative for early training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552858871750729781)
