- **buying id wands**: ID wands can be bought from vendor backpacks outside Prevalia or found via the Outlands Portal vendor search tool, though the exact name and locations are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548718661546676377)
- **character creation choices**: At character creation only the name really matters, because skills can be retrained quickly and for free (or by paying 500 gold to have NPCs train to 50), while name and gender can be changed later for a notable amount of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551648436137365606)
- **character creation skill choice for spellbooks**: Picking Necromancy or Chivalry at character creation makes it easier to obtain the spellbook for that skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551316657149059213)
- **character name rules**: Character names can be anything as long as the first letter is capitalized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544743637295042570)
- **character template statue**: A character template statue lets players choose from a handful of preset character templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550052361794363413)
- **chatgpt build advice reliability**: ChatGPT is unreliable for Ultima Online Outlands build advice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555287732174061581)
- **checking leaderboards**: To check the leaderboards, open the paperdoll, then choose Help, then Server Rankings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548051505842495589)
- **checking young status**: Single-click your own character; if you still have Young status, '(Young)' appears next to your name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547532439260241950)
- **codex use on shelter island**: Codices do not work on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552321721976229900)
- **command list**: Typing [commands shows the list of available commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777444811087924)
- **connection failures and exitlag**: Using a VPN or connecting from certain countries commonly causes connection failures, and admins frequently suggest ExitLag as a workaround. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553879933439311883)
- **connection lost before character selection**: If the connection is lost before selecting a character, try adding an exception for the game folder in your antivirus software, though this may not resolve every case. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554603980137435161)
- **corpse protection in sanctuary dungeon**: A player's corpse is reportedly protected from other players in the sanctuary dungeon, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544123441697915032)
- **crafting skill training cost**: Crafting skills are expensive to train, so a new player should first build a money maker such as Paladin/Bard or Miner/Lumberjack, and a miner has plenty of free skill slots for extra skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659642051821590)
- **create food spell**: Create Food is the spell most players get first; it creates magic mushrooms that can be eaten for free mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554585795556548659)
- **creating a hotkey macro**: To create a hotkey, open Options, then Macros, then New Macro; assign the hotkey in the blank field at the top and fill in the macro actions below it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554552320027791422)
- **dedicated pvm and pvp characters**: Mixing skills for multiple playstyles makes a character average at both, so most players make a dedicated PvM character and a dedicated PvP character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555276354172489769)
- **default character slots**: Players have 5 character slots by default, and changing skills on a character is easy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550894159504871498)
- **default inventory macro**: Alt+I is likely the default macro to open your inventory, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544917253890379826)
- **dexxer starter template skills**: For the standard dexxer starter template, Swords determines chance to hit and should be raised to at least 100 early on, and chivalry should be used with the Divine Fury ability while fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548768853977342134)
- **differences from osi**: Outlands differs substantially from OSI Ultima Online, and most of what returning players remember beyond basic interactions will be different. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545243658016657479)
- **discord guild recruitment channel**: The Discord guild recruitment channel lists guilds seeking new players, with information about each guild and often links to their open Discords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547183809357676565)
- **double-click and drag interaction**: Much world and item interaction in Outlands, including equipping gear, is done by double-click or left-click-and-drag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547565244744736879)
- **early armor choices**: Mastercrafted iron armor and basic leather armor are decent early gear choices, and leather is recommended if you use Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548164917360721943)
- **early fishing equipment**: Cheap fishing equipment is sufficient for the first few hours because little is caught at low fishing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527312452201615522)
- **early game equipment needs**: Early on, vendor-bought equipment and plain crafted equipment such as plain iron or leather is generally enough to get by. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547267405250691133)
- **early game mage summoner advice**: A mage without summons can struggle early on, so a common suggestion is to play a summoner for meat shields until the post-skill XP systems are leveled, then switch to arcane. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546224563506126928)
- **early game spending priorities**: Early game funds are better spent on the progression systems than on Item ID skill scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451996414255226)
- **early hunting locations after shelter**: Good early hunting locations for new players after Shelter are Prevalia Sewers, Urukton Bluffs, and the Ratmen Hovel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545195963071602758)
- **early hunting spots urukton and ratman hovel**: Urukton and the Ratman Hovel are reported by one player as reasonable early-game hunting spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553535096550596639)
- **early mastery link slotting**: Slotting mastery links early gives little noticeable power increase, so funds are better spent leveling your aspect, and active guilds regularly run activities that award links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546725696271945870)
- **early progression pace**: Progression is fairly slow in the beginning regardless of template until codices and aspects are leveled up a bit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767142412025927)
- **early quest givers**: Quest givers (red NPCs) outside the new player dungeon offer quests that are very valuable early on and are a way to earn early gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567118906691704)
- **early skill training path**: Train skills to 80 in the newbie dungeon first, then after leaving Shelter Island macro skills at the zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341771890786385)
- **echo item price for new players**: The echo item used to switch builds is expensive for a new player, who should buy other essentials first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545711889491955784)
- **eldritch scribe summoner necromancer starter build**: An Eldritch Scribe / Summoner / Necromancer build may be a good starter build, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327566041255936)
- **expanded stats window**: Double clicking the resource bar opens an expanded stats window, and clicking the dash at the bottom right of that window returns it to the resource bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569126250381332)
- **factions system and character creation**: The factions system is optional organized PvP and does not affect how you create your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546698279989940334)
- **farming low level dungeons at 80 skills**: Players commonly get their skills to 80 and then farm low level dungeons to continue progressing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544652172900433942)
- **fastest early gold method**: Gathering, such as mining or lumberjacking, is the fastest way for a new player to make gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602492227264593)
- **first crafter priorities**: Getting three 100 skill tailors should be the first priority, followed by three 100 skill alchemists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544316376020287538)
- **first dungeons after shelter island**: The Bluffs and the Prevalia sewers are probably the best first dungeons to visit after leaving Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550136041497694230)
- **first new player quest reward**: Completing the first New Player Quest on Shelter Island rewards a tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554252892679053344)
- **first quest young status requirement**: The first new player quest, which rewards a rune tome, probably does not require Young status, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547401926235131985)
- **first society crafters**: Tailoring, alchemy and inscription are good first society crafters, because getting the cheapest three to 100 skill carries a player a long way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546353981037617222)
- **forensic evaluation income for new players**: New players can use Forensic Evaluation income to fund their own tailors to get into societies, and can also loot leather left behind by others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072681063612470)
- **forgot password button**: The game launcher may have a forgot password button for resetting an account password, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546539527940604065)
- **friends list and global chat**: The game has no in-game friends list or global chat, so players use Discord for that, and Razor friends only manage lists of targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479984870199421)
- **gear value**: Items are not very important or expensive in Outlands, so gear should be treated like ammo that will eventually be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548163549115846747)
- **getting codices crafted in shelter**: After getting a codex, buy the needed materials and ask in the crafting channel for someone in Shelter who crafts for others, or buy from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552323227093565493)
- **getting unstuck**: Use Help -> Stuck to get unstuck or relocated, but the option is limited in how often it can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518959371587665)
- **global video scaling option**: The game has a global video scaling option for sizing the interface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554564878637858869)
- **gold requirement for skill training**: To buy skill training from an NPC trainer you must have the gold in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019236609630280)
- **grimoire new player reward**: Following the new player quest line lets you choose a grimoire as a reward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544918938972852294)
- **guild acceptance of new players**: Practically all guilds in Outlands accept new players and help them along, since guilds benefit from additional members regardless of their experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546909136099475647)
- **guild acceptance of new players**: Practically all guilds accept new players and listings can be browsed in the guild recruitment channel, though some small guilds do not want new members and do not post there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553222080676503704)
- **guild chat command**: To use guild chat in game, type a backslash (\) before your message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550766190681530409)
- **guild recruitment of new players**: Guilds benefit from new players' activities, so they are incentivised to recruit them, and most guilds are happy to help newbies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545203935055192175)
- **guild storage shelf gear**: Many big guilds keep a storage shelf full of gear that guild members can use for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051369568833607)
- **harvest aspect unlock kit from newbie quests**: Completing the newbie quests does not grant a free Harvest aspect unlock kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533903042011725994)
- **harvester and crafter roles**: A harvester character gathers raw materials such as boards or ingots, while a crafter character uses those materials to make items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634174045126687)
- **healer role in team pvp**: A new player in team PvP events can play a dedicated healer or support role and try to keep the team alive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899603814256720)
- **hiding pet names**: To hide pet names, open Options, go to Nameplates, and adjust the Own Followers selection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548107466196389960)
- **holy aspect for beginners**: The Holy aspect is popular with new players, while frost or lightning aspects are stronger late game but require more expensive cores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553013878521209015)
- **house availability for new players**: Finding open land for a house is highly unlikely, so new players are best off using the Rental Room System or buying a listed house from the Real Estate Vendor NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **in-game item stat inspection**: Item stats, especially for weapons and armor, cannot be inspected in game, including vendor wares, so the wiki must be consulted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549838938263392289)
- **items dropped in starter square**: Players sometimes drop items in the starter square for other players to take. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545304725396783166)
- **kraul hive level 1 safety**: Kraul Hive level 1 has 6 gates for escaping PKs and gives good experience and gold, but has stealth backstab mobs; leaving level 1 or entering level 2 is very dangerous for a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553537792360054787)
- **launcher verify failure**: If the launcher verify fails, the patch server may have been down, so wait a while and try verifying again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544818726115876895)
- **level 1 nusero difficulty**: Level 1 Nusero is not a sanctuary, but it is still fairly easy for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554128013044613121)
- **linux support and wiki guide**: UO Outlands can be run on Linux, and the official wiki has an Install UO on Linux page covering setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551276374030033019)
- **lockpicker stealth template**: Lockpicker (stealth) is a popular template with a lot of competition, and stealth lets players learn dungeon layouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546771056579055637)
- **low mana penalty armor for mages**: A new mage with mana problems can wear armor with less mana penalty than full plate, such as bone armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **lutris installation method**: When using Lutris, do not use Lutris's built-in installer because its launcher is outdated; instead download the Outlands launcher and install it directly through Lutris using the latest Proton version. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551283166403371111)
- **macer vs archer stabber for new players**: Being a macer is better for newer players than being an archer stabber. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550091172133871647)
- **mage difficulty for new players**: Mage is a hard path for newer players who have low links and aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327111022055447)
- **mage reagent cost**: Reagent cost for a mage becomes a non-issue after the first couple of days, especially in a guild, since most guilds keep a shelf of reagents and gear for newbies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552319040939098283)
- **mage template cost for new players**: A mage template can be cost prohibitive for newer players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545088861024292864)
- **magery spellbook**: A character with Magery should have a red magery spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282923610472569)
- **mana conservation via codex spells**: Mana can be conserved by casting more mana-efficient spells that have points in the arcane codex, such as lightning and harm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **map layout**: UO Outlands uses a custom map and has no Trammel/Felucca split. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377686341754911)
- **mining advice for new players**: Traditional mining is the recommended way for new players to level Mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528213026304557136)
- **mining controls**: To mine, double-click the pickaxe or use the item in hand, then target the ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424799839551589)
- **monster hunting society start**: To start with the Monster Hunting Society, go to the Societies hall in Prevalia and accept jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553852907802067056)
- **monster slaying job locations**: The monster slaying job NPC does not tell you where to find the target monsters; you can look them up with Outlands Butler or Explore Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554865127562682451)
- **moving the spellcast bar**: To move the spellcast bar, open Options -> Interface, find the spellcast bar section and uncheck 'lock spellcast bar', then drag it like other UI elements; a button there also moves it back onto the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553519298541133905)
- **nameplate display options**: Press Ctrl+Shift to choose which nameplate text is shown, and adjust each category in the in-game Options under Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545970673799794740)
- **new boater ship sinkings**: New boaters on the ocean are likely to get their boat sunk several times at first, but sinkings become rare as the player learns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531381798452592681)
- **new lyceum daily quests**: New Lyceum has a few easy daily quests that give items, including one that gives a bag of reagents (reportedly about 50 of each, unconfirmed), which saves new players some gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545300285122154588)
- **new lyceum wilderness**: New Lyceum has a small stretch of wilderness with mobs and no player traffic, where new players can get used to fighting non-sanctuary mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545298407692836966)
- **new mage spell choice**: New mages are probably best served by low-tier offensive spells such as Lightning, Harm and Fireball. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554585934123769968)
- **new player apple quest**: To collect apples for the new player quest, find the cart of apples (not the individual apples on the ground) and use the quest item you were given on the cart. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553205419017642126)
- **new player dungeon ankhs and healer**: Ankhs inside the new player dungeon resurrect you when you approach them, and a healer NPC building sits just south of the main dungeon entrance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919982645706784)
- **new player dungeon gold achievement**: Farming 1 million gold in the new player dungeon reportedly grants a hidden achievement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537477696013992066)
- **new player dungeon layout**: The new player dungeon has 2 levels, and the stairs down are in the SE or NE corner of level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544152003767177338)
- **new player island quests**: Only one quest is available on the new player island, and the remaining available quests are found after leaving the island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355503148699721)
- **new player quest aspect unlocks**: Aspects unlocked through the new player quest reward do not consume the aspect items, so you keep your cores and distillations for your first couple of rank-ups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547239043270709498)
- **new player quest codex reward**: Completing the new player quest on your Outlands ID gives a codex, but you must leave Shelter Island to do it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552321930021830657)
- **new player quest combat**: Some new player quests require killing monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929281656950926)
- **new player quest horse**: The horse that follows you from the new player quest can be ridden by double-clicking it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553206824495480834)
- **new player quest rewards**: Completing the new player quests unlocks 3 aspects for free and grants many other rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539595353572118579)
- **new player quest rewards value**: The new player quest rewards are worth roughly 2M gold in total, according to a single player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539596059259703347)
- **new player quest runetome**: The runetome from the new player quest can have more runes added to it, and a script can use the command "[recall home" to recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549621112885870603)
- **new player quest series gold limit**: The new player quest series requires that you have not farmed more than 5m gold across your OutlandsID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550052028938584187)
- **new player questline gold lockout**: The new player questline for the free codex and rewards is reportedly locked out once you have farmed more than 5 million gold across all your accounts, and is probably only available once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551279852622192643)
- **new player questlines**: The new player questlines reward useful items such as a first horse and first blessed rune tome and introduce post-skill progression systems, but each quest can be completed only once per player account, not per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **new player quests**: The New Player Quests include a 25K quest and a 50K quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589277409677404)
- **new player quests**: New players should pick up the new player quests because they are very important for early progression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550136228223909929)
- **new player quests command**: New player quests can be listed with the !npq command in the Discord, and completing all of them is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546531136656638082)
- **new player recycling advice**: New players should recycle most magic items except supremely, vanquishing and greater slayer items, since essence is needed most at first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **new player tutorial restriction**: New player tutorials are blocked once a character or account has reached 5 million total gold farmed; the restriction is based on gold farmed, not current wealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544105747581763674)
- **new player weapon recommendation**: Sword and shield is recommended over a two-handed weapon for new players because Parry is strong, though it becomes more template-dependent once the aspect is leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554529223954145305)
- **newbie dungeon gold quest requirements**: Gold for new player quests such as the Runebook quest only counts when earned by killing monsters in the New Player Dungeon, not from chests or lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554139535187775489)
- **newbie gear keeping and recycling**: At the newbie stage, keep weapons with force or better properties and armor with hardening or better, and recycle hardening armor once you have a decent supply of better armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550065341466542083)
- **newbie island quests**: The newbie island quests provide almost everything a new player needs to enter the main world ready to fight mobs, while Young status lasts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546316858079060069)
- **newbie quest rewards for mages**: The newer newbie quests may reward the items a new mage needs, such as an aspect, a grimoire and a spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544135200219340940)
- **newbie weapon on death**: A newbie weapon stays on the character after death and is not left on the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544121081881829406)
- **newplayer quest gold kill requirement**: The newplayer quest steps requiring 50,000 gold worth of creature kills count only base gold value and do not benefit from the Bonus Gold weekly dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546713653892350012)
- **non-combat build difficulty**: The server does not make non-combat builds easy except for crafters, and some combat skill helps for resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553981068280074360)
- **npd xp gain**: The only XP obtainable in the NPD is from tamed pets going from level 0 to level 1 to bond them; no other XP is earned there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552535820605587477)
- **obtaining harvest aspect**: Harvest Aspect is obtained by completing the new player quests or by buying the items from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549608151647789117)
- **ocean content cost**: Getting into ocean content (being a pirate) is costly, so players should wait until they have saved up some gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546710864151842897)
- **office of alchemy and magic location**: The Office of Alchemy and Magic for the orientation quest is located at the bazaar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548472429221777540)
- **office of the shield location**: The Office of the Shield for the orientation quest is located at the moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548472429221777540)
- **opening multiple game clients**: In the launcher, clicking the play button again opens an additional instance of the game client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547641076091850892)
- **opening the health resource bar**: To view your health bar, left click and hold your character sprite and drag to pull out the resource bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564863205675028)
- **opening your own corpse**: To open your own corpse reliably, assign a hotkey for Show All Names, press it, then click the corpse that displays your name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549821433436446721)
- **orientation quest sign count**: The Orientation quest from the first NPC in the Godfrey north library questline reportedly requires finding about 24 signs scattered throughout the area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555338171527471117)
- **orientation quest sign locations**: Signs for the Orientation quest are located on both upper and lower floors, so check every floor of the area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555351460450144277)
- **outlands id account linking**: If a player had no Outlands ID when they last played, they must open a support ticket, because the 3 accounts are now linked to a single Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546544291948658788)
- **outlands portal login credentials**: The Outlands Portal login uses the same credentials as the game account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546372584491323422)
- **outlands shard background**: UO Outlands is a heavily modded private UO shard run by a small company and team of developers, and is likely the biggest free UO shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551267834678480928)
- **outlands wiki tameables list**: The Outlands wiki page 'Tameables List' catalogs tameable creatures along with their taming requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555404513920159834)
- **pack animals at stables**: Pack horses and oxen can be obtained at the stables and carry loads without requiring Animal Taming, but they cannot be bonded or named. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547426581473923072)
- **paladin/bard starter template**: Paladin/Bard is a good starter template that is easy to control, makes good early money, stays strong later and is loved as support, but it is not a preset template so a custom template is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550387400134361100)
- **passive combat training on shelter island**: Combat skills can be trained somewhat passively on the trainer NPCs on Shelter Island, which is easier than starting in the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547563415399305226)
- **pet naming feedback**: When naming a pet, watch the system messages to see whether the name is accepted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553744243346907187)
- **pk activity in cemetery near town**: The cemetery next to town is a common place where player killers hunt new players for easy kills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554464403380768769)
- **pk behavior toward low-level players**: Players at levels 1-2 are likely to be ignored by PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551735134804381769)
- **poison summoner suitability for new players**: The poison summoner approach likely needs a good amount of progression before it feels effective, so it may not suit a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547230555828129853)
- **post-island goals**: After leaving the starting island, players are advised to do quests to obtain a Codex, Aspect and Chain, and to rent a room soon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546631015248830474)
- **post-skill progression priority**: Progression in the post-skill XP systems matters far more than better gear and cannot be lost, and the third newplayer quest chain provides the first items needed for those systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546728770747109446)
- **prevalia and outpost as locations**: Prevalia is mainly worth visiting for societies, and the Outpost is a comfortable default location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549150580004618316)
- **prevalia bonded horse quest**: A quest in Prevalia grants a bonded horse; it is best taken on a harvester or a character that cannot control pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841873169022997)
- **prevalia sewer farming**: Prevalia Sewer is an easy and safe place for new players to farm and train, with its entrance in town inside a safe zone, and it also has a quest inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552903265417437205)
- **prevalia sewers dungeon**: The Prevalia sewers dungeon is not restricted to Young players, so skills can rise above 80 there, and its enemies are reportedly tougher than in the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555068398042611723)
- **prevalia sewers purpose**: The Prevalia sewers were added so new players would not need to travel to the orc dungeon, which was for a while PvP enabled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555069589912555521)
- **prevalia sewers safety**: The Prevalia Sewers are a very safe hunting location that does not require using recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197217374277643)
- **progression systems in pvp**: Advanced progression systems generally do not work in PvP (except possibly against nearby mobs), so little grinding is needed to play PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545205085255106590)
- **public dip risk at horseshoe bay**: When using the public dip at Horseshoe Bay, carrying nothing valuable limits your loss if you are killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549594330484973709)
- **pulling your own health bar**: To pull your own health bar, hold click on yourself and drag it out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554805370126336011)
- **pvp avoidance**: PvP is effectively unavoidable unless a player sticks to newbie or sanctuary dungeons, which have reduced loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671065248305182)
- **quest item acquisition order**: Most quests require you to obtain the quest item after you have accepted the quest, so items collected beforehand usually do not count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549288327985762355)
- **quick travel to inn via runebook**: Mark a rune for the inn, place it in a runebook along with recall scrolls, and recall using the runebook to reach the inn quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549185351636226109)
- **reagent carrying advice**: Players are advised to carry all reagents rather than only the ones they expect to need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554182507673427979)
- **recovering a guarded corpse**: To recover a corpse guarded by a monster, revive, lure the monster away from the corpse first, then run in a big circle back to your corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549249982434123897)
- **recycling early loot for essence**: Early in the game, basic unidentified weapons and armor found as loot can be recycled for essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005926354976830)
- **red players in wilderness**: Many red players (PKs) roam wilderness spots killing new players, and with mounts they can reach you before you notice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664268419334185)
- **regional skill caps**: Shelter Island and the New Player Dungeon have regional skill caps that prevent skills from gaining beyond 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554160828826263635)
- **renaming versus making a new character**: If a character is fresh and has not yet invested in Aspect, it is simpler to make a new character than to pay to rename it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496093950517289)
- **rental contract check for alt characters**: A character made on another account receives another rental contract check of 2k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374654989303839)
- **reopening the journal window**: To bring back a closed journal (chat window), use the top bar menu and choose Gumps, then Journal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550879870006075548)
- **restarting a character**: To restart a character, go to the statue where you started and click on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553779079088574505)
- **restarting quests after death**: If you die during a quest you should be able to restart it, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547261827291942973)
- **restoring hidden npc names**: If an NPC's name was hidden by accidentally right-clicking it, press Ctrl+Shift, untick the 'always' option and tick it again to restore name display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555018592284704780)
- **resurrection outside new player dungeon**: Outside the new player dungeon, you usually need to find a healer in a town or a wandering healer, which are often close to dungeon entrances, to be resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544920112706879548)
- **resurrection via npc healer**: To resurrect after dying, approach an NPC healer while dead and accept the resurrection prompt that appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555684269899255909)
- **retrieving a lost horse**: To find a lost horse, go to a stable master, access the stable, and choose 'Retrieve lost followers' from the options at the bottom of the menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553880653974610061)
- **retrieving abandoned pets**: If you show 0/5 followers, have no pets on the stats gump followers tab, and did not stable them, visit an Animal Wrangler to attempt to retrieve abandoned pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554795973253791754)
- **returning to newbie dungeon after young status**: After losing Young status, players can still return to the newbie dungeon to train for its increased skill gain chance, for the skills it applies to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355998408048721)
- **riding a mount**: To ride a mount, make sure you are not in war mode by pressing Tab to toggle it off; otherwise clicking the mount attacks it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546527894296334416)
- **risk of losing equipment on death**: Players will die to PKs or mobs and may be unable to recover their belongings, so they should not wear equipment they cannot replace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **rotating sanctuary dungeon**: A Sanctuary dungeon rotates each week, offering a safe place for new players to learn the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549446649116491969)
- **runetome from new player quest**: A runetome may be obtainable from the new player quest in Shelter, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545718250271277116)
- **running one aspect early**: Running just one aspect at the beginning of the game is advisable for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539596159906091059)
- **sanctuary dungeon of the week for beginners**: The Sanctuary dungeon of the week is good for beginners because dying does not lose everything as long as you recover your body, which is easier by hiding, sneaking and looting the body while hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554366612151472159)
- **sanctuary dungeons for early game**: The new player dungeon gives no XP or rare drops; besides it there are 3 early game dungeons and one weekly rotating core dungeon that are Sanctuary, where criminal actions cannot be performed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159246869733460)
- **sanctuary dungeons for finding players**: Sanctuary dungeons such as Sewer, Uruk and Ratman are places where other players can be found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546045541593645089)
- **sanctuary dungeons runebook**: The sanctuary dungeons are included in the starter runebook if the new player quest was completed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552859283450896385)
- **scavenger character**: A scavenger character is cheap to make, earns good gold, and is a good way to learn the dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362823860293694)
- **selling unidentified items on shelter island**: Unidentified items can be sold to NPCs on Shelter Island, and the weaponsmith is east of the main plaza. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925467464040449)
- **separate pvm and pvp characters**: On Outlands it is hard for one build to be good at both PvM and PvP, so players typically make separate characters for each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547633153466834954)
- **server count**: Outlands has only one server, so European players cannot choose a European server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548540188161216612)
- **shelter gathering eligibility**: Only players with Young status can gather resources in Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549606133872730113)
- **shelter gathering timer**: A new player timer can expire and then prevent further gathering on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549605697048547469)
- **shelter island**: Shelter Island is a starter area that players are not meant to spend much time on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547534642930778232)
- **shelter island gathering and crafting penalties**: Shelter Island gives no bonus gains for crafting or gathering, and gathering harvest success chance there is reduced by 50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544174002753511575)
- **shelter island gathering training**: Shelter island is safe for training gathering skills up to 80 as long as you do not give up Young status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544628895721070602)
- **shelter island leaving advice**: New players should train their skills to 80 on Shelter Island and then leave; quests are available in Prevalia afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549849736851492975)
- **shelter island monster difficulty**: Monsters in the Shelter Island dungeon are weaker than the animals outside, which are regular and harder mobs, so beginners should fight in the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547265813952864287)
- **shelter island resurrection crosses**: On Shelter Island, there is a cross at the entrance and another in the dungeon where you can resurrect yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547262041549705308)
- **shelter island skill cap**: Skill gains on Shelter Island stop once skills reach about 80, so players should leave the island and move on at that point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550135520854679573)
- **shelter island skill trainers for macefighting**: The skill trainers on Shelter Island can still be used to train Macefighting, and it is usually easier to continue training it in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554901262393417819)
- **shelter island skill training**: New players train skills to 80 on Shelter Island and do the first quest, optionally adding utility skills like Magic Resist and Healing, then leave to train main skills to 100 while doing the other quests, dropping the utility skills and renting a room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548004655575867516)
- **shelter spellstone**: In the Shelter new player dungeon, a spellstone grants a limited number of free spell casts without reagents, and once it runs out you need reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554922400079151145)
- **show hp option**: To display health below your character, enable Options > General > Mobiles > Show HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547203166905307176)
- **showing overhead names**: Pressing Ctrl+Shift opens a red box where an option can be picked to show overhead names all the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549830820620148837)
- **skill information resources**: Most information about each skill is on the wiki; there are no tutorials for individual skills, only some community template tutorials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042838977183826)
- **skill respec and newbie quests**: Skills can be learned and unlearned freely, but newbie quests cannot be undone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546670485226524753)
- **skill retraining**: Retraining skills is very easy in Outlands, so you cannot permanently mess up your skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544946695656316959)
- **spellbook requirement for casting**: You can only cast spells that are in your spellbook; choosing a skill at character creation does not necessarily give you the spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282185262112840)
- **spells needed to start mage farming**: Only a few spells are needed to start farming as a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544134990500077739)
- **standard platemail via portal vendor search**: The Outlands Portal vendor search can list standard platemail sellers, and standard platemail is plain iron, mastercrafted, and a good starting point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549693414193365014)
- **standard skills gump setting**: To switch from the scroll-style skills window to the standard (black) skills gump, go to Options > General > Gumps & Context and enable Use standards skills gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547164408986476594)
- **standard skills gump setting**: To enable the standard skills gump, open Options > General > Gumps & Context and enable 'Use standards skills gump'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548492642751479950)
- **starter rune tome contents**: The starter rune tome from the quest reportedly contains a rune to Urukton (the bluff) that can be used directly to travel there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545334050884030464)
- **starter templates for new characters**: Outlands offers starter templates to choose from the first time you log into a new character, and the wiki has further template lists for Dexxer, Mage, Bard, Tamer, Gathering, PvP and Misc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589450829136065)
- **starting skills on new characters**: A newly created Outlands character starts with many skills already at 80, so it may already be at or near the 700 total skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546159822339047485)
- **starting spell stone binding**: The starting spell stone (aspect crystal) is likely bound to the character rather than blessed, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545161592994267268)
- **starting stat distribution**: A suggested start is to set Intelligence to 25 and cap it so the other stats can rise, with Strength at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554372537381822516)
- **starting statue for basic build**: A statue where players appear after creating a character lets them create a basic build from examples. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547322421432811640)
- **starting template wiki page**: The Outlands wiki page TemplatesNewPlayer explains the basic gameplay of each starting template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564385092767764)
- **starting training credit deed**: New characters start with a training credit deed that can be used to train a skill instead of training it manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763199559336009)
- **starting treasure mapping as a new player**: New players can start treasure mapping without connections by mining their own ingots, or by selling crafted jewels to recoup gold while raising tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537104185382801488)
- **statue character restart limit**: The statue character restart can reportedly only be used once per OutlandsID, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553783690054729740)
- **statue skill re-roll**: The statue lets you re-roll your character once for free, which allows you to start with all your skills at 60. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589784794632225)
- **stopping attacks with peace mode**: Press Tab to enter warmode, and press Tab again to enter peace mode in order to stop attacking a target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919776814702662)
- **stranglelands event**: Stranglelands is a beginner-friendly PvP event where players join, pick a character, and are given all gear, like a battle royale with everyone starting at the same point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899015734824962)
- **strongest starting templates**: A fencing dex tamer and a summoner mage are probably the strongest templates right from the start in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **stuck character fix**: If your character is stuck, such as on an island, use Options > Help > In-Game Help > Character is stuck. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549236036926840843)
- **summon creature early game**: Summon Creature can be used to survive and kill monsters in the early game, and saying 'all guard' directs the summons to guard you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340792554496043)
- **summoner early game strength**: Summoners are considered strong early on because their summons absorb damage and aggro while the player learns mob mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555299801258664009)
- **summoners for new players**: Summoners work very well for new players, but you must maintain reagents to cast spells once your spell stone runs out of charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550914688060227686)
- **switching to arcane mage**: Players can start as a summoner and later switch to an arcane mage that uses no summons once they can output more damage and know how to survive without summons tanking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925470607417354)
- **tamer creature acquisition**: Tamers acquire creatures either by taming them in the field, which is free but potentially dangerous, or by buying them from other players with gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **tamer progression quests**: Players suggest that tamers who have outgrown Shelter Island should do the new player quests from Wellington in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552747986537160815)
- **tamer strength for new players**: Tamers are quite strong on Outlands and are one of the easier paths for getting started. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547358840515985448)
- **template re-roll and character slots**: A template can be re-rolled once using the statue in Shelter Haven, characters can be deleted after a week, and each account has 3x5 characters in total. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544946695656316959)
- **template statue near docks**: A statue in front of the docks lets you try out a new template, reportedly about 3 times, and double clicking it shows the templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589156764590151)
- **test shard build checking**: A test shard can be used to try out a character build before investing real time into it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548201567251988501)
- **thief danger outside sanctuary**: Thieves can target players anywhere outside of sanctuary areas, so players should stay alert for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554370287389253663)
- **thief risk in cities**: Players can still be stolen from inside cities, so bank often and carry only essentials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545295997083717723)
- **thieves in town**: Thieves operate in town, so valuables should be kept in the bank or an inn room rather than in your pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548250998890438658)
- **three account layout**: With 3 accounts, put the main character with many echoes (including a crafter, a harvester and other PvM styles) on Account 1, and a crafter for societies on each of Accounts 2 and 3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **tidal tomb and kraul hive difficulty**: Tidal Tomb and Kraul Hive are somewhat harder than other starting dungeons, though their first floors have nothing too dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078357313626137)
- **tidal tomb newbie suitability**: Tidal Tomb is not a recommended dungeon for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545919172985356381)
- **time to reach average competitiveness**: Reaching an average level of competitiveness takes roughly 1-3 hours a day for a few weeks, yielding a few links and levels in an aspect or two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549446082260639805)
- **trapped containers in the starter area**: Loose boxes and chests found lying around can be trapped, so they are suspicious, while bags cannot harm the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545305616791380080)
- **triple harvesting for new players**: Triple harvesting early on is a recommended way for new players to fund their PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551890386375676057)
- **un-upgraded boat fishing viability**: A fisher can do well with an un-upgraded boat, though upgrades maximize results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527083312655630586)
- **unidentified items recycling advice**: Unidentified items are better collected for later recycling than sold, unless you urgently need gold for your first gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925467464040449)
- **unstuck after dying on an island without a healer**: If you die on an island with no visible healer, open the Help menu and use the unstuck option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532472201285703)
- **urkton bluffs as early dungeon**: Urkton Bluffs is suggested by one player as an entry-level dungeon with low PK risk to visit after the Prevalia sewers, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534319413305565)
- **urukton bluffs difficulty**: Urukton Bluffs is new player friendly, and it has deeper levels with more difficult monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554129489447886919)
- **vendor gate safety**: Most vendor gates are safe to enter, as the vast majority of home owners do not kick customers out and murder them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549115441975402648)
- **weapon build stat distribution**: A weapon-using build uses 100 Strength, 100 Dexterity and 25 Intelligence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338719314214944)
- **wellington quest chain aspect bundle**: The second quest in the chain from Wellington rewards a bundle that unlocks up to 3 different aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816896424546456)
- **wiki template viability**: Nearly all of the templates shown on the Outlands wiki are viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609094263808061)
- **wiki templates page**: The Ultima Online: Outlands wiki has a Templates page that includes a Basic Backstabber template, which is useful for new players looking for a starting template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545571500252200972)
- **wild herdy tribal bard tamer starting build**: For a wild herdy tribal bard tamer, pick any starting build offering 80 Taming skill, since barding skills are easy to macro up with essentially no risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549998616582823989)
- **wizard codex source**: A Wizard codex can be bought from player vendors or obtained through the new player quest, and other codexes such as the Summoner Tome exist for other roles; an Alchemy codex is for 80 or more alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549649613089144905)
- **writ of orientation delivery**: For the beginner quest to deliver the Writ of Orientation to Godfrey (Dean's Assistant), Godfrey is reached through the portal right next to the quest giver. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544799227236982794)
- **young status loss effects**: Once Young status is gone, you only lose access to NPCs for buying, selling and banking, and you can still return to the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554933497821536267)

## Scripting & razor

- **razor item delay in beta client**: The Razor item delay is completely removed in beta client 1.0.3.704, which is available only on the test shard. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
