- **unified action queue**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes a Unified Action Queue for both the client and Razor, which should fix many Razor-induced drag and drop issues. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **fishing pole double-click macros**: Macros and scripts that double-click a fishing pole can fail or stall, even though the same approach works for lumberjacking and mining tools. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551678269642907790)
- **moving gumps with the alt key option**: To stop gumps such as a spell hotbar from moving when clicked, enable Options > General > Gumps & Context > 'Hold ALT key to move gumps', which applies to all gumps; to move a gump such as the cooldowns gump, temporarily turn that option off. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553485752611119105)
- **afk animal taming training script**: To level Animal Taming, Animal Lore and Herding AFK, perform the taming once manually, record it with Razor, add timing, and loop a script that releases the pet and re-tames it repeatedly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553027114993975307)
- **afk auto taming script setup**: An auto taming script is not fully AFK unless the pet is kept where it cannot move, such as a small room; the stable behind the gate or small rooms in town inns work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554116848587513877)
- **afk taming razor script**: A Razor script for AFK taming training exists, such as 'Flu AFK Tamer to 120'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083011874529321)
- **auto dexxer razor scripts**: Players have built Razor scripts for auto-dexxing during PvM, findable by searching for "auto dexxer" on the UO Razor scripts site. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554538365393571874)
- **auto recall for harvesters**: Outlands has an auto recall mechanic that works as AFK protection for harvesters, and most harvesters reportedly use an auto recall script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552106224605204582)
- **automated mining scripts**: Complex automated mining scripts exist, such as the 'SUPER-AUTO Mining and Lumberjacking' script on UORazorscripts.com. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665131561222165)
- **background script to cut hats**: Run a script in the background that cuts the wizard's hats made during Inscription training with scissors so they are recycled while you train. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546612413175042138)
- **buy agent vendor requirement**: The Razor buy agent does not require a specific vendor and works on any vendor that has the listed items in stock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553872814279233599)
- **casting on current target via macro**: To cast a spell on your current target without clicking, build a macro that casts the spell and then uses a last-target or current-target action; ending the macro with a 'CurrentTarget' entry makes follow-up 'LastTarget' hotkeys work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545889063976837210)
- **community razor script library**: The Outlands community maintains a library of ready-made Razor scripts, including mining macros and mega scripts from Jaseon, at outlands.uorazorscripts.com, and the Outlands wiki documents the extended Razor scripting features. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549454515952947252)
- **corpse auto-open failure**: A corpse may fail to auto-open if another game action (bandaging, casting, opening a bag) is in progress as the mob dies, because only one action can occur at a time; the corpse stays unopened and auto open corpses catches it on your next step, so moving one square can trigger it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548305372844925079)
- **harvesting macro weight tracker**: Add a weight tracker to a harvesting macro so that, when near carry capacity, it moves ore to a pack animal (for mining) or recalls home (when the pack is full), avoiding exceeding capacity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526221154023641148)
- **last target casting macro**: Create a macro that casts spells on your last target and a hotkey that sets whatever you have targeted as last target; after using a targeting macro you can cast another spell with a LastTarget hotkey, which helps when the mob moves and is no longer the closest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553944629131345991)
- **loadout switching scripts**: A script can swap between loadout configurations, and outlandsbutler.com offers a loadout script maker that automates this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539502440157276)
- **moongate escape script**: Spam a moongate script when near a yellow or red gate to escape almost instantly, but you must still reach the gate first. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476303395233803)
- **razor client software**: Razor, a forked version heavily customized by the Outlands team, is the software used to log on to Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341049497686089)
- **razor profile location**: Razor profiles are stored in Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Plugins\Assistant\Profiles and can be deleted manually from that folder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553197970772729857)
- **razor pvp script restrictions**: Outlands restricts certain Razor scripting functionality in PvP situations, as documented on the wiki's Razor Scripting page under PvP Restrictions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536924393840574475)
- **razor rails removal**: Rails (pathing) were removed from Razor on Outlands, which previously let macro users automate mining routes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544810118082854984)
- **scripted gatherer auto-recall**: Some players script everything when harvesting with multiple characters, and some gatherer scripts include an auto-recall that recalls the character away when tracking detects a red (hostile) player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544336221537574923)
- **scripting after map patch**: After the map patch, only clicking buttons on the map gump is disabled for scripting; harvesting actions, auto recall and other scripted actions can still be scripted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536925960253866077)
- **scripting combat advice**: Scripting is useful for repetitive tasks like restocking, but long-term scripting of combat is discouraged because it plays the game for you and stunts learning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547566496484691968)
- **scripting treasure digging**: When scripting digging up a treasure, loop the dig action continuously rather than waiting for a system message, because the completion message is not a system message. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537014928613838849)
- **skinning blue corpses**: Blue (non-criminal) player corpses can be skinned, but they must be targeted manually; scripts exist that try to skin all nearby corpses, grey or blue. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553311055323861073)
- **stopping script before afk**: Stopping your harvesting script before going AFK is the safest option and avoids ending up in jail. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549416515785199707)
- **taunt keybinding**: To bind a key for taunt, use an in-game macro with the [taunt command, or in Razor go to Hot Keys -> Outlands Commands -> Mechanics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820192952295445)
- **vet supplies hotkey**: To hotkey Vet Supplies, create an in-game say macro with [VetSupplies, or alternatively record a script or macro that double-clicks the item itself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553484532810776688)
- **abilities hotbar persistence**: The abilities hotbar disappears each time you rejoin the game, and opening it can be added to a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553143175307198467)
- **ability hotbar auto-open**: The ability hotbar's position can be set but it cannot auto-open; make a macro that says [abilityhotbar and a macro button to click after login. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547579115912036392)
- **afk detect hidden training**: To train Detect Hidden while away, make a Razor macro that uses the Detect Hidden skill and targets the ground near you, add a pause of about 11 seconds, and loop it; stand in a public area carrying no loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550336982767640639)
- **anti-pk razor script**: An anti-PK Razor script can recall you out instantly when you track a PK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664955492732949)
- **arcane essence tracking**: Outlands sends one system message when arcane essence runs low and a notification when it runs out, and there is no known way to track the exact amount in Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547560398797148200)
- **atlas hotkey script**: Record a simple script of opening the Atlas and selecting your destination, then bind it to a hotkey; the Atlas hike itself is a manual action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **auto health collector tools and nameplates**: Auto health collector tools affect only health gumps and do not affect nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545533970760859718)
- **auto queue object delay workaround**: The Auto queue object delay setting might work around corpses failing to auto-open, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548305541057617981)
- **auto track and recall script setup**: Use an auto track and recall script set for red and grey players (or blue players too for extra safety), and occasionally track manually to see who is nearby that the red/grey tracker might not be picking up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543052329656254604)
- **auto-looting scripts**: On Outlands, scripts cannot be used to auto-loot corpses; only grid loot or grabbing items without a script works, and restock cannot be used to loot from a body. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551915416098574387)
- **auto-recycle scripts**: Scripts exist that automatically recycle items from a bag using wands or skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546350322526588940)
- **automating codex abilities**: To automate a codex ability such as Spinslash, macro it; for weapon abilities, type [codex to keep the gump open and click whichever ability you want to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551599072391987211)
- **avoiding pet targeting**: To avoid accidentally targeting pets, pull out health bars and click the health bar of the exact mob, or set up cycling hotkeys in Razor: cycle to the desired monster (making it Last Target), press the spell hotkey, then press the Last Target hotkey when the reticle appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554693099605860414)
- **bandage macro setup**: To create a bandage macro, make a new macro with the action "bandageself" (or just "bandage"), which sets up bandaging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547568453676699739)
- **bard training prevalia zoo script**: The 'Bard Training - Prevalia Zoo' Razor script keeps bard skills balanced when training all three and uses the lower discordance cooldown to speed up training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549006325629976586)
- **basic harvesting macro**: To make a basic harvesting macro, record yourself double-clicking the tool and targeting yourself, then experiment with a loop timer that suits your ping, and add an overhead message for when it is time to move. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521225704958857226)
- **butler redline config menu**: Butler has a redline config menu at the top of the page for setting up redline links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547292746199601172)
- **button macro editing**: The black boxes showing bindings are button macros; hold Alt to unlock them so they can be moved, and right-click them to remove them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546478292520140800)
- **buy agent movement requirement after recall**: After recalling into a vendor shop you must move a few tiles before the buy agent works, to prevent AFK bots from buying up resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553871249078222919)
- **camping safe place script**: Camping can be scripted with a hotkey button that hikes you to your safe place, and the trip cannot be interrupted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553984171767238748)
- **cartography automation organizer setup**: For the Cartography automation, set up the Razor organizer for gold and set the hot bag to the material bag in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549546403905142805)
- **chest open and close sound files**: The chest open and close sounds are chstopen2.wav and chstcls3.wav, which do not appear in Razor's sound info and are not filtered by it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551797176584118274)
- **classic uo macro storage**: Classic UO (CUO) macros do not have separate profiles; they are stored on a per-character basis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548746579404529715)
- **client rate limiting from fast scripts**: Looping a script about twice as fast as intended triggers client rate limiting, which prevents interacting with other items such as potions or bandages until the script is stopped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529183816298528879)
- **client versus razor profile folders**: The folder other than the Plugins folder holds the in-game client profiles, while the Plugins folder holds the Razor profiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553198464400101418)
- **closest player targeting**: There is no option to target the closest player; only next and previous player targeting exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544598709537349713)
- **codexhotbar blessed item requirement**: The [codexhotbar command does not require a blessed item, unlike using a spellbook for sound alerts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788879267762262)
- **companionbot map command names**: The CompanionBot !map commands no longer use the 'map-' prefix, so commands such as !sewers, !dungeonpath and !progress are used without it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555249196444024897)
- **copying ui profile between characters**: To copy a UI setup (layouts and profile) to another character, use the Profile Manager in options, or copy the character's profile folder in the game directory and rename it to the new character's name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555041704715755584)
- **counter box re-equip hotkey**: Drag items into a counter box, then right click the box to set a hotkey for that item so you can re-equip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544923114821914664)
- **crafting setup for map disposal**: To bulk-craft maps and discard them, set the resource stockpile as the source for resources and set a trash can as the destination for the crafted maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390791371755631)
- **creating macros**: Macros are created under Options > Macro, and the top row of the action dropdown is a search field so you can type the action name instead of scrolling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567813630230608)
- **custom xml map markers**: Place custom XML map marker files in the ClassicUO Data\Client folder (e.g. C:\custom folder\ClassicUO\Data\Client\), then activate them in the in-game marker menu; the exact path depends on where ClassicUO is installed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549785094699360388)
- **cycle target and last target hotkeys**: Pressing a cycle target hotkey sets the selected mob as your last target, so the last target hotkey can then be used once a targeting reticle is up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548725293299147014)
- **dual wield skill name in razor**: In Razor Outlands Edition, the Dual Wield skill may be displayed under the name Ninjitsu in the skills window because it mirrors the Ninjitsu skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545470185920663622)
- **elderstone lumberjacking script**: Elderstone's lumberjacking script requires a hotkey at each group of trees (or harvests all trees in the 24 tiles around you) and has no auto recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534317420788056155)
- **escaping solo pks**: To escape solo PKs, set up a macro to use the nearest gate, a hotkey for rope usage (carry 20-30 ropes), and an hp collector arrangement for reds and criminals, who can be seen from a maximum of 18 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553356392935460905)
- **explosion potion cooldown tracking**: To track the explosion potion cooldown, use the system message 'Where should I throw this potion' as the trigger for a 15 second cooldown bar, since there is no dedicated system message for the potion being ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550158338803638323)
- **finding razor hotkey bindings**: In Razor, open the Hotkeys tab and type the key in parentheses into the filter box, e.g. (e), to see what is bound to that key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551426108413448193)
- **fishing rod macro workaround**: If a double-click macro on a fishing rod stops working, throw the rod away and re-target with a new rod, which then works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551679343346847875)
- **game sound controls**: Game sounds, including the lumberjack sound, are controlled in the Razor client assistant, which has options to mute sounds and possibly adjust volume. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526208312658497626)
- **gather scripts behavior**: Gather scripts are largely automatic and flee when red players appear; the player only needs to move the avatar between gathering spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548521354314256416)
- **harvest script sound alert**: Set the harvesting script to double-click a musical instrument when it says to move to the next spot, which produces a sound alert. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788106257530992)
- **harvesting hotkeys**: Set Ctrl to use item in hand and Alt to target self to streamline harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545425466545143950)
- **harvesting script setup**: Harvesting scripts are typically set up by hitting a wall, then tabbing out and returning after 10-15 seconds to move to the next spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525630025469005904)
- **hiking script to custom atlas locations**: To script hiking to your first custom location, say '[atlas', wait for gump 341416395 and respond with gumpresponse 100, wait for the gump again and respond with 20, then wait again and respond with 14; to target custom location 2 or 3, change the 'gumpresponse 20' line to 21 or 22. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550182123716218972)
- **hp collector gump nameplate grouping**: The HP collector gump can group nameplates of incoming mobiles within X tiles and auto-remove them beyond Y tiles, with groups such as summons, monsters and pk/grey players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544291662300446812)
- **in-game harvest macro**: Repeating a harvest action with one button can be done with an in-game macro, without external scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525633328626270298)
- **inn room dump and recycle workflow**: Dump items in your inn room and have another character run a script to identify and recycle them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500637049491566)
- **item recycle script keep value**: In the 'Item Recycle while Farming (i)' Razor script, a value of 1 probably means keep the item, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544323159530930337)
- **key customization and f1 popup**: Most keys can be customized with a few odd exceptions, and the F1 popup is likely set by a ClassicUO in-game macro or a Razor hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545557863865258044)
- **last object command target**: The 'last object' command used for harvesting repeats double-clicking the mountain (the target), not the tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525629979126141080)
- **last target client versus razor**: The client's last target is not the same as Razor's last target, so they can refer to different targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544600459753431050)
- **last target macro prerequisite**: The last target macro only works if the monster is already your last target, which you can set by casting the first spell on it or by using another macro to set it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544631819100758066)
- **leather entries in mine.gumps.xml**: The leather entries in the counter's mine.gumps.xml use graphic ID 4225 with hues 0, 2419, 2406, 2413, 2418, 2213, 2425, 2207, 2219 and 1763. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **loadout profile cost and scripts**: Extra loadout profiles are an expensive customization, so most players run a script instead of buying them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550447486521450498)
- **log protection with organizer agent**: Set your Organizer-11 agent to a trapped pouch or boombox so harvested logs are protected immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534317863811289139)
- **loot goblin and explore outlands map setup**: To use Loot Goblin and Explore Outlands with maps, set render scale to 100% in both, make sure the full map is visible for Loot Goblin, and when snipping for Explore Outlands include no pixel outside the map (including borders); snipping smaller is fine. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531299193304518656)
- **lootgoblin tool technology**: The lootgoblin tool uses OCR (screen text recognition) to function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347708641579051)
- **lootgoblin under resource map system**: Lootgoblin, which tracked player location for resource map navigation, is not banned but is pointless under the new resource map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534344835987804211)
- **lord glacier gatherer scripts**: The Lord Glacier lumber and mining Razor scripts rely only on Tracking and harvesting skills and recall away when red players appear; they do not use Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205181183397979)
- **macro to set last target without clicking**: A macro action exists that sets a last target without needing to click on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544631879339212842)
- **macroing and scripting limits for gathering**: Players can AFK macro and use simple scripts while actually playing, but cannot automate gathering unattended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672105930760294)
- **magery training 60 to 80**: To train Magery from 60 to 80, put a Razor script in Razor's script section that repeatedly casts Invisibility on yourself and meditates when mana is low, then run it AFK once you have 60 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340871939948605)
- **map script breakage after patch**: Some existing map scripts may break after the patch because certain map messages changed between system messages and overhead messages, so scripts need rewriting to match. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536926238680154183)
- **map script helper functions**: A map script can check harvest status, check for captcha before a map begins so it does not occur mid-map, and then recall home after harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536925748382662778)
- **mining script extensions**: A mining script can be extended with parts from other scripts to find nearby forges and automatically smelt, and to auto-recall if a PK is within 70 steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555092993336287263)
- **mining script loop delay**: If a mining script loop delay is too low, swings are skipped; one player uses 960 ms at very low ping and raises it to about 1000 ms when latency is bad. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529113268113641562)
- **mining swing timing**: The next mining swing can be started before the previous swing has finished, so a looped mining script can run faster than about 1.2 seconds per swing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529114548202770432)
- **musicianship discordance peacemaking script**: The 'Training Musicianship, Discordance and Peacemaking' script looks for the same instrument type but does not include Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549006414951882772)
- **nested containers and razor organizers**: Unless the base-level container is open, the game often does not know about its nested containers, which may stop Razor organizers from moving items into them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546654584171134977)
- **new resource map automation**: Under the new resource map system, resource maps can be almost entirely macroed except for the short jog to the chest location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544761890687684628)
- **one-key loot drop-off, repair and restock scripts**: Players commonly script a single keypress that drops off loot, repairs gear and restocks supplies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550499246560510096)
- **ordered attack spell casting with hotkeys**: To cast attack spells in a specific order, bind each regularly cast spell to its own hotkey plus a last target hotkey, then press the spell hotkey, wait for the target reticle, and press the last target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724848790872148)
- **organizer agent**: An Organizer Agent can be set up to sort items automatically into containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364519180279859)
- **parsing guild chat with razor**: Guild chat should not be parsable with Razor scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552729991744327735)
- **peacemaking harvester script setup**: A peacemaking-only harvester setup using scripts auto-peaces all mobs on screen while the player keeps moving and mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533261513467629660)
- **portal escape hotkey**: Create a script or macro bound to a hotkey that uses the portal so you can quickly escape PKs and mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850957322391634)
- **post-recall mining timer**: A timer after recalling must expire before you can mine, so a recall-based mining macro cannot loop continuously. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424612706353162)
- **preventcriminallooting command**: The [PreventCriminalLooting command toggles whether blue corpses can be looted; macros using it must match its case exactly because commands are now case sensitive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777464897732708)
- **preventing pet wandering during tame and release script**: To stop a pet from wandering away while using a tame-and-release script, tame inside a box in a stable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546101601385840671)
- **razor add friend keybind**: The Razor add-friend keybind may be broken or removed, since it sends the apparently former command [addfriend. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549482073926930502)
- **razor attack closest mob script**: A Razor script can attack the closest mob: clear the sysmsg, target closest nonfriendly, and if the sysmsg contains "no one matching" show an overhead message, otherwise turn warmode on and attack lasttarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547550962808528936)
- **razor bard sound filter**: To filter bard skill sounds in Razor, enable 'show none filter sounds', play the sound, find it in the long sound filter list and tick its box, then save the filter in General. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546124110373855233)
- **razor buy agent for reagents**: Set up a buy agent in Razor with the desired reagent amounts so you can buy them quickly when the NPC vendor is stocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551165440900866179)
- **razor buy agent usage**: Add the items and quantities you want to the Razor buy agent and enable it, then say 'vendor buy' in range or click buy on the vendor's context menu to auto-buy those items if in stock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553871249078222919)
- **razor camping script**: A Razor script can automate camping by looping a dclick on the target item every 5.5 seconds and using kindling every 10 minutes (600000 ms) via a timer to restart the campfire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549671844519481355)
- **razor cancel target and ground targets**: With Razor smart targeting, the cancel-target hotkey cancels ground targets from AoE spells but does not cancel the ground target set when throwing an explosion potion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551855201567117413)
- **razor cancel target hotkey**: To cancel the last target in Razor, open Razor hotkeys and search for 'cancel' to find and bind the cancel-target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551854367437496361)
- **razor cooldown xml script**: The Razor script 'Ultimate Cooldown XML file - all skills in one cooldown' by Jaseowns includes instructions on where to put the cooldowns.xml file and creates a single cooldown called 'skill' covering all skill cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555162614747766795)
- **razor cooldowns.xml buff bar entries**: Cooldowns recently added to the in-game buff bar may be missing from older Razor cooldowns.xml files, so an outdated file may need updating to track them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544055708486598726)
- **razor dress equipment swap**: Use Razor's Dress feature (Razor > Dress) to switch between equipment sets, such as swapping weapons when changing which skill you are training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547771219611230320)
- **razor dress feature**: Use Razor's Dress feature (Razor > Dress) to re-equip your gear, and it can also re-equip directly from your corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544923294594244668)
- **razor hotkey passing**: Passing a hotkey in Razor means allowing the key press to also be seen by the UO client, so both Razor and the client can act on the same key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548764638961860730)
- **razor hotkeys for last target and target self**: In Razor, bind Last Target and Target Self to hotkeys (e.g. the two side mouse buttons), then press either while a targeting reticle is up to target your current opponent or yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474470690193421)
- **razor item recycle while farming script**: A Razor script named 'Item Recycle while Farming (i)' identifies and recycles items while farming, and it operates on your backpack without asking you to set a bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544322698610475068)
- **razor lasttarget variable for explosion potions**: To keep throwing explosion potions at the original target while manually switching attacks, use a Razor hotkey that stores lasttarget as a variable and have the throw-explosion-potion hotkey target that variable; cycling hotkeys set lasttarget without clicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547116695200473088)
- **razor loot bag after death**: To keep Razor from getting stuck after death, set your loot bag to your main backpack after dying, since it may still point at the old bag left at the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544319670293626891)
- **razor magery training script**: A Razor script on uorazorscripts.com trains Magery from 0 to 80 by casting Invisibility from scrolls (falling back to the spellbook), and auto-meditates or eats magic mushrooms when mana is low. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660091031093248)
- **razor object delay**: If a 600ms object delay in Razor options (targeting and queues) is not working, raising it to 1200ms can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544319710227603636)
- **razor overhead messages**: Razor's Overhead messages feature makes game messages easier to read than the scrolling text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526938534718607380)
- **razor pet commands location**: Razor provides pet commands under Hot Keys -> Misc -> Pet Commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546537191218356336)
- **razor profile manager behavior**: The Razor Profile Manager is expected to change hotkeys if anything, while macros should stay the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548601608093433919)
- **razor quick escape scripts**: Razor scripts exist for quick escape, including 'Ultimate Quick Escape through gate (M)' and 'Ultimate Recall using Tome or Book as Escape (ALT-M)'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341240571760840)
- **razor resource info bar display**: The Razor resource display setting for info bars appears to have been removed and may no longer be available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547212543687266304)
- **razor script for smoke bomb after cooldown**: In a Razor script, loop with 'while cooldown "Smoke Bomb"' and 'wait 100', end the loop with 'endwhile', then 'if not cooldown "Smoke Bomb"' do 'say "[smokebomb"' to cast it once ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544057467938537523)
- **razor script resources**: Razor scripts that automate dungeon grinding, such as auto-healing and gold pickup, are available in the Scripts channel and on outlands.uorazorscripts.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554231564882419783)
- **razor scripts and captcha**: All Razor scripts are forced to stop when a captcha comes up in Ultima Online Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555090042559668335)
- **razor scripts for begging**: Razor scripts for the Begging skill are listed on uorazorscripts.com, and begging can be macroed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601047298515024)
- **razor scripts versus macros**: In Razor, scripts are generally preferred over macros because they are easier to debug, easier to copy and paste, and more flexible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548770527726796957)
- **razor sell agent for gems**: The Sell Agent in UO Razor can be used to quickly sell gems to the jeweler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046363540201504)
- **razor set last target harmful hotkey**: Using the Razor 'Set Last Target (Harmful)' hotkey with Smart Targeting enabled, followed by an explosion potion and the 'Last Target' hotkey, throws the potion at the selected mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547120844298526760)
- **razor skill cap column**: The skill cap column in Razor is a read-only readout of the game's value and cannot be edited. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550778539698159758)
- **razor skill groups**: In the Razor skills window, create a new category, drag skills into it, and single-click the group to name it; use the arrows on the left to collapse and expand groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548187505348706355)
- **razor skill lock changes**: Razor applies skill lock changes live without needing to log out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548186760687657112)
- **razor skill lock script**: To cap skill gain at a threshold, use a Razor script such as: if skill "Healing" >= 80, then setskill "Healing" lock, which locks the skill at 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550779613725065279)
- **razor skill-conditional scripts**: In a Razor script, use skill checks such as 'if skill "Fishing" >= 80' so one hotkey performs different actions depending on the character's skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537551278710980719)
- **razor sound filter lookup**: In Razor's Filters > Sound and Music tab, enable 'show non-filtered sound info' and trigger the sound to display its file name, which can then be added to the filter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794590758080515)
- **razor target and attack hotkeys**: Razor has no hotkey for targeting the nearest enemy player and no single hotkey that selects the next target and attacks; you can only cycle next/previous non-friendly player targets, and combining target and attack requires two hotkeys or a script/in-game macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555602258501308457)
- **razor target-by-type setup for trees**: In Razor, when setting up a target-by-type for a tree, click yourself rather than the tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548975192599171094)
- **razor targeting hotkey location**: The cycle target, last target and target self hotkeys are found in Razor > Hotkeys, and target self lets you cast heals or cure on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548725564511092817)
- **razor versus cuo grab bag**: Razor's grab bag and ClassicUO's grab bag are separate: the CUO bag, set with the set grab bag button on the grid loot gump, receives grid loot and double-click loot, while Razor's bag works only with its Grab Item hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550040292454043691)
- **recall by hotkey with rune tome or book**: To recall by hotkey or on-screen button, create a Razor hotkey that uses a say macro for the recallcharge command followed by the rune name; this works with a rune tome or rune book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341179964072077)
- **recallcharge equivalent for atlas hiking**: No built-in equivalent of the recallcharge command is known for Hiking with an Atlas, so it would require a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341764490535054)
- **recalling to rented inn room**: You cannot recall directly to a rented inn room, but you can make a script that recalls and enters the room with one button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553102690916241440)
- **recorded macro swing speed**: A basic recorded macro can swing faster than community scripts, which can slow harvesting, because you can swing faster than it takes for ore or boards to land in your bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521233115966869594)
- **removal of all scripts**: The Outlands team has never considered removing all scripts from Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525636405202653307)
- **restock agent source container limitation**: The restock agent works, but not when the source container is in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546264784692056136)
- **restock agent usage**: To use the restock agent, keep a container with your reagents on the floor or in another container, set your destination bag as the Hot Bag, then trigger the agent and target the source bag in your chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546264784692056136)
- **restoring hidden window**: Press Ctrl+Shift to bring back the hidden window; enabling the 'prevent overlapping' option is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553356747132108851)
- **rope and teleport razor script**: A Razor script called 'Quick Rope Tele with cooldowns (F)' on UORazorscripts.com can be used to perform the rope and teleport combo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554811740342980659)
- **rope macro limitations**: A script cannot perform the left click for a rope macro, because it cannot know which way you are facing or target a set number of tiles ahead, so the cursor must be placed manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554943252447236179)
- **runebook in razor scripts**: To use a runebook in a Razor script, run the >info command and target the runebook to get its code, or record opening the runebook and clicking the gem or recall button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554100030917447793)
- **saving the necromancy gump**: Use the command -savenecrobar to save/lock the Necromancy gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554472986960990229)
- **script interaction with other players**: Script interactions with other players are intentionally restricted compared to what scripts can accomplish against monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **script item dropping with stacking**: When dropping items with a script, use -1 -1 as the coordinates so the items stack; specifying coordinates dictates a specific location in the container and prevents stacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364508606431242)
- **script library website**: A website containing many pre-existing scripts exists for players to browse and try. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552022318144950393)
- **script to auto refresh weapon ability**: A script can auto refresh a weapon ability by checking for the system message 'Weapon Ability Ready', waiting 500 ms, and then saying '[weaponability2'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548020849339015259)
- **scripted auto healing**: Scripting can auto cast heals, but you cannot move while casting, so a script that stops you to cast at the wrong time can be worse than just moving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **scripted fishing pole equip**: To equip a fishing pole in a script without double-clicking: find the pole in the backpack, use the 'Undress Both Hands' hotkey, wait 650 ms, lift the pole, wait 650 ms, drop it on self RightHand, then wait 250 ms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551689440378884169)
- **scripting hiking**: Hiking can be automated with a script instead of being done manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550179420029849722)
- **scripting in structured pvp**: Scripting is very limited in structured PvP such as factions and events, while scripts can be used in unstructured PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672497099804672)
- **setting up a razor script**: Find a script on outlands.uorazorscripts.com, copy it into the script section in Razor, save it, then hit play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554259368508133417)
- **simple dig script setup**: A simple dig setup is to bind a script to a key that double-clicks an Elven Spellblade (skinning knife) in the backpack and targets self, then press the key about every 2 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537016685045878784)
- **skinning script with elven spellblade**: A UO Steam-style script that finds an Elven Spellblade in the backpack, double-clicks it, and uses a Target Self hotkey works for skinning maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537191079009583166)
- **sorting mibs with butler tools**: To locate and sort MIBs efficiently, use the Outlands Butler tools, which include sorting scripts and a map file you can add, rather than clicking each MIB individually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555558107189485700)
- **spellbook sound alert for multiboxing**: A spellbook can be used as a blessed item that makes a sound to signal when to move to the next harvesting spot while multiboxing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788172179410954)
- **stealing macro**: A simple macro can be set up to use the stealing skill on whatever nearby monster is currently targeted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **stuck razor organizer**: If a Razor organizer bugs out and gets stuck trying to move items (possibly worsened by the object/action queue), press 'stop' on the running organizer in Razor to end it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546653707222122577)
- **swapping hotkeys between characters**: Create and use different Razor profiles to swap hotkeys easily between echoes (characters). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548770527726796957)
- **tazuo client prohibition**: TazUO is prohibited on UO Outlands; the server only allows connection through the official Outlands Launcher, which uses its custom ClassicUO with Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554881651409035266)
- **teleport and rope hotkey**: You can cast teleport and rope back to back, and you can set up a single hotkey that does both at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552704761189376021)
- **text commands list**: Type [commands to see several pages of text commands usable from scripts or macros, including changing aspects and toggling disarm; they produce system messages that can be shown as Razor overheads. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545062742661009458)
- **thief razor last-target steal**: Thieves can lower their object delay, temporarily move items, and set a target in Razor so they can hotkey a last-target steal without seeing the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143376258011229)
- **tracking gatherer script skill requirements**: The tracking-based gatherer script setup calls for 100 Tracking and at least 90 Detect Hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205695820300309)
- **tracking overhead alerts against pks**: Tracking can be configured with overhead messages to make approaching PKs more noticeable, or a friend with Tracking can accompany you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476693654249624)
- **tracking recall script**: For a tracking-based gatherer script, use a blessed runebook and write a script that recalls to the rune of your choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **unattended harvesting script penalty**: If staff find your harvesting script still running while you are away, they put a timer on you, and a repeat offense reportedly results in a ban. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549416940701876306)
- **upcoming rope macro update**: An update expected soon is rumored to make rope macros slightly easier, but the details and timing are unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554944502261883294)
- **waitfortarget in combined cast macros**: When combining casting and targeting in one macro, add a WaitForTarget action between the cast and the targeting action so the target cursor is ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544632191978315878)
- **walking in mining scripts**: Scripts may only dig and recall when tracking finds a red; scripts that walk were disabled because many players used walking in scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545423859400974366)
- **weaponability hotkey commands**: The commands WeaponAbility1, 2 and 3 let you hotkey weapon abilities, but they do not auto renew the ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548018672079995012)
- **witcher tmap location markers for razor**: To show Witcher TMap location markers on the in-game map, place the provided .xml file in the Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Client folder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531092366398717993)

## Economy

- **full spellbook price**: A full 64-spell spellbook typically costs about 30K to 40K gold on player vendors, with recent listings around 35K. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550785709395284038)
- **magic item recycler**: The Magic Item Recycler, obtainable from the Prevalian Merchant for mid-late game, is loaded with identified magic items (identified via ID wands), supports dropping everything in at once, and can yield echoes; early game, NPC-bought tools can recycle magic items instead. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559740996718704)
- **magic item recycler price**: The Magic Item Recycler costs 25 Prevalia coins or 625,000 gold from the Prevalian Merchant; Prevalia coins come from website donations (about $25), and the gold price can change as coin value changes. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655934722740275)
- **outlands portal**: The Outlands Portal (portal.uooutlands.com) is a staff-developed and staff-maintained vendor indexer and sales history for player vendors, accessed with OutlandsID login; it lets players search and sort vendor items by price and locate vendors, but you must travel to the vendor yourself and it is not an auction house. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867430885429269)
- **harvest aspect on treasure maps**: The Harvest aspect can give a double proc when opening treasure maps, doubling stackable rewards such as gold, which makes it the preferred aspect for running treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538209209798234242)
- **iron ingot commodity deeds as income**: Iron ingots can be turned into commodity deeds (5k ingots per deed) and sold to other players, which is a good way to raise early funds for training more expensive templates; the going price was roughly 142-145k per deed in early September 2026. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544714769905225768)
- **animal broker pet market**: Animal Broker (Stable Broker) NPCs, typically found in stables near Stable Keepers, sell players' pets, and many cheap level 1 mounts are available there, typically for 1-2k gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552118811136884818)
- **early gold from lumberjacking and mining**: Lumberjacking and mining are very good ways for new characters to raise initial funds, and selling ingots and boards early is lucrative and helps fund PvM characters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072372224426035)
- **echo stamping cost**: Stamping echoes costs 1M gold for the first and an additional 1M more for each subsequent one (2M, 3M, 4M, etc.), and swapping to an already stamped echo costs no additional gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550486334005841993)
- **npc vendor restock timing**: NPC vendors periodically restock their wares at a variable interval of roughly 10 to 30 minutes, with variability meant to stop players clearing them out on a fixed timer. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552338755724116029)
- **outlands portal vendor search**: Log in to the Outlands Portal (portal.uooutlands.com) with your OutlandsID credentials, or use the in-game chat command '!portal <term>', and search for an item to see player vendor listings and sales history. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550392921860214895)
- **plain scrolls from mobs**: Plain scrolls dropped by mobs are generally not worth collecting, since NPC scribes do not buy them and mobs do not drop tier 7/8 scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554576516589818019)
- **runebook bless deed vendor**: A runebook is blessed with a runebook bless deed, sold by Jakesh, the Prevalia Merchant; the price is reported as around 100K by one player and around 25k by another, so it is unclear. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554338135159083049)
- **t8 treasure map economics**: Before the patch, a T8 treasure map cost about 300k to buy and its loot sold for about 600k, giving roughly 300k profit per map and about 3-3.5 million gold per hour for typical runners, with outliers like Witcher near 10 million per hour; the patch's cost mechanic applies to T8 maps as it does to level 1-3 maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537105857236697108)
- **arcane scroll sources and price**: Arcane scrolls drop from monsters or are found in treasure chests, and they are commonly listed on player vendors for around 1k gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550694899593121884)
- **buying spell scrolls from mage npcs**: Mage NPC scrolls are overpriced, so buy only the few you need from them; there is no proper way to obtain a full spellbook other than buying scrolls from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547415174049300500)
- **cheapest mount token sources**: The cheapest ways to get a mount token are the societies point system and the achievement points system. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551175380088660090)
- **checking vendor sales and prices via portal**: To see what your vendors actually sold, open the Portal and use the 'My vendors' link; clicking 'vendor search' in-game also links you to the vendor portal website, where you can look up item prices. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553532662084272129)
- **chromatic aspect changes and core prices**: Chromatic aspect changes regularly cause core prices to fluctuate depending on the current meta, and resellers have lost large sums during such swings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531105543475826748)
- **colored resource prices after map overhaul**: The map overhaul increases the drop rate of resource maps, which raises the supply of colored resources and is expected to lower their value, so resource maps are likely worthwhile over normal mining only for avar/val/ver maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **converting a check back to gold**: To turn a check back into gold, place the check in your bank box and double click it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554246142206804039)
- **corrupted link pricing**: Corrupted links are cheaper than gold links because they are only usable for a limited number of days. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545414967942185031)
- **crafter income from society jobs**: Crafters such as alchemists make money mainly through weekly society jobs rather than by selling goods or potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008884406100058)
- **creature broker pet pricing**: Pet stats are random on spawn with a wide range, so players buy pets from the creature broker instead of taming one with good stats, and some listings are priced unrealistically high while good-stat pets can often be found for much less than the top listings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666061280551084)
- **dull copper resource map price**: Dull copper resource maps have recently sold for about 7k, down from 15k+ when competition was active, and one seller says he has never sold them for more than 9k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531356781346033864)
- **finding player vendors via outlands portal**: To buy from player vendors, search for the item on the Outlands Portal vendor search site, click the item to list vendors selling it and where each is located, then travel to that vendor in-game and buy it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551766021621415946)
- **gem demand from tinkerers**: Gems are used for tinkering, and players buy them in bulk at higher prices than NPC vendors pay, mainly to train tinkerers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474322880921661)
- **gem value for tinkering and gold**: Gems are valuable for levelling tinkering and also give a decent bonus amount of gold per dungeon run, especially in the early game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046724166459555)
- **gold link prices**: Gold links are a good purchase with society points and currently sell for roughly 2.5M gold, down from about 3.5M, as link prices have fallen in general lately. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549427327014928500)
- **harvest aspect initial unlock cost**: The initial Harvest Aspect unlock costs around 150k gold in items, down from roughly 400k in the past. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549608263845158954)
- **house lottery gold sink**: House lotteries act as a gold sink and ticket totals are not publicly shared, and some players reportedly spend millions or even tens of millions of gold on tickets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544347330537590794)
- **inexpensive quality-of-life purchases**: The resource stockpile and magic item recycler are recommended inexpensive quality-of-life purchases after the storage shelf, while the much more expensive strongbox comes later. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500245959999629)
- **item price history lookup**: Item market values and price history can be checked on the Outlands portal's vendor-search page, which helps in deciding when to sell goods such as colored leather. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827272368980118)
- **leather commodity player price**: Leather sells to players for well above 1gp per unit, with a 5,000-leather commodity estimated at roughly 7-9k gold, possibly more. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827372562382900)
- **leather uses**: Leather can be used to make armor or sold to other players for quick money. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339616005955717)
- **loot sale value**: Rare loot prices have dropped, and loot now sells for very little. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550258818359894017)
- **mastery link reforging prices**: A Mastery Link Reforging tool sells for around 100k and bronze bard mastery links with damage/buff bonuses sell for around 50k, so it is probably better to sell the reward link and tool and buy the desired link; check current prices first. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553167355473960961)
- **npc vendor stock sharing**: NPC vendor stock is shared among all players, so players can deplete it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554553409443602613)
- **outlands butler website**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com) provides tools for calculating crafting and society profits, including a societies optimiser that takes your skills and shows which society jobs you can do, your success rate and expected profit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547991020413648926)
- **per-item pricing on player shops**: To price individual items in a stack on a player shop, check the 'Use Item Pricing Menu' checkbox to open the pricing gump. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552241236331728926)
- **pit gold income**: Pits have been yielding about 1 million gold per hour, and an upcoming poison change is reducing this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898021150527559)
