- **player trading options**: Outlands has no in-game player market; players trade through vendors, rented spots with hired NPCs, or a trade channel, and meet at Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503239842824363)
- **player vendors and early income**: Major trade in Outlands goes through player vendors, and selling farming loot there is a useful way to generate early income. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867316821332104)
- **portal price overview**: The Outlands Portal has a vendor-search price overview page showing price history for items such as commodity ingots, and it has no public API. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554563356642381864)
- **prevalian coin acquisition and resale**: Prevalian (donation) coins are obtained by donating and can be spent at the Prevalia shop or sold to other players for gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552994495304310907)
- **price checking a large dragonship**: To price check a large dragonship, screenshot the ship's stats pages and post them in the community channel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548867759767818321)
- **safe player vendor purchases**: When buying from a player vendor, quickly hide (about 50% chance to hide within 1 tile of a house), buy, then run at least one screen away before recalling since thieves may be hiding nearby, or wait until you can afford the small fee to have the item sent directly to your bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584302434947195)
- **sanctuary dungeon gold income**: Sanctuary dungeons such as Prevalia Sewers drop low gold, making them a slow way to earn gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549247370942742649)
- **ship exchange refund**: Crafted ships can be exchanged for half of their materials with the Prevalia Exchange officer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550981771401629822)
- **smuggler npc stock and pricing**: Smuggler NPCs sell unlimited amounts of certain vendor items at a 25-33% markup over normal vendor NPCs, and vendor discounts do not apply to them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951170508853476)
- **smuggler npcs**: Smugglers are resource NPCs who sell reagents and other commodity items in bulk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554556924765274113)
- **society point rewards**: Society points can be exchanged for gold, chain link reforges, mastery chain links, tokens and other rewards, which is where much of the money in crafting comes from. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051103222140990)
- **society point spending options**: Gold links and gold reforging tools are good ways to spend society points, especially after getting both strongbox unlocks, and gold reforging tools return gold value sooner; check market prices before redeeming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551367544122908673)
- **society points cash-in for gold**: Players typically convert society points into gold reforging tools for faster cash or gold links for slower cash, then sell those items for gold; points can also be advertised and exchanged for whatever a buyer requests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576871097274450)
- **spell scroll availability**: Spell scrolls up to level 6 drop from monsters and can be bought from vendors, while level 7 and 8 scrolls must be bought from players (a few thousand gold each) or crafted; only one of each needs to be dropped into the spellbook, and scroll drops add weight. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552972016800505938)
- **strongbox deed cost**: Strongbox deeds cost 500 Society points each, earned through weekly society jobs, or about 2 million gold each on the market; they are account customisations that make gold weigh less. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554885453440880652)
- **strongbox deeds gold weight reduction**: Strongbox deeds can be bought with society points; the first reduces carried gold weight to 75% and the second reduces it further to 50%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554537713728884889)
- **strongbox gold weight reduction cost**: The strongbox gold weight reduction upgrade costs about 2.5M gold, and buying both items discussed totals about 5M. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546363100876247161)
- **strongbox upgrades priority**: If you have not unlocked the two strongbox upgrades and do not need immediate profit, saving society points for them is recommended, as strongboxes are considered a must-have. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576683565486091)
- **survival gears and research material prices**: Survival gears drop at a rate much higher than the number of pits players will run, and research material and survival gear prices on the Portal have been declining since the patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537107796061982810)
- **t8 treasure map run rate**: Before the patch, a skilled T8 treasure map runner could complete about 10-12 T8 maps per hour depending on location, while Witcher reportedly ran about 50-60 per hour. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537105037807849584)
- **theft risk while vendor shopping**: Thieves can steal items from players while they shop at vendors, so players should take precautions when buying. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671118704705677)
- **top gold earner and treasure mapping**: The top gold earner on the server leaderboard is a treasure mapper, who also ranks third in treasure map levels. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548050005301010523)
- **treasure map income via cartography**: Cartography lets players run treasure maps, and with 85 Cartography, level 1 treasure maps are a cheap-to-build-up way to earn loot and gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548271988244615240)
- **triple-boxing harvesters**: Many harvesters on Outlands run three clients at once to increase gold per hour, which increases the supply of harvested resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535526452747960382)
- **vendor purchase delivery**: When buying from a vendor, send the purchase to your bank and then run fast to your inn room to avoid theft. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547174964895944815)
- **wizard satchel**: A wizard satchel is used to conserve reagents and reduces how many a player carries, limiting losses when PKed; thieves can steal the reagents inside it but not the satchel itself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551114477796204565)
- **7th and 8th circle scroll sourcing**: 7th and 8th circle spell scrolls are player made rather than sold in NPC shops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548147836783304815)
- **afk fishing fish steak yield**: AFK fishing only occasionally generates regular fish steaks, which are useful for training cooking but are worth less than 1gp each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530653005488197844)
- **antiquity large plough price**: The antiquity large plough sold for about 20k gold on the player market after the listing price was lowered by 10k each day, though one copy reportedly once sold for 100k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549952922903773327)
- **appearance ingredient sales**: Appearance ingredients sell very quickly on a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546790266223198209)
- **arcane aspect cost and codex**: Arcane Aspect is not cheap and also requires an Arcane Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549647370197794878)
- **arcane essence price**: One arcane essence is worth roughly 1k gold, though player-market prices may vary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546487539882262539)
- **arcane mage as new player money maker**: Arcane mage is not a good money maker for a new player; mining, lumberjacking, or a Paladin or Bard are suggested as temporary money makers instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589277409677404)
- **arcane mage t4 treasure map rate**: An Arcane mage with 120 Cartography can complete about 25-30 T4 treasure maps per hour, helped by the multiplier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544401583427551284)
- **armor set sales as crates**: Armor sets are commonly sold as crates because this is more convenient for sellers, who otherwise must price each armor piece individually on the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767479617159360)
- **arrow vendors bowyer and carpenter**: Bowyer or Carpenter NPCs sell arrows, but their stock can be bought out and takes roughly 10-30 minutes to restock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552076109699350559)
- **aspect dye on shields**: Aspect dye can be applied to a shield, but each replacement shield needs fresh aspect dye, which can be expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555277220396798025)
- **aspect quest cost**: The aspect quest costs 50k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767743917170830)
- **avarite valorite verite map prices**: Avarite, valorite and verite maps are expected to stay at the same price after the map changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529894724083646464)
- **avoiding theft while vendor shopping by hiding or running**: To avoid being stolen from while vendor shopping, hide next to a house before pressing buy and then trap the pouch holding the purchased item, or press buy while running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542688893428830228)
- **avoiding theft while vendor shopping using recall**: To avoid being stolen from while vendor shopping, cast recall and press buy during the casting phase while holding the item on your cursor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542688893428830228)
- **bank check double-click behavior**: Double-clicking a check in your bank box converts it to gold in the bank box, so the account balance stays the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413350279123024)
- **bank check function**: A bank check functions as gold while it is in your bank, and gold spent is automatically deducted from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554245464302288947)
- **bank delivery cost for purchases**: Sending purchased items to the bank costs barely any extra now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547521266540347433)
- **bank gold capacity**: When the bank stops accepting gold it is at capacity, and the gold should be condensed into a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553964942796001292)
- **bank gold capacity via checks**: To store more gold in the bank, convert bank gold into a check; a check likely has no upper limit and you can make multiple checks, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768154172657726)
- **bank safety against thieves**: Spend as little time at the bank as possible and, while there, stand next to multiple NPCs, which makes thieves less likely to target you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555624583569215509)
- **banker voice commands**: Say 'Balance' near a banker to open the balance gump, or say 'Check [amount]' near a banker to have a bank check created for that amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768362424303747)
- **best dungeons for gold farming**: Farming non-sanctuary and non-new-player dungeons is the best way to earn gold if your character can handle them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549178710744240231)
- **blank scroll prices**: Many player vendors sell blank scrolls at lower prices than the Smuggler NPCs do. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552817392629846097)
- **blessing fancy clothes**: Blessing fancy clothes is an end-game activity because the bless deeds required are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855945776332823)
- **breaking checks into 60k stacks**: Breaking a check automatically separates the gold into 60k stacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553947422735204483)
- **buying echoes to save gold**: Buying echoes saves gold overall, because relevelling an aspect or expensive skill on a different character is the biggest waste of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527291601796333608)
- **buying mounts**: Horses are not sold by the Stable Master; mounts can be bought from players at an Animal Broker NPC, and level 1 mounts cost roughly 1-2k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546525032782630963)
- **buying nightshade commodities from player vendors**: To buy nightshade commodities from player vendors, search the portal for "night comm". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552343322255958141)
- **caddelite decoration sale value**: Caddelite decoration sells for 2 million gold or more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533929196454281296)
- **cancelling a player vendor**: Type [vendors to cancel a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546877641758482453)
- **carpet dye cost**: A single carpet dye costs roughly 60k gold worth of infinity coins at current prices, and infinity coins are currently cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200961785434163)
- **chain cooldown reduction**: Endgame players can pay to reduce the chain cooldown to 15 minutes, reportedly costing about 10-15 million gold, though the price is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548552230649467001)
- **character rename deed**: A Character Rename deed is sold by the Prevalia Merchant for roughly 200K gold, though the exact price is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496028372836393)
- **cheapest repair kit type**: Tailoring repair kits are the cheapest type of repair kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991960421572609)
- **checking doubloon balance**: To check your doubloon balance, say "balance" while at the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548871299625918528)
- **chest exchange for essence at prevalia**: Chests can be exchanged for essence at the Prevalia exchange. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489790157201539)
- **chromatic core loot table addition**: Chromatic cores were added to the loot table in April 2024. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537987900027830422)
- **chromatic core price**: Chromatic cores were selling for about 30k gold in early September 2026, though prices have been falling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545974368641884241)
- **codex acquisition**: Codices are purchased from other players who can craft them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554453259295531079)
- **colored ingot supply**: Most colored ingots in the Outlands economy come from the drop rate of resource maps, so the economic impact is the same whether one player or many complete the maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529590196096602355)
- **colored leather pricing**: The price of colored leather fluctuates based on which society jobs are paying well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532429778789990400)
- **colored ore commodity deed size**: Colored ore only requires 2500 to fill a commodity deed, and most colors sell in less than a full deed amount since buyers usually want only enough to finish their weekly society needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544715174341116056)
- **colored scroll drops**: Colored scrolls dropped by enemies are worth collecting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554577892451688449)
- **commodity deed theft risk**: Commodity deeds are not blessed and can be stolen, so trades involving them should be done on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544714461326348399)
- **commodity purchase quantity for logs and ingots**: Players generally buy logs and ingots in lots of 5000, which is called a commodity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554353639282180218)
- **container id wand value**: A container ID wand gives more value per charge than an item ID wand, but it is wasteful if the bag holds only 20-30 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546349654139207680)
- **core price drop cause**: Core prices dropped mainly because of increased supply, since there are more players than ever and farming is relatively easy, rather than because of lower demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546000816765403136)
- **core prices**: Core prices have dropped substantially, with chromatic cores having been listed for around 35 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679323833434212)
- **corpse eater taming value**: Corpse Eaters on level 2 of the dungeon are in demand for taming; Lore them to check stats, and one with 4+ attack speed, 8+ damage and wrestling can sell for a good amount of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545087572240498718)
- **cosmetic quivers**: Cosmetic quivers may be available from the Prevalia Merchant and are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554328553821044767)
- **cost of full spellbook from players**: Buying a full spellbook from a player effectively gives circles 1-6 for free, since the price is mainly for the arcane scrolls needed for 7th and 8th circle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546339279247118436)
- **crafter income sources**: Crafters earn their income mainly through societies, since crafting and selling on the market has very low profit margins and is done mostly by roleplayers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544304411507953704)
- **crafting profit market**: Crafted gear is very good and cheap in Outlands, but there is almost no market for profit from crafting and selling armor or weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550050210623787080)
- **crafting profitability and gatherer income**: Crafting is expensive and not very profitable up front, mostly used for passive gains through crafting societies over a long period, while boards and ingots sell very well so gatherers can make a lot of gold fairly easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550893936770285709)
- **daily resource map creation rate**: About 350 maps of each resource map category are created every day on the server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528202664251228301)
- **dedicated buyer character**: A second-account character with resist, hiding and parrying makes a good dedicated buyer that can always hide and has a better chance of surviving attacks by reds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584827876511745)
- **delectable food price**: Delectable Food rose to about 300 gold each during the season, though the price may have changed since. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533774639405334619)
- **demand for colored boards**: Colored boards have a similar demand problem to colored leather, but to a much lesser extent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525675714131529758)
- **demand for colored leather**: Demand for low and mid-end colored leather outside societies is insufficient, and societies do not consume nearly enough low-end colored leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525675714131529758)
- **destard gold farming during wilderness bonus**: Periods of a 20% wilderness gold bonus occur, and during them players commonly farm gold in Destard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536454135392772116)
- **discord sell channel access**: To gain access to the sell channel in Discord, log into the Outlands Portal and link your Discord account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549412469695447192)
- **distill prices**: Distills sell for only about 2-3k gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679243156258848)
- **doubloon discount on loadouts**: Buying loadouts with doubloons instead of gold gives roughly a 10-15% discount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547464283875577916)
- **dullhide leather map price**: Dullhide leather maps were reportedly purchasable for about 10 gold each, though the price may have changed since the speaker last checked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529873937763270868)
- **dullhide value per weight**: Dullhide is not as valuable per unit of weight as gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551830445573021757)
- **dungeon farming gold efficiency**: Dungeon farming is currently considered low on the gold-efficiency chart because you can only farm about 10 minutes before having to leave, especially without a strongbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547647766417645578)
- **dungeon gold looting limit**: Players must leave the dungeon roughly every 5 minutes or they stop receiving gold loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549475576396652645)
- **dungeon income**: Dungeons are a source of quick money, though the start of the server is somewhat difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548556315637457017)
- **dungeon slayer items**: Dungeon slayer items such as cloth, lanterns and dyes share the hue of that dungeon's drops and are mostly wanted as deco rares. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546259403072872488)
- **duo-boxing treasure maps**: Since the harvest change, duo-boxing treasure maps is beneficial because the second character can skip the 60 second timeout and start digging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525571123373146272)
- **early gold in shelter dungeon**: About 5,000 gold can be earned quickly in the Shelter dungeon, enough to cover a week of the cheapest inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546240625236775123)
- **echo cost and value**: Echoes are expensive up front but have high long-term value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **echo purchase cost scaling**: Each additional echo purchased on the same character costs progressively more, with no known limit, and some players reportedly have a dozen or more echoes on one character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550387631919992864)
- **echo unlock costs**: Echo 1 costs 1m gold or doubloons, 100 skill scrolls or 25k arcane essences; Echo 2 costs 2m gold or doubloons, 200 skill scrolls or 50k arcane essences; Echo 3 costs 3m gold or doubloons, 300 skill scrolls or 75k arcane essences, and a character can have many echoes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550579668397326456)
- **empty bottle vendors**: Alchemist NPCs in most mage shops sell empty bottles depending on demand, and smuggler NPCs sell them in bulk at a higher price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550162551407517697)
- **extra aspect hue cost**: Extra aspect hues are bought in the customization menu under help for millions of gold, reportedly about 31 million including the spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549975996810268723)
- **finding item id wands for sale**: To find an Item ID wand for sale, use the vendor search in the top bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546920166418415636)
- **fire aspect distillations availability**: Fire Aspect Distillations are available on player vendors in decent quantity and can be found via the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547229220747354142)
- **first commodity deed**: A player can obtain a first commodity deed by gathering at least 5k of a resource on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549605130477903913)
- **fish as byproduct**: Fish caught in Outlands are effectively a byproduct that sits around unsold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527123817762127913)
- **fish filet vendor price**: Fish filets sell to vendors for 100 gold each, which adds up when boating a lot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555371515250343988)
- **fishing boat and crew cost**: A fishing boat and crew can be obtained for about 50k gold in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394041232171169)
- **fishing income source**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, the money in fishing comes from the special fishing nets obtained while fishing, not from the fish themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527124010142404618)
- **fishing net sale price**: Fishing nets sell for about 9,000-9,500 each when stacked and sold in batches of 100 or more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549690701808148510)
- **full spellbook player vendors**: Full 64-spell exceptional blessed spellbooks can be bought from player vendors found via the portal vendor search; Anchor's Rest has an easy-to-find vendor selling one for 35k, and the Cambria vendor sells one for 39,900. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553619485749940264)
- **full spellbooks on outlands portal**: Once a player drops Young status, full spellbooks can be found for sale on the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547416090538414226)
- **gathering income for new players**: Training mining or lumberjacking to 100 takes roughly 10 hours and yields about 150K gold along the way, after which income is about 75K gold per hour without an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602714214862909)
- **gem selling location**: Gems can be sold to a Jeweler NPC, with one located against the west Prevalia wall, a bit southwest of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474213065531634)
- **gem weight value versus gold**: One stone of weight of gems is worth more than one stone of weight of gold, which is 100 gold with Strongbox 1 and 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545509375228121230)
- **getting scrolls to shelter island characters**: To get scrolls to a character in Shelter Island, use a mule character outside to buy them, give them to the mule, then transfer them to the character that needs them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554333194843594793)
- **gold earning rate on shelter island**: Roughly 12,500 gold can be earned in one to three hours in the dungeon on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548439111000526853)
- **gold harvest links leather yield**: Grabbing 10 gold harvest links does not significantly increase leather yield and is not a great investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **gold link loot bonus**: 22 gold links may give only about 2% better loot, though the actual value is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526320274872598528)
- **gold sinks this year**: Gold sinks this year include a Winterhoof lottery, Terran and Cambrian unique house lotteries, increased redline point costs, a 25% increase in Prev merchant prices, and gold decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544154958377783416)
- **gold stack auto-stacking limit**: Dropping a gold stack onto another stack does not auto-stack up to 60k; the remainder is left aside and must be calculated manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553947134959812740)
- **gold stack limit**: A gold stack holds at most 60,000 gold; amounts beyond that need a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553946577645735937)
- **guild vendor spots**: Guilds may offer cheap or free vendor spots to their members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551994032270479401)
- **guildhouse npc vendor contracts and guild discord sales**: A guildhouse may offer contracts for NPC vendors, and guilds with a Discord allow selling directly to guild members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549830785383661674)
- **hair dye value versus cloth**: Hair dye and similar dyes are worth more than the cloth colors that drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544562080252825682)
- **harvest aspect return on investment**: The return on investment for Harvest Aspect is roughly 8 million gold, though this figure is recalled from memory and may be inaccurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549608508272672839)
- **harvest cores for levels beyond t10**: Going past Harvest level T10 requires harvest cores, which cost gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530950428278263990)
- **high circle scroll availability in shelter island**: Seventh and eighth circle scrolls cannot be bought from NPCs in Shelter Island and must be purchased from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554332581091344507)
- **high-value pets via animal lore**: Using Animal Lore to inspect creatures can reveal pets with 4+ attack speed and 8+ melee damage, which can likely sell for more than 50k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549714935267991553)
- **higher level chest loot**: Higher level chests contain armor, weapons, gems and valuable items that can be sold or used to improve a character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341381329789050)
- **identification wand cost versus item id scrolls**: Identification wands may be cheaper than buying 20 Item ID skill mastery scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544511051087745115)
- **inn room cost versus bank upgrade**: Renting an inn room is probably cheaper than buying the bank storage upgrade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092573290045523)
- **inn room rent payment**: Inn room rent drains slowly, and it can be paid from a second account's bank holding only enough gold to cover the desired weeks of rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550042306365628478)
- **item pricing method**: A reasonable way to price items is a mix of median market price and how long the item has been listed; an item that is not selling may need a lower price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547576158223208468)
- **item sale value and top modifiers**: Significant gold from selling an item is only expected if the item has at least one or more of the top modifiers on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548444336096673845)
- **jack and jill echo cooldown upgrade costs**: The Jack and Jill echo cooldown upgrades cost 2.5m each, and the final quick upgrade costs 5m. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550498055650811917)
- **kings faire event and prev coin prices**: Kings Faire is an annual in-game event; last year Prev Coins sold for about 19.5k each, and habits sold for 5-10 million at the end of the event before reaching a high of 120 million. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107136267096188)
- **kings faire gold sink**: Kings Faire is the biggest gold sink of the year and causes item prices to drop considerably that week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544158984284672116)
- **leather availability**: Leather is very cheap and effortless to obtain and sustain on this shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677525487849562)
- **leather commodity deed price**: Regular leather commodity deeds sell for about 10k each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532429778789990400)
- **leather commodity deed value per weight**: Converting 5000 leather into a commodity deed makes it far more valuable per unit of weight than carrying gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551814740794417283)
- **leather commodity size**: A leather commodity consists of 5,000 leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827176264638586)
- **leather versus gold weight value**: With falling market prices, loose leather is no longer worth more than gold per unit of weight in strongboxes: 5000 leather weighs 125 stones, while the cheapest leather commodity on the portal (11k gold) weighs 110 stones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551809622837305485)
- **loadout unlock cost**: The loadout unlock costs 4.5 million gold for 6 profiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539500452057190)
- **locked chest antiquities and rare dyes**: Chest antiquities are among the coolest finds in locked chests, and the most valuable find is a double proc on a rare lustrous or powder hair dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553261865188982786)
- **lockpick chest dye drops**: The most valuable drop from dungeon lockpick chests is probably a lustrous or powder dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544554338922405948)
- **lockpick chest shoes with rare cloth**: Shoes from lockpick chests can carry 6 of a rare cloth, which may make them a valuable drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544556564411588648)
- **lore page trading volume**: Lore page trading on the Portal dropped from many trades per day to a couple after the treasure map patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537108351014666480)
- **lower-level ingot prices**: Lower-level ingot prices have likely dropped since the resource map change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544096362755395585)
- **lumberjacking income source**: Higher Lumberjacking skill does not directly mean more money; the profit is in selling normal colored boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544398921101480029)
- **magic spellbook damage and vendor availability**: A magic spellbook may also increase spell damage, and Magic Spellbooks and crafting codexes can be found on player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549649089719963689)
- **magic weapon vendors**: Weapons with magical modifiers are sold by player vendors rather than NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549613152994467851)
- **maps in pilfer and mugging loot**: Maps are in the loot pool as a potential drop from pilfering or mugging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550103253197398147)
- **mastery chain link sources**: Mastery chain links come from buying them from players (most reliable early on), society jobs, and advanced or guild-level activities such as T8 treasure maps and omni bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655024242491425)
- **material price spikes**: Prices of a material spike during weeks when that material has a highly profitable society job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548176792391778328)
- **meta pet farming value**: A current meta pet with extremely good stats can be worth millions of gold, and some players farm them to earn serious gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666249248284865)
- **missing bank check after double-click**: If a bank check seems to vanish after double-clicking it and the balance does not change, re-open the bag or bank box to refresh the displayed contents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544414869175144498)
- **monster gold scaling**: Gold earned from monsters scales with mob difficulty, so fight the hardest mobs you can handle without taking too long, about a minute or less per monster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549178908262400136)
- **monster hunter society point spending**: The best uses of monster hunter society points are gold reforges for quick cash, or strongbox deeds or gold links if you can wait for better value per point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588125880000515)
- **monster-dropped gems uses**: Gems dropped by monsters can be sold to jewelers or players, and can be used to train Tinkering, which saves a lot of ingots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033101847040063)
- **mount token tradeability**: All mount tokens are believed to be tradeable, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547418171047149649)
- **multiboxing lumberjack income**: This season's best multiboxing lumberjack averages about 14 board commodities per day, which works out to less than 200k gold per hour of play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527348890591039488)
- **multiboxing treasure map digging**: Multiboxing treasure map digging was never removed on Outlands, but few players do it because it is not worth it; the most gold has historically come from running a single treasure mapper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525570714193756242)
- **nightshade stock at npc vendors**: Nightshade may be sold out at NPC vendors because players burn through reagents, while Smugglers always have stock at higher prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552336865087062102)
- **npc butcher sell batch size**: Selling to an NPC butcher sells 50 pieces per sell action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546343029126725652)
- **npc vendor gear quality**: NPC vendor gear is poor quality and not cheap, so players should avoid buying it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331064380063795)
- **npc vendor meat purchases**: NPC vendors will not buy meat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553617284008902747)
- **obtaining arcane essence**: Arcane essence can be obtained by picking dungeon chests, or by harvesting resources, selling them, and buying essence from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546470764402708521)
- **ocean farming versus treasure mapping returns**: Ocean farming yields more gold and experience than treasure mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900118969680142)
- **ocean fishing gold per hour**: Ocean fishing yields roughly 150k gold per hour for a character fresh off Shelter Island, about 200k per hour while raising fishing from 100 to 110, and 500k-750k per hour for end-game players fishing and rescuing castaways, with MiBs paying more; results vary with RNG and ocean familiarity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534240670171004978)
- **ore price fluctuation around king's fair**: Ore prices normally fluctuate around the King's Fair event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545880189605642381)
- **ossuary 3 lockpicking income**: A dungeon lockpicker can leave Ossuary 3 with roughly 40-50k gold plus loot and trash per run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554001294681964627)
- **outlandsmall price site**: Outlandsmall.com, the old player-run price site, is dead and has been replaced by the Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554009484781682830)
- **overworld gold farming**: Farming gold in the overworld is convenient because players can recall straight to their house to deposit gold and then return to repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536453779614863401)
- **paragon chest core rewards**: Paragon chests sometimes give a core, reportedly about 1k from a lesser, 2k from a regular, and 3k from a greater paragon chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545188691981500456)
- **pawnbroker item recovery**: The Pawnbroker NPC lets you get back lost items for a fee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547809468719435857)
- **per-item stack pricing limit**: Per-item pricing of a stack only works for stackable items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552240672038453258)
- **pet level and value**: A pet's level makes little difference to its value because buyers focus on its stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666061280551084)
- **plain leather price**: Plain leather has sold for around 10k gold per 5k commodity, down from about 12k earlier, though prices fluctuate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525678490035159133)
- **player vendor commodity prices**: Commodities such as reagents cost about 2k more per 5000 regs on player vendors than from NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554553732681826318)
- **player vendor portal sync**: Player vendor listings are automatically synced to the Outlands portal website. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545128111887360131)
- **player vendor purchase history and stealth**: Player vendors in Ultima Online: Outlands do not appear to provide a purchase history showing who bought your items, and players stocking or buying from them should avoid staying visible near the vendors longer than necessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552463836756451370)
- **player vendor search for furniture**: Player-made furniture appears in the player vendor search under 'all items' rather than under the Furnishing tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554615688663146536)
- **player vendor send to bank option**: Players can buy gear from player vendors using a send to bank option, which delivers the purchased items to their bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331347512631306)
- **player vendor stack purchasing**: Player vendors are not set up to let you buy a single item out of a listed stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554276160530161807)
- **player vendor stock levels**: Many player vendors are nearly empty because many players run small vendors with only a couple of items, while a few malls are well stocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546324722726215761)
- **player vendors**: Players place vendors in their houses, stock them with items, and set prices manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551766174923100241)
- **player-crafted items sold to npcs**: The player-crafted items that are sold to NPCs are items crafted with gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098331235024917)
- **player-made exceptional armor price**: A full set of player-made exceptional armor costs about 500 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331219116462140)
- **popular materials vendor display**: The vendor's display has a 'Popular Materials' section at the top listing all materials and how many society jobs use each this week, but it does not distinguish highly profitable jobs from poor ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548181124931653632)
- **portal vendor listings**: The Portal lists an item as soon as someone places it on a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554009684501856297)
- **portal website vendor prices**: The portal website portal.uooutlands.com lists vendor prices and items, which can be used to estimate item prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544653553342218260)
- **posting in sell channel**: To post in the Discord sell channel, link your Discord account in your Portal account settings, and always meet buyers or sellers in Shelter for trades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554009333958844458)
- **potion stacking on vendors**: Potions no longer need to be placed in kegs for sale on player vendors, because many potions fit in a single stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551042692836753470)
- **powdered hair dye drop value**: A powdered hair dye dropped from a lockpick chest has sold for roughly 4 million gold in one reported case, where a guild mate double-procced the drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544558535663423498)
- **premade veterinary supplies price**: A stack of about 30k veterinary supplies can be bought premade for roughly 10-15k gold, which is quicker than crafting them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974702095605833)
- **prevalia coins and cosmetic clothing**: Prevalia coins can be bought with real money, and cosmetic blessed clothing can also be earned with in-game gold over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550990768091561991)
- **prevalian merchant event rotation**: The Prevalian Merchant's stock changes with each event, and limited edition items sold there will not return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413696242090025)
- **prevalian merchant inventory**: The Prevalian Merchant sells a wide range of items that can be purchased with Prevalian (donation) coins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413583675363430)
- **price check channel purpose**: The price check tab/channel is intended for rare items that cannot be found on the vendor portal site. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553532714617929729)
- **profit from selling crafted gear**: Crafting gear and selling it yields almost no profit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846491048972479)
- **protecting smuggler purchases with magery**: A character with 100 Magery and the Invisibility spell can use it before buying from a smuggler to avoid theft, without needing a dedicated runner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553738161815953480)
- **rare dungeon hue items**: Rare dungeon hue items such as the blue drum are mostly bought for house decoration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546506259455283263)
- **raw rib bulk sales**: Raw ribs can be sold in bulk; about 2 million raw ribs reportedly sold for roughly 4 million gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525680159238389850)
- **reagent commodity prices**: Smugglers sell reagent commodities for 20k, while the raw price from magicians and alchemists is 15k, so player vendors selling near that range are pricing fairly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552343322255958141)
- **recycling drops into arcane essence**: Drops such as those from Prevalia sewers are generally better recycled into arcane essence, which is needed to fuel an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553524825832820766)
- **reforge market prices**: Reforge market prices are currently down because supply outweighs demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588305828085871)
- **reforge tool value versus links**: Reforge tools can sometimes be worth more than the link a player actually wants, so it can be cheaper to sell the reforge tool and the link you have and buy the desired link directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656421038002248)
- **reforges as society reward**: Reforges are among the highest valued items purchasable with society currency and are commonly sold by players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544304585341014026)
- **regular poison availability**: Regular poison potions are player made and cannot be bought from NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549873848084860972)
- **remote vendor gold management**: A player can monitor, deposit and withdraw gold for their vendors from anywhere without being at the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464010795028622)
- **renting a vendor via a rental contract**: To rent a vendor, walk into the house and double-click the rental contract, which looks like a bundle of 3 scrolls and shows the weekly or monthly price set by the house owner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550810626518028339)
- **repair kit player price**: Players sell repair kits for about 8gp each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991744800784385)
- **resource map completion rate**: Resource map completion fell after a patch from about 3,000 maps per day, mostly by 2 players, to almost 600 per day, mostly by 4 players; a handful of players can do at most about 18 maps per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544060865907658823)
- **resource map cost versus profit**: Resource maps must be purchased, so map harvesting profit is reported to be lower than regular harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529895528022802504)
- **resource map drop rate control**: Staff can control the supply of resource maps by lowering their drop rate, since every created map is eventually completed by someone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528230317926912041)
- **resource map leaderboard page count**: The resource map leaderboard had 192 pages last season and has 193 pages this season with 30 days remaining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544118428929892433)
- **resource map profitability**: Most low and medium color resource maps yield only about 1-2k profit each, while the highest color maps still have decent margins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535327020496724048)
- **resource mapping profitability**: Resource mapping reportedly yields less profit per hour than a single-client lumberjack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531440782764933151)
- **reveal scroll price**: Reveal scrolls cost 500 gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550411881641152585)
- **safe player trading location**: Trade with other players only on Shelter Island, and sell goods through the sell Discord or a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545121820641075353)
- **safe vendor restocking via inn**: To restock a vendor safely, store the goods to sell in the inn, recall out from within the inn directly onto the vendor, hide, and then restock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545126908092485802)
- **scavenger build nerf**: The scavenger build was reportedly nerfed heavily in the most recent patch, with players saying gold disappears every minute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545962211485159496)
- **scavenger income rate**: A scavenger in an active dungeon during USA daytime can earn roughly 15-20k gold plus 5k+ leather and other loot every 30 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554365675517124649)
- **scroll cost versus reagents**: Spell scrolls for spells needing more than two reagents are generally cheaper than buying the reagents for those spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549194587149701181)
- **sell discord post format**: Posts in the sell Discord must start with WTS, otherwise the post is removed and the poster must wait about a day before reposting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545123043897249884)
- **selling and recycling empty spellbooks**: Empty spellbooks cannot be sold to NPCs but can be recycled normally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549469916199919700)
- **selling colored ingots**: It is better to wait until you have your own player vendor before selling colored ingots, to avoid dealing with many buyers who each want a small amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544715174341116056)
- **selling colored lumber and ingots**: Selling colored lumber and ingots in stacks is likely better than in commodity deeds, because buyers more often want a smaller quantity than a full commodity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548162064479162522)
- **selling colored materials for society jobs**: To maximize profit, sell colored materials in stacks, and sell a given color only during weeks when that material has a highly profitable society job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548176792391778328)
- **selling drops to npcs**: The only drops worth selling are gems sold to a jeweler, and only in the early game, since players later buy gems in bulk at a higher price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098242772836406)
- **selling gathered resources**: Resources like iron can be sold through a hired NPC vendor or in the trading channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602945824198660)
- **selling goods to players**: Goods can be sold to players via the market channels in Discord, by PMing players (who usually lowball), or by renting a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549828696167419965)
- **selling ingots in trading channel**: To sell ingots, log into the Portal, link your Discord account, then post in the trading channel; iron ingots are sold in 5k lots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549595625002115084)
- **selling items to npc vendors**: Items are usually not worth selling to NPC vendors, with gems being the main exception, and players pay more for gems in bulk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547975452457705633)
- **selling jeweled beads to npcs**: Beads made while training Tinkering can be sold to a jeweler NPC, and they are likely the main item sold to NPCs during skill training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098141182468107)
- **selling leather to npc vendors**: Selling leather to NPC vendors at 1gp each is a poor deal; filling a 5,000-leather commodity and selling it to a player is better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827176264638586)
- **selling society points**: Players selling society points state how many they have, the buyer asks for a specific item, and the price is worked out from that item's value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549032130904858637)
- **send to bank cost**: The Send to bank feature is currently very cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542662661706088588)
- **sending vendor purchases to bank**: Items bought from vendors should be sent to the bank, because vendor thieves camp vendors and steal purchased items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547521246571528243)
- **sharing gold between characters via bank checks**: To share gold between characters, say the keyword 'balance' at the bank to write a check; checks over 5k pull from your other characters on the same account if the current character lacks enough gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549832970179969177)
- **shelter island dungeon chest lockpicking income**: A newbie character with Lockpicking can earn gold by picking chests in the Shelter Island dungeon, reportedly 100 gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667854444535839)
- **ship deeds and dockmaster system**: Ship deeds go into the dockmaster system and can no longer be sold on standard player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549238241763270667)
- **skeletal dragon from creature broker**: Skeletal dragons can be obtained from the creature broker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486623730180167)
- **skill scroll handling**: Skill scrolls are sold to other players rather than recycled, and junk scrolls that sell for under 7k should be saved for echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552971649333338143)
- **skinner income sources**: Skinning leather is nearly free money, but most skinners earn more from the gold other players leave on corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525689668497178756)
- **small caravan cost versus inn room**: A small caravan costs multiple millions of gold, which would pay for the biggest inn room for years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544447437316423733)
- **smuggler arrow purchases**: Smugglers sell unlimited arrows at a slightly increased price, but you must buy at least about 500 at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552076109699350559)
- **smuggler runner protection**: A smuggler runner character with detect hidden, tracking and invisibility can protect bulk purchases worth roughly 100-400k from being stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553738083042857091)
- **societies optimiser tool**: The website outlandsbutler.com/societiesoptimiser can be used to decide whether spending arcane scrolls on the inscription society is worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547706675924832397)
- **society link acquisition strategy**: When doing society jobs for links, it is typically best to take gold links or gold reforge tools, sell them, and then buy the specific links you need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655024242491425)
- **society point accumulation time**: It takes a while to save up enough society points to turn them into good gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547991305634840627)
- **society point upgrade payback**: The society point upgrade requires 120 skill in crafts such as tailoring and alchemy, and with several 120 crafting skills on one character it pays for itself in about 10-12 weeks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546354074343964723)
- **society points profit calculation**: The society points profit calculation is based on the per-point amount the player sets, and the Resource Costs can be updated if they are inaccurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547748322553626716)
