- **society points tradability**: Society points are account bound, but they can be spent to redeem an item that can then be sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550999224332853249)
- **solo harvester income**: A solo harvester earns roughly 200k gold per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527357995799941241)
- **solo tier 8 treasure map profitability**: Soloing tier 8 treasure maps is regarded as the most lucrative treasure map activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528244402206806066)
- **special fishing net profitability**: Without a high-level harvest aspect, 20 special/rare loot links, a full-tidings boat setup and 220+ effective fishing skill, selling special fishing nets is more profitable than running the MiBs yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212813086326865)
- **special fishing net sale price**: Special fishing nets sell for about 8k gold each in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394579688656979)
- **special fishing net yield rate**: Fishing yields roughly 25-50 special fishing nets per hour, depending on luck and competition from other fishers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394579688656979)
- **splitting a check**: To split a check, make a new check from the existing one at the bank, or use a checkbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553950791637794817)
- **spyglass requirement on resource maps**: The overhaul removes the spyglass requirement on resource maps, which removes an ingot sink from the economy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **stars carpet pricing**: The stars carpet is not listed on the Infinity Market wiki page and costs 5 infinity coins per tile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200115387211888)
- **starter crafter money-making approach**: Smith, tinker and carpentry crafting are expensive to train, so a crafter with tailoring, alchemy, inscription and mage can instead save society points to buy items such as gold links to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555706450498691156)
- **starter fishing boat cost**: A cheap small or medium fishing boat can be started with for under 100k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **stealth chest picking income**: Picking dungeon chests while stealthed is decent passive income, comparable to backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546172996631396383)
- **straight gold farming locations**: Players who want straight gold can farm the challenger dungeon or the weekly gold bonus dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552120632471195779)
- **strongbox enchantment for dungeon farming**: The strongbox enchantment is recommended for dungeon farming because gold weight otherwise forces players to leave dungeons after about 10 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213891156476067)
- **strongbox payoff time**: A strongbox can take a lot of volume over months to pay off its cost, so players without time to grind may do better spending society points on quality-of-life, aspect, links or expanded society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553578899399778305)
- **strongbox versus echo cooldown enchantment**: The strongbox enchantment suits players who farm with the same echo for long periods, while the echo cooldown enchantment suits players who switch roles often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213278138110166)
- **suggested purchase order for upgrades**: One suggested purchase order is to raise aspect to about tier 13-15 first, then buy the storage shelf, then the resource stockpile, and only then the strongbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546363510156562523)
- **t1 and t2 resource map profitability**: Running T1/T2 resource maps is expected to require 2 explorer packs, with raw material costs of about 100gp versus 3-4x that on the portal, making them less profitable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531108214068875435)
- **t1 and t2 treasure map value**: T1 treasure maps are rarely run and are mostly forced into bundles, while T2 maps are common, cheap, have a good loot pool and give a good yield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531108314577113128)
- **t3 map profitability by fortune or harvest**: Running a T3 map on fortune gold covers the map cost each run; on harvest it costs a few thousand gold less than covering it, or breaks even on procs, and all loot is extra. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530990228439957545)
- **t3 treasure map price**: T3 treasure maps sold for about 18k each in October and have since fallen to about 11-12k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107696818913340)
- **t8 treasure map lore page cost**: A T8 treasure map typically requires roughly 300-350k worth of lore pages to create. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **tailor npc robes**: Robes can be bought repeatedly from the tailor NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550989701534720056)
- **tailoring society job profitability**: Tailoring society jobs are usually the most profitable, but there are typically only about 5 per week, so players fill the rest with alchemy and inscription jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547992353632026764)
- **tamer pvm money maker**: A tamer with 120 Camping and 120 Forensic Evaluation is a good PvM money maker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546233266682593451)
- **thief camping of aspect triumph vendors**: Thieves camp popular player vendors selling Aspect Triumphs and steal the item from buyers who do not use the send-to-bank option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553035826898804817)
- **thieves codex sale price**: Thieves codices sell for around 40K gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550392828226572301)
- **third echo customisation cost**: The third echo customisation costs 5 million. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527535022377144422)
- **tier 4 treasure map gold yield**: A tier 4 treasure map chest yields about 16k gold, plus roughly 20-22k gold from mobs, when using Fortune with a gold/doubloon chain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538221055049601195)
- **time dungeon carpet hues**: Time Dungeon carpet hues are obtainable only from the Infinity Coin vendor; the dyes do not drop in the dungeon, but infinity coins drop randomly there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200860987654175)
- **top ingot consumers after resource map change**: Some of the top ingot consumers on the server left after the resource map change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544104182980812862)
- **top tier fishing boat cost and income**: A top tier, fully upgraded fishing boat costs roughly 3-4 million gold and reportedly earns about 500k gold per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **trade channel post format**: In the trade channels, posts must start with WTS in the sell channel and with WTB in the buy channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552756016779632662)
- **trade meeting location**: Trades are done by meeting in Shelter, and the Portal shows the current gold price of 5k iron. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549595831680630827)
- **trading from shelter island**: To trade from Shelter Island, post in the trade channel, wait for a DM, meet in Shelter, check the Portal for prices, and link your Discord account so you can post in the sell channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546790722764546078)
- **traditional redline region cost**: Traditional Redline regions cost 5,000,000 gold plus 1,000,000 gold per tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525944824052715660)
- **trapper build cost**: A trapper build is expensive to make, costing lots of gold or many gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550079786813231167)
- **trapper skill nerf**: The trapper skill was recently nerfed heavily, and gadget core prices crashed as a result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536276742015033494)
- **treasure map change impact on tier 8**: The treasure map change mainly hurts players soloing tier 8 treasure maps, which are an outlier in profitability and are being nerfed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900367482060882)
- **treasure map extra item value**: Extra items from treasure maps, such as aspect cores, count as profit on top of the raw gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552119308111315005)
- **treasure map gold and xp rates**: Since the changes, a skilled mapper burns about 25 T3 maps per hour (the average player about 15), with each T3 map grossing roughly 55-60k gold, for about 775k net per hour for skilled players and roughly 500k per hour for average players, while XP has dropped to about 250k per hour for 25 T3 maps and 300k per hour for 25 T4 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525625855139774474)
- **treasure map income modifiers**: Treasure map income is further increased by the T16 harvest aspect and 22 special loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525625789327085578)
- **treasure maps and boating gold farming**: Treasure maps and boating are considered very good methods of farming gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547647851352424581)
- **undecoded resource map prices**: Undecoded resource maps are expected to drop to around 25k each after the patch, though prices usually swing before the market stabilizes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528614296899162242)
- **unregistered antiquity items**: An item marked 'Unregistered', such as a Woodsman Axe, is worth more left unregistered than if it is registered as an antiquity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533347311365918812)
- **used grimoire trading**: Grimoires can still be bought and sold after they have been used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553593529337512071)
- **value of lucky identified drops**: Lucky identified drops can be valuable: vanquishing maces are in demand for backstab templates and crooks are rare, so both can be worth keeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553524903678840943)
- **vendor command**: Type the [vendor command to manage your vendor and collect its gold from anywhere, without having to visit the vendor in person. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298261873364993)
- **vendor listing search delay**: There is likely a cooldown between placing an item on a vendor and it appearing in the Outlands website item search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553803982965837936)
- **vendor price confirmation**: When setting prices on a vendor, click the blue button to confirm the price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551972519320231958)
- **vendor purchases paying from bank**: Almost every vendor purchase pulls gold from the bank, so gold or checks should be kept in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768560865087742)
- **vendor restocking safety**: Restocking a vendor is not safe in general, but it can be made fairly safe with preparation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545126908092485802)
- **vendor send-to-bank cost**: Sending an item bought from a player vendor to your bank costs 25K gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553037411775414303)
- **vendors command access via help gump**: The [vendors command can also be reached through the Help gump, on its bottom row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464460738859019)
- **vendors command remote monitoring**: Use the [vendors command to monitor your player vendors without being at the vendor location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552463887159529565)
- **viable money-making characters**: Viable money-making characters include a miner, a lumberjack, a miner/lumberjack, a PvM character, a dungeon chest picker with skinning, or a scavenger who skins mob corpses without picking chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555707269382017095)
- **water aspect kit cost**: A water aspect kit costs about 20k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549344292827439125)
- **weekly city bonus npc discount**: The weekly city bonus makes items bought from NPCs in that town cost a little less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161913347440792)
- **weekly gold reward scarcity adjustment**: Weekly gold rewards appear to be adjusted by a scarcity percentage, e.g. a 150k legendary base shows about 160,500 and a 10k rare base shows 11,400. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546412596125769738)
- **weekly society resource consumption**: Resources such as boards are consumed weekly through society jobs, so they sell reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553990939251318805)
- **weekly vendor rebate town**: The weekly vendor rebate town discounts only buying from vendors, not selling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549253826345836697)
- **where to buy runes**: Runes can be bought from mage shops and possibly from provisioners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546860226899349685)
- **wilderness recall farming income**: Wilderness recall farming yields over 300k XP per hour and roughly 300k gold per hour plus items, comparable in gold per hour and loot to treasure mapping if you know the spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529899971355213824)
- **writing a check with the check keyword**: Saying 'check <amount>' at the bank also writes a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549833334878769353)

## Housing & storage

- **storage shelf loadout renaming**: To name an individual Storage Shelf Loadout, use the Rename button in the loadout interface. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **storage shelf loadout switching**: To switch Storage Shelf Loadouts, use the Loadout Up/Down Arrow buttons or select a specific Loadout directly. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **storage shelf loadouts section**: The Storage Shelf menu has a dedicated Loadouts section where players manage Storage Shelf Loadouts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **interior decorator tool**: The Interior Decorator tool costs about 500 gold from an Architect NPC and lets you survey, lock down, secure, release, rotate and reposition items in your home. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555149846518702173)
- **adding inn room co-owners**: To add a character from another account as an inn room co-owner, bring them to the same innkeeper or room location as the owning character; the owner says 'room', chooses add in the menu, and targets the character. Friend status alone does not grant access, even for your own characters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548622308162146355)
- **bank theft risk and inn rooms**: Thieves can steal items kept in the bank, so valuables should be kept secured in an inn room and the bank used only when necessary. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553773195847278724)
- **changing inn rooms**: To change to a bigger inn room, double-click the door, choose End Rent, then pick Moving Crate so the innkeeper holds your packed belongings; rent the new room, go inside, double-click the door to get the crate back, then unpack and sort, lock down or secure items again (about 5 minutes). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607991553003602)
- **commodity weight**: One commodity weighs 1 stone, so 5,000 plain leather stored as commodities weighs 125 stones, while plain leather not stored as commodities is heavier than the equivalent gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553997248025858052)
- **storage shelf bag restock**: To make a storage shelf take bags, put the bag in a container, select restock, and target the container; the shelf takes empty bags and NPC bags. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550991822640382093)
- **storage shelf loadouts**: A storage shelf saves lockdowns with a loadout function, and items in it do not count against the room's lockdown capacity; it has one loadout by default and more are purchased as customization unlocks. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539221329518665)
- **strongbox customization deed sources**: A strongbox customization deed can be obtained through achievements, society jobs, faction silver, or by buying one from a player for roughly 2.3 million gold; society jobs take several weeks of points, with tailoring and alchemy typically the cheapest to start. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547641522772648067)
- **adding items to a storage shelf**: Most single items can be added to a Storage Shelf by dropping them onto it, provided the item is fully repaired, armor and weapons are exceptionally crafted, and the shepherd's crook is deactivated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103049776439467)
- **additional storage loadouts**: Additional loadouts for the storage shelf are bought as upgrades in the [customizations menu (check the next page for more); they are expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547461982024765511)
- **boat blessed status**: A boat is blessed before you register it but is no longer blessed after registering. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549421966178652223)
- **chest secure efficiency**: Items can be placed in a chest that is secured so that only 1 secure is used, and the storage shelf can be locked down without using a secure. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043355121983609)
- **first storage quality-of-life purchases**: The Storage Shelf, Resource Stockpile, Magic Item Recycler and Magic Item Vault are the recommended first storage quality-of-life purchases, with Storage Tomes, Bank Vault, Checkbook and Garden Shelf also useful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554935502048723045)
- **getting a house as a new player**: New players can get a house by buying from another player, winning a lottery, or waiting for a land expansion, where players who have never owned a house have increased odds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550982024863555656)
- **house ban bots**: Many players and some public houses run a ban bot that bans criminal-flagged or red players from the house, keeping players who are training safe. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552587481260757013)
- **house door access without key**: To let only chosen people open or enter a house door without a key, unlock the door with the key first, then set the door's permissions as for shelves and chests without clicking apply to all; afterward the key is not needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555722165918113873)
- **increasing inn rental room size**: To get a larger inn rental room, cancel the current room and rent a new, larger one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545552937797812335)
- **inn floor item decay time**: An unsecured item thrown on the floor of an inn lasts 1 hour before disappearing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547809097246711849)
- **inn rental system**: UO Outlands has an inn rental system that lets players rent rooms. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379098387611669)
- **inn room co-ownership**: Characters on the same account that rented an inn room are automatically co-owners, while characters on other accounts must each be individually added as co-owners; adding one character per account is not enough. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544107334580576437)
- **inn room cost comparison**: A medium inn room (7500/week) plus one extra secure (2500) costs the same as a large room with 4 secures (10000/week), but the medium room can later expand by another 2 secures. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043276696887337)
- **inn room gold drop-off and setup**: Gold dropped off in an inn room must be moved to the bank through many separate drops, and a fully set up inn room can hold a shelf, repair bench, tomes and a bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550500217248555009)
- **inn room rental cost**: Inn rooms cost 2,500 gold per week per secure, so a small room with 2 secures costs 5,000 gold per week, and secures can be expanded up to double the starting amount, for example 4 secures at 10,000 gold per week. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043059935256630)
- **inn room style by town**: The style of a rental inn room depends on the town where it is rented, though not every town has a unique style. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607414974750833)
- **item decay and pawn broker**: Items on the ground that are not locked down or in a secure container decay after 1 hour, and some decayed items can be recovered from the Pawn Broker NPC in Prevalia, southeast of the main bank, though not all appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550045644293537824)
- **item decay in homes**: Items on the ground in your home or inn room that are not locked down or in a secure container decay after 1 hour; decayed items may be recoverable at the Pawn Broker in Prevalia, though not all appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **magic recycler availability**: Most guilds have at least one magic item recycler in their guildhouse for members to use, and many players also own one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655680086671361)
- **missing crates**: Dropping one crate on top of another can make it appear that a crate is missing because items can get placed inside other crates, so check inside nearby crates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555148332207448087)
- **moving items from bank to inn**: To move items from the bank to an inn room safely, load a trapped pouch or bag (ideally nested in another container) while it is in the bank box, loot or carry it out as a whole, then go to the inn, or run a screen away and recall, to avoid thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555625185120493692)
- **moving to a new rental room**: To move rooms, go inside the old room, double click the door, click End Rent, and click Moving Crate to pack everything into boxes; then rent the new room, go inside, and double click the door to get your items back, then lock down or secure them again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554423647827922995)
- **pawn broker recovery of decayed items**: The Pawn Broker in Prevalia can return items that decayed in your house or inn, though not all decayed items appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **pit trial table on test server**: To use the pit trial table on the test server, lock it down by first renting an inn room or placing a house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553475941995388989)
- **player vendor rental price**: You can rent a vendor spot in another player's home, typically for about 2500-6000 gold per week (roughly 3-6k, with 2.5-5k cited as a good price). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503818484817990)
- **qol items wiki category**: The Outlands wiki has a QoL category listing an extensive set of Quality of Life items for use on your person and for storage in an inn room or house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553094305780994200)
- **qol storage items**: QoL storage items such as the Storage Shelf are containers that technically hold well over the 125-item container limit and greatly increase available storage space. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092837325799445)
- **real estate broker house prices**: Buying even the smallest house from the real estate broker costs multiple million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544446902467035259)
- **resource stockpile contents**: The Resource Stockpile stores ingots and nearly every other crafting resource, and vendor-bought harvesting tools can also be placed into it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550997381028384890)
- **resource stockpile contents**: The contents of a resource stockpile are specific to that individual stockpile and are not shared between stockpiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552785978362437764)
- **resource stockpile placement**: The Resource Stockpile must be locked down in a house, and it cannot be kept in a bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551584743689158737)
- **safe bank withdrawal**: To avoid theft when withdrawing from the bank, put an empty container in the bank, put a trapped pouch inside it, drop the items to transfer into the pouch, move the outer container to your backpack, and run fast to your inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175538236334180)
- **secure versus lock down**: A secure container automatically uses 125 lockdown spaces but lets items move freely in and out, while a locked down normal container does not use 125 slots and auto-locks dropped items, so it suits rarely accessed items; items must be locked down or secured to avoid decay. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554620004417282089)
- **securing and locking down items**: To secure a container say "I wish to secure this", and to lock an item down say "I wish to lock this down"; both prevent decay in a rented room or home. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553488014674632768)
- **selling registered ships**: A registered ship can be sold without unregistering it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550993287739998430)
- **storage shelf and resource stockpile purpose**: The storage shelf and resource stockpile are personal items: the shelf holds loadout items and the stockpile holds crafting resources, whereas recyclers are shared and can be used wherever found. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550389647954149437)
- **storage shelf armor and weapon quality**: Armor and weapons added to a Storage Shelf must be exceptionally crafted; master crafted items are not accepted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103125857050776)
- **storage shelf aspected items**: Disabling the 'Keep Aspect Items' option should allow aspected items from your inventory to be put back into the storage shelf, provided they are fully repaired; an option on the shelf may otherwise prevent it from accepting aspected items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103859550003220)
- **survey tool house fit check**: If the survey tool says a house can fit, then in theory the spot is valid for placing that house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544205935571107850)
- **tome blessing**: Skill mastery scroll tomes and other tomes cannot be blessed, except runebooks and runetomes, so they are only for bank, room or house storage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550599555211333776)
- **upcoming land expansion**: Another land expansion is reportedly planned with no confirmed date, which would open up more housing room and may bring a land rush where houses cost only the deed price. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546506266103390259)
- **vendor rental malls**: Several malls exist where players can rent a vendor spot, and gate bots near the Shelter Island moongate and Prev bank often advertise rental spots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551991037977952368)
- **vendor spot rental without land**: Players without land can rent a vendor spot in another player's house or ask their guild whether it has a vendor house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549257885006172192)
- **adding containers to storage shelf**: To add containers to a Storage Shelf, place them inside another container and target that outer container, because targeting or dropping a container directly onto the shelf empties it instead of adding it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103276193615994)
- **attacks inside public houses**: A player can be attacked inside a publicly accessible house, though some houses use scripts to ban troublemakers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461361093550231)
- **auto-stacking items via container**: To auto-stack items, drop them onto the container holding the stack rather than onto the stack itself; in the bank, place a container in the bank, since you cannot drop onto the main bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553964525059842149)
- **available tomes**: Tomes exist for treasure maps, lumber maps, ore maps, fishing maps, skinning maps, skill scrolls, rare cloth (which also holds aspect cloth), dyes, and ship upgrades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549651305855844385)
- **backpack item storage**: Players should avoid placing items directly in their backpack and instead use the inn room with organizers to place and retrieve items in trapped boxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175665382457407)
- **bag item capacity**: Bags in Ultima Online: Outlands can hold a maximum of 125 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238197853786122)
- **balcony attack risk in private houses**: In a private house you can be attacked if you stand too close to a balcony or terrace edge, because players outside can throw explosive potions at you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552488863958704160)
- **banning people from a house with a vendor**: A player who has a vendor in a house can probably ban people from that house, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461885742383165)
- **battle trainer house deed vendor**: The house Battle Trainer deed is sold by a Prevalian Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545521119048630354)
- **battle trainer on test shard**: On the test shard you can buy a house, place it, and buy the battle trainer from the Prevalia shop; the battle trainer can also be placed in an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824585579335721)
- **bed crafting costs**: Beds made through the carpenter's artisan furniture are very expensive to make, while tailor-made beds are considerably more affordable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614240004939878)
- **best inn rooms**: Horseshoe Bay is claimed to have the best inn rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294598472372264)
- **blessed runebook**: A blessed runebook stays with you if you die but is expensive, while an unblessed runebook can be kept locked down in your inn room to save money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546762240412356749)
- **board commodity deed capacity**: Board commodity deeds in Outlands hold 5,000 boards each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549029597125943309)
- **boat item management**: A boat must be taken off the dock master before items can be added to or removed from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549422557797683283)
- **buying from player vendors in guarded zones**: Items are supposed to be buyable from a player vendor placed in a guarded zone, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553892122422411361)
- **closed vendor contents**: When a player vendor is closed or dismissed, its items and gold are typically sent to the owner's bank, and no reports of lost gold are known. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553061099052728391)
- **closing a rental room**: Closing a rental room dumps everything into your bank, with items removed from their boxes and left loose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551096709273227345)
- **closing a rented room**: If you close a rented room without using the moving crate, all items go to your bank; the moving crate lets you move them to a room in a different town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552423806059155618)
- **co-owning other players' characters**: A player can co-own characters belonging to someone else's account, but this is risky because of theft and is not recommended in most circumstances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544107458195103744)
- **colored material commodity deed capacity**: Commodity deeds for colored materials in Outlands hold 2,500 units each, versus 5,000 for plain board deeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549043782719377430)
- **confirming vendor item price**: After entering a price in a player vendor's price field, click the gem next to the price field to confirm it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554133091369615381)
- **container capacity upgrades scope**: Increases to carry capacity or bank storage apply only to the base container (backpack or bank), not to containers inside it, so an individual pouch in your backpack still holds only 125 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092155587698709)
- **container item limit and carry capacity**: No container holds more than 125 items, and the Redline endgame system can increase carry capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553089035780497500)
- **decorating tool survey on close**: Use the survey on close option at the bottom of the decorating tool to confirm you did not forget to lock down anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554621181812801549)
- **decoration sources**: Much of the decoration in Outlands is sold by the Prevalia merchant, often as seasonal or limited-time items that sometimes return for sale again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614084627075097)
- **dyeing carpet tiles**: To dye a dyable carpet tile, keep it in your backpack and apply the dye twice; this is recalled from memory and may be inexact. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554593905310310461)
- **early housing purchases**: The magic item vault, resource stock and shelf are among the most worthwhile early purchases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550065341466542083)
- **entering vendor house hidden**: A player can enter a vendor house hidden even without using the hiding skill, so they can hide inside and restock the vendor while hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545126908092485802)
- **exiting inn room after death**: If you die inside your inn room, double-click the inn room door to exit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250301948960769)
- **expansion home placement lotteries**: Each new landmass expansion is followed by a month of daily lotteries that award players the right to place a home in the new area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544107276036481174)
- **extra loadout profiles**: Creating additional loadouts on the storage shelf requires unlocking extra profiles, found under Customisations for a price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550442195746562090)
- **finding houses for sale**: To find houses for sale, check the real estate channel or visit the Real Estate Vendor NPC in-game to see listings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **finding player houses for sale**: Talk to any house NPC in town to see all houses players have for sale, then travel to the location to inspect the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545699358471618600)
- **finding unlocked items after changing rental rooms**: To find items not locked down in a house after changing rental rooms, use the [survey command or a decorating tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551663850141651116)
- **fixing a malfunctioning recycler filter**: If the Magic Item Recycler filter seems to malfunction, unsecure the recycler and then place and secure it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544875706720347)
- **furniture default color reset item**: An item reportedly returns furniture to its default color, but it likely does not give back any dye colors previously used on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474781073154049)
- **furniture dye recovery**: A furniture dye is likely not recoverable once applied to a piece of furniture, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474781073154049)
- **garden shelf seed storage**: A garden shelf can hold seeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595499245703278)
- **gems in resource stockpile**: Gems are used in the Resource Stockpile furniture item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033536938705108)
- **giant castle secures**: A giant castle in Ultima Online: Outlands provides 80 secures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528241033576452269)
- **giving other accounts access to a rental room**: To give characters on another account access to a rental room, a character from the renting account must meet them at an innkeeper NPC and add them as friends or co-owners through the room gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553459466295447604)
- **guild bank deposit safe access**: A guild gives access to a bank deposit safe, which can also be bought by donating 25 prev coins, or possibly for about 500k gold if not going through prev. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550499751466901615)
- **guild hall eligibility**: Any house can be made a guild hall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552544224669335603)
- **guild house battle trainer**: If you are in a guild, there should be a battle trainer at the guild house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552589945347117117)
- **guild house witcher runes**: A guild house should have a set of Witcher runes available to guild members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623846729744395)
- **guild houses and ownership limit**: Normal guild houses count toward the house ownership limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143591693951106)
- **hair and beard dye storage**: All hair and beard dyes, including those labeled rare, go in the single dye tome; the name 'rare dye tome' is only a name, and opening the tome lists what can go in it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549650478575394848)
- **house agreement cancellation item handling**: When you cancel a house agreement, the items inside go to your bank, and shipping crates can be used to store items when moving or upgrading. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550889843590955060)
- **house chest access for friends**: A secured chest set to owner/co-owners only cannot be opened by a friend of the house; the owner can set a lower secure level or promote the friend to co-owner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554985461850841110)
- **house commands**: House commands include "I wish to lock this down", "I wish to secure this", "I wish to release this", "I ban thee", "Remove thyself", "I wish to place a trash barrel", and "[survey", which checks for items that can decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **house commands**: House commands include "I wish to lock this down", "I wish to secure this", "I wish to release this", "I ban thee", "Remove thyself", "I wish to place a trash barrel", and "[survey" (which checks for items that can decay). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487284714864705)
- **house container co-owner permissions**: A house container set to 'Co-owner' permissions cannot be opened by friends of the owner, so friend-level access needs a different permission setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554988547365408840)
- **house deed resale value**: A house deed can be sold back for roughly 90% of the price paid. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549082218125729825)
- **house lotteries**: UO Outlands holds house lotteries where players can buy tickets to potentially win homes that have been abandoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379100056817777)
- **house lottery entry per house**: Each house in the house lottery can be entered by buying a ticket for that specific house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544105815420567642)
- **house lottery ticket cap**: There is no cap on the number of tickets sold in a house ownership lottery; the total depends on how many players buy tickets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544346882409762916)
- **house lottery winning odds**: Getting close to a 50% chance of winning a house lottery would likely cost more in tickets than the house is worth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544357399941353544)
- **house lotto ticket**: The House Lotto lets a player place one ticket for 1000 gold for a chance to win a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544104899904798747)
- **house ownership limit and taxes**: A player can own up to 3 houses per Outlands ID, but taxes are paid on any house beyond the first, which is 1 per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143382222020650)
- **house patio line of sight risk**: Some patios and courtyards in player houses have line of sight from outside the house, so players can be attacked from outside while afk there; staying afk inside the house is safer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549523011760038001)
- **house placement availability and inn rooms**: Free spots to place a house are effectively impossible to find, and renting an inn room is almost equivalent to owning a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544205680049655858)
- **house queue and shipping crate expiry**: The house queue has no time limit, while items in shipping crates disappear forever after about 14 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550893644720906344)
- **house replacement window**: After you demolish a house to place a new one, there is a short window in which others cannot place a house on that spot unless they are you or in your party, but the protection is not absolute, so act quickly and carefully. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551619866908164210)
- **house sign ownership display**: House owners can choose whether to show their name or guild on the house sign, so ownership is not always visible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551649118492041270)
- **house storage chests crafting**: Chests for house storage are crafted by player Carpenters, who can be hired to make them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487227382792323)
- **house storage starter containers**: Any container (pouch, bag, or backpack) can be used to start storing items in a house, as long as you use the lock down or secure commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552060949890994329)
- **idoc lottery and inn rooms as housing options**: Players can obtain a house by winning the IDOC lottery, and the inn room system is another housing option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544447242017050695)
- **idoc lottery odds for new players**: Over roughly a month, about 60% of IDOC lotteries were won by the same group of people, so buying only 1-2 tickets is not a reliable way for a new player to get housing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544474515965218968)
- **inactivity and housing loss**: Accounts and characters are not deleted for inactivity, but housing is lost if the owner does not log in for 30 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554561281791492251)
- **inn rental rooms as housing alternative**: The inn rental room system serves as a housing alternative until a player can afford to buy a house from another player or wins an IDOC lotto or land expansion lotto. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549082435613098045)
- **inn room bank transfer limit**: Sending more than 125 items from a rental room to the bank places them in a bank queue, and carrying items back to the inn risks theft by thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545554393498128424)
- **inn room contract cancellation**: When an inn room contract is cancelled, all lockdowns in the room, including secured containers and the resource stockpile with its contents, are sent to the player's bank box by default, or to the moving crate if that option is set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554589673307902023)
- **inn room contract upgrade**: When ending an inn room contract to move to a bigger room, choosing the moving crates option moves your chests automatically; otherwise the items are deposited into your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282768266174627)
- **inn room eviction before storage shelf**: Before owning a storage shelf, being kicked out of your inn room can take hours to restore (about 3 hours each time for one player). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546363050028699649)
- **inn room render proximity**: Inn rooms are often placed near the edge of render distance of other players' inn rooms, so parts of neighboring rooms can sometimes be seen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545835804301987943)
- **inn room safety deposit box**: The safety deposit box in an inn room only allows sending gold, and nothing else, to the bank without visiting the bank in person. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768505143894140)
- **inn room secure limit**: An Inn room in Ultima Online: Outlands can have only 9 secures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238197853786122)
- **inn room sharing**: An inn room in Ultima Online: Outlands is shared with all characters on your main account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554235921598128209)
- **inn room storage**: A rented inn room provides storage for ingots and other resources in addition to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548845510805159988)
- **inn room storage of valuables**: Valuable items such as a sealed paragon chest can be taken to your inn room for safe storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549142802397659157)
- **inn room storage safety**: Items stored in an inn room are safe from loss when a house would decay (IDOC), unlike items in a regular house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544106085290475553)
- **inn room styles reference**: The Rental Room System wiki page shows the available inn room styles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607702565716054)
- **inn room tomes**: Inn room storage provides tomes for maps, skill scrolls, dye and rare cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974036585381909)
- **inn rooms location**: Inn rooms are located in the Malas facet, which is now basically a void that exists for inn rooms and has no traversable tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545835163731238912)
- **inn rooms versus houses**: Inn rooms are in many ways superior to houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553093088627662891)
- **items left on the ground**: Items left on the ground vanish after a while, so they must be locked down or secured to be kept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546577295706431569)
- **land expansion house lottery**: In the last land expansion, houses were awarded by lottery, and players who had never owned a house on any account had a much better chance of winning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550982378057371659)
- **land expansion placement passes**: Roughly every couple of years UO Outlands gets a large land expansion, and players who have never had a home are favored in the first 30 days to win a placement pass allowing them to place a house in the new area before it opens to everyone else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379296425869383)
- **larger room rentals**: No room rentals larger than the two-story inn room have been announced; that room was added roughly 1-2 years ago. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548440851435495487)
- **loadout needs without echoes**: A character without echoes should not need more than one loadout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550445951984992287)
- **lock box key storage**: A character with Tinkering gets a key when crafting a lock box; players carry a lock box while farming to store items, unlocking it with the key, moving items inside and locking it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555395441515040771)
- **locked chest protection from thieves**: After buying an item, put it in a locked chest before unhiding to protect it from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584395871326281)
- **locking down chests in rented rooms**: Chests in a rented room should be locked down, especially those holding valuable reagents, or their contents can be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544717966430445658)
- **looting corpse of player who died on roof**: Someone inside a house (public or private) with access to a corpse can probably loot the corpse of a player who died on the roof, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549524733899575487)
- **magic item chest**: A magic item chest that stores a practically unlimited number of items can eventually be obtained. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551258673832263864)
- **magic item vault**: A magic item vault can be bought to store unlimited magic items, but it is expensive for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **mah account house and skinning restrictions**: MAH accounts reportedly cannot own a house and cannot be used for skinning, for example on a boater or backstabber character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537962803107991562)
- **map tome add all in backpack**: The Add All In Backpack option on the map tome should work for adding maps to the new map tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536780735061565581)
- **moving crate for inn room to house transfer**: A moving crate makes it easier to transfer items from an inn room to a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550890428981837916)
- **moving crate option**: If the moving crate option is offered when closing a rental room, everything is collected into boxes in the crate instead of being dumped loose in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551098298717437983)
- **moving crates and resource stockpile**: Packing a rental room with moving crates keeps resource stockpile contents in place in the stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554380624679407697)
- **moving items between characters**: To move items between characters, get an inn room, invite the characters on your other accounts, and give them co-owner status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554235671613542451)
- **moving large stacks into containers**: If a large stack won't fit in a container, likely due to weight, put a small portion in the container first, then drop the rest of the stack onto the container itself to merge them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489195241316523)
- **moving tomes safely**: To move tomes between a rental room and the bank, put them in a lockbox, or at minimum in a trapped pouch inside a trapped pouch, to protect them from theft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545463033357148251)
- **open land for housing**: Finding open land to place a new house in Outlands is highly unlikely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **open land for new houses**: There is essentially no open land for new houses in UO Outlands, though a tiny chance exists to find a small spot for a caravan if a home was resized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379024681115770)
- **plant bowls in inn rooms**: Plant bowls must be locked down, but they can be placed in an inn room, so a house is not required to grow mushrooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555621147628937297)
- **player house locations**: Player houses can usually be found near the moongates of the cities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299877109604353)
- **player vendor creation cost**: Players can create their own vendor cheaply, reportedly around 3-8k gold per week, through an automated process that does not require contacting landlords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550620273932378215)
- **player vendor gold deposit**: Gold collected from a player vendor is deposited directly into the bank, not the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298402147401768)
- **player-made storage shelf for pvm loadouts**: A player-crafted storage shelf is handy for building PvM loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552037680500703315)
- **prevalian coin quality-of-life items**: The magic item recycler and the resource storage shelf are quality-of-life items that can be purchased with Prevalian Coins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413705989652700)
- **prevalian trunk and trophy hutch placement**: A prevalian trunk and trophy hutch may be placed with the other storage items in front of the Prevalia bank, as seen on the test shard, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554543642696220705)
- **pricing items in vendor containers**: To price items inside a container on a player vendor, check the "use pricing menu" box, mark the container itself as not for sale when placing it, then put items in the container and price each one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554133727905579180)
- **protecting items in a rented room**: To protect items in a rented room, secure a bag (container) so its contents don't decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615366848643083)
- **public houses with free item identification**: Some public houses, such as the riverside mall house, are set up to identify items for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553526655044030545)
- **public repair benches near butler services**: A player running a public butler service is likely, though not certain, to have a public repair bench nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552300380543787031)
- **reagent theft protection**: A locked chest can protect reagents from thieves, and reagents can still be used from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551111652550774866)
- **real estate agent npc**: A Real Estate Agent NPC lets a player view all houses currently for sale by other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544104514708054027)
- **real estate lottery information**: No winner or ticket count information is given for real estate lotteries, unlike other lotteries such as the Kingsfaire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550144898148073592)
- **real estate scarcity and inn rooms**: Real estate is a prized, limited resource in Outlands, and the inn room system is available as an alternative to owning a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554558822864003184)
- **recycle box placement requirement**: A recycle box must be locked down or secured in a house or inn room to function, and it does not work from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550041494583386164)
- **registered boat storage at shelter**: Place a registered boat on the Dock Master at the Shelter dock. Because it is not blessed, never leave Shelter with it in your backpack and never dry dock it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549421660900167833)
- **remote banking of items**: Items cannot be sent to the bank remotely; apart from gold, you must go to the bank and place them inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546432184666300486)
- **rental room access and exit location**: You can enter your rental room from any inn in the world but always exit in the town where you rented it; Prevalia has all the special NPCs, and the room style depends on the town rented in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546575994843045888)
- **rental room access for same-account characters**: All characters on the same account as the renter can use a rental room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550624519784497303)
- **rental room co-owners on same account**: All characters on the same account that rented a room are automatically co-owners of it, and rent can be pulled from their funds if the renting character's bank runs out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553459466295447604)
- **rental room duration**: A rental room has no time limit and stays as it is as long as the bank holds enough money to cover the rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547009460600307804)
- **rental room expansion**: A rental room cannot be expanded in size, but additional lockdowns can be added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551088402214944899)
