- **rental room floor size upgrade**: The floor size of a rental room cannot be upgraded in place; the player must terminate the rental and rent a new room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374482532114455)
- **rental room safety and storage**: Rental rooms have no thieves and offer more storage than a bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546576964784234576)
- **rental room system for new players**: New players seeking housing in Outlands are best served by using the Rental Room System. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **rental spot filter menu**: Press Shift+Ctrl to reopen the filter menu that helps find spots to rent if the small red menu has been closed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503818484817990)
- **rented room lapse handling**: If a player runs out of money for a rented room, the items are moved to the bank of the character that rented the room instead of decaying or being auctioned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550046153121202277)
- **rented room rent payment**: Rent for a rented room is pulled from other characters on the same account if the renting character's bank is empty; if all are empty, the rental ends and items move to the bank, or to a bank queue if the bank is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554932396003168429)
- **rented room sharing**: Rented rooms in Outlands can be shared with all characters across all of a player's accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550046153121202277)
- **rented room versus bank storage**: Players are advised to rent a room and avoid using the bank to store items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544718228226580572)
- **resource stockpile contents**: The Resource Stockpile stores crafting materials, arcane scrolls and MCDs, but does not store orbs or RMs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552293143494267062)
- **resource stockpile map storage**: The Resource Stockpile can hold blank maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550389883837747304)
- **resource stockpile usage**: Resource Stockpiles must be locked down in a house to be used, and only the house's Owners and Co-Owners can use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549789792319836211)
- **room sharing across account characters**: Characters on the same account share the same room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548627446545260627)
- **rotating placeable decorations**: Some placeable decorations can be rotated with an architect's tool, some have a context menu option to rotate, and some can be double-clicked to cycle through styles; this does not work for all items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552068478331002981)
- **safe house replacement**: To safely replace a house, bring trusted friends, use Tracking and Detect Hidden to confirm nobody is nearby, stay hidden while replacing, practice or script it on the test center first, and empty the house beforehand without replacing it right away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551621007876292720)
- **safe item for depositing currency**: A safe item placed in your inn room or house lets you deposit currency directly into your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768036753375294)
- **safely stocking a vendor in a house**: Hide while stocking your vendor; others could only track you with Detect Hidden and tracking set to include people in houses, and you can recall out if red players approach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461939580342273)
- **secure and lock down limits**: A house or inn room has a limited number of secures and lock downs, and the limits can be seen by interacting with the door or the house sign. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547323792282484746)
- **securing containers**: Securing a container uses up 125 lockdowns and lets you put items in and out without releasing it first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554620004417282089)
- **sending items to bank via distribution chest**: To send items to a character's bank via a Distribution Chest, add the receiving character to the chest, log that character out, then use an alt to send the loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546452611014594581)
- **sewing kits for storage shelf**: Sewing kits bought from an NPC cannot be added to a storage shelf; only exceptional-quality sewing kits can, which you must craft yourself or have made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544338504144781342)
- **sharing a supply shelf in a house**: To let friends use a supply shelf in a house, the owner says "I wish to secure this", targets the shelf, and then sets permissions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555710793343959202)
- **shelf item requirements**: The shelf only accepts exceptional-quality items, and items with uses, such as harvesting tools, must be at their maximum number of uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550996216119165119)
- **small house cost versus inn rent**: A small house costs about as much as renting an inn room for roughly 18 years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546238923724824637)
- **smart vendor houses**: Smart vendor houses block the entrance so vendors can restock safely, so buyers and anyone other than vendors and their stockers should not be inside the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464037915402373)
- **sources of bags, chests and tables**: Bags can be bought from the Provisioner NPC, and chests and tables can be bought from player shops; a fresh carpenter can also craft chests and tables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615515742248982)
- **starter container capacity**: A bag, backpack, or pouch works as a starting container and has the same item capacity as a chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487275004792925)
- **stolen lock box key**: If a thief steals the key to your lock box, you can go home and axe (destroy) the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555395564982640661)
- **storage advice for gold and loot**: Players are advised to keep gold in the bank and other loot in their inn room or house, keeping only restock loadouts in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546419673866702942)
- **storage capacity sources**: Bank storage is increased through customizations, inventory capacity is increased through the Camping skill, and the redline mastery also increases capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092311510945833)
- **storage furniture lockdown**: Many storage items such as the trophy hutch, prevalia trunk and wardrobe hold different item types and function when locked down, so many secures are rarely needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550044350703079456)
- **storage lockers**: Storage Lockers exist and can be crafted by carpenters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549788054946840608)
- **storage shelf container acceptance**: A storage shelf only accepts containers such as a wizard's satchel if the shelf is exceptionally crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088871086723214)
- **storage shelf keg capacity**: A Storage Shelf can hold empty kegs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552175253369651361)
- **storage shelf loadouts**: The Storage Shelf lets you keep loadouts so you can resupply yourself with a single click after a death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **storage shelf potion capacity**: A Storage Shelf only holds Greater and above potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549874282732200049)
- **storage shelf skins**: Storage shelf skins likely apply to the individual shelf item rather than the account and can be freely swapped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550175182382178405)
- **storing containers in storage shelf**: To store a container such as a wizard's satchel in a storage shelf, target an outer container that houses the satchel, because targeting the container directly tries to empty it instead of storing it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088871086723214)
- **storing cores at a store**: When storing cores at a store, bring them in small amounts rather than all at once if you fear being attacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552488863958704160)
- **storing spare mounts**: A spare non-bonded mount can be stored by visiting a stable keeper NPC and placing it in the stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544811601851449465)
- **strongbox 2 upgrade requirements**: Upgrading to Strongbox 2 requires two deeds, and Strongbox 1 and Strongbox 2 are separate customizations unlocked in the help/customizations page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554974296386969731)
- **strongbox customizations scope**: Strongbox customizations are claimed to apply to the whole account, though this is only asked as a question and is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550822258908467261)
- **survey command for decay**: The [survey command used in a room or house checks for any items that can potentially decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550045409974550561)
- **taking a break with a house**: Taking a break from the game while owning a house can be disastrous, whereas renting an inn room carries no such risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548441482560536718)
- **taking boat off dock master**: If you are in a guild with a dock master, you can take the boat off the dock master at the guild house or at any guild member's house that has a dock master. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549422465187323927)
- **tavern room rent**: Tavern room rent is charged weekly, and a first character starts with a rental room credits deed covering about 2 weeks of the small room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548434333398863923)
- **tome storage**: Tomes are mostly kept in a house or in the bank for storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545458901162659981)
- **transferring items between accounts**: To transfer items between accounts, rent a room and lock down a container in it so the other account can access it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548498116309946499)
- **transferring items between characters**: To transfer items between characters, rent a room at an inn and secure a container to the floor so another character can access it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546575649823653980)
- **trapped box storage of loot**: Loot is worth storing in a trapped box because it is light and easily stolen, while gold is heavy and not worth stealing, so gold should be left out of the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552746696381825165)
- **trash barrel for unwanted items**: A trash barrel can be used to dispose of unwanted items such as surplus maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529875026231169184)
- **unlocked house door with permissions**: A house door that is unlocked but has permissions set only lets the people you specified enter the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551370406277939211)
- **unmaintained house**: If a house is not maintained, it gets auctioned off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534848629743629)
- **unpaid inn room rent**: If you forget to pay rent on an inn room, your belongings go into a queue in your bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534792262230117)
- **upcoming land rush**: Another land rush is expected soon and is described as pretty chaotic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550146037170307134)
- **upgrading a rental room**: To upgrade a rental room, rent the larger floor, move into it, then close the old room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374770424942673)
- **vendor gold deposit and withdrawal**: You can deposit or withdraw vendor gold from anywhere without being at the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552991784915837049)
- **vendor house rent**: Houses with vendors are available for rent; double-clicking the locked down scroll at a vendor house shows its weekly rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867339701387308)
- **vendor house sale effects**: When a vendor house is sold, a courtyard rune is likely cleared by a clearing deed, and a warptile spot likely has its settings changed and must be set up again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546874934477987891)
- **vendor rental contracts on house floors**: Many houses have vendor rental contracts on the ground that let you rent a vendor for that spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550810522759331906)
- **vendor rental payment**: Vendor daily cost and weekly rental are not taken from your bank; you must deposit gold on the vendor gump, and vendor sales earnings also cover these costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552991300347891745)
- **vendor slot scrolls in houses**: Some houses have vendor-slot scrolls locked down on the floor; double-clicking one grants a vendor slot, and owners typically claim those scrolls themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546275153288368219)
- **viewing houses for sale via agent gump**: To see houses for sale, look for a button on the Real Estate Agent's gump, possibly at the bottom, rather than using the house deed purchase option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544104714495336670)
- **weight reduction bags**: Bags with weight reduction are reportedly limited to reagent and potion containers, with none for general loot, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551674607948267592)
- **wizard satchel add all**: Clicking the wizard satchel to add all moves reagents and scrolls from the backpack into the satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551918239527993365)

## Travel & locations

- **beekeeper npc locations**: Beekeeper NPCs are found in Andaria (Francisca, near the west entrance), Southreach (at the inn), Shelter Haven village, Horseshoe Bay (Carroll and Chet, south of the bank), Cambria (Jacques), Prevalia (Ananda), and Marcus at the Cathedral and Inn POI. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552445731632062601)
- **outlands map**: The Outlands map is completely new rather than the original Ultima Online map, with new places and town names. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547478724184772628)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons**: Prevalia Sewers, Urukton Bluffs (inside), Ratman Hovel and Shelter Island Dungeon are permanently sanctuary dungeons, and no criminal actions can be performed inside a sanctuary dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111460353777817)
- **creature spawn location lookup sites**: The Outlands Butler website has a creature library (bestiary) where searching a mob and clicking it shows spawn locations and the dungeon it is in, and Explore Outlands also offers a mob search. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554865552172916789)
- **necromancy trainer locations**: Necromancy trainers are found on Shelter Island (Mage shop west of the main plaza) and in Prevalia, on the way to the dock, next to the stable, and in the library west/north of the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552351680211718198)
- **sanctuary dungeon weekly reset**: The Sanctuary dungeon changes weekly on Fridays, and the countdown to the reset is visible in game. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554844508385050655)
- **adding location to runebook**: To add a location to a runebook, take a blank rune to the location, mark the rune there, then drop the marked rune onto the runebook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546762473305018439)
- **adventurer's rope**: The Adventurer's Rope is the item that lets you blink a short distance without casting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546637557209768088)
- **citadel progressive spawn**: The Citadel progressive spawn is no longer active. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725567862771732)
- **current sanctuary dungeon**: The sanctuary dungeon for the week of 2026-09-26 is Kraul Hive, and its level 1 is good for newer players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553535603692413019)
- **dungeon forges**: Nusero is the only dungeon that has a forge. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522636196365336717)
- **dungeon travel without magery, chivalry or camping**: Players without Magery, Chivalry or Camping can travel to dungeons using a runebook or rune tome with dungeon locations, or by getting ported by a chivalry bot on a second account; Camping works with the atlas and Chivalry has Sacred Journey. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546637508237070456)
- **explore outlands map accuracy**: Explore Outlands is outdated for some content, for example it does not mark a progressive spawn in Midlands Ruins 1. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547551536534786069)
- **finding healer caravans on exploreoutlands**: Enter your in-game coordinates on exploreoutlands.com to find your location, then select healer caravans in the left panel to see them marked on the map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541386111193159)
- **hiking to marked spots and inn**: Players can hike (mark and travel) to marked spots using three free custom slots, a script can hike to the inn, say the room and click it, and the 'new player' tab already includes the previous inn location. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546514394249302016)
- **locating portal shops via witcher runes**: To reach a shop or vendor listed on the portal, open its location on ExploreOutlands.com via the portal link, turn on Witcher runes on the left, find the Witcher rune closest to the vendor, then recall there from a witcher library; alternatively add witcher runes to your in-game world map and use the set map position button. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554114741809577985)
- **magic resist training locations**: Common Magic Resist training spots include Ossuary floor 1, southwest of the Ossuary near the pyramids, a small building with caster mobs east of Andaria near the mountain (Andaria Ruined Tower), and Telescope Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101170590388267)
- **nusero mining location**: Nusero is a mining location with heavy dragon presence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549869236820910081)
- **ocean boat safety**: A small or medium boat on the ocean is one of the safest ways to play Outlands, since ocean danger was greatly reduced by the big ocean patch from the previous year. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521069796769267782)
- **outpost moongate rune library**: A rune library is in the battle trainer house directly behind the Outpost town moongate, with a book to the dungeons on the table outside the door. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703344290144257)
- **pets glitching underground**: Pets can glitch underground in the Paralia sewers and in Darkmire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551309681073324153)
- **reaching a treasure map location via witcher runes**: To reach a treasure map location, find the closest Witcher rune to the map location (Witcher tmap numbers can be added to your map in game); a friend can then use a Witcher runebook to recall to that spot and travel the rest of the way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546272825982189588)
- **recall by typed command**: Typing [recall <rune name> recalls you to a rune in a runebook you carry, and [recallcharge <rune name> does the same using charges instead of Magery, so it works for characters without Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554852623163723947)
- **recall mana cost**: Casting Recall (including via Rune Tome charges) costs 11 mana, so a character needs at least 11 intelligence and should keep 11 mana available, especially when wearing plate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553577856917962863)
- **recall requirements**: Recall only works if you have a rune marked to the destination. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546761967438405632)
- **recalling in and out of dungeons**: Dungeons allow recall in only near the entrances, and once deep enough you must leave via special gates, so murderers cannot recall in on top of you; recall out generally does not work except near a yellow gate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474344563118134)
- **repair bench locations**: Repair Benches are placed in player houses, and many are publicly available in battle trainer and vendor houses, such as those around the Prevalia and Outpost moongates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554846223096356997)
- **returning to shelter island**: Players can return to Shelter Island after leaving to level up or change skills, but lose the ability to use its NPCs and bank, except quest givers and the innkeeper. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552901421299671041)
- **ruined lycaeum difficulty**: The ruined Lycaeum is harder than the nearby valley because it has magical mobs, and its healer is the caravan at the ruined Lycaeum. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549248769852178593)
- **ruined original map remnants**: Outlands contains a ruined, abandoned version of Papua and a ruined version of Jhelom, with other remnants of the original UO map scattered around the new map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671584335364167)
- **rune marking in dungeons**: You can mark a rune inside a dungeon while standing next to a golden (yellow) moongate, which exists only on level 1 of the dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553537305313280061)
- **runebook scroll consumption**: Using a runebook can consume both a charge and a scroll, which is a known issue; automatic scroll consumption can be turned off to avoid this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546625056187088927)
- **sanctuary dungeon safety**: The dungeon marked (Sanctuary) in the atlas is a safe dungeon where players cannot be looted or killed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550759470311931915)
- **starting runetome contents**: The starting runetome does not include a rune to Andaria, but runes can be added to it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552883349914390559)
- **telescope island poi runes**: Telescope Island is a POI whose runes can be found at rune libraries, and the Outpost moongate has a house behind the gate for POI spots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554480049124540531)
- **town npc availability**: Every town has the same set of NPCs, except Prevalia, which has all the special NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549601234455896067)
- **travel to dungeons without sacred journey**: Without Sacred Journey, players can reach dungeons by walking, camping, using rune books or the Recall spell, and cartography can also be used for travel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546750751588491305)
- **uko/uruk dungeon**: Uko/Uruk refers to the orc dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330018614517811)
- **urukton bluffs dungeon sanctuary**: Urukton Bluffs is a sanctuary only once you are inside the dungeon itself, not in the surrounding area. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046348910592083)
- **urukton dungeon location**: Urukton dungeon is just outside the starting town of Hailstone, which is SIR's territory. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545164175108735087)
- **8x8 grid on world map**: To display the 8x8 grid on the world map, zoom in on the world map until white gridlines appear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522900327999868998)
- **adding marked rune to runebook**: Drag and drop a marked rune onto a runebook or rune tome, provided no book or tome is currently open on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452474956910693)
- **animal broker locations**: Animal Broker NPCs are usually near Stable Keepers; in Prevalia there is one at the stables just north of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546525263334998127)
- **apple cart location in prevalia**: The apple cart in Prevalia is located north-west of Prevalia's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545003004955201607)
- **armourer location on shelter island**: The armourer NPC is located east of the main plaza on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549693215261855804)
- **bard npc location**: Bard NPCs are located east of the docks on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547572103769759836)
- **blessable head items from prevalia shop**: Other blessable head items can be bought from the Prevalia shop left of the bank, and anything labeled armor counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925116039663687)
- **blessed traveler's torch vendor**: The blessed traveler's torch was probably sold by the vendor Jakesh, unless it was a limited-time item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548856201255723019)
- **bluffs dungeon chests**: The Bluffs have dungeon chests that require lockpicking to open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555068621812797493)
- **boat launch cooldown after recall**: Boating has a cooldown on launching a boat after recalling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537964440811471000)
- **bot summoning gates in orevalia**: Summoning gates run by bots in Orevalia announce where they lead, and many announce repair benches, libraries and other services. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299877109604353)
- **buying a taming bestiary**: To buy a taming bestiary, search the Outlands Portal for a vendor selling one, preferring a vendor located near a town or point of interest that you can reach with a tmap or runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551908371882311692)
- **cambria moongate rune library**: A free rune library is located at the Cambria moongate, in the stone house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331395952517160)
- **camping skill hiking**: With 60 camping skill, a player can hike to dungeons, points of interest and towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551146723643232307)
- **cartography world atlas hiking**: Cartography lets you use your world atlas for hiking, giving a quick way to travel around the entire world. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548271948255989853)
- **challenge and sanctuary dungeon overlap**: Challenge dungeons and Sanctuary dungeons do not overlap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075462736486463)
- **chameleon spawn locations**: Chameleons are found at three spawns in Nusero level 1, one in Nusero level 2, and one in Shelter dungeon level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554580388914012201)
- **chivalry gate**: The Chivalry gate spell is the easiest way to get around and also grants a damage buff when used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361652126818409)
- **chivalry gates unlock**: At around 90 or 95 chivalry, players gain access to chiv gates that make travel to core dungeons and towns easier; the exact threshold is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548768853977342134)
- **clothing bless deeds**: Clothes can be blessed, and the merchant Jakesh sells clothing bless deeds next to Prevalia's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855734144475157)
- **corpse creek town**: Corpse Creek is the lawless town and is described as the least popular town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551694719967301734)
- **corpse creek zone status**: Corpse Creek is a lawless zone in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547795480908660882)
- **custom location dungeon recall rule**: The yellow moongate dungeon recall rule may recently have been extended to work for hiking and sacred journey custom locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386540247523389)
- **dragon taming location**: Dragons to tame can be found west of Andaria, in the mountains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549448792548450395)
- **dungeon chest locations**: Dungeon chests stay at fixed locations and are not randomized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555041086794371165)
- **dungeon difficulty parity**: Apart from Kraul Hive, Tidal Tomb and Shadowspire, the other dungeons are roughly equal in difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075359246090281)
- **dungeon gate exit destination**: Walking through the gate when leaving a dungeon ports you back to your town of choice at a random spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545333587547787334)
- **dungeon list and buffs**: The list of dungeons and their buffs is posted every Friday at reset in a Discord channel, and a map or banner showing it is placed near every bank in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987453022445729)
- **dungeon moongates as exits**: Yellow and red moongates inside a dungeon are quick exits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550547364693934286)
- **dungeon recall near yellow moongates**: You can mark runes and recall into or out of a dungeon when within 8 tiles of the yellow moongate on the dungeon's first floor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386540247523389)
- **dungeon rune books availability**: House vendors don't usually sell full rune books of dungeons, but most guilds have them available for members to use, and public rune libraries likely exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551313889181040825)
- **ettin valley gold grinding spot**: An unnamed valley north of the ruined Lycaeum, nicknamed Ettin Valley by one player, has ogres and a nearby healer caravan around a waypost and is a gold-grinding spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549248115134177352)
- **event objects blocking runes in prevalia**: Temporary event objects can sometimes block runes marked in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547670560018800650)
- **explore outlands player tracking**: The player-tracking API used by the Explore Outlands tool was removed, so player positions show as coordinates 0,0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366920304066722)
- **explore outlands tool**: Apart from the removed player tracking, Explore Outlands is simply a website. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366920304066722)
- **exploreoutlands witcher location after t-map update**: After the T-map update, players can still use ExploreOutlands to find the witcher location: hike to the area, crop the minimap, get the witcher number, then reveal the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531086588484784258)
- **exploreoutlands.com accuracy**: exploreoutlands.com is fairly out of date and does not mark some progressive spawns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546523121748672562)
- **explorer pack buff**: An explorer pack grants a 1 hour buff that removes the need for a secure campfire to hike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534398409048330432)
- **finding monster locations**: To find monster locations such as Banshees, use the Explore Outlands feature or the Outlands Butler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547406601890172948)
- **fishing island healer**: The fishing island reportedly has a healer to the south that can be reached by walking across shallow water, though this is recalled from memory and unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552258037727756328)
- **gating a red player with chivalry**: A blue player sneaks ahead of the red, marks the target spot, and then gates the red player in using a Chivalry gate (Sacred Journey). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547374691398848542)
- **godfrey north library tower npc route**: To reach the NPC locked in the tower during the Godfrey north library quest, use the runic tiles to teleport from the ground floor to the second, then to the third, then climb a ladder and another set of stairs to his floor; alternatively, a path in the building just right of the library skips the tiles and enters the library next to the ladder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555337996163620975)
- **golden statue all tomes option**: The Golden Statue's All Tomes option provides a link tome containing every obtainable chain link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554051524513103943)
- **guild rune sets**: Guilds reportedly have their own set of runes available to members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549754861212663819)
- **hailstone to urukton road safety**: The road from Hailstone to Urukton is usually relatively safe to travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545164398467747964)
- **harpy nest location**: A nest of harpies is located northwest of Horsehoe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550201531578454188)
- **hiking restrictions**: Normal hiking restrictions include things like PvP flags and a frozen character, not a skill requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536831254010400798)
- **horseshoe bay and cambria beekeepers**: Horseshoe Bay beekeepers are Carroll the Beekeeper and Chet, and the Cambria beekeeper is Jacques. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551067123659571311)
- **horseshoe bay pickpocket dips location**: The Horseshoe Bay pickpocket dips are located north of Horse Shoe Bay in the first house on the shore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549447186314432643)
- **horseshoe bay witcher rune library**: A Witcher rune library is at the Horseshoe Bay beach house, on the beach down from the moongate on the way to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549754731486773322)
- **identifying dungeons with the wiki**: To identify a dungeon, compare its layout against the maps in the wiki Dungeons category to find the matching name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554866894195130408)
- **in-game healer locator**: There is no in-game way to point toward the nearest healer after dying in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518632778047588)
- **infinity coin vendor location**: The Infinity Coin vendor is located in Colony. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200665009061909)
- **inns in towns**: Every town in Outlands has an inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607384314249277)
- **iron bank public repair bench**: A public repair bench is in The Iron Bank, a large building just north of Prevalia's north gate on the left side of the road. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **island healers**: Islands tend to have only a wandering healer NPC rather than a healer caravan, and wandering healers are not marked on exploreoutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518784364388392)
- **jakesh npc location**: Jakesh is an NPC located just south west of the main bank in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553502125819044014)
- **jungle ban bot and battle trainer**: The Jungle location has a ban bot, and the battle trainer is in the middle of that room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552587799973339187)
- **kraul hive access**: Kraul Hive can be walked to from the Totem Moongate but the route is quite dangerous; otherwise teleport from a public rune library, where Witcher runes 325 and 331 are close to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553862642538520737)
- **leaving a dungeon**: To leave a dungeon, walk outside; a gate portal may also work, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550371139228925963)
- **locating nearest healer**: There is no command to locate the nearest healer, but healers can usually be found on the world map if healer markers are enabled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555685276406259855)
- **lower prevalia inn rental**: Rooms cannot be rented in Lower Prevalia; the rentable inn is always the one in Upper Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545640964981264457)
- **magery trainer locations**: Mage NPCs teach Magery; on Shelter Island they are on the west side of town, and in Prevalia they are just north of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042958313656443)
- **main popular city**: Prevalia is the main and most popular city. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551168103428259911)
- **making your own rune**: To make your own rune, buy a blank rune from a mage NPC, cast Mark (6th circle) on it at the desired location, double click the rune to name it, then drag it onto your rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545180240890961922)
- **map drop sources**: All maps drop from mobs and may also be found in dungeon chests and paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548974689852985405)
- **mapmaker npc locations**: Mapmaker NPCs are found in Prevalia (Isoke), Andaria (Shen), Cambria (Penda), Horseshoe Bay (Kalika), Outpost (Ardith) and Terran (Dane). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549545643175845890)
- **marking runes in low-traffic spots**: Mark runes in out-of-the-way, low-traffic spots so players or NPCs are unlikely to block the destination. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547666893563895878)
- **marking runes near dungeon gates**: Mark a rune inside a dungeon near the yellow gates so you can recall straight back there; marking near the red gates is not possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550547510949453915)
- **marking runes near the bank**: Don't try to mark a rune right next to the bank; try another spot and check the message you get. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676535073538139)
- **marking runes without mark spell**: A Paladin who cannot cast Mark can create an alt on another account to mark runes for the runetome obtained from the new player quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703027267993621)
- **martial manual vendor**: The martial manual is sold by a Scribe NPC, probably in the mage's shop on Shelter Island, though the exact location is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549842679209267282)
- **mini-map shop markers**: You can right-click the mini-map to choose which kinds of shop markers appear on it, which may help locate shops such as the blacksmith in Anchor's Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546924397636489396)
- **misaligned sextant origin**: The misaligned sextant is believed to be a New Lyceum quest item, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547673868536385680)
- **monster slaying job location**: The target monsters for a society monster slaying job can be found in Nusero, an area described as PK infested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554866722887041157)
- **monster spawn location website**: exploreoutlands.com has a monster search that shows monster spawn locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554579713446641768)
- **moon gate to shelter island**: A moon gate on the west side of Prevalia town can be used to travel back to Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553471696713949448)
- **moongate travel to anchors rest**: Any moongate can be used to travel to Anchors Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553581306447921203)
- **mount petram multiple character entry restriction**: A player cannot enter Mount Petram while another of their characters is already inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548013529288671304)
- **naming runebook locations**: You can name a location within your runebook, and you can also name it on the rune itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545825241333502113)
- **necro scroll drop from antediluvian dragon**: A necromancy scroll rare has been reported dropping from an antediluvian dragon in the Sacrificial Cliffs area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723556928884766)
- **necromancer trainer location near prevalia**: The necromancer NPC trainer near Prevalia is northwest of the bank, in the old library. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554158579236339825)
- **new player rune tome urukton rune**: The Urukton rune in the new player rune tome likely places you just outside the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197403252985926)
- **new treasure map spots**: The new treasure map system adds new spots, and some of them port the player into a full danger zone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538222330310823936)
- **north prevalia bank thieves**: The north Prevalia bank is a common gathering spot for thieves, so carrying valuables there is risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549142556137357514)
- **nusero level 1 safety**: Nusero level 1 is fairly safe for a regular dungeon because PKs tend to go straight to level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553354128225476629)
- **obtaining and marking blank runes**: Mage NPCs sell blank runes, and saving a location to one requires a player mage with enough Magery to reliably cast Mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452160245694535)
- **old dungeon access**: The old dungeons in Outlands are accessible by faction members only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671547916226663)
- **old pap spawn spot**: Old Pap is a humanoid spawn spot near Totem that is great for backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536453585381097623)
- **opening a gate from a rune or tome book by command**: When controlling the character yourself, use a command such as [recall gate (exact command uncertain) to open a gate using a rune or tome book in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552730224859549840)
- **orange non-attackable wilderness mobs**: Orange non-attackable mobs in the wilderness are world flavor and may be tied to quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554164212404723865)
- **outlands mall**: The Outlands Mall no longer exists and has not for years; the Outlands Portal replaced it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547124366205255680)
- **outlands portal vendor locator**: On the Outlands Portal, use the buttons that show a vendor's location on the map, and one button provides an in-game GPS to guide you to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547621132155486223)
- **outpost moongate runebooks**: The Outpost moongate has runebooks you can use; to use one, drop a recall scroll on the book you want to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545718164804079616)
- **outpost public repair bench**: A small building just northeast of the Outpost moongate has a public repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **paladin gate travel**: A Paladin with Chivalry can gate to towns and dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703027267993621)
- **paladin npc location in prevalia**: The Paladin NPC in Prevalia is located just north west of the Thief NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547241257078620170)
- **party treasure map travel**: On a party treasure map hike, the other party members do not automatically travel to the destination when the map owner arrives; the owner must open a gate or give coordinates so they can make their way there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551659286839431209)
- **pawn broker location in prevalia**: A pawn broker is located in Prevalia, just east of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551663161227219079)
- **pickpocket dip location**: A public pickpocket dip is located near the Prevalia moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545245169023057952)
- **plant pot vendor in prevalia**: A farmer NPC next to the north exit out of Prevalia sells plant pots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287009492869271)
- **poi and tmap runebook locations**: The Outpost moongate area has POI runebooks, and the Horseshoe Bay beach house just outside town on the way to the moongate has tmap books that can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551908371882311692)
- **poi books location**: POI books can be obtained at the Outpost moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549755037784215585)
- **prevalia bard npc location**: The bard NPC in Prevalia is located between the zoo and the castle gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554529396230979615)
- **prevalia dock steps to shelter island**: The 'To Shelter Island' steps at the Prevalia docks are disabled because of abuse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553472301964599348)
- **prevalia mage shop location**: In Prevalia there is a mage shop just north of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546338788534521957)
- **prevalia moongate location**: The Prevalia moongate is outside town near the training house; from the front of the Prevalia bank go left over the bridge, then turn right, though the directions are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552880849643643058)
- **prevalia riverside mall**: The riverside mall in Prevalia is a bot that is always present unless the server has just gone down, and it has a rune library and a repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545332556365439046)
- **prevalia south bank**: The Prevalia South Bank is reportedly always empty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551699425489854546)
- **prevalia stable keeper location**: A stable keeper NPC is located just north of the Prevalia bank, west of the mage shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544811720600588450)
- **prevalia theft frequency**: Prevalia has the most thefts of any city and is considered the worst city for thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039541677137963)
- **prevalia thief npc location**: The thief NPC who buys black goods is located in the bottom right area of the Prevalia map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554935893817696428)
- **prevalia vendor mart rune libraries**: The vendor marts in Prevalia have rune libraries that can be used to travel to Urukton, so players should use them instead of running there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330448006123642)
- **public rune tome libraries**: Some guilds and players leave rune tomes publicly accessible as libraries containing runes to many locations, and the outpost reportedly has one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545171478167691344)
- **reaching dungeons via rune libraries**: Players can reach dungeons such as Tidal Tomb by using public rune libraries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545919172985356381)
- **reaching kraul hive**: To reach Kraul Hive safely, get a player with Chivalry to open a chiv gate that takes you inside the dungeon, since running there is dangerous because it lies in a hard area of the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553868847394590753)
- **reaching totem**: To reach Totem, use the gate system, press Totem, then walk north. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552661797717278762)
- **rearranging runes in a rune tome**: Runes in a rune tome can be rearranged later, and other runes can be dropped in or added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545180934054215710)
- **recall requirements**: Recalling requires the Magery skill and a rune book or rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554201027832713257)
- **recall versus hiking cast time**: Recall takes about 3 seconds to cast while Hiking takes about 5 seconds, so hiking is slower than recall, though the figures are approximate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550178514685132961)
- **recalling to lower prevalia inn**: Use the command [recallcharge Lower Prevalia Inn to recall to the Lower Prevalia Inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545640964981264457)
- **recalling while holding an item on the cursor**: You can keep an item held on the mouse pointer by dragging it without releasing, then press a recall macro to recall; the item is not lost as long as you do not drop it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175994459430962)
- **recalling with runebook charge**: To recall using a runebook charge, click the blue gem next to the entry rather than the recall icon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545719967410954322)
- **red player travel method**: A red-named (murderer) player cannot use recall and most likely travels using a Sacred Journey/Chivalry gate set up by a blue player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547374691398848542)
- **removing a rune from a runebook**: To remove a rune from a runebook, open the runebook, click the box for the rune's location, and choose the 'drop rune' option at the bottom. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555190792585216092)
- **renaming a marked rune**: To rename a marked rune, remove it from the rune book, double click it, and type the new name into the chatbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548384342512902145)
- **renaming an unnamed rune in a rune book**: To rename an unnamed rune in a rune book, go to the 2nd page, click the drop rune button, then rename the dropped rune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548383832892514330)
- **resource map destination**: A resource map takes the player to the Caldera, and reaching the map spot requires dealing with multiple mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529571312450932817)
- **resource map locations**: Resource map locations depend on the map itself rather than its level, so low-level resource maps send players to the same expansion-area locations as higher-level ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546942961848331)
- **resource map travel to location**: Under the new resource map system the map takes you directly to the location, so runes or rune tomes marking each location are not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536015293917175819)
- **returning to town when stranded**: When stranded or dead in a remote place, open the in-game Help tab and choose the Stuck option to get back to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544842038825193703)
- **route to new lyceum**: To reach New Lyceum, use the gate near the northwest Prevalian stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546356678147055746)
- **rune book blue dot recall**: The blue dot in a rune book always uses a charge and cannot be changed to cast the recall spell; a macro such as say '[recall Prevalia' can be used to recall via spell instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548383832892514330)
- **rune libraries and dungeon runebook**: Rune libraries around the land hold runebooks, and the small marble shop next to the Terran moongate has a dungeon runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549691432753832049)
- **rune libraries near prevalia**: Rune libraries exist; there is likely none near Prevalia, but the outpost gate has one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552881785577283626)
- **rune library recall scroll use**: At the rune library, drop a recall scroll into the runebook you want to recall from to travel to farming spots around the maps that are not dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703344290144257)
- **rune location blocked error**: Rune teleportation can fail with 'the location is blocked' when something such as a player or NPC occupies the destination spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547666637443043329)
- **rune re-marking behavior**: Marking a rune at a new location automatically overwrites its previous mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545127302977822831)
- **rune tome**: A rune tome holds runes that you mark with the Mark spell, so casting Recall on a rune teleports you to the marked location, and it also holds recall scroll charges that let a character without Magery recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545006297328394311)
- **rune tome**: A rune tome is larger than a normal runebook, holds more charges, and lets you rearrange and rename runes without removing them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547312540294578227)
- **runebook blue jewel buttons**: A recall scroll may need to be dropped onto a runebook before its blue jewel buttons can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549691618452570175)
- **runebook default location**: To set a default location on a runebook, click the green or red gem at the top left of the rune page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554852297484542084)
- **runetome copying tool**: A runetome copying tool can be purchased that copies runebooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551313968784740506)
- **runetome quest cost**: The runetome from the Shelter dungeon quest costs 2500 gold, while the codex quest costs considerably more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552883157559418921)
- **runic tomes vs runebooks**: Runic tomes are considered much better than runebooks, so players should work toward tomes rather than buy many runebooks, since eventually only tomes get used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554248145058136127)
- **sacred journey gate**: The Sacred Journey (chivalry) gate remains where it was cast and is one way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545442232444915863)
- **safe zones**: UO Outlands has a couple of safe zones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377838158651433)
- **sanctuary dungeon rules**: Sanctuary dungeons forbid criminal actions and give less experience and less gold than other dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550783716081664012)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Three dungeons are permanent sanctuaries where PvP is not allowed, and one additional dungeon becomes a sanctuary each week on rotation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553850231374876765)
- **sanctuary dungeons in the atlas**: In the Outlands atlas, opened with the [atlas command, sanctuary dungeons are colour coded yellow with 'Sanctuary' in brackets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111192203665430)
- **sewer location**: The sewer is located just above the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549617432572723301)
- **sharing unblessed runebook across alts**: Until you can bless a runebook, keep the unblessed one locked down or in a secure bag in your inn room so all alts can open it and recall from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554351667447730247)
- **shelter dungeon portals**: The yellow and red portals in the Shelter dungeon are both exits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850780268240897)
- **shelter healer respawn location**: Shelter has a healer, and players who die can be found at the front of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554806461253558283)
- **shelter island chivalry trainer**: The chivalry trainer in Shelter Island's town center, named Giles, stands next to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555018193431564309)
