- **shelter island mage shop layout**: The Shelter Island mage shop has an alchemist, a scribe and a necromancer downstairs, and a mage upstairs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546864669568929843)
- **shelter island moongate**: The Shelter Island moongate can be used to travel to any other moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553735784056492063)
- **shelter island thief trainer location**: The thief trainer on Shelter Island is reportedly located under the inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019491547549878)
- **shop location via valor shrine rune**: A rune to the Valor shrine is likely the way to reach the shop location a player asked about. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548263943984652470)
- **smuggler npc locations**: Smuggler NPCs are located at Black Market Vendor, Corpse Creek, Desert Outpost, Dusty Mercantile, Granite Docks, Palmshade Trading Camp, Smugglers Den, Smugglers Dock and Winter Harbor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951170508853476)
- **society jobs location**: Society jobs can be obtained in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **strangelands event entry via moongate**: Entering a certain moongate can place a player into the Strangelands event, where the player is labeled a 'stranger' and other players can kill them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550150618142875749)
- **teleport button macros**: Button macros can be set up to teleport to different locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546484608634327070)
- **teleporting a friend to a treasure map location**: Apart from a gate, there is no way to teleport a friend to a treasure map location; recall and camping to the spot do not work, so other means of travel must be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546273252169744456)
- **test shard prevalia bank area**: On the Test shard, the area around the fountain in front of the Prevalia bank is crowded with storage items and colored statues, and the [go command does not work there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551294711304556635)
- **third-party map trackers**: Third-party map trackers such as Ultima Mapper reportedly no longer work for UO Outlands, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551259689780510783)
- **totem bank and inn proximity**: In Totem the bank and inn are close enough that you can stand between them and use both at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293274724868187)
- **totem city location**: Totem is a city on another continent (Wildlands), reachable through any regular town gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294314207875092)
- **town struggle gate locations**: A Town Struggle gate is always present at Prevalia, though other gates may exist elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554995856565076069)
- **town travel options**: Every town has a moongate, and players can also travel by chivalry gate if they have chivalry, or hike with 60 camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552881711304413266)
- **town with map maker near bank**: The town with a map maker close to a bank might be Cambria, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390820031565847)
- **tracking on the ocean**: Tracking is not needed on the ocean because anyone can use a spyglass, which requires no skill, to see who is nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527626670436122664)
- **trapped boxes on shelter island**: On Shelter Island in the Test environment, players are not allowed to open trapped boxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545571286317531198)
- **travel to prevalia via help command**: Type [help and use the in-game option to travel to Prevalia; it has a 12 hour cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552290648806129765)
- **treasure map mapper role**: The mapper, who opens a gate for a treasure map, needs to be a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551662029050478724)
- **treasure map runes**: Treasure maps no longer require runes; the player hikes to the spot and is placed directly into the zone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538228937753366568)
- **treasure maps unlocking links**: Treasure maps (tmaps) can unlock links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544625114220462162)
- **unmarked wandering healers**: Unmarked wandering healers that are not healer caravans are almost always found near a point of interest, such as the one at Blackthorn's fort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532619207188601)
- **urukton bluffs cave entrance**: A cave entrance near the Urukton Bluffs fort transports you inside the dungeon itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552047243681472653)
- **urukton bluffs fort wilderness status**: The fort outside Urukton Bluffs is still in the Wilderness, so other players can attack you there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552047172005007661)
- **using witcher rune libraries**: To use the Witcher Rune system, find a Witcher Rune library (many are free), make a rune to that library, then travel from the library to anywhere on the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623638537343086)
- **vendor mart yellow portal**: To use the yellow portal at the vendor mart, double click it or walk through it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545332636384231424)
- **w339 spellbook vendor route**: To reach the W339 spellbook vendor, go to the Horseshoe Bay beach house just outside town on the way to the moongate, recall to rune 339, then run to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553619074532245504)
- **weekly dungeon bonus map**: A map on a pole at or near all banks shows the dungeon bonuses for the week, including sanctuary status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111325121019936)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon location**: To find the current weekly sanctuary dungeon, double-click the map available at any bank in town, or check the atlas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550305793021054997)
- **witcher bot command**: Using the !witcher command with a rune number (e.g. !witcher 84) makes the bot link directly to that rune's location on exploreoutlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547633777482797057)
- **witcher rune system**: Witcher is a player-developed rune system covering nearly the entire Outlands map, widely adopted alongside Point of Interest libraries for travel, and Witcher Runes can be toggled on the left side of the Explore Outlands map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553621539927105667)
- **witcher runes map toggle**: On the exploreoutlands.com map link, Witcher Runes can be shown by enabling the option on the left-hand side of the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623336719290532)
- **witcher's tome utility**: Witcher's Tomes remain useful for finding vendors and getting around, and they save recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538234411944771635)
- **world gate travel to check npc stock**: Use the world gate west of Prevalia to jump to other towns, for example to check other NPCs' stock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549561582755774475)
- **yellow and blue gate behavior**: Yellow gates are chivalry gates and are one-way, while blue gates are two-way and let you return to where you entered when the gate reopens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552544224669335603)
- **zoo location**: The zoo is in the Shelter dungeon, to the left behind the player guard, and the 'prev' location also has a zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341532878503997)

## Systems & mechanics

- **action queue**: The Outlands Action Queue has been unified and overhauled, so Razor and the client now use the same pathways for lift/drop and double click. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **activating a selected loadout**: After selecting a different Loadout in the Codex Menu, players must still click the 'Active' button to make it their currently Active Loadout. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1540432718079336549)
- **beta client 1.0.3.707 patch contents**: The 1.0.3.707 beta client patch includes updated handling for Stealing and Last Target, various target cursor features, and more fixes for the 'satchel bug'. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **beta client availability**: The beta client is restricted to the test shard only for now. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **beta client instability warning**: The new beta client is unstable and should not be used for activities that could cause catastrophic item loss, since picking up, using or dropping items might not work as intended. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **beta client versions**: Ultima Online: Outlands beta client version 1.0.3.707 and an accompanying test shard update have been deployed, superseding beta client 1.0.3.704, which contained experimental features. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **grid loot auto loot button**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes grid loot with an auto loot button. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **item counter fixes in beta client**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes fixes for item counters. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **switching loadouts in codex menu**: Players change between Loadouts in the Codex Menu using a Drop Down Menu or the Up/Down Arrows. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1540432718079336549)
- **character slots and accounts per outlands id**: Each Outlands ID has access to three game accounts, each with 5 character slots by default, for 15 slots total, and only one character per account can be logged in at a time so up to 3 can be online simultaneously. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690018314813554)
- **pet control slot limit**: Going over 5 pet control slots stops pets from obeying commands and following you (except via All Follow), so they won't protect you; pets take 1 to 4 slots and a previously ridden unridden horse may count. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486887329472764)
- **progression systems**: Outlands progression continues after reaching maximum skill through the Codex, Aspect and Skill Mastery Chain systems, which provide long-term progression, and players typically raise core skills first and then work on Codex and Aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274585050185731)
- **treasure map cartography requirement**: Treasure maps require Cartography skill on the character to decode; the decoded map is blessed and bound to the decoder, and at first only that character can open the chest, which no longer needs Detect Hidden or Lockpicking. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555030435229335604)
- **active resource map limit**: Only one resource map of any of the 5 types can be active per Outlands ID at a time, so a fishing map on one character blocks an ore or treasure map on another character on the same account. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761121426505759)
- **arcane essence and aspects**: Arcane essence, obtained by recycling magic items, is the fuel that keeps Aspects running and must be replenished regularly, but it is not needed until an aspect is unlocked, so new players can simply bank magic items until then. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724513011667125)
- **codex bonuses in pvp**: Codex bonuses and stances apply only in PvM and do not function in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555582712104886275)
- **decoded resource map limit**: A player can carry multiple resource maps but can have only one decoded at a time; the decoded map must be finished or junked before another can be decoded, and the tome of maps and decoding supplies are not blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930923457806377)
- **harvest aspect double loot on chests**: The Harvest aspect can proc double loot on treasure map chests and message in a bottle chests, and it still does so after the new patch. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541868039103053945)
- **harvest links usefulness**: Harvest links are generally not useful for treasure mapping, lumberjacking or mining (t-map links only add rare finds, and in lumberjacking and mining they merely reduce rare failed swings), and are used mainly by fishers or by PK-resistant resource-map-only builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539255807873392741)
- **leaving red hand status**: To stop being Red Hand and avoid death region restrictions, visit a Thief NPC, open the Thieves Guild gump from the context menu, check whether you are a Red Hand member, and either switch to Grey Hand or leave the guild. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550882685990207569)
- **loot links and harvest on treasure map chests**: Special/rare loot links affect treasure map chest loot, while effective harvest links do not; the harvest aspect gives a chance to double chest contents. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550051784427307129)
- **pet bonding**: A tamed pet becomes bonded to its owner when it reaches level 1, and bonded pets can be resurrected if they die. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551275709421592628)
- **post-patch resource and treasure map state**: After the August 11, 2026 patch, previously decoded treasure maps reverted to undecoded and most resource maps likely did too, except partially completed ones, which stay partially completed; resource maps now work like the manual process players used before and are faster to run. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215506170613760)
- **recycling magic items in the dungeon**: To recycle magic items in a dungeon, bring an item ID wand (a container ID wand for bags) and a crafting tool such as a saw or tailoring kit; identify the items with the wand, then use the crafting tool to recycle them for essence, which saves carry weight, and scripts exist to automate it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553904728042381385)
- **resurrecting dead bonded pets**: A dead bonded pet can be resurrected by a healer, and can also be revived with chivalry heal, the mage resurrection spell, bandages (with healing and anatomy), or veterinary for tamers; it can also be stabled and retrieved. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554796338015633541)
- **weapon setup bonus table**: The Weapon Setup Bonus table lists per-weapon-type bonuses such as 2H Melee +25% Melee Damage, Ranged +50% Melee Damage and Arcane Staff +10% Arcane Mana recovery chance. The +50% on the arcane wiki page is the Ranged setup bonus and does not come from the Arcane skill, since each weapon skill benefits only its own weapon type. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546329153840742471)
- **aspect slots and usage**: Once an aspect is unlocked it can be used on armor and on the held item (weapon, spellbook, staff), with one aspect active on each, and the held item's aspect determines the aspect proc; the same aspect is not unlocked twice. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554562705497526313)
- **bard tamer weapon aspect procs**: Bard tamers get almost no command aspect procs since they have no weapon and cannot cast spells without Magery; occasional procs are possible from weapon swings (e.g. throwing weapon or magic bow) but are very rare. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554121285431197698)
- **changing hair style**: Hair can be changed at the Prevalia stylist; once a hairstyle is unlocked it stays unlocked, and you can switch between styles with a wig stand or vanity travel kit, with hair colours and paperdoll backpack dyes working the same way. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553572490054340691)
- **codex leveling requirements**: A codex gains experience only while you meet the skill requirements to use it, and it levels while in your backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300029329838131)
- **codex resetting**: Weapon codices can be fully leveled but cannot be reset, whereas point-limited codices such as the bard codex can be reset to reallocate points. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547617675507802163)
- **echo swap cooldown**: After swapping builds with an Echo there is a waiting time before you can swap again, 12 hours by default, which can be reduced to 15 minutes with expensive customisation upgrades. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553544589884006512)
- **harvest aspect effect on chests**: The Harvest aspect increases effective Lockpicking and Detect Hidden skill when opening chests and gives a 2x chance for stackable loot, but does nothing for stealing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416273081372673)
- **harvest aspect essence and armor requirements**: Harvest aspect only works and gains experience when arcane essence is above zero and harvest armor is checked (equipped). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553123803083841568)
- **healer codex with veterinary**: The Healer Codex works with Veterinary supplies if you qualify, but some traits do not apply to them, so read each trait's description. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629915263729685)
- **health bar collector target filter**: The health bar collector cannot be configured to show only your current attack target. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548402026780688515)
- **hiding system chat from game viewport**: To remove system chat from the left side of the game window, right-click the Journal (or click the gear icon) and open Settings, then enable 'Hide Messages In Game Viewport'; unticking it makes messages show again. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554581697528463493)
- **magic mushrooms mana restore**: Magic Mushrooms restore mana when eaten, but only if the wizard grimoire has the Summon Food (create food) upgrade; without it they do nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551005070127136780)
- **mastery chain wiki page**: The Outlands wiki has a Mastery Chain page at wiki.uooutlands.com/Mastery_Chain that lists all of the Mastery Chain link types. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554077150263640095)
- **multiboxing after patch**: Multiboxing remains possible after the patch, for example one character mapping, one doing regular harvesting, and one boating, fishing, lockpicking, or running MiBs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536936397162942535)
- **outlands butler website**: The community website outlandsbutler.com lets players build templates, plug in gear, and compare skill, link, bonus and damage effects, and lists popular community builds with codex and aspect leveling suggestions. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550700450410401874)
- **outlands id per ip limit**: Only one Outlands ID is allowed per IP address; a second ID on the same IP requires staff approval via a ticket or application, and extra IDs may conflict with the 3 account rule. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604775599775876)
- **paragon chest aspect effects**: Paragon treasure chests are not affected by the Harvest or Fortune aspects, because their loot is rolled when the paragon creature is killed, and they do not give harvest experience. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544446557925933096)
- **recall scroll charges in runebooks**: Recall scrolls added to a runebook or rune tome as charges can be used by anyone to recall, even with 0 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452722336956467)
- **red hand thief attackability**: A Red Hand thief is always freely attackable and lootable anywhere, even in town and even when their name appears blue, cannot give murder counts to players who kill them, always flags criminal to the person they steal from, and sometimes flags criminal to everyone else. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555304633759563832)
- **showaspectexperience command**: Use the [ShowAspectExperience command to toggle text display of Aspect experience earned, which can be shown as a system message. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215827030810704)
- **skill needed to hike to resource map locations**: Hiking to a resource or treasure map location requires at least 60 Camping or 60 Cartography skill, with no campfire or Explorer Pack needed; the earlier claim that Cartography is useless for this is outdated. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546218686745157683)
- **t-map location and travel**: After the T-map update, players cannot run many T-maps in one spot and must travel between map locations. A map's location is unknown until the player hikes there, so a poor area cannot be avoided. Players can carry several maps, but each must be decoded on site. T-map loot is unchanged. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531076942659326204)
- **thieves stealing from pack**: Thieves can steal items from your pack, so valuables should be kept in your inn room, house or bank box rather than carried; a bank should hold only gold and some loadouts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549973796319137905)
- **treasure map lockpicking requirement**: Under the new system, lockpicking is no longer required for treasure maps or resource maps; maps stay undecoded, cartography is used for treasure maps and the relevant harvesting skill for resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550102177056563211)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon**: One core dungeon each week is designated a sanctuary where players are safe from PKs and thieves, with about 33% less rewards. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784663808680068)
- **abandoned pet recovery**: Abandoned pets can be recovered from an Animal Wrangler NPC, often found near Stablemaster NPCs, for roughly 7 days, though the exact window is uncertain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555305735620141127)
- **account deletion**: Players cannot delete accounts themselves and can only delete or re-make characters, though staff may help via a ticket. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548500193018908713)
- **achievement point links**: Links bought with achievement points are random. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544707947412848640)
- **active codex limit**: There is no cap on the number of active codices other than the skillpoints available to spend on them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553553767490912339)
- **advancing aspect tiers**: After reaching max Aspect XP, open the Aspect menu via the hexagon and consume more cores and distills to advance to the next tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548519244935995412)
- **antiquity achievement point rewards**: Registering antiquities earns achievement points that accumulate over time and can be spent on items such as gold chain links, emote deeds (which can be resold) or a mount token. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555390842447855647)
- **artisan aspect xp from monsters**: Artisan aspect XP can be gained by killing monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545718399554949120)
- **aspect armor suit slots**: Activating an aspect requires a six-piece armor suit (helm, gorget, chest, gloves, arms, legs), and the helm, gloves and gorget slots can later be replaced with fancy clothing alternatives that count as exceptionally crafted leather. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887404912410777)
- **aspect echoes on one character**: Echoing an aspect on the same main character avoids having to level aspects twice, and the first echo or two are cheap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000291833282671)
- **aspect essence consumption**: Aspect essence is consumed whenever you deal damage, not only on proc, and when essence runs out the aspect is removed and stops gaining XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553884585199140900)
- **aspect hue toggle on helm**: To show your helm's actual dye color instead of the aspect hue, click Manage Hues at the top of the aspect menu, toggle the aspect hue off, then activate the aspect again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551702975507075235)
- **aspect unlocks and red line experience**: Each unlocked aspect raises red line experience gain by roughly 33% (three aspects give about 99%), and unlocking 30 links instantly unlocks 100%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552983585550504008)
- **avoiding potion satchel counter issue**: To avoid the potion satchel counter issue, keep the satchel open, reopen it after looting it from your body following death or after changing maps, or keep health potions outside the satchel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552790485960106069)
- **bestiary point allocation**: Points spent in a bestiary category only affect pets of that class; each class has 20 points, and some points can go to cross-class. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552410910327447566)
- **blessed items theft protection**: Blessed items cannot be stolen or pickpocketed and are not lost on death, unless you place them on the ground; for example, the Thief Codex is blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550935267639164949)
- **bound item protection**: Bound items typically lack blessed protection and can be looted, but they are safe if stored in the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502647929634838)
- **calling guards on pickpockets**: You can call guards against a pickpocket by typing 'guard', and NPCs will often witness the theft too, but there are blind spots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555020929581719575)
- **cartography requirement for resource maps**: Cartography is not required to decode or run resource maps; the requirement was briefly present on the test server patch and then removed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535323152333148230)
- **catch of the week**: The [cotw command opens the catch of the week system, where you turn in a randomly selected set of three fish each week for reward points based on weight ranking, and fish can be held in an aquarium until they match the week's set. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794404845559870)
- **chain activation requirement for links**: Link bonuses only apply when the relevant chain is active, so the chain must be active for links to take effect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537340632778145894)
- **circling warning ravens**: Crows or ravens circling you are Warning Ravens indicating a murderer (red) has just killed someone else in the area; they do not reveal your position and can be turned off. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553166915822682193)
- **closing nameplates by clicking**: Individual nameplates can be closed by clicking them, and enabling the relevant nameplate setting prevents misclicks from closing them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532324270047323)
- **codices and pvp flag**: Codices do not work while PvP flagged, but they help when unflagged or fighting mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475336815612018)
- **command aspect damage proc**: For mage summoners and tamers, command aspect's chance to increase damage is gained by casting spells, and higher tier spells have a higher proc chance that scales with the spell's mana cost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554120642700247143)
- **corpse decay timing**: Corpses turn to bones after about 15 minutes and the bones decay after another 15 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548420162909245483)
- **dead blue players in cambria**: Dead blue players in the Cambria streets are most likely from the Town Struggle PvP event, or possibly from faction fights. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554877641243369483)
- **deleting characters with aspects or quest rewards**: Characters that hold quest rewards or an aspect should not be deleted, because those benefits would be lost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549588987008786523)
- **detective lens**: With the Detecting Hidden skill, a player can use a Detective Lens on players to tell whether they are Red Hand thieves (or Grey Hand) and to see who has looted a corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **echo behavior**: An echo is not a fixed snapshot; it is a skill/stat profile that can be changed normally while it is the active one, and you swap between profiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553545262897696821)
- **echo characters for gathering**: Once echo is available, a character can be echoed to rework its skills, such as making echo miner and lumberjack characters to gather resources for craftables or a lumberjack/miner tamer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367608470507621)
- **echo skill profiles**: A character has one skill/stat profile by default, and unlocking an echo gives a second profile, allowing swapping between two templates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553544439962542093)
- **echo swap cooldown**: Echo swaps have a 12 hour default cooldown. Cooldown upgrades, including Jack of All Trades and Jill of All Trades, can reduce it to as little as 15 minutes for about 10M gold total. Jack and Jill alone bring it to about 1 hour. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550497725018275981)
- **echo unlocking**: An echo can be unlocked for about 450k gold using essence, and it can also be unlocked using skill scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539098595663933)
- **effective skill links**: Effective skill links (e.g. +3 alchemy) only apply to combat: the bonus does not affect crafting and does not show in the skills menu, but computations that use that skill, such as greater heal potion healing or greater explosion damage, behave as if the skill were higher while the link is equipped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554684994729808054)
- **explorer pack consumability**: Explorer Packs are consumable items that are used up when used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536746765527687238)
- **explorer pack cost per treasure map**: Each treasure map requires at least 2 Explorer Packs: one to decode the map and one to locate and dig up the chest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212626630053958)
- **fixing unwanted squares in dungeons**: If unwanted squares appear in dungeons, verifying the game files fixes the problem. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550407045923082293)
- **fortune aspect gold and xp bonus**: The Fortune aspect gives extra gold and increased XP (one player cites about 29% more), which makes it desirable even though it is not the best damage boost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413244269596733)
- **gold link from society points**: A gold link obtained from society points is random and cannot be chosen by the player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548368679564218442)
- **grey corpse gold reduction**: When a corpse goes grey, the gold it holds is reduced by 50%, and it reportedly drops a further 10% every 60 seconds afterward. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545079964959772803)
- **grid loot bag opening**: With grid loot, bags cannot be opened without immediately attempting to loot them, though this is not certain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550202960628293694)
- **guard calling after theft**: NPCs near a theft call guards automatically, but nearby players must call guards manually. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143511046164653)
- **harvest aspect damage resist**: The Harvest aspect grants damage resistance for 60 seconds after each harvest, which lapses if you stop harvesting, and switching to the aspect carries a 60 second delay before it takes effect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **harvest aspect on maps**: Harvest aspect bonuses apply to resource maps, with double harvest procs and aspect exp gain working, though effective skill bonus likely does not matter there; after login, reapply the aspect with the apply aspect button if treasure map digging does not proc. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540454232472166534)
- **harvest aspect sources and benefits**: Harvest aspect experience comes from harvesting resources, fishing (maps and ocean), and skinning leather from mobs spawned at special fishing locations and MiBs. The aspect also benefits maps, chests and MiBs, doubling MiB crate loot and skinned leather but not other mob drops. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537646750058283088)
- **harvest aspect swap delay**: Swapping to the Harvest aspect has a 60 second delay before its bonuses apply, so swapping in mid-activity is not worthwhile, though clearing treasure map mobs in Harvest aspect is fine. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546214183685853327)
- **harvest aspect tier upgrades**: Harvest aspect does not gain experience while an available tier upgrade remains unpurchased, so each level must be upgraded as soon as it is available. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553121253693460606)
- **harvest xp rate for pure harvesters at t15**: A pure harvester at T15 Harvest aspect receives 100% of Harvest XP for harvesting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525963378345119906)
- **health bar collectors**: To auto-open enemy health bars, go to Options > General > Healthbars and set up a health bar collector by drag-selecting; it can be configured for enemy type, placement, open distance and auto-close on leaving range, but it cannot filter by whether the enemy is attacking you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555577395082174505)
- **hiding bonus near houses**: Standing next to a house (including a vendor house) grants a +50 Hiding bonus, which applies even at 0 Hiding skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452233781805157)
- **hiding corpse nameplates**: To hide corpse nameplates, untick 'always active' for nameplates or choose mobiles-only in the nameplate options; right-clicking a nameplate closes it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495338507804774)
- **hiking for escaping pks**: Hiking cannot be interrupted by PKs and is considered a good way to escape PKs that sneak up on you, though one player disputes its usefulness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **hiking interruption and immunity**: Hiking cannot be interrupted, but a hiking player is not immune and can still be killed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550153340241846423)
- **hued item drop locations**: Cloth-hued items like the lantern can drop anywhere at random, while regionally hued ones such as the Aegis Keep lantern drop only in their corresponding regions, and these items drop blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553595109323575397)
- **in-game stats display reliability**: The in-game stats display is broken and should not be relied upon, as its values do not match the armor chart. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544102121979387977)
- **lantern effects with two-handed weapons**: Holding a lantern with a two-handed weapon carries no penalty, and the different lantern types give no bonuses or penalties because they are cosmetic. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595198719496192)
- **link cap per type and redline points**: Without redline points only 10 links of the same type can be active at once; with full redline points this rises to 15 links of a type. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537316951439839302)
- **magic item recycler identification**: The Magic Item Recycler does not require the Item Identification skill, but items must be identified before recycling; feeding item ID wands or container wands to the recycler identifies them automatically. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549795603008061541)
- **magic mushrooms for mana regen**: Magic mushrooms for mana regeneration come from upgrading the Create Food spell in the Wizard's Grimoire, and players can also make them themselves by casting Create Food. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583140180856893)
- **mana refund chance cap**: Mana Refund Chance is capped at 50%, so Mana Drain/Vamp grimoire upgrades cannot raise it higher, and points in Mana Drain can be moved elsewhere once the cap is reached. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549575125081395233)
- **mana regeneration sources**: Mana regeneration comes from actively using Meditation and from regen upgrades such as Focus, delectable food and material spellbooks (an Exceptional Avarhide spellbook may add about 1-2 mana per second). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546594762222469180)
- **mastery chain xp and early links**: Mastery Chain XP accrues even without a chain, each link adds one chain slot, and spending gold on links early gives little benefit compared with spending it on leveling your aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547613984826593400)
- **mount bonding and feeding**: Level 1 and higher mounts are bonded, so they are not lost on death and return instantly when you resurrect; mounts do not need to be fed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841477134188695)
- **multi-account household approval**: A Multi-Account Household (MAH) approval is still required when playing from different devices on the same network. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553478535790993531)
- **multi-account login limit**: You can have multiple characters logged in at once, but only one character per account (e.g. 3 characters across 3 accounts). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553393826368847883)
- **multi-account pvm and dungeon limits**: Playing PvM on all three accounts at once is allowed, but characters cannot share chain (link) progress, and only one account/character can be in a dungeon or engaged in PvP at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548508633866833942)
- **nameplate interrupting dungeon chest clicks**: If an item nameplate such as 'rock' interrupts you when clicking a dungeon chest, switch to a nameplate filter that includes items and double-click the chest's nameplate, or increase nameplate transparency. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551978764475301891)
- **nameplates hotkey**: Holding ctrl+shift brings up nameplates, though players are not fully certain of this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495594226257921)
- **naming pack horses and deep crawlers**: Pack horses cannot be named, while deep crawlers are normal pets that can be named, though a name already used by another player's pet is rejected. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546279717911666798)
- **nearby npcs and players affecting stealing**: Each nearby NPC or player within 8 tiles with line of sight progressively lowers the chance to steal successfully, and nearby players also increase the thief's chance of being flagged. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143671838867628)
- **ocean redline cost per level**: Ocean redline cost per level is now believed to be about 500k, up from roughly 200k earlier, versus 1 mil per level in the wilderness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898983600689323)
- **opening corpse loot behind walls**: To open the loot of a mobile corpse behind a non-transparent wall, hold Control and Shift and click the corpse's gump; if the gump is not clickable, turning on the 'all mobiles' setting made it clickable again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545238905744527484)
- **pack for horse on mount tokens**: Pack for horse is not available on mount tokens. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548347362945138759)
- **party ping wheel**: Alt-click opens a party ping wheel; configure it under Options > General > Party Pings, and changing its key to one you never use effectively disables it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554582929936744479)
- **pet follower slots**: A character has 5 follower slots and each tame takes 1 to 4 slots; when over the limit, tames only obey follow commands, and some pets take 2-3 slots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555615062171975831)
- **pet limit and pet leveling**: The maximum number of pets is 5 and does not increase with skill level, but pets can level up themselves and the bestiary unlocks many possibilities. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544999185684758560)
- **pet rename uniqueness**: A pet can only be renamed to a name that is not already taken, and the name must be unique for the rename to persist across relogs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553744205174669409)
- **point-limited codex passives**: Point-limited codices have all invested bonuses active at once as passive bonuses, and the bard codex has no stances. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547618329538203718)
- **poison aspect armor effect**: The poison aspect armor resolves poison ticks rather than poison stings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060152246698044)
- **potion duration when drunk before pvp flag**: Potions drunk before becoming PvP flagged retain their codex-extended duration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475427291201567)
- **potion satchel counter reset**: After changing maps, potion counts in the counter bars for the potion satchel can reset to zero and the drink hotkey stops working until the satchel is reopened; it is believed to be a bug, though possibly not unintentional. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552790467622604881)
- **prevalia test shard item spawning statues**: On the Outlands test shard, the Prevalia town center has statues, clothing racks and storage shelves for spawning items, and the green (possibly yellow) player statue spawns items such as shepherd's crooks with modifiers, a chain and all tomes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824280129147016)
- **preventing overlapping nameplates**: Press Ctrl+Shift to open the options window, then tick 'prevent overlapping nameplates' so nameplates stack instead of overlapping. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554646151314284555)
- **progression systems**: Outlands has multiple XP progression systems on top of random-gain skills, including Aspect Mastery, Codex and Chain Links, so progression items that complement a template matter more than gear with stacked bonuses; a reasonably effective player is around Tier 10-13 in Aspect Mastery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560732073431045)
- **protection spell tooltip accuracy**: The in-game spellbook tooltips for the Protection spell are incorrect and should be ignored; the wiki description, which says it increases armor rating, is accurate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555412373538472058)
- **quest progress in sanctuaries**: Quests, including weekly quests, do not count progress while you are in sanctuary locations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381499072286792)
- **ranged damage progression**: Ranged damage increases come from progression systems: Codex and Aspect leveling first, then the mastery chain, and much later redline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553752364123553853)
- **reason for mah harvesting lock**: MAH accounts are locked from harvesting because the potential for abuse, such as multi-boxing harvesters, is considered too high. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537959975442186392)
- **recycling unidentified items**: Unidentified items are magic loot items that can be recycled for materials and Arcane Essence, which is essence for your aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655190603141174)
- **red hand death region lockout**: Dying as a Red Hand thief (Thieves Guild member) applies a temporary region restriction that locks you out of dungeons such as Mount Petram, shown as a debuff timer on the buff bar, even if you only fought mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548686169313640459)
- **red wall collision highlight toggle**: To toggle the red highlight that shows wall collision, change the setting in the transparency options. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549051403652300880)
- **regional gold bonus and experience**: The regional bonus for extra gold in an increased gold dungeon applies after experience is determined, so the extra gold does not add to experience, including mugging exp. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546639779658211398)
- **releasing a follower via context menu**: Single-click a follower to open its context menu and choose release; this is the default behavior, though it can be harder because followers stack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546681113899171920)
- **resource map delay design intent**: The resource map system's delays are intended to offset faster resource lookup, so casual mappers cannot gather as fast as optimized mappers and flood the server with resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347706775109834)
- **resource map sorting**: After the resource map update, sorting maps is removed and existing sorted maps become unsorted, so players no longer need sorting or the exploreoutlands website to find where to go. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788223870439557)
- **resource maps and mining leaderboard**: Ore gathered from resource maps counts toward a player's lifetime mining leaderboard score, and resource maps let players gather ore much faster (reportedly about 10x) than other maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525897076439912609)
- **resource maps on gathering leaderboard**: Resource maps currently count toward the gathering leaderboard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529892472355033148)
- **retrieving lost pets**: If you have at least 1/5 followers and your pets appear on the followers tab of the stats gump, visit a Stablekeeper NPC, open the Stables Gump, click More Options, then click Retrieve Lost Followers; if you show 0/5 followers, no pets on the followers tab, and did not stable them, visit an Animal Wrangler to attempt to retrieve Abandoned Pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554795973253791754)
- **reveal immunity from picking**: Picking resources and dungeon or treasure chests grants Reveal Immunity, which protects the player from being revealed and killed while doing so. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552248231209996392)
- **rope teleport max range setting**: There is currently no setting to make the rope/teleport use its max range when the cursor is beyond range, though a later update is reportedly planned to add this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553185753557762061)
- **sacred journey buff eligibility**: The Chivalry Sacred Journey buff applies only if you cast the gate yourself or the caster stays with you; a gate cast by another character that does not stay with you does not give the bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555655774498463938)
- **sanctuary criminal protection**: Sanctuary protection against criminal actions applies only inside sanctuary dungeons, not outside them, such as the courtyard outside Urukton. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196288792862783)
- **saving spell icon positions**: If spell icon positions are not saved between logins, run the game as administrator and log out with the logout button in the Paperdoll so the profile is written. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546256529924034662)
- **scroll consume chance reduction**: Scroll consumption has two reductions, one from Inscription skill and one from the wizard's satchel, and the chance to consume can only be reduced to 0% for level 7 and 8 scrolls, so lower-tier scrolls are still sometimes consumed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552977106583953549)
- **sealed paragon chest theft**: A sealed paragon chest counts as a single item, so a thief can steal it as a whole. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549141446521651323)
- **spellbook loss on death**: You do not lose your spellbook when you die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549625486500696106)
- **stealing and monsters**: Monsters do not steal items from a player's corpse, and players can steal from monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478886532718735)
- **thief grey flag visibility**: A thief who flags grey can appear grey to only one player or to everyone, so not every nearby player sees the grey flag. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144090837258250)
- **tier upgrades above t15**: Tiers above T15 cannot be gained through normal XP; they require redline points and a purchase, costing 15 redline for T16, 30 for T17, 45 for T18, 60 for T19, and 75 for T20. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522791203454849146)
- **total stat cap**: The total stat cap is 225 points, though this comes from player claims rather than official sources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554375776407658527)
- **trap damage on paragon chests and bomb boxes**: Failing to remove a trap on a paragon chest, or opening a bomb box, can kill a character, including one standing inside their inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250621240221823)
- **trapped pouch decoys**: Loading trapped pouches with worthless items is a common tactic used to deter thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555626498839412807)
- **treasure map decoding**: Under the new treasure map changes, a single character must complete the whole decoding process and cannot hand it off to another character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549792027544256624)
- **treasure map digging requirement**: Following the August 11, 2026 patch changes, only a character with Cartography can dig up treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549183059285254355)
- **treasure map spots near witcher's tome locations**: Treasure map spots are still found around Witcher's Tome locations, though some are deeper inside certain areas; near a point of interest the spot is usually inside the tower or house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538231213125279756)
- **turning off aspect hue**: To turn off aspect hue on equipment pieces that already show the aspect color, reactivate aspect on those pieces; closing and reopening the paperdoll may also refresh the display. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553411126820077650)
- **water aspect healing build**: The Water aspect gives bonuses to healing, so a healer build for group events is possible. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532972870893712)
- **weapon/parry codex gump persistence**: Not every gump has a Stay option, and the weapon/parry codex gump does not reopen automatically after a client restart. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544818410112819230)
- **weekly pit trial limit**: Pit trials are limited to 7 per week. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548038731536269455)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon buff**: Each week certain dungeons receive a buff; the weekly Sanctuary Dungeon grants reduced xp and gold (reported as about 33% less, i.e. 66% of normal, though one early claim said 25% less), but players cannot be PKed or stolen from there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330467119702106)
- **wiki modifiers page**: The Outlands wiki Modifiers page lists all possible magic modifiers an item can have, which lets players see the bonuses on items after identifying them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551764317022453792)
- **wizard's grimoire**: The Wizard's Grimoire lets mages invest points to upgrade spells, making weak spells like Magic Arrow, Harm and Fireball more useful, increasing damage against mobs, and including an option that makes Protection last more hits before needing a refresh. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547614740736385074)
- **wizard's grimoire skill requirements**: The Wizard's Grimoire requires at least 80 Magery plus 80 Meditation (or, per one report, 80 Evaluating Intelligence) to benefit, and points must be put into its Create Food spell to use mushrooms. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583321358016524)
- **wizard's satchel blessing**: A wizard's satchel cannot be blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545490178917929051)
- **5-step restriction**: A 5-step restriction was introduced to stop instant spots and instant recalls, partly because of recall farmers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529897871766192209)
- **account and character limits**: You can have 3 accounts with 15 characters available, but only one character can be active at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367698190733313)
- **achievement title unlocking**: Achievement titles such as Monster Hunter ranks are probably unlocked by completing the next achievement in that line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547686526861840455)
- **activate echo swap**: Pressing Activate Echo swaps to the other echo loadout and stores the current one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550457501575553107)
- **active map limit per outlands id**: After the patch, each Outlands ID (account) is limited to one active map at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536936523956625500)
- **adding a resource to the counter**: To add a resource such as a log, board, ore or ingot to the counter, get its ID with the >info command and replace the leather graphic ID 4225 in an existing control line of mine.gumps.xml, adjusting the hue as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **adding items to resource counter**: To add items manually to the resource counter, edit the mine.gumps.xml file in the ClassicUO Data\Profiles\<Account>\<Character> folder of the Ultima Online Outlands install directory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **adding scrolls to an open book**: Scrolls likely cannot be added to a spellbook while it is open, as with adding recall scrolls to an open runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546859116360769547)
- **administrator dislike of map chaining**: Outlands administrators reportedly dislike map chaining, harvesting scripts, and wilderness multiboxing, and the resource map changes are speculated to address these. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529295129377116210)
- **adventure satchel blessed status**: Adventure satchels are blessed and enable use of the item counter bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544483969783959552)
- **afk activity rules**: In UO Outlands, AFK is acceptable for skill training, but activities that gain gold, resources, or XP should not be done AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378168082464840)
- **afk client disconnect**: The client can disconnect after about 15 or more minutes of being AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544791794032578730)
- **afk fishing from houseboat tos status**: AFK fishing from a houseboat is not against the TOS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530653005488197844)
- **alchemist satchel potion bug**: The alchemist satchel has a bug that prevents potions from being used until the satchel has been opened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546956172353871892)
- **always active nameplate setting behavior**: If the Always Active nameplate setting is disabled, nameplates may appear only while Shift+Ctrl is held or if they were not individually closed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532180074332272)
- **always show mobile names**: To always show mobile names, hold Ctrl+Shift to open the nameplates gump if it has been closed, switch it to mobiles, and click always on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551252601402564739)
- **arcane codex finisher trigger**: The arcane codex finisher is triggered by casting spells; if you rely on summons or pets instead of casting, the arcane codex does nothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549963870691393628)
- **arcane codex stances**: Arcane Codex stances are set with the in-game commands menu (page one) using the [ArcaneStance1 through [ArcaneStance5 commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548115274207600761)
- **arcane mage aspect proc rate**: Arcane mages proc spell aspect effects only about 60% as often as the listed chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544400043908399114)
- **arcane mage mana recovery**: After the last patch, mana recovery for Arcane mages reportedly comes from a percentage chance on hit that rises with Arcane armor, so mana arrives in bursts even with high dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399107488223298)
- **arcane staff aspect mastery slot**: On the Aspect mastery screen, an Arcane Staff can count as either the weapon or the book for aspect effects, at the player's choice, and it is the only weapon type that can do so. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544362321248395374)
- **archery codex naming**: Archery is considered a melee skill, but its codex is still called the archery codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612060232196167)
- **armor aspect choice**: Armor aspects differ much more in mechanics than weapon or spellbook aspect procs, so choosing an aspect usually means choosing the armor aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **armor aspect impact**: The aspect on armor is typically much more impactful than the aspect on the held item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554562866105942074)
