- **armor penalties**: Wearing armor carries no hiding or stealth penalty on this server, but armor does impact meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550342331696156794)
- **armor set aspect activation cost**: Activating an armor set's aspect costs 5 essence, and typically only one armor set should be activated at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548319805738590251)
- **armor slots**: There are 6 armor slots in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552089863178821717)
- **artisan aspect tier 15 xp**: Artisan is an easy harvest aspect to bring to T15 first, which enables the redline XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527534309236408403)
- **aspect activation armor color change**: When an aspect is activated, the worn armor changes colour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887037214687384)
- **aspect armor activation requirement**: Fully activating an aspect requires wearing a full suit of armor, and any armor type works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553886932810076273)
- **aspect armor set requirements**: A full armor set needed for an aspect is 6 pieces (head, neck, chest, legs, arms, gloves); casters wear leather and everyone else wears plate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554514308539355147)
- **aspect core combining**: These items may be combinable into Aspect Cores, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601884377288744)
- **aspect experience split**: Aspect experience is split 50% to the armor aspect and 50% to the aspect on the weapon held in hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551788751376748651)
- **aspect hue selection**: Use the manage hues button at the top of the aspect gump to choose the aspect hue; three hues are available by default, plus any others purchased in the customization menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549975996810268723)
- **aspect level requirements**: Each level of an aspect requires more cores and distills than the previous level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887493483401246)
- **aspect level-up reapplication**: After leveling up an aspect you do not need to reapply it; it uses whatever tier is set in the aspect gump, which becomes the new highest level automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554507769531473951)
- **aspect leveling materials**: Cores and distillations are needed to level up an aspect, and the essence icon shows how much essence remains and when it will warn you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553885523708477481)
- **aspect leveling per character**: Aspects are leveled independently on each character, so swapping between aspects without losing progress only works on the same character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416078658605082)
- **aspect requirement for redline experience**: Redline experience can probably be gained without being aspected, but this has not been tested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548368976348848230)
- **aspect tier activation cost**: Activating a lower tier of an aspect uses less arcane essence than activating a higher tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546486715919892500)
- **aspect tier cap**: The aspect tier cap is reportedly 15 before redline and 20 if redline points are used, but leveling beyond 15 is extremely costly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554501672124944405)
- **aspect tier charge consumption**: Upgrading an aspect to a higher tier makes it consume more charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548217977525112957)
- **aspect toggle for helmet, gloves and neck**: The aspect appearance can reportedly be toggled on or off for free on the helmet, gloves and neck slots, while customizing other slots costs millions in unlocks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551703130289475746)
- **aspect xp scale**: Aspect gains 1/100th the normal amount of XP because it was the first XP system introduced and uses different numbers, but progression per mob difficulty is equivalent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550561457421422615)
- **aspects on fishing poles**: Aspects cannot be applied to a fishing pole, though this is stated with some uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409246002225162)
- **aspects sharing**: Aspects are not shared across an account; they are character-only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000214872006657)
- **aspects system**: Aspects enhance damage and survivability and grant abilities, but consume arcane energy and require materials plus exp points to level up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550699819868233749)
- **attacking guild-tagged bosses**: If you attack a boss tagged by a guild, you temporarily flag orange (enemy) to that guild, and its members may kill you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547724407760359525)
- **attacks on tamed pets**: Other players can possibly attack your tamed pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554292632396632146)
- **auto-blessed items**: Spellbooks holding spells, Chivalry and Necromancy books, codices (Codex progression items) and bank checks usually come blessed automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016986524647434)
- **autoloot availability**: Outlands has no loot-all or autoloot feature; the only options are grid loot and grab item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555382239326371931)
- **automatic last target casting**: Spells do not automatically cast on the last target by default because automatic targeting would cost the player too much control. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553944528732422185)
- **autousespellscrolls command**: The [autousespellscrolls command makes spell casting automatically use scrolls instead of reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549193596543172639)
- **backpack grid loot layout**: The backpack cannot be made to look like the grid loot layout, although some backpack display overrides are available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551917817035759687)
- **bag contents recognition after login**: After logging in, the game does not recognize an item inside a bag, such as a spellstone, until the bag is opened again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160964431675502)
- **bank box stockpiles**: Stockpiles exist for the bank box, allowing the queue to be used for region bonuses and Society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549786584188981390)
- **bank gold deposit command**: There is no command to deposit gold into the bank; only withdrawing gold has a command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550498961431863336)
- **bard codex buff target settings**: The bard codex settings offer buff-target options beyond just party members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292651037393038)
- **base hit points**: Every character has 100 HP, rising to 120 HP with a strength potion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338604956385384)
- **bedroll logout in dungeons**: A bedroll does not work for logging out inside dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546976940844646452)
- **beneficial and harmful last targets**: There are separate beneficial and harmful last targets: beneficial spells like heal go to the beneficial last target, and hostile spells like energy bolt go to the harmful last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553946003072225381)
- **blessable items**: Most items cannot be blessed; fancy clothing, runebooks and rune tomes can be blessed using a type-specific bless deed, and until blessed they can be lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016986524647434)
- **blessed 48-spell spellbook contents**: A blessed 48-spell spellbook contains only the vendor-available spells and no 7th or 8th circle spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550785486555971689)
- **blessed items on death**: Blessed items never end up on your corpse and return to the top level of your backpack on death; if inside a blessed adventurer's satchel, the satchel returns to the top layer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196361589465159)
- **blessing clothing**: Clothing items can be blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548164313418571899)
- **blessing weapons and armor**: Weapons and armor cannot be blessed, which includes the shepherd's crook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855898045292636)
- **blue meteors event**: Strange blue-hued meteors fall from the sky in Outlands, and the impacted areas swarm with dangerous creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533926874252578988)
- **boat crew**: Veteran crew such as a medic and a boat repairs person can be added to a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534127480909205575)
- **boating xp and link unlocks**: Boating gives very good XP, which can be used to unlock links by fishing or by hunting PvM boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553463332558606457)
- **bonded mount quest limit**: The bonded mount quest can only be completed once per Outlands ID, so a spare bonded mount can be shared with an alt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544812632140283915)
- **bonded pet left out at logoff**: A bonded (level 1) pet left out of the stable when you log off can be retrieved and is not lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554136629063585913)
- **bonuses when pvp flagged**: Some bonuses switch off entirely while PvP flagged and are replaced by generic PvM damage and damage resistance bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549347113366982677)
- **book of grifts and grudges refund reason**: The Book of Grifts and Grudges was refunded because its fundamental operation was changed, whereas resource map tomes continue to store maps as before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528233956195963061)
- **books of grifts and grudges reset**: The books of grifts and grudges reset every week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550530040037384283)
- **bronze link activation**: A bronze link (chain) must be activated before its bonuses, such as poison damage, apply; either equip it, or single-click it and activate it via the context menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546189400252354570)
- **browsing guild information**: Guild information for all guilds on the server can be browsed in the in-game guild menu under "diplomacy". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546206013018087424)
- **buff bar customization**: Right-click the buff bars to choose which buffs and debuffs they display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546042028146823218)
- **caddellite meteor debris**: A meteor event may leave caddellite debris at its landing site, though this is based on a single uncertain player observation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541582235893771)
- **camping requirement for harvest maps**: The test server requirement to camp for harvest maps was a bug that the developer said he would fix, and the gump is not planned to require camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534386309974724658)
- **carry weight limit**: The carry weight limit is 450 stones, which is easily exceeded when looting everything (such as regs, bandages and arrows) while running harvest and T4-5 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542358547566694431)
- **cartography bonus to resource map yield**: A player suggests that Cartography should boost resource map yield proportionally, as it boosts trap damage, but this is a design proposal and not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107891573035048)
- **chain link xp and character slots**: Each account has 5 character slots, and chain link XP is tied to the account's first character, so players are advised to do chain content on that character; this is an uncertain claim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548551315842400289)
- **changing spell color on screen**: To change the color of spells on screen, check the combat spells section of the options menu (possibly options > speech > you speech color); Razor also has a spell-related setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554458276253401170)
- **chaos and order mount token requirements**: Using a Chaos or Order mount token has no requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547418536866095164)
- **character deletion**: To delete a character, wait a week, then hover over the character name on the login screen and click the red X. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496804214087771)
- **checking active pvp bonuses**: Click the blue 'pvp mechanics' gem in the bottom left of the screen to see which bonuses remain active in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549346309444468747)
- **checking barding success chances**: Open Help, then player stats, then barding to see your chances of success against monsters, which are based on monster difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554927558091472928)
- **checking durability of worn gear**: To check durability of worn gear and your equipped weapon, use [stats or open help / player stats and click the equipment gem at the bottom left; it lists worn gear and current durability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549743280848113685)
- **checking equipment durability with stats**: Typing [stats and opening the equipment tab shows the current durability of worn equipment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549702133299941410)
- **checking follower limit**: Open your status window to check whether you are over the follower limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555614915484721284)
- **checking journal log after interference**: Log off, which saves your journal to a text file, then read that file to see whether someone was interfering with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554290727465394187)
- **checking society reset time**: Click the quest icon on the paperdoll to see the days and hours remaining until the society reset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545609833519120414)
- **chest link stacking**: Chest success/progress links stack multiplicatively rather than additively, so 10 bronze links give a 30% bonus and a 70% chest success chance becomes 91% (70*1.3) instead of 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543361125008154664)
- **chest opening aspect experience split**: When opening chests, aspect experience is split as usual between aspects if different aspects are on your armor and in your hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555358981742927976)
- **chest trap death recovery**: If a chest trap kills you, you can exit the inn room and re-enter as a ghost, which resurrects you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546287971307880520)
- **chest trap types**: Not all chest traps cause explosions; some only reveal you and prevent hiding for a period of time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550317023450497129)
- **chest xp calculation**: XP gained from chests is reportedly based on the gold value of the loot, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550850212204122226)
- **chivalry ability hotbar**: Chivalry abilities can be accessed by double-clicking the white book in your backpack and opening the hotbar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548206681174057071)
- **chivalry gate bonuses in pvp**: Chivalry gate bonuses may not apply in PvP, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552711871013060699)
- **chivalry gate marked locations**: A Chivalry gate holds 1 marked location by default, and extra marked locations can be obtained. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533033182679662602)
- **chivalry personal moongate**: Players with Chivalry can create a personal moongate that can take them and others to dungeons and cities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553536273296269396)
- **client object delay queue option**: Uncheck the client option 'object delay queue'; when enabled it queues repeated actions done faster than 600 ms, such as equipping a weapon, and replays them later, wasting seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546855303885361162)
- **closing anchored gumps**: Alt + right-click closes anchored gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544729535566712853)
- **closing extra health bars**: Extra health bar boxes can be closed with alt + right click, and a setting reportedly exists to auto close them when the target dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570886545248266)
- **clothing bless deeds**: Clothing bless deeds can be used on items so they are not lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549753580846714961)
- **codex ability commands and macros**: To trigger Codex stances, finishers and abilities by macro, look up the commands in help/commands/codex and bind the chosen command to an ingame macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093585594978365)
- **codex activation requirement**: Owning a codex gives no immediate benefit; it must be leveled to unlock its bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612630066135201)
- **codex and abilities hotbar commands**: Type [codexhotbar or [abilitieshotbar to open a hotbar for other codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548209323744821249)
- **codex and aspect carryover on build switch**: Maxed codexes and levelled aspects carry over when switching builds on the same character, saving the cost of cores needed to level a new character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548553251455111290)
- **codex and bestiary experience**: Experience in the healer codex or bestiary is gained from killing mobs, not from healing pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544665351734698025)
- **codex experience gain without equipping**: Experience toward a codex can be gained even when it is not the codex currently in use, provided the player has the skills for it, e.g. with Tactics and two weapon skills one can gain toward one weapon codex while another weapon type is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300337418244157)
- **codex experience locations**: Codex experience can be gained in Sanctuary dungeons but probably not on Shelter Island or in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548072786235363380)
- **codex experience without codex in inventory**: On the live shard, experience is gained for Taming bestiary, healer and bard codices even when the codex is not in your inventory, according to a player test. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551296213628747879)
- **codex finisher trigger threshold**: Codex finishers can trigger when the enemy being fought is at low health, with the threshold scaling from 5% health at rank 1 up to 25% health at rank 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549955985555202069)
- **codex hotbar visibility**: The codex hotbar may not appear if your codex level is too low, though this is only a guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548209809373929522)
- **codex improvements in pvp**: Codex improvements generally give no PvP bonuses, but while flagged you still get bonus healing from greater heal potions, disease and bleed cure from panacea, and a shorter bandage timer from the healing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820404387291190)
- **codex leveling for inactive echo**: To level a codex for an inactive echo, you still need the required skills on your currently active echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300164591812713)
- **codex point persistence**: Once a codex point is earned it is unlocked permanently and does not need to be re-earned when swapping loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550936701852061717)
- **codex point reset**: Most codex points can be reset freely by clicking the reset points button, though weapon and parry codexes are exceptions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551007801055248497)
- **codex rank 0 effect**: Rank 0 of a codex ability does nothing, and the first rank grants the first increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546294011344723979)
- **codex scalar in resource map patch notes**: The codex scalar mentioned in the initial resource map patch notes was removed by Luthius after a day or two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536837753646350416)
- **codex single-click display**: Single-clicking a Codex displays the player's selected Stance and, if one is activated, their selected Finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **codex special attacks**: A codex lets you set up special attacks that give different effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554953320190443571)
- **codex system**: Codex are blessed items carried on your character, determined by your template and chosen skills; using related skills or abilities earns exp points that can be applied to the Codex to enhance abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550699819868233749)
- **codex with shield**: The Codex works normally while a shield is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381246751211531)
- **codex xp**: Codices earn XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544749952054468650)
- **codices are blessed**: Codices such as the Wizards Grimoire are blessed, so they cannot be stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584435281137685)
- **collecting arcane essence**: Identify magic items you won't use and recycle them to collect arcane essence, the fuel that powers aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054397417853010)
- **collector box settings**: Overlapping collector boxes malfunction, and the Murderer option should not be checked on gray collector boxes because it will collect red mobs such as the omni boss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554878197584236737)
- **command spell proc feedback**: When Command Spell procs from Greater Heal, a sound effect and animation play, plus a buff shows how much of the bonus damage remains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547235921282203659)
- **container auto-stacking**: Items dropped onto a container automatically stack with matching items already in that container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364237117394964)
- **container id wand**: A container ID wand can be bought on the Portal to identify items in a container, for players who are no longer Young. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548189158340821093)
- **context menus via shift-click**: To get context menus from clicking, go to Options > General > Gumps & Context and toggle 'hold shift for context menus'; with it on, shift+click the health bar to open the interact menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547242187975163974)
- **cooldown on switching tmapper to harvesting**: Switching from a tmapper setup to harvesting is subject to a cooldown that was added to Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531106329295589606)
- **cooldown timer triggers**: A cooldown timer can be started by several triggers, including a buff being removed from your buff bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565065884115086)
- **corpse decay to bones**: After the blue-corpse period the corpse turns grey, and roughly 10 minutes later it becomes bones, which anyone can loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016305130737856)
- **corpse lootable and decay timers**: Non-player corpses become freely lootable after about 5 minutes and decay roughly 5 minutes later, while player corpses use 15 minutes and 15 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555493049038143489)
- **corpse name clutter settings**: To reduce corpse name clutter, open the general options and adjust the 'show incoming mobiles' and 'show incoming corpses' settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554497660671500389)
- **corpse skin disease application**: Corpse Skin only applies disease with directly damaging spells and does not apply it with poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545179815924207747)
- **counters feature**: The Counters feature is toggled under Options > Counters; you can drag and drop items onto squares to monitor item counts and right click squares to use the item, remove it, or assign it to a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554806879702622209)
- **cracking objects aspect proc boost**: Cracking these objects temporarily increases your Aspect Proc chances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601759865049098)
- **crafters for weekly society quests**: Having crafters is very worthwhile for the weekly society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846413567594567)
- **crafting and mastery chain xp**: Crafting items does not give mastery chain XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552476186591105095)
- **creating echoes from banked arcane essence**: To create an echo that requires a large amount of arcane essence, consume essence so the echo is created from your character's banked pool of essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553523889349464156)
- **creating macros**: Open Options > Macros to create a new macro entry, choose an action, then set a hotkey and/or generate a button that performs the macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553139849433841827)
- **creature corpse decay rules**: Per the April 4 2024 patch notes, a carved creature corpse with 0 items decays after 60 consecutive seconds, and an uncarved corpse with 0 items decays after 5 consecutive minutes; standard decay is typically 15 minutes but varies for bosses and event creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555494141037645868)
- **creature experience source**: A creature's experience is tied to its creature difficulty rather than the gold it drops, though difficulty roughly correlates with gold dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546648773642424340)
- **cursor stuck holding item**: If your cursor is stuck holding an item (for example when Razor gets stuck), you may be unable to double-click your main bag, and relogging can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549823536833765520)
- **cutting up player corpses**: Players can cut up other players' corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196987438080151)
- **daemon scroll summoning of greater or elder daemons**: Outlands has no known mechanic that uses daemon scrolls to summon a stronger Greater or Elder daemon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548026783427858444)
- **damage tracker command**: A damagetracker, invoked with the [damagetracker command, is available for running damage tests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546374655949152307)
- **decoded t-map time limit**: After the T-map update, a decoded map must be completed within 1 hour of decoding or it is deleted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **default aspect level cap**: The default maximum level for an aspect in one field is 15, and most players stop at that level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **defensive links list**: Defensive links include Melee Defense, Physical Damage Resistance and Spell Damage Resistance, among others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527331052836753529)
- **detecting hidden immunity message**: A Detecting Hidden message saying the target is immune means the player has lockpicked within the last 60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552248081863671861)
- **developer intent for t8 maps**: The developers do not want T8 maps to be soloable, and a major goal has been to remove solo T8 runs for many players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528901989445144628)
- **disabling aspect gain messages**: Aspect gain overhead messages can be turned off through the text menu opened with the [Commands command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529185310104359052)
- **dispelling gates on outlands**: On Outlands, dispelling a gate with Dispel Field removes it on both sides, unlike old-school UO where only the dispelled side was removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536559315039686667)
- **distill use in mount breeding**: Distills can be used for mount breeding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679327864426547)
- **double click looting**: Double clicking an item in a container sends it directly to your set loot bag, or to your main backpack if none is set, and this works for bank items and monster corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293573418291210)
- **double proc of maps inside chests**: After the patch, maps found inside chests can double proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825306751434904)
- **dragon fire breath ability type**: Dragon fire breath is likely just a basic attack and not an immolation ability for taming bestiary purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545105728929267823)
- **dropping items onto character**: Dropping an item onto your character is treated as dropping it into the top level of your backpack, so loot held in a sub-container is not automatically stacked into that sub-container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364032938934383)
- **dungeon chest respawn time**: Dungeon chest respawn time increases with chest level, and very low level chests probably respawn in about 15 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554841190619160627)
- **dungeon flashpoint event**: Dungeon Flashpoint is a PvP king-of-the-hill style event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553463550125801505)
- **dungeon re-entry cooldown after death**: There is no cooldown to re-enter a dungeon after dying unless you are Red, and then it applies only if you committed crimes while inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554856241795301501)
- **duplicate lore pages**: When gathering lore pages, you can receive the same lore page more than once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552964880490037282)
- **earth phylactery guaranteed aspect proc**: A phylactery such as the Earth Phylactery gives one guaranteed aspect proc for its matching aspect, usable once per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **echo and codex reuse across builds**: An Echo helps with xp for your chain and allows using multiple aspects on the same character, and a leveled codex does not need to be leveled again for another build that uses it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545341347202998303)
- **echo build switching**: An 'Echo' can reportedly be made in the future that lets a player switch between character builds, but it is not confirmed as currently available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555299801258664009)
- **echo builds**: Unlocking the first Echo slot stores your current build as a second build on the same character, giving access to 2 builds; both start identical, you train the new one up and can swap back to the original. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550486743575437342)
- **echo characters via codexes**: Additional characters with other weapon skills can be created later as echoes using other codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554396456142643213)
- **echo command for viewing build**: Type [echo to display your character's build (skills). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550147328470679613)
- **echo duplication overwrite**: Copying a different echo over an existing echo replaces it entirely, so copying the wrong echo over a 120 mining echo loses that echo's skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541437207473037312)
- **echo duplication warning**: The red confirmation warning shown when duplicating an echo displays the skills of the two copies being duplicated rather than the echo being overwritten, so it does not clearly show what will be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541511823746924677)
- **echo system**: The echo system lets a character keep multiple skill and stat profiles while retaining progression toward codices, aspects, and leaderboards without swapping between characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553545066843209839)
- **echoes**: Echoes are a mid-game purchase that gives a character an additional template of skills and stats that can be swapped to, with a cooldown between swaps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690018314813554)
- **echoes as character versions**: Echoes are different versions of the same character, so many players prefer one PvM character with many echoes and aspects over many separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549315502550159482)
- **effective harvesting skill cap**: There is no hard cap on effective harvesting skill; a player could theoretically reach 167.5 with a T20 Harvest aspect and 15 Corrupted Harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **effective inscription effects**: Effective Inscription counts toward interrupt avoidance/immunity, spell scroll damage boost, scroll refund, buff duration, and spell perks like reactive armor hardiness, but not toward crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549151553024295035)
- **effective mining skill formula**: Effective mining skill equals raw skill plus harvest aspect plus harvest links, and it does not matter how the total reaches 110. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935059283116033)
- **effective skill on chests link**: The 'Effective Skill on Chests' link gives about 4.5 effective skill at gold tier, much more than the roughly 1.5 skill from harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527078946045165670)
- **eldritch aspect tier 6 inscription bonus**: The Eldritch aspect at tier 6 grants +125 inscription, enabling capped scroll casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544542914833813514)
- **enlarging health bar**: To enlarge your health bar, enable Options > Nameplates > Compact nameplates, or increase Options > Video > Display Scale to make the whole interface larger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548409408592023583)
- **enlarging vendor buy gump**: The vendor buy gump can be enlarged by clicking and dragging the small blue gem at the bottom of the gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544165576190992414)
- **equipping unidentified items**: Unidentified items can be equipped, but their bonuses are more effective once identified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548189063041908818)
- **essence usage and recycling**: Most builds need to recycle everything they find to keep up with essence usage, though it can sometimes be more efficient to take gold instead and buy essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553904498471346201)
- **essence yield from identified items**: Identified items give more arcane essence when recycled than unidentified ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553526424617492500)
- **estimating rope range with out-of-range color option**: Enable 'No color for objects out of range' in Options > General to show an 18-tile range cutoff as grayscale, then place the cursor roughly halfway between the character and the grayscale cutoff to estimate distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546901250958958672)
- **estimating unlocked mastery link slots**: Without a chain, estimate your unlocked mastery link slots by checking your gold-collected achievements (Achievements > Luxury > Affluent) against the cumulative gold table on the mastery chain wiki page; this is only a rough estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553061265293975554)
- **evaluating intelligence spell damage bonus**: In Outlands, Evaluating Intelligence at 100 skill gives a 50% spell damage increase, while 0 skill gives a -25% damage penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544888385640992870)
- **experience sharing in parties**: Guild membership does not share experience automatically; you must form a party and check the EXP sharing box in the party window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553031475996262525)
- **explorer pack consumption on map actions**: Players must have Explorer Packs in their backpack, which are consumed on successful completion of Decode Map and Reveal Camp actions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534323547634143262)
- **explorer pack use when digging too far**: Digging in a location too far from the chest might still consume an explorer pack, so more than 2 packs may be needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212776177827890)
- **extra gold drop chance link on treasure chests**: The extra gold drop chance link likely applies to treasure chests, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316087214604359)
- **faction city war**: Four cities are at war in the faction system, and players can opt in to that conflict for bonus rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671929312809043)
- **faction hue requirements**: Faction hues require faction participation to wear, at least on clothes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545950420575199262)
- **faction names**: The four factions are Prevalia, Andaria, Terran and Cambria, and they represent major cities without much deeper lore or mechanics behind them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546698299195523082)
- **faction score earning limit per outlands id**: If you earn faction score on one character, no other character on the same Outlands ID can earn faction score until 1 hour has passed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537964440811471000)
- **feeding distills to essence**: Distills can be fed into essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679267931750430)
- **finding a buff name**: To find a buff's name, hover over it in your buff bar while it is active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565137225027726)
- **finisher selection**: Each codex offers two Finishers to choose from, toggled with the large button next to each, and players can switch between them freely at no cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **fishing aspect alternatives**: There is no alternative aspect for fishing other than the Harvesting aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409534826061954)
- **fishing echo placement**: A fishing echo should be created on the character that has the harvester aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527124010142404618)
- **fist hit and interrupt avoidance formula**: The chance to hit with fists and to avoid interrupts while casting equals (attacker's wrestling + 50) / ((defender's weapon or wrestling skill + 50) * 2), plus relevant accuracy bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546656811484979220)
- **fixing missing nameplate**: If a character's name stops showing above it, open the nameplates menu (Ctrl+Shift) and un-check then re-check 'always active'; right-clicking removes the nameplate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544522180266561576)
- **follower limit pet obedience**: If you are over the 5 follower limit, your pets will only obey follow commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555614998242271322)
- **follower roping mechanic change**: Followers once roped alongside the player, but the developer Luthius changed the follower mechanics after Elderstone reported it, so followers no longer do this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531094471016452106)
- **following players as harassment**: Continually following a player between dungeons and areas to interfere with them can count as griefing or harassment, whereas merely taking mobs in a shared dungeon does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554994097637560391)
- **food buff duration**: The buff from eating food lasts 60 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522311963768651927)
- **food buff expiry alert**: To get a visible alert when a food buff wears off, create a cooldown in Options > Cooldown triggered by removal of that buff, enter the buff's name, and set a duration of 30 seconds to 1 minute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565065884115086)
- **food choice recommendation**: Players are advised to eat only the best food, such as Delectable food. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553908512860545055)
- **food mana regen effect**: Food gives a chance to regenerate 2 mana instead of 1 on each regen tick, and better food gives a higher chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545337746342543360)
- **food swing speed bonus and mining**: The swing speed bonus from eating food does not make mining faster and only helps if the character is also swinging a mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522216610633482342)
- **fortune armor experience bonus**: Fortune armor increases all experience gains, including chain, aspect and codex experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530996249241718896)
- **fortune aspect**: Fortune is the aspect that combines harvesting with some killing power. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539657444232265728)
- **fortune aspect early value**: Players are typically better off choosing a different aspect than Fortune until they have finished their codices and have a handful of chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413499140673617)
- **fortune aspect effects**: The Fortune aspect increases results for both chest opening and stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416534198030387)
- **fortune aspect experience value**: Fortune aspect only yields more experience if its bonus exp exceeds the extra exp a stronger aspect would give by killing faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552985403940929639)
- **fortune aspect proc feedback**: The Fortune aspect proc gives only a sound and an animation, with no system message or buff bar entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452450661011589)
- **fortune aspect progression speed**: A player running the Fortune aspect gains links, aspect levels and redline about 30% faster than a player running the Harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540050665668354069)
- **fortune aspect usage**: Most players use the Fortune aspect only for lockpicking, treasure maps, or boating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879211811741767)
- **fully safe places**: The only fully safe places are houses, inn rooms and sanctuaries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554293615952658444)
- **gate duration**: Gates last considerably longer than players expect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546225169700233337)
- **gatherer multiboxing removal**: There is unconfirmed discussion on test/admin chatter about removing the ability to multibox gatherers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532813928101576885)
- **gathering and redline experience**: Gathering does not currently contribute to redline experience, which largely locks gatherers out of a major area of the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525888080840757278)
- **ghost auto-teleport to town**: If you stay a ghost for an extended time, you are automatically sent to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549592654835224710)
- **ghost visibility and war mode**: Ghosts and living players see each other only when the ghost is in war mode, except for allies and players who opted in with the [GhostVisible command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287068381155411)
- **golemancy upcoming content**: Golemancy is reportedly an upcoming content addition in which crafting Golems will require gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547974832111620161)
- **gray hand thieves guild pilfering**: The Gray Hand thieves guild allows you to pilfer from monsters, which yields gold and a chance at an item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550327206952181791)
- **greater strength potion hit point bonus**: A greater strength potion gives about 20 extra hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784964800315443)
- **grey hand thief attackability**: A Grey Hand thief is not open to being attacked anytime and anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550883151109296130)
- **grid loot**: Grid loot, enabled in Options > General, shows a book-like menu of a corpse's loot where clicking items loots them into the set loot bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555382402275082271)
- **grimoire magery specificity**: The grimoire is Magery specific and gives bonuses to various spellcasts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919281572118559)
- **guild activities**: Guilds offer lucrative activities such as very high level treasure maps that scale with the number of participating players, caravans, and dungeon crawls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672655627718759)
- **guild boss summoning cost**: Guilds must earn gold in the dungeon to summon their boss, the cost increases with each summon, and the cost resets on Fridays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553159064408555541)
- **guild leaving cooldown**: Leaving a guild in Outlands costs the player nothing personally, but a three-day cooldown applies before the player can join another guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545228188022476851)
- **guild membership scope**: Guild membership is per character, not per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292920282226700)
- **guild prestige rewards**: Guilds can earn prestige rewards, including a custom guild house or island at roughly 5000 prestige. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143965146259498)
- **guild requirements for pvp events**: Dungeon flashpoints and town pvp require being in a guild, while shrines do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552948768662622250)
- **guild swap timers**: A 3-day timer applies to swapping guilds, added because players used to constantly jump guilds for harvest buffs; it also applies to PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529095950415560744)
- **gump manager red pin**: To use a gump placed in the gump manager, hold ctrl+alt until a red pin appears on it, then click the red pin, though the click location can be finicky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546954828452995103)
- **harvest and fortune on treasure chests**: For treasure chests, the Harvest aspect increases gold while the Fortune aspect increases experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538108889281863710)
- **harvest aspect effective skill delay**: After activating the Harvest aspect, the effective skill bonus only takes effect after 60 seconds, so you do not have the boosted skill before then. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551100641168850946)
- **harvest aspect on weapon**: Having the Harvest aspect on a weapon does nothing for aspect experience gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555365201275256965)
- **harvest aspect proc links**: No link or mechanic is known to make the Harvest aspect proc more often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543521027253076048)
- **harvest aspect switch cooldown**: Harvest Aspect has a 60 second cooldown before it becomes active after switching to it, which was added to prevent quickly swapping aspects to open locked chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521056702001184858)
- **harvest experience with mixed aspects**: If weapon and armor carry different aspects, harvest experience is probably shared between them, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535914835257065583)
- **harvest gear switch cooldown**: After switching to harvest gear, there is a one-minute cooldown before the extra skill and proc chance take effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535717813875122266)
- **harvest level 10 experience requirement**: The experience required to reach the next Harvest level jumps considerably around Harvest level 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539274937548668928)
- **harvest map stealing after patch**: After the patch, in-progress harvest maps are blessed and cannot be stolen mid-harvest, while undecided (not yet started) maps may still be stolen, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536938890395389972)
- **harvest tier 15 redline unlock**: Reaching harvest tier 15 gives a second redline unlock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520926331083165757)
- **harvesting aspect double chance**: The chance of the Harvesting Aspect doubling a stackable item scales with aspect tier, with a T15 aspect giving a 36% chance to double. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524197220981801051)
- **harvesting aspect doubling**: The Harvesting Aspect can double stackable harvested items, except redline bottles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524196485233770717)
- **harvesting aspect experience**: Actual harvesting activities such as lumberjacking and mining do not produce aspect experience for aspects other than the Harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555358981742927976)
- **harvesting aspect scope**: The Harvesting Aspect applies to all harvesting activities, including chopping trees and mining ore, not only treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523855058771509318)
- **health bar auto-open behavior**: Auto-open for health bars works only for NPCs; player enemies must be drag-selected into the matching collector box, though greys or reds may auto-open outside pvp events. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555577853129789581)
- **health bar collector box overlap**: When setting up multiple health bar collector boxes, they should not overlap, because overlapping breaks their behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555578451241738344)
- **hiding armor graphics**: There is apparently no option to hide equipped armor graphics other than helmets, so plate armor may clip through cosmetic clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547602256210432163)
- **hiding helmet graphic**: To hide the helmet graphic, go to Options > General > Mobiles and enable Hide Helmets in Paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601838797357067)
- **hiding in combat**: You cannot hide while in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615777379844176)
- **hiking immunity**: Players are immune to interruption or attack while hiking, including when using Camping to hike out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535322368032112794)
- **horse speed**: All horses run at the same speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545984062550843425)
- **hotbar availability**: Ultima Online: Outlands has no unified hotbar, but spell icons can be dragged from the spellbook and arranged into a bar shape. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546564789487014009)
- **household play on one outlands id**: Household members can play together on one Outlands ID while an MAH exemption is pending, but not together in a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553493054109786255)
- **ignore list behavior**: The in-game ignore list hides ignored players' speech in the game window but their speech may still appear in the journal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546469732654387201)
- **immolate modified abilities**: The only two abilities modified by Immolate are Flamestrike and Spellburn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545121510963028068)
- **infamy decay rate**: One infamy point is removed per day, at around 6 or 7pm CST according to one player's observation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy gain from sinking player ships**: A player gains 1 infamy for killing a player captain and another 1 infamy for sinking that captain's boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy red ship threshold**: A ship turns red at roughly 10 or more infamy, though this threshold has reportedly changed several times and the exact value is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy ship visibility range**: Each infamy point adds a raw +10 tiles to the distance from which other players can see your ship, capping at 30 infamy for +300 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy threshold for red name**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, a player's name turns red (murderer status) at 30 infamy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546675621206425731)
- **inscription effect on scroll buffs**: Inscription increases the duration of buff spells cast from scrolls, such as Bless, but not their strength; scroll buffs will still apply to Reactive Armor and Magic Reflection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549873824328196188)
- **item counter supported items**: The item counter works for chains, runebooks/tomes and clothing, as well as mount tokens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544484121806377010)
- **item identification effect**: Identifying an item does not change the item or raise its sell value; it only reveals exactly which magic modifiers the item has. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551764410417025125)
- **item stat display and properties**: Outlands does not display weapon and armor stats and has fewer item properties than OSI, so players infer stats from the material or magic property rather than adding magical properties. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548162639203541023)
- **item stat inference**: Item stats are inferred from the item's material or magical properties, as described on the wiki Modifiers page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547902746600939551)
- **items kept on death**: Only items with a Blessed tag, shown when you click the item, do not drop on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016526375944285)
- **items with deletion countdown timers**: Items that show a countdown timer to deletion are usually quest-related, such as the Thanatite Shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631930477682739)
- **joining town struggle**: To join the Town Struggle, enter the gate that appears at the Prevalia bank, which takes you to a waiting area; when the event starts, another gate opens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554995746103894097)
- **journal customization**: Customize the Journal via the gear icon at its top right: enable 'Hide Messages In Game Viewport' to stop chat and system messages in the viewport, set Border Style to Minimalism, and right-click to add tabs with custom filters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551341873631858819)
- **karma effects of stealing and killing mobs**: Stealing from mobs likely lowers karma, while killing them, such as by backstabbing, increases it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545143497575637002)
