- **karma locking at ankh**: Karma can be locked at an ankh so that it can only decrease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545145369015353476)
- **keeping chat entry open**: To keep the chat entry open without pressing Enter, enable the relevant setting under Options > Speech; hotkeys may not work while the chat box is up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551330006536421437)
- **killed released pets**: If you release a pet and someone kills it, it is permanently gone, even if it was bonded before release. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380982317121559)
- **killing track during treasure map hunting**: Killing a track can now be done from outside a house while the player is inside it, a change to treasure map hunting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537988661734281366)
- **lantern toggle with double click loot setting**: With 'double click to loot items inside containers' enabled, a lantern cannot be toggled on unless it is in your hands, while unchecking the option lets you toggle it anywhere; lanterns on the ground toggle regardless of the setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088576508039169)
- **lanterns going out in containers**: Lanterns go out when put away in containers, which may be intended behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544087829905412268)
- **last laugh perk looting restriction**: If an attacker kills a player with the Last Laugh perk and then dies, the attacker is on a wilderness timer and cannot loot that player on any character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529672906572042281)
- **leaderboard points from maps**: Resource maps and Message in a Bottle maps provide leaderboard points, which appeals to leaderboard grinders and evens the ground between MIB players and PvPers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531445008891384019)
- **leaderboard season length**: Seasons on the Outlands leaderboards reportedly last 90 days, though this comes from a passing remark and is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525906033359192074)
- **leaderboards**: Other leaderboards exist besides the mapping leaderboard, and the mapping leaderboard remains open to everyone since all mappers are slowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536937911344439297)
- **leaving the strangelands event**: Type [stranglelands to open the event menu, which contains an exit button to leave the Strangelands event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550151849544384583)
- **level 0 mount death risk**: A level 0 mount that is not levelled up to level 1 or higher might die, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841540145356872)
- **level 10 aspect color requirement**: Level 10 is not required to show normal armor material instead of the aspect hue; it is required only to use the color of another aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551703224346476565)
- **leveling aspects**: Players are advised to level an aspect rather than farm with a capped aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548218323945394251)
- **link slot unlocking**: Link slots are unlocked by farming gold, which earns chain XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147974328614955)
- **lockpicker on pvm account unlocking links**: A lockpicker on your PvM account helps unlock links for your PvM character regardless of which aspect you pick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544500266596831292)
- **logging in multiple accounts simultaneously**: To log in with additional accounts at the same time, launch the client a second or third time and choose the other accounts in each instance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329742605226026)
- **logging out with pet in inn room**: You can log out with your pet in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554136722785304581)
- **logout time outside houses and inns**: The logout time when not in a house or inn is likely 5 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548558864356479086)
- **loot goblin necessity after planned change**: A planned change is expected to remove the need to use the loot goblin, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531101979420659822)
- **loot link caps**: Gold and doubloon loot links cap at 10, whereas special loot links cap at 20. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540196072964489246)
- **loot weight reduction**: No bags reduce the weight of loot; a common way to manage weight while out is to carry an ID wand and something to recycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548440347011452969)
- **lost pet retrieval**: Lost pets can be retrieved only by going to a Stablekeeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554099620127178834)
- **lowering karma by snooping or poisoning**: According to the Outlands Reputation wiki page, repeatedly snooping or poisoning could lower karma. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545140913909796946)
- **mage aspect armor type**: Mages should use leather armor for their aspect armor suit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887168957648947)
- **magic item recycler auto keep**: The Magic Item Recycler has options to automatically keep specific modifier types, so you can hold onto good gear to use or sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **magic item recycler box**: The magic item recycler box can be configured to keep the items you want to retain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550678083303112847)
- **magical item identification**: Magical items always have to be identified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548841692294160456)
- **mah account harvesting restriction**: MAH accounts are flagged as such and cannot harvest; attempting to harvest on one returns a system message saying harvesting cannot be done on a MAH account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537960282255663105)
- **mah account structure**: A MAH setup consists of 3 accounts of its own, and MAH accounts are flagged as such and linked to their parent accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537960282255663105)
- **mana refund cap**: With T0 aspects and a rosewood staff, a mage is already over the cap for mana refund. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546229520560816138)
- **mana refund chance from wrestling and focus**: Wrestling gives a 12% mana refund chance when casting spells and Focus gives a 15% mana refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546226905621991575)
- **mana-free casting wands**: There are no wands that allow casting without mana, because spells are balanced around requiring mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554526508393955453)
- **manual map sorting removal**: Manual sorting of maps into tomes has been removed from the game and replaced by a new map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544886196503580773)
- **map decoding changes**: After the map changes, players reportedly can no longer decode multiple maps and complete all of them in a single area, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529666081378009178)
- **map gump hiking**: Hiking through the map gump works only for the character with Cartography, so other characters need a gate to be brought to the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546213099621715968)
- **map tome decoded map storage**: After the upcoming tome change, map tomes can no longer hold decoded maps, though they could before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238833597157498)
- **mark cave tiles client setting**: The client settings include a 'Mark cave tiles' option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550402782752677988)
- **mass undecode of decoded maps**: The admins mass-undecoded all decoded maps ahead of the T-map update, and undecoding maps does not refund spyglasses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531025634585874443)
- **mastery chain account placement**: Anything that benefits from the mastery chain should be kept on one account; this is an extensive list, so most players end up using echoes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549507371070521527)
- **mastery chain experience from fishing and mibs**: Killing mobs while fishing and mobs in bottles (MiBs) gives mastery chain experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522205781162852473)
- **mastery chain link activation**: An installed mastery chain link shows 0% until the chain is activated; once activated it works even when the link is only in your bag and not worn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656928460836945)
- **mastery chain quest rewards**: The mastery chain quest gives the player both a random link and a reforge tool to teach how the system works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656383033675868)
- **mastery chain size and total xp**: The mastery chain system has about 30 link slots to unlock, and maxing it reportedly takes roughly 120 million total experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546748154563661884)
- **mastery chain type**: Mastery chain type is purely cosmetic; all chains function the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548410070897926218)
- **mastery chain xp past harvest aspect t15**: Echo and ocean fishing can be used to gain the mastery chain XP needed to progress beyond harvest aspect T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553434856938016779)
- **mastery xp from treasure maps and mibs**: Treasure maps and ocean MIBs (messages in bottles) grant mastery XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553438610311614585)
- **maximum follower count**: The maximum number of followers is 5 for every character and cannot be increased; some minions take 2 slots and others take 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550933391245844482)
- **meanings of defense**: The word 'defense' has two uses in the game: the lowest-level magic armor prefix, and the defense links in mastery chains along with the defense stat that helps avoid being hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551186014016512062)
- **melee codex tier strength**: Each tier in melee weapon codices gives a smaller boost than tiers in point-limited codices, so they must be leveled more to give noticeable benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547611980125315142)
- **meta build requirements**: Meta builds generally require 30 links on the mastery chain, high tier aspects, and sometimes large amounts of resources or an expensive kit, along with in-depth knowledge of mob mechanics and dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544488043929665596)
- **metabolism buff**: Metabolism is reportedly getting a buff, which would help keep pets alive while harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532873602670792924)
- **meteor landing on tmap dig spot**: A meteor can land directly on top of a treasure map dig spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545542831173799966)
- **mib system leaderboard**: The MIB system has a leaderboard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532091756542169129)
- **mine.gumps.xml counter entry format**: Each counter entry in mine.gumps.xml is a control line with a graphic attribute (item ID) and a hue attribute, matching the ID and hue values shown by the >info command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **mining codex smelting**: The Mining Codex lets a player smelt ore from anywhere at set intervals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530390024615624714)
- **modifiers applying to followers**: Modifiers generally apply to followers only when their description explicitly says so. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554950246268674079)
- **monster loot changes**: Normal monster loot has not changed, but loot obtained through scavenging and pilfering has been altered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547267612512227519)
- **mount statue cast time**: Mount statues have no cast time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537813490159583272)
- **mounting from the item counter**: To mount without lifting the mount token from your pack, place the mount token into a cell of the item counter bar (using an Adventure Satchel), then mount from the item counter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544483969783959552)
- **mounts in dungeons**: A mount you are riding is stored away when you enter a dungeon unless you dismounted before entering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274983160938648)
- **moving cooldown icons**: To move a cooldown icon, hold Alt or Shift while dragging it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631740521848974)
- **moving ui elements out of a book**: To move a UI element such as a spell icon out of a book, click and hold on it and drag it out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550622334266642554)
- **multi-account household setup**: To set up a multi-account household, open a support ticket with the admins, since only admins can handle it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553472746569076801)
- **multi-client limit**: Players are allowed to run 3 game clients in parallel, subject to caveats listed in the server rules. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547427077618143323)
- **multiboxing and scripts**: Multiboxing multiple characters cannot realistically be done without scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525627100617511104)
- **multiboxing rules in pvp**: Using a second character before PVP starts (for example to mark a chiv gate or find a target) is allowed, but using a second client to heal yourself after PVP has begun can get you banned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532076207292547233)
- **multiple character logins per outlands id**: An Outlands ID is not the same as an account; only one character can be logged in per account at a time, but up to 3 characters can be logged in total, one from each account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329796963270727)
- **multiple characters in dungeons and boats**: Only one character per player at a time is reportedly allowed inside dungeons or when performing actions on a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367833490587840)
- **multiple codex per character**: A character can have multiple codex active at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676722059546795)
- **multiple map types at once**: The overhaul removes the ability to run different map types at the same time using multiple characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **nameplate menu and group editing**: Hold Shift+Ctrl to open the nameplate menu, and edit nameplate groups in Options > Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545530917991489580)
- **necro scroll sources**: Necromancy scrolls drop from the undead progressive spawns at graveyards, burial grounds and similar locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723457439993897)
- **new treasure map system steps**: Under the new treasure map system, players return to base to decode the map, wait a 15 second timer, go through a flowchart, and then follow an arrow to an unplanned location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528207547834699907)
- **newly tamed creature release timer**: A newly tamed creature is safe to release for 60 minutes after taming, but each release resets that timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549494109641773098)
- **non-tamer pet limit**: A non-tamer can only have 1 pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554796094884683898)
- **notoriety options hiding nameplates**: Notoriety options in the nameplate settings can hide a mob's nameplate when it becomes aggressive or hits you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545537408513220688)
- **npc full name display**: The full name of an NPC including its profession title cannot be shown permanently; names appear only when you approach the NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551252561531764827)
- **npc healer resurrection prompt bug**: The NPC healer resurrection prompt sometimes bugs, and walking away a short distance and approaching the healer again can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555684342838206535)
- **npc nameplates on drag select**: To show NPC nameplates when drag-selecting, open Options > General > Healthbars and Drag Select and set the drop-downs to match the keys held when grabbing specific healthbars; the exact settings are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552874602500333609)
- **obsolete tome conversion precedent**: When tomes have become obsolete in the past, staff have added a conversion option on an exchange NPC that converts them into other tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528233016311419060)
- **ocean redline cap**: The ocean was reported to have no redline cap, unlike the wilderness, though this may have changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898820912152667)
- **ocean redline xp per level**: Ocean Redline levels originally cost 200k XP each instead of 1 million, were later raised to 500k, and remain much cheaper than other Redline sources at higher levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900809972617369)
- **odd squares in dungeons from zoom**: Odd squares displayed in dungeons may be caused by the client being zoomed in; zoom level 5 is native resolution. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550402712057675847)
- **old partially completed maps**: Old partially completed maps appear in an unhued color and cannot be placed into a map tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536781330233172041)
- **on-demand map location assignment**: Under the new map system, a map's location is determined in real time on demand so the server can prevent two people from doing maps on top of each other, so old locations are presumably wiped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529347661025513575)
- **on-screen countdown icon cooldowns**: The on-screen countdown icon is a general cooldown indicator, not specific to spell casting, and many different cooldowns exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631740521848974)
- **opening the journal**: The Journal opens with Alt + J (a default macro) or from the top menu bar under Gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551342039713710213)
- **orc progressive spawn rare**: The rare from the orc progressive spawn is unusable orc armor that is a deco item and cannot be worn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723395968536706)
- **organizer and unidentified items**: An organizer cannot distinguish between identified and unidentified items, so the magic item recycler is the tool to use for handling unidentified magic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545792888024076288)
- **pack animal for low-level t-maps**: After the T-map update, a pack animal may be needed to carry lower-level maps, though this is not expected to be a problem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531077113887723641)
- **party chat**: Start a chat message with / to send it as a party message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544948554005483582)
- **party settings management**: To manage party settings, say [party or double click the appropriate scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545200789092442192)
- **passive boat riding for xp**: Having a friend ride along on a boat while you farm NPC ships and receive XP without actively participating is not allowed, as it counts as unattended gameplay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548371900743549061)
- **patch-driven skill meta**: Outlands receives regular patches that change which skills are strong, and because progression is easy, players can readily change skills to follow the current meta. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553439934923145439)
- **pet abandonment after logout**: Pets that are not stabled and remain out of range for 24 hours after you log out become abandoned, while stabled pets or pets with you at logout are unaffected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555304827171373177)
- **pet bonding in shelter dungeon**: Pets can be bonded in the shelter dungeon at any level, and bonded pets can be resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554291219675480147)
- **pet bonding level**: A pet bonds when it reaches level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552106185568817193)
- **pet command speech throttle**: Issuing pet commands too quickly can hit a speech throttle, causing tames to ignore them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054735243870246)
- **pet death and bonding**: An unbonded pet that dies is dead forever; getting a pet to level 1 bonds it, and a bonded pet that dies follows you as a ghost and can be resurrected by a healer or player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545005994718011484)
- **pet kills and equipment xp**: When your pets kill mobs, all equipped items that can gain XP (aspects and codices) receive an equivalent amount of XP as if you had killed them yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550561457421422615)
- **pet name spaces**: Pet names may not be allowed to contain spaces, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544286715689173132)
- **pet naming gump behavior**: When an unacceptable pet name is entered, the naming gump does not reset and only a system message appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546280144782495945)
- **pet stat needs for quests and zoology**: A pet does not need perfect stats if it is used only for a society quest or to complete its zoology entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461193195397181)
- **pet stat variation ranges**: Pet stats vary from -10% to +10% of base, except speed, which varies from -5% to +5%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555660939829841982)
- **pk name color**: A purple name is the default color for a PK (player killer) in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550257912650141788)
- **player movement speed and sight distance**: Players move about 11 tiles per second and have an 18-tile sight distance without the Tracking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **poison sting definition**: A Poison Sting is a special effect that occurs when the target is already poisoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060663112933496)
- **poison strike classification**: Poison Strike is a Necromancy spell, not an ultimate ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549955985555202069)
- **poison ticks definition**: Poison ticks are the number of times a single poison stack damages a target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060723498582037)
- **poison tier upgrade and damage**: The chance to upgrade through poison spell tiers depends on your Poisoning skill, while poison damage per tick depends on the tier achieved and your Taste Identification skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553864713262333985)
- **portal vendor locate tracking arrow**: In the portal vendor search, click 'locate vendor' to open an in-game menu that works as a tracking arrow to the vendor; it can auto-open the vendor backpack and the item will flash. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111890609668239)
- **potent spellbook function**: A Potent spellbook contains no spells itself; the character's Magery spellbook provides the castable spells, while the Potent book acts as a magical spellbook similar to a magical weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544872903609421925)
- **potion codex elixir damage reduction bonus**: With the Potion Codex, having Strength, Agility and Resist elixirs active may give a flat 7.5% damage reduction bonus, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029970463723622)
- **prevalia bank clothing rack**: The clothing rack item at the Prevalia bank on the test shard has every clothing item, including ones no longer available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547272263009828864)
- **progression xp sources**: XP in the progression systems is earned by killing monsters, stealing from monsters, or unlocking dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553773563969015949)
- **progressive spawn behavior**: A progressive spawn keeps spawning until it is killed, and once killed it can respawn after a time within a set range of hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725880972021790)
- **progressive spawn mechanics**: A progressive spawn advances steadily as its mobs are killed, and any mob in the spawn can drop the potential rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723112857083904)
- **pushing through npcs and players**: Passing over (pushing through) NPCs or players requires 100 stamina even though the push itself consumes only 10 stamina, as it has always worked in UO. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544710974756626478)
- **pvm and pvp separation**: PvM and PvP are separated in UO Outlands, and the post-skill XP progression systems apply only to PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377795255115826)
- **pvm characters account placement**: It is best practice to keep all characters you intend to progress through the PvM systems on a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545823351547633745)
- **pvm stealing requirements**: Stealing from monsters in PvM requires either enough Thief codex points for Shadow Hands or the Snooping skill; one of the two is required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550334432425283706)
- **random spawns versus progressive spawns**: Random spawns (tent spawns with a chest) are a different thing from progressive spawns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546521832285540352)
- **ranking dungeon skull in paperdoll**: The ranking dungeon skull shown in the paperdoll is a Redline Trophy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548328457946144779)
- **rare links on treasure maps**: Special rare links work on treasure maps (T-maps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551122338160836719)
- **reaching 100% with 15 links**: With 15 links, reaching 100% red line experience is likely quicker by raising two more aspects to tier 15 than by other routes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552984286343340094)
- **reapplying an aspect**: To reapply an aspect, double click the blue diamond on the book, weapon or armour; aspects do not affect clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549976783703515187)
- **recall casting vulnerability**: Casting Recall roots you in place before you disappear, giving thieves an opportunity to steal from you during the cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555626300935372910)
- **recent patch content**: Recent Outlands patches added a new Ossuary level, guild prestige changes, pit trial changes, creature facing mechanics (target arcs), and weapon setup bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545455209814167633)
- **recent patch contents**: The recent patch combined a treasure map rework with gold decay and taming changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537140410810507316)
- **recovering from being stuck while dead**: If stuck while dead, use the stuck command in Options > Help to teleport to town, visit a healer there (or find a wandering healer or healer caravan) to resurrect, then run back to recover your corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541386111193159)
- **recovering misplaced pets**: A pet that has been physically misplaced can still be recovered at a stablemaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551275959318085744)
- **recycle all magic items option**: The recycle-all-magic option recycles all magic weapons and armor in the inventory, so players should not carry anything they want to keep; it does not affect codex items such as the Wizard's Grimoire or Summoner Tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553902721785008290)
- **recycler settings with vault**: After obtaining the magic item vault, lower the recycler settings to catch more items that have multiple lower tier modifiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550061718103920691)
- **red hand and gray hand swap cooldown**: The cooldown to swap between Red Hand and Gray Hand is 24 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **red hand death restriction in nusero**: Red Hand players who die in Nusero receive a 30 minute Account Aggression Restriction; the fix is to switch to Black Hand or switch dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547598122975494227)
- **red hand dungeon re-entry restriction**: If you die inside a dungeon while a member of the Red Hand, you are temporarily restricted from re-entering that dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552569782426148915)
- **red hand notoriety when attacked**: A Red Hand player always turns Grey (but not Criminal) to any player who attacks them, even if they initially appeared Blue to that player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555309760528650411)
- **red hand thief baiting tactics**: A Red Hand thief can swap to Gray after stealing to bait an attack that allows murder counts to be given, and some Red Hand thieves bait you into attacking first so they can kill you without taking a count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **red hand thief detection chance**: For a Red Hand thief, each non-friendly player within 8 tiles reportedly increases the chance of being noticed by 10%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555312858948964383)
- **red-hand thief status duration**: The red-hand thief status lasts about 30 minutes, the same as the thief flag, though this figure is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545585344974426152)
- **redlightning bottles**: Redlightning Bottles are a late game item related to the Redline System. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552279935291359255)
- **redline aspect account requirement**: The three aspects needed to unlock redline should all be on a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547876822862135307)
- **redline aspect cap increase**: With Redline, points can be spent to raise the aspect cap, possibly up to 20, but the costs are steep for small gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **redline carry capacity**: Increasing redline increases total carry weight and item count, taking carry capacity from roughly 450 or 600 up to about 1k or 1.2k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544665457179627570)
- **redline chain cap spending**: Players invested in Redline typically spend their first points on raising the chain cap for specific link types so they can slot 15 links of the same type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **redline contribution conditions**: Activities contribute to Redline only while the aspect is in use during XP activities; crafting and harvesting wood or ingots do not contribute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550852880813264977)
- **redline farming strategy**: Farming each Redline source (wilderness, dungeons, ocean) equally earns Redline points faster than focusing on one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900889710661722)
- **redline gain xp cost**: Each redline gain costs 500k xp on the ocean, whereas it costs 1 million xp everywhere else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531369012255260723)
- **redline level xp requirement**: Each Redline level requires 1 million more XP than the previous to reach the next level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **redline progression source**: Redline progression runs off gold farmed rather than harvest XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525943826257023150)
- **redline progression system**: Redline is the ultra late game progression system, which casual players are not expected to reach for years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546756730665439303)
- **redline trophy location in achievements menu**: Redline Trophies are likely listed under the trophy category of the achievements menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548328772900495452)
- **redline xp from dungeons**: Players can cycle through all the dungeons for Redline XP, so dungeon farming rarely pushes them to higher, more expensive Redline levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **redline xp from treasure maps**: Treasure maps only grant Redline XP from the Wilderness source, so progress from tmaps is capped at wilderness points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **region lock penalty**: A region lock penalty appears in the buff bar and usually lasts 30 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550111152334307482)
- **region restrictions for red hand members**: Region Restrictions can now apply to Red Hand members on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550991244384272509)
- **registering antiquities with antiquity manifest**: To register an unregistered item as an antiquity with your name shown in its description, use an Antiquity Manifest on the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533347311365918812)
- **releasing a named follower by speech**: If a follower has a name, you can release it by saying its name followed by 'release'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680877763919902)
- **releasing a single follower via healthbar**: To release one particular follower, open the followers' healthbars, shift-click the bar of the mob you want to release, and select release. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680814526267522)
- **relog fixing missing name display**: Logging out and back in fixed a character's missing name display above its head. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544511877357379725)
- **remembering container positions**: To remember container positions, enable 'remember all containers' under Options > Interface, and keep the container open on screen when logging out and closing the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550242067656089691)
- **removing an aspect from worn gear**: To remove an aspect from worn gear, place the item into another container not on your person, or on the ground, such as a bank or inn room box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549977197786169445)
- **removing aspect from an item**: To remove the aspect from an item, drop the item on a wall; it returns to your pack without the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554130046359314535)
- **removing collected hp bars**: To get rid of collected HP bars, use Alt + right click; this can also be changed in options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554377858066030593)
- **removing item aspects**: Aspect is removed from aspected items by taking them out of your immediate possession; there is no command to unaspect many items at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548319805738590251)
- **removing mastery chain links**: Removing a link from a Mastery link chain puts that link in your backpack, so do it in a safe place. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553073275217911841)
- **renaming pets**: A pet can be renamed from its health bar, but the rename does not take effect if the chosen name is unavailable or unacceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544274636940906536)
- **render distance**: The game only renders objects within roughly 20 tiles of the player, though the exact distance is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554564143657259019)
- **reopening a closed gump**: Pressing Control+Shift brings back the gump the player had closed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552717339596685394)
- **reopening weapon/parry codex**: Create a hotkey that opens the weapon/parry codex so it can be reopened quickly after a client restart. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544819119772139571)
- **repair bench usage**: Double-clicking a repair bench, found in some player houses or shops, repairs all equipment you are wearing or carrying, provided the bench has charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552298929901674528)
- **repositioning locked gumps**: If a gump or icon is locked in place outside the book, hold Alt while moving it to reposition it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550622528991526924)
- **resetting chivalry necromancy hotbar position**: To reset the position of the chivalry/necromancy hotbar, delete its entry in the gump manager section of Options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548880498019799093)
- **resetting display scaling**: Reset display scaling in the Options video tab; a gump menu also lets you reset individual interface components. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546113877979439154)
- **resource and treasure map tome exchange**: Resource map tomes and treasure map tomes are expected to be exchangeable for any other type of tome rather than refunded, as was done for aspect tomes when added to stockpiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528242681904369774)
- **resource map change requiring cartography**: The upcoming resource map change is expected to require Cartography for harvesters and to work like treasure maps, where the map is decoded and then hiked to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531095018771714108)
- **resource map count after patch**: After the resource map patch, the number of resource maps in the world reportedly dropped because many maps were combined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544452321969311815)
- **resource map destination**: Under the new resource map system, the location a map leads to is random and not shown in advance, so players do not know where they will end up until the map is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528170505058652170)
- **resource map experience**: Completing a resource map grants harvest experience of about 1.0 XP per swing, but does not grant long-term character experience the way opening a treasure map chest does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529592541752856776)
- **resource map loading bars anti-abuse**: The new resource map system uses loading bars that prevent resource maps from being abused by stacking multiple maps in one spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544487515975590008)
- **resource map overhaul patch**: An upcoming Outlands patch will overhaul resource maps (tmaps), though the details are not yet fully final. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536179859561250866)
- **resource map skill requirements**: In the testing patch, resource maps require the specific harvesting skill (e.g. mining or lumberjacking) but not cartography, as of the current test state. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536003805374709760)
- **resource map time limit**: A 30 minute time limit applies to resource maps as well as to other maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761651649314857)
- **resource map timing**: On the test shard each resource map has a 15-second delay at the start, a 5-second hike, and another 15-second delay on top of the camp, taking about 90.5 seconds minimum with a ~40-second baseline, and Avarscale maps take roughly 2.5-3 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536063026464034846)
- **restoring closed nameplates**: Toggle the Always Active nameplate setting off and then on to bring back all closed nameplates; the toggle also works while the setting is on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532513743540344)
- **restoring closed nameplates and red menu**: If a nameplate (including your own) was closed by right click or alt+right click, toggle 'Always Active' off and on to restore all nameplates, and press Shift+Ctrl to bring back the red menu if it is gone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549670593622708345)
- **restoring nameplate gump filter**: Press Shift+Ctrl to bring the nameplate gump filter (mobiles only, pvm default, pvp default, etc.) back on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544498631003086941)
- **restylable blessed head item**: Only the leather cap can be restyled and blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549924913886793780)
- **resupply shelf auto-equip behavior**: A resupply shelf automatically equips armor or weapons in your loadout if you are not already wearing or holding some, and there is no known way to prevent this; it ignores magic armor you are wearing and still equips crafted armor from the loadout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552052733568090225)
- **retrieving abandoned pets**: If the stats gump shows 0/5 followers and no pets, visit an Animal Wrangler to try to retrieve abandoned pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554099641199497307)
- **retrieving stuck pets**: If a pet is stuck, single-click your character and choose the "pull followers" option while close to the pets to bring them to you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551309553444851825)
- **riding nightmare without taming**: A nightmare can reportedly be ridden without taming only by mounting while on an echo that grants taming and then switching to an echo without it, and after dying or dismounting you cannot remount without the taming echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554193944621879359)
- **rune tome transcribers**: Rune tome transcribers appear to have a single use each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553223022419386524)
- **runetome capacity**: A runetome holds runes on two pages for roughly 16 runes total, though the exact count is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547579217397416057)
- **running a treasure map**: To run a treasure map in the new system, decode the map with Cartography and hike to the spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538222289735262218)
- **sacred journey buff range**: To keep the Chivalry Sacred Journey buff, you must stay within 50 tiles of the character who made the gate, not of the marked location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545442708653613156)
- **sanctuary dungeon penalty**: Sanctuary dungeons cost roughly 34% of gold, XP and loot in exchange for the added safety. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159246869733460)
- **sanctuary dungeon rules**: In sanctuary dungeons criminal actions are not allowed, so you cannot be robbed or killed, and a blue corpse (the first 15 minutes) cannot be looted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553355285454917726)
- **sanctuary reset countdown command**: Typing [jobs shows the countdown to the Sanctuary dungeon reset in the lower left of the window; per a later report, the countdown is also visible via quests on the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551356547441893468)
- **saving gump window positions**: To save window positions, open Options > Gump Manager and hover over the ? in the bottom right for instructions; not every gump can be pinned, and pinnable gumps show a red pin when the correct keys are held. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550242067656089691)
- **saving necromancer hotbar**: To keep the necromancer hotbar on screen after logging out and back in, type the command -savenecrobar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987543602372660)
- **saving necromancer hotbar manually**: The necromancer hotbar position can also be saved manually through Options > Gump Manager. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987629111906386)
- **seasonal mining trophies**: Seasonal mining trophies are awarded to the top miners each season, with a number 1 mining trophy for the winner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544811915346448384)
- **separate characters for red-hand thieves and pks**: Players who want red-hand thieves, PKs and similar characters have reasons to create additional separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **server rank command**: Typing [serverrank in game opens the server leaderboard lists, which show how you rank against other players doing the same activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537860475864490065)
- **server rankings season length**: A Server Rankings season lasts 90 days, after which it resets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545419543583658014)
- **setting a loot bag**: Set a loot bag in the grid loot settings (or via an in-game macro) so looted items go into a specific container such as a trap pouch or lock box; if no loot bag is set, all loot goes into your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551916238433820763)
- **setting traps while hidden**: A trap can be set while hidden, but triggering it reveals you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549712911725891665)
- **shadow aspect effects**: The Shadow aspect grants extra stealth steps and a chance to heal on step while stealthed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416592528216135)
- **shared mastery chain and redline progress**: Mastery Chain and Redline progress are shared across all characters on the same account, so PvM characters should be kept on the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589345241600153)
- **ship control and boarding**: You can only control your own ship, but you can board and sink other ships, whether player or NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555047436853182597)
- **ship pvp overflow into pvm**: One player believes ship PvP would not overflow into PvM, contrary to what they think the developers fear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521678441211236452)
- **ships and crew**: Ships are needed to sail the ocean and boat crew provide support and bonuses; crew are similar to tamer followers and have stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668459941666817)
- **showing hidden name**: To show your name again after hiding it, toggle the 'always active' setting; otherwise hold Control+Shift to show it if it isn't set to stay open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555216976941555772)
- **single aspect leveling**: Using one aspect on both armor and weapon levels that aspect up twice as fast, and a second aspect can be leveled later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554563325155606591)
- **skill cooldown display setting**: The skill cooldown display is controlled by the 'Show cooldown gump' option in the Cooldowns general settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546012974458601512)
- **snoop red hand requirement**: Snooping already requires Red Hand membership. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925952552083518)
- **society crafting upgrade points**: Buying two society crafting enhancements gives 2 more and then 3 more weekly society points on an account, totaling 5 more per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546354220133912706)
- **society job rewards**: Society jobs earn points that can be spent on rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008959333408830)
- **society job selection**: Once progressed, players should skip monster hunter society jobs except bosses, mini bosses and omni bosses and do crafting society jobs otherwise; completing every society job each week is not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544315732450349126)
- **society job tracking**: Society jobs are tracked per account rather than per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545404266615930970)
- **society npc point strategy**: Focusing society tasks on one NPC early accrues points faster toward strongboxes, while taking the best-paying jobs across NPCs yields more points per week but takes longer to unlock high-end rewards from any single NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554884784327491676)
- **society points scope**: Society points are account-wide, so crafters should be kept on the main account to benefit from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550998601310670881)
- **society quest slots for crafting**: Society quest slots can be used for crafting societies instead of dungeon society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476108003582023)
- **society quests**: Society quests are taken from the society NPCs at the society house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553763068410994719)
- **society reset timing**: Societies reset at the same time that the bonuses change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545610359682105444)
- **society rewards**: Societies are not mandatory, but they reward points that can be redeemed for valuable rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553762330733707376)
- **sources of character strength**: Gear gives only a moderate improvement; most character strength comes from leveling the post-skill XP systems, with codices first and aspects next. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548766657445625877)
- **special rare loot link limit**: A character can reportedly have 20 special rare/loot links, or 25 with redline, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545441215502090271)
- **speech color and title color**: Changing your speech color also changes your in-game title color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547247713811308604)
- **spell aspect chance from links**: Spell aspect chance from links is a percentage increase applied to your current chance, not a directly additive bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552444862014427307)
- **spell checkmark auto recast**: The checkmark on a spell in the UI recasts that spell automatically on cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550021004808556555)
- **spell icon hotkey assignment**: Go to Options -> Combat Spells, scroll to the Spells section, check "Enable Fast Spells Assign (Ctrl + Alt)", then hold Ctrl+Alt and click a spell icon to create a macro for that spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546565549281116260)
- **spell interruption chance from damage**: Players have a chance equal to Effective Inscription Skill divided by 100% to avoid spell interruption from creature or environment damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554945852319993897)
- **spell mana cost**: Spells require mana whether cast from scrolls, reagents, or a spell stone, and there is a chance of a mana refund depending on skills and equipment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554520430025515120)
- **spell scroll cooldown**: There is no cooldown on using spell scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554514401128620045)
- **spell scroll mechanics**: Spell scrolls add +20 Magery solely to raise spellcast success chance, which is irrelevant at 100% success, they are often cheaper than reagents, and they can be refunded for extra uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546721540186574919)
- **spellcasting stone depletion**: Once a spellcasting stone's charges are used up, you must cast using reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552295089886466049)
- **stacking pouches against thieves**: Stack several pouches in a corner of the inventory and keep valuables in the bottom one so thieves must dig through the pile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555623750202957941)
- **stamina loss from tripping over players**: Tripping over other players causes a loss of stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552450084409712722)
- **starfall meteorite library quest**: The Starfall meteorite is part of a library quest that requires collecting one of a handful of collectible items plus one tag on a Starfall kill, rather than the cadellite ore drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546974419069702144)
- **stats command usefulness**: The [stats command is only reliable for checking equipment durability and is not useful for other information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544102794343219300)
- **stats display reliability**: The stats display is broken and should not be relied upon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502214280675401)
- **stats window reliability**: The [stats window is unreliable except for its durability information, so Outlands Butler should be used for accurate calculations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891223871430706)
- **stealing carried items**: Thieves can steal items a player is carrying, such as a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143064562368603)
- **stealth and running**: Stealthed characters cannot run, so stealthed thieves are limited to walking speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555625900907692165)
- **step after 30 links**: After reaching 30 links, the next step is redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553172121486631129)
- **strength and hit points**: A character's strength stat determines their hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784865437261865)
- **strength potion duration with potions codex**: With the potions codex, a strength potion can have a 30 minute duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475592441925726)
- **summon hue dyeing**: On the live shard only non-necro summons can reportedly be dyed via spell hue, while on the test shard the purple statue can change creature hues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546356450073247804)
- **summon type points**: Players eventually unlock 20 points for each summon type, which can be spent on that summon type's page and can be reset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553463068141420587)
- **summoner codex strength**: Summoner strength likely comes in large part from points in the summoner codex, similar to the tamer codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553522893269237893)
- **summoner's tome**: A summoner's tome lets a player individually spec each summon, including its strength, damage, and summon duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149447315624108)
- **summoning during map decode**: Summoning elementals while a map is decoding does not interrupt the decode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536900154655907880)
- **t8 map creation requirement**: Creating T8 maps requires making a lore book from research materials, as described in the Lore System. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552960676165587034)
- **target health bar display option**: To control the small health bar under your target, open game options, choose General, scroll down to Mobiles, and use the first checkbox, which offers Percentage or Both display modes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551643360987586653)
- **targeting indicator**: A targeting indicator showing your current beneficial, neutral and hostile targets can be enabled through the menu bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548403044692271117)
