- **taste identification and food satisfaction**: Effective Taste Identification, including from aspect armor, counts toward food satisfaction unless Cooking is higher, in which case Cooking is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549151272538607627)
- **test shard chest experience**: On the test shard, players currently get no experience from treasure chests, which is an error rather than intended behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528469891798138940)
- **test shard codex presence check**: On the Test shard, codex experience does not check for the presence of the codex to reduce server load, and this is not supposed to be the case on live. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551298709214466162)
- **theft history**: To see what was stolen from you, visit a Thief NPC and choose the 'Theft History' option, which costs 1000 gold each time you have new thefts to check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551595907114336257)
- **theft notification coordinates**: The theft notification message includes the coordinates of where the theft occurred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175111466160159)
- **thief guild and grey hand**: You are not automatically a thief; you must join the thief guild as a grey hand, and being able to steal from monsters means you have already joined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549997424502775849)
- **thief safety in towns**: No town in Outlands is completely safe from thieves; thieves in towns have a chance of being guard-whacked, so players should act accordingly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039539869384815)
- **thief target selection**: Thieves often move on to an easier target when they see nothing valuable in the first bag they open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555624187668987986)
- **thieves in towns and dungeons**: Every town has thieves, and thieves are also found in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551168336354607166)
- **thieves stealing in towns**: Thieves can steal from players in towns, including at the Prevalia bank, so players should be careful with valuables carried in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553074847582785698)
- **thirst in stranglelands**: A player can die of thirst in Stranglelands even while still carrying water, so thirst must be actively managed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899257352167525)
- **tier 10 aspect default color**: Once an aspect reaches tier 10, you can select its color as the default regardless of which aspect you apply, but only if you have bought the corresponding customizations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549976325463343126)
- **tier 20 aspect progression**: Reaching Tier 20 Aspect via the Redline system takes many years, and the Time Dungeon is the difficult end-game dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560732073431045)
- **tier 4 chest lockpick time**: Lockpicking a tier 4 treasure map chest takes about 30 seconds under the current system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528245867600023594)
- **time rare items double click looting**: Items from the Time rare content, including marks and other time items, cannot be double-click looted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293816041873431)
- **tmap cartography buff**: The new tmap system gives a Cartography buff that is active while you take part in the dig, and you can move around instead of being stuck in one spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532108502741291029)
- **trammel-like safe zone**: Outside Sanctuary dungeon and Shelter Island, a Trammel-like safe zone is not expected to be added to Outlands, though this is one player's opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550757732376649779)
- **trapped boxes for murder counts**: A tinker can leave trapped boxes around so that other players who trigger them generate murder counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545146130692706405)
- **trapped pouch and boom box**: A trapped pouch alerts you when a thief opens it, and a boom box kills a thief who tries to open it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555623483617181827)
- **trapped pouch as theft alert**: Carrying a trapped pouch to put items into acts as an alert against thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145149068812379)
- **travel pack item**: The Travel Pack item is likely just a blessed wig stand, purely cosmetic, and cannot be used to log out inside dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546976702180237406)
- **traveller's lantern and day/night cycle**: The Traveller's Lantern is blessed and emits light, and the game now has a day/night cycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595798928597052)
- **treasure map automap requirement**: After the recent patch, treasure maps no longer require the Lot Goblin automap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544022144348983299)
- **treasure map decode timer**: After the patch, a 1 hour timer starts when a treasure map is decoded (not when the chest is revealed), and the map is deleted if not completed in that time, removing the option to choose when to dig. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **treasure map harvest xp recipient**: After the treasure map changes, the chest opens on boss death, so the cartographer in charge of the map likely gets the harvest XP instead of a lockpicker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528609095983169616)
- **treasure map hiking**: In the new treasure map system you can hike directly to the map area without looking up different maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528540300379816107)
- **treasure map location danger**: Hiking to a treasure map location can put you in a dangerous spot, so be ready to run immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212956126191678)
- **treasure map lockpicking**: Treasure map lockpicking is being sunset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534344821882355792)
- **treasure map loot scalar**: Treasure maps have a 4x loot scalar, so a T-map chest holding 5000 gold gives the same loot chance as killing 20,000 gold worth of regular monsters; the chest is dug up, guardian mobs spawn, and you kill them before looting it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554864241540866139)
- **treasure map navigation**: After traveling to a treasure map location, an arrow to the chest appears, and players can use the world map, mini map and radar to navigate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554608831831609436)
- **treasure map on-demand generation**: Under the treasure map changes, maps are generated on demand, so a treasure map should not send a player to a spot where another player's chest is already present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528189726677274817)
- **treasure map overhaul limits**: After the treasure map overhaul, regular treasure maps use loading bars and Outlands limits each account to one treasure map at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537843990458794094)
- **treasure map patch changes**: The treasure map patch increased boss HP and made treasure maps take longer to complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **treasure map time limit**: A recent patch introduced a 30 minute time limit for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542362931088597064)
- **treasure mapper and ore map restriction**: A character turned into a treasure mapper cannot run an ore map, because the five map types are reportedly combined into a single account-wide locked activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535495384023961691)
- **trees disappearing near player**: If trees disappear when you get close, turn off the 'CircleTrans' (Circle of Transparency) button at the bottom of the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660980101775403)
- **two-handed weapon with shield codex**: A two-handed weapon can be used without a shield while using the shield codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555277220396798025)
- **unidentified magic item modifiers**: Looted magic items are unidentified and their modifiers are revealed only once identified; the Modifiers wiki page shows the bonuses of the revealed mods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724390277947423)
- **unlocking an aspect**: To unlock an aspect, you need 4 cores, 2 distillations and an aspect kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553885369739772045)
- **unlocking an echo with essence**: To unlock an Echo, put the essence in your bank; it is consumed when the echo is unlocked, though another player suggests it may also be held in the Aspect gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554538914893529129)
- **unlocking customisations**: Open Help and choose customisations, or type [customisations in game, to see where account customisations are unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554885937606168768)
- **unopened corpse name marker**: Unopened corpses have a * at the beginning of their name, which can be used to filter for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495657593675838)
- **untouched corpse message**: When no one has looted a corpse, a system message indicates that the body is untouched. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549686252251512903)
- **upcoming expansion**: An expansion with a new landmass, new dungeons, and new skills is reportedly in development for UO Outlands, expected around spring next year, though some think it may arrive later this year. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379463757496340)
- **used mastery chain binding**: A used mastery chain displays "(bound to `player name`)" in its description, showing it is bound to the player who used it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546616770583072799)
- **using an alt to escape pvp combat**: Having an alt open an escape gate during active PvP combat is against the rules; the only loophole is to do it before combat starts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552734028921180222)
- **using two characters in pvp**: Using a second character to loot or act while another character is engaged in PvP is reportedly against the rules. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535278797455233134)
- **using two characters on treasure map chest**: Two different characters can be used on a treasure map chest as long as only one of them deals damage to the mobs; if both characters are engaged in combat, both will do only 1 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546210832138903652)
- **vanishing loot when looting corpses quickly**: Loot that vanishes when looting a corpse too fast is caused by the object delay queue, which shows the item as taken before it lands in the bag; with the queue off, fast looting just moves the item to the end of the corpse list and no relog is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546856726991474789)
- **viewing aspect details**: To view aspect details, type [aspects in chat or double-click the pentagram at the top of the paperdoll, then choose 'aspect details' instead of 'aspect overview'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **visibility of blue player footsteps**: Footsteps of blue (non-criminal) players appear not to be visible on this shard; only some mobs' footsteps were seen in a test. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533085328808874157)
- **void aspect and spell ignore links**: Void aspect and spell ignore links are likely two separate rolls, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555049904274022503)
- **war mode and attacking**: Double-click attacking requires war mode, but with hotkeys for cycling targets and initiating combat you never need war mode, except as a ghost wanting to be visible to others for resurrection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552686714336583793)
- **water aspect for tamers**: The Water Aspect is decent for Tamers and cheaper than the Command Aspect, though weaker than Command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549742094736687115)
- **weapon and parry codex resets**: Weapon and parry codexes have no point limits, so they cannot be reset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551007909322956821)
- **weapon codex active slots**: Only one stance, one finisher and one ability from a weapon codex can be active at any one time, but they can be swapped freely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547617981633273896)
- **weapon codex cap**: Weapon codexes, such as the archery codex, have no points cap and can be filled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005554403844137)
- **weapon codex leveling**: All options in a weapon codex can eventually be leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547618030798905344)
- **weapon codex upgrade unlocks**: A weapon codex can be completely filled to unlock everything, and once an upgrade is unlocked it stays permanently unlocked for any codex of the same weapon type, even if you are not carrying it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008359426035713)
- **weapon setup bonus**: Weapon Setup Bonus grants bonuses against creatures based on the weapons and shields in your hands, shown as (Setup) on the stats page, and applies only to non-blessed weapons and spell books. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546329153840742471)
- **weapon xp with harvest aspect on armor**: With the Harvest aspect on your armor and another aspect on your weapon, killing mobs gives 50% weapon XP toward the weapon aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **weapons codex finisher leveling**: With a weapons codex, each stance that reaches level 5 raises your finisher by one level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546257402410565633)
- **weekly buffs and dungeon activity**: The weekly buffs determine which dungeons are busy; a dungeon with the weekly experience buff is crowded all week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554365848137760769)
- **weekly safe dungeon**: Each week one dungeon is designated safe; there experience gain and gold loot are reduced by 33%, but it is a safe place to learn or farm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274245646983309)
- **weekly society contracts limit**: By default a player has 10 society contracts per week, which can be spread across NPCs such as armorers, monster hunter and artificer; the Social Network (500k gold) and High Society (750k gold) account customisations raise this to 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554883811760676896)
- **wilderness and crafting society quests**: Wilderness society quests exist, and crafting society quests can be completed while AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474961176006827)
- **wilderness bar capping methods**: Gold is a good option for quickly capping the wilderness bar and pushing bosses, while treasure maps already cap the wilderness bar daily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539274710834086038)
- **witcher tome set size**: A full witcher tome set is roughly 15-16 tomes, though this is an uncertain estimate based on one player's partially complete set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553223022419386524)
- **wizards grimoire codex caps**: The Wizards Grimoire is a codex like the Summoner's Tome; its upgrades cap at about 40 points while other codices cap at 20, and it adds conveniences like mushrooms and increased offensive spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583565617365126)
- **xp eligibility threshold**: Experience from a monster is proportional to damage dealt, and a player must deal 5% of the monster's health or 1000 damage, whichever is smaller, to receive XP; this figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547412010642313286)

## Other

- **beta client bug reporting**: Players who find bugs or issues in the Outlands beta client test patch should report them in the #beta-client-feedback channel. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **bastet harvester killer**: Bastet is a player who hunts harvesters and will kill them again after they resurrect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549716312295481416)
- **changing skills on the test shard**: On the test shard, double-click the green statue at the main previous bank, then use 'set values' and 'apply all stats and values' to change skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528540806485639299)
- **cosmetic test server**: A test server is available where players can try cosmetic outfits before buying them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601909869977712)
- **guild tag color change**: To change guild tag color, change your speech color, then move and speak to apply it, then click your character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547442184457035796)
- **mage shop staves**: The different staves sold in the mage shop differ only in appearance, not in function. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586245045452942)
- **wiki event and merchant item lists**: The Outlands wiki lists all events and their Prevalian Merchant items in Category:Prevalian_Merchant and Category:Events, but these pages do not list prices. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544075471514509442)
- **!portal bot command**: The !portal bot command only returns a search link and reportedly accepts up to 5 search terms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554012981967200309)
- **ability hotbar position storage**: The ability hotbar position can be stored between sessions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548019583682609172)
- **ai tools reliability**: AI tools are very often wrong about Outlands information, so their answers should be verified against official sources or experienced players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545629133592207370)
- **boat choice for fishing build**: A medium boat or a speed-capped large boat with good stats are both viable choices for a fishing build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521687029019181137)
- **brigands faction protection offer**: The Brigands (BRG) faction offers newcomers who buy a caravan in their territory an offer of protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536942959378038836)
- **collector bar for grey health bars**: A collector bar can be set up in the options so that it only picks up grey health bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546255933091352626)
- **community settings finder tool**: A community Settings Finder tool at harald.ist.org helps locate specific options in the many Outlands dialogs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546042742155513858)
- **copying chat text**: There is no known way to copy in-game chat to the clipboard; the way to get chat text is to close the game session and pull it from the log files. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551955624533696554)
- **damage tracker as timer**: The Damage Tracker window updates every few seconds even when minimized, so it can be used as a rough timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522218407553011907)
- **faction discord invite**: A faction officer in your guild can invite you to the faction Discord. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546964435757830246)
- **fairy wings item**: Fairy Wings are a decoration or outfit item on Outlands that is marked 'not for sale'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536454198135103588)
- **guild recruitment faction posting**: Guilds do not post their faction in the guild recruitment channel, but members can be sought by looking at guild tags. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546896878870728744)
- **h'trok harvesting leaderboard rank**: Leechy holds the number one rank on the server's H'trok harvesting leaderboards by a large margin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537205608464392323)
- **hair dye scope**: A hair color dye applies only to the single character that uses it, not to every character on the account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546592855349264457)
- **hiding aspect color on helmet slot items**: To stop helmet slot items from showing the aspect color, open the aspect menu and click on hues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549585356532351028)
- **hiding other players' pet health bars**: There is no known option to hide the health bars of other players' pets; if one exists, it would most likely be under Options > Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546253156206252152)
- **hiding the buff gump**: To remove the buff gump, go to Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Display buff icons on health bars for > Yourself, which lets you hide the actual buff gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545621103689601084)
- **jakesh fancy satchel**: Jakesh sells a fancy satchel that does not hold reagents and can be worn as part of an outfit's appearance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545490253609967667)
- **leaving a poker game**: To leave a poker game, click the Leave Game button at the bottom right of the poker window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548426369506087133)
- **loot lists availability**: The official Outlands wiki has a Loot page, but full actual loot lists are probably not available unless a player has compiled them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531675511112073226)
- **lyceum quests content and rewards**: Lyceum quests in Outlands include lore content, some ties to Time Dungeon, and reward decoration items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525527648111956128)
- **messages in a bottle**: Messages in a bottle work similarly to treasure maps (tmaps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551669132234199103)
- **mib collection batch size**: It is suggested to collect 100 or more MIBs before going after them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555558107189485700)
- **mount tack for bears**: Mount tack cannot be obtained for bears, though this is stated tentatively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538275776200314901)
- **october event**: The server has an October event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554201782148800605)
- **old map system leechy throughput**: Under the old map system, one player (Leechy) completed over 100 maps per hour running 3 clients and sorted 256,923 maps by hand without third-party tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544873018822754436)
- **outlands butler mib tools**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com) offers tools for MIBs, including an SOS clustering tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555543150473384049)
- **outlands butler tool**: Outlands Butler is a community tool that helps make shelf loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550446214363873300)
- **outlands butler versus explore outlands**: Outlands Butler is updated more frequently than Explore Outlands, so players commonly use it instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547556944405991475)
- **outlands drip paperdoll tool**: Outlands Drip (outlandsdrip.com) is a tool for designing character paperdolls, and players can import their own paperdoll into it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547272471009300570)
- **outlands wiki gathering pages**: The Outlands wiki has a Gathering Templates page and a Skill Synergies page, and the gatherer template lists 7 skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546774825627025488)
- **outlands wiki stealing page**: The Outlands wiki Stealing page documents the full stealing mechanics, including detection, under its 'being noticed' section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143748342980699)
- **outlandsdrip hair preview tool**: The outlandsdrip.com tool has a hair option where you pick the hair and then the hue, which makes previewing colors easier than clicking left and right at the in-game stylist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544614718004666448)
- **patcher downtime**: Patcher downtime is typically about 5 minutes, and extended downtime is usually announced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554201654713127085)
- **peg leg dyeability**: The peg leg may not be dyeable, since a clothing alteration kit reports 'That clothing item cannot have its hue altered'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553869310336704633)
- **pegleg item color change**: A clothing alteration kit is likely the tool that changes the color of the Pegleg item, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550314129854566401)
- **pilfering and mugging reference**: Pilfering and Mugging are covered in the Thieves Codex on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479722914807901)
- **player population by weekday**: Outlands generally has more players on Fridays than Thursdays, so the wilderness tends to feel busier on Fridays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535347064479940620)
- **robes over armor**: A robe can be worn over armor, so a blessed robe covers the armor's appearance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550988305531666473)
- **roleplay on outlands**: Outlands is not a roleplay server itself, but roleplay guilds exist, and Discord has a recruiting channel and a roleplay channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929437399584790)
- **server location**: The UO Outlands servers are located in North America. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551218411399282771)
- **server player count cap**: The server's online player count can reach up to about 3500. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547545732565958686)
- **showing hp on health bars**: Enable Options > General > Mobiles > Show HP to display HP on health bars; it appears only as a line or percentage, and there is no specific numeric option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546254132287897761)
- **shrinking friendly pet size**: To display friendly non-human mobiles such as pets at a smaller size, enable Options > General > Mobiles > Limit friendly non-humans mobile size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546252547940028416)
- **stylist skin hue preview**: The stylist NPC shows a preview of skin hue colors before you choose one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549231294985011300)
- **test center guide**: A Test Center Guide for the Outlands test shard is posted on the official Outlands forums. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824768224628867)
- **treasure map overhaul status**: A treasure map overhaul has reportedly been in development for about 3 years and is on the back burner, with no release date known. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525963058772447292)
- **typical player population**: UO Outlands typically has around 3,000 players online, fluctuating between roughly 2.8k and 3.4k, with spikes during events or major announcements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547376343166230579)
- **wiki lockpicking chart omission**: The Outlands wiki lockpicking chart omits the +5 bonus for mastercrafted lockpicks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523511017236201686)
- **zucchini event seeds**: Zucchini event seeds are believed to be usable only for the zucchini event, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551222823383466085)
